In 1991, a sheltered teenage boy comes of age during a wild summer he spends on Cape Cod getting rich from selling pot to gangsters, falling in love for the first time, partying and eventually realizing that he is in over his head.

A group of outcasts known as the Pariah have been tasked with vanquishing these demons back to the fiery gates of Hell. As some of the Pariah give into temptation, the distinction between good and evil becomes blurred.
A combat veteran, with serious psychological damage, stalks campers and hunters in the woods.
In Washington, D.C., a reporter faces a possible jail sentence for outing a CIA agent and refusing to reveal her source.

movie_name: Dos nacos en el planeta de las mujeres
synopsis: Try out some frightfully fun movie and television titles to keep you up at night.

Features five French romance and love story shorts, produced and directed by the new generation of Gallic cinema: Gratte-Papier; La Petite Flamme; L'Armée du Bonheur; 40 mg d'Amour par Jour; and Entre Parenthèses.
Animated version of Charlie Chaplin's 'The Kid' set in a futuristic New York City.

A multiple homicide at a luxury villa in Malibu sets two detectives down a harrowing path of truth about a young girl who was brutally bullied her entire life, while discovering another woman has taken up revenge.

An inventor of robotics technology is robbed by his girlfriend and business partner and sent to the future via cryogenic sleep. But when he awakes 30 years later, he is assisted by a humanoid robot originally his own creation.
A beautiful mistress lures a NY detective into the future to solve a murder, but doesn't know not only did she do it, but he is now her pry.

A couple move from the city to a perfect country village to give their peculiar young daughter a new start, only to realise they have been lured there for their daughter's secret; they fight to save the family from the mystical cult.

Intersecting scenes thru the seasons in the Wuppertal area in which performers appear in cafes, flower shops and pools and traverse streets, fields and forests, accompanied by folk songs and popular music.
Two young robbers meet an old man. The three start traveling together, looking for the same thing.
Two young scientists are swept up in a government plot to suppress the truth about a biological disaster at a genetic research facility.
A Thai youth football team is trapped in a cave while rescue workers scramble to save them.
A priest recovering from the death of his mother is targeted by a mysterious cult.
Danny Cruff returns home years after his father was wrongly accused and hanged for murder. But he can't escape his past.
Two sisters vacationing in Mexico are trapped in a shark cage at the bottom of the ocean. With less than an hour of oxygen left and great white sharks circling nearby, they must fight to survive.

A statue of Venus with a human mind falls in love with a statue of David. Eros jealously controls the sculptor's mind to destroy her. Libera's songs and Tempei's piano lead the story in a poetic way. Libera play the Angels to comfort her.
When a series of unusual murders occurs, Detective K (KIM Myung-min) and his partner (OH Dal-soo) are once again called into action as they discover a trail of bodies with mysterious bite marks.
Shortly before his execution on the death row in San Quentin, amateur sleuth and baby photographer Ronnie Jackson, tells reporters how he got there.
After being falsely imprisoned Ryan looks up his old girlfriend Carla who set him up. Carla is now married to Vincent who is Ryan's old nemesis and old vendettas resurface.
A desperate con artist convinces two fools into a get rich quick scheme.
English feature film. a group of original six short movies, with a variety of style and presentation. featuring exciting artistic elements comprised of drama, horror, Sci-fi, mystery and crime.
Inspired by real events and people, 21 is about six MIT students who become trained to be experts in card counting in Black Jack and subsequently took Vegas casinos for millions in winnings.
A down on his luck street magician and his con artist ex-wife reunite to swindle an accounting firm.
High stakes battle of wits and morals between gentlemen crooks, set in beautiful Portugal. A smuggler is hired to kidnap the rich husband of an American woman who's just arrived in Lisbon, Portugal.
A governess unmasks her employer as the leader of a gang of thieves.
A cop goes undercover in a South Carolina high school. With the help of a local narcotics officer, he investigates the drug ring responsible for another cop's death.
A cleric's son saves a maid from suicide and she saves him when he is framed for killing a crook's mistress.
Cosmo Academy has set a test for ten of its applicants to survive on a spaceship for 2 months. But there is an eleventh member aboard.
The captain of an Antarctic whaling ship falls overboard in mysterious circumstances and his daughter, aided by a sympathetic American, decides to investigate the accident.
A family fights to survive as the streets of Paris fill with a deadly gas.
THE VISION FOR A BETTER SOCIETY OUTLIVES THE MAN WHO PASSIONATELY FOUGHT FOR IT IN HIS LIFE TIME.
A young slacker circumstantially gets involved in the smuggling of falsified English pounds via Trieste-Yugoslavia route. He helps the police to solve the case.
Two rival newsreel photographers join forces to find an aviatrix's missing brother, who has disappeared in the Amazon rainforest.
A freak storm unleashes a species of bloodthirsty creatures on a small town, where a small band of citizens hole up in a supermarket and fight for their lives.

Liyla Litvak is the most decorated female fighter pilot of all time as a fighter ace in World War II. She shot down 12 German planes for the Soviet Union, garnering her the name "The White Rose" of Stalingrad and ace of The Night Witches.
A grisly unsolved murder links three seemingly unrelated stories in three different Japanese cities.
Five movie buffs racing against time, trying to save the only theatre in the village from being locked down.
A teenage boy panics and takes hostages when he thinks he's committed murder.
Inhaling a hallucinogenic drug can give the impression that the woman looks exactly like his ex-wife, but Paul discovers the scam and tries to rescue the kidnapped woman.
A feral demon is going to come from the hell.
After his girlfriend is kidnapped by a satanic trio of escaped mental patients, a young man must rescue her from a Hollywood home before their sadistic plans can be realized.
In Africa an explorer is the reincarnated lover of the 2,000-year-old White Queen.
During an intense hostage situation, an ex-con comes face to face with the father of the boy he accidentally killed.
When a man's wife dies, the new executive of his company makes a move. Though they know that sexual relations could cause problems, that does not stop them.
Based on the SEGA video game title.

After a run-in with the law, an angry maladjusted young man starts calling himself "Hate". One night he saves a girl from a lusty Assistant District Attorney. He falsely accuses them of robbery, so they go on the run and make things worse.
Xiaofei is going out with his school friends on a Enviroment protection in the nature. But after they fall a sleep by rain drops they turn back in time 40 years and learn lessons of nature.
Psychological drama-thriller about a man attempting to come to terms with a diagnosis of Schizophrenia.
Two friends, playing paintball in anomalous zone nearby Chisinau, suddenly meet Fat-Frumos - hero of Moldavian folklore. He is lost in time and tries to find way home.
About a group of three friends that choose to rob the neighborhood drug dealer to make some fast money.
In the early Showa period (1926-1989) in Japan, detective Mamiya Mugen solves weird cases.
While struggling to fight the darkness that grows inside himself, Link must find the hero within, in order to bring peace to Hyrule.

Based on the acclaimed DC/Vertigo graphic novel. In a surreal fantasy world, Blood must battle monsters, depraved humans and his own raging bloodlust as he seeks a lost temple which may hold the key to his and humanity's salvation.
Two young women on the lam for a murder they didn't commit become lovers, and Detroit's Most Wanted.
A look into the inequities of the ghosts of society through three interwoven french new wave styled vignettes by three different visual and literary artists.
December 1926, Agatha Christie's husband asks for a divorce. She leaves her car and goes missing 11 days. She books into a hotel as Mrs. Neele. Fiction: A US reporter looks for her and investigates.

Andrea the son of Anita and Tristano killed himself on Christmas night. Tristan betrays his wife with Anna, Andrea's ex-girlfriend, who is later killed. A crescendo of tension as Anita listens to the switchboard phone .
In London during World War One, a simple-minded slavey awaits her Fairy Godmother and her Prince Charming.
A strange missile from outer space circles the Earth at low altitudes, destroying everything in its path.
Set in the Basque region, a story of the rivalry of two families, period 1870-1935
In November 2009, French security van driver Toni Musulin makes off with nearly 12 million euros, then turns himself over to the authorities a week later.
A conference about the forgotten painter Augustin Desombres, who mysteriously disappeared on the high plateaus of Aubrac.
The struggle of Ravi, an IPS aspirant who has to travel beyond imagination through time to stop a criminal mastermind, save his loved ones and his beloved town
A bleak-sounding future, where an AI soldier has determined that the only way to end war is to end humanity.
Is set against a backdrop of simmering racial tension in a remote Australian outback town.

Rick has always been in love his friend Lisa, and in another universe Lisa has always been in love with her friend Rick. A connection is made across these universes; Rick and Lisa vow to help each other win the hearts of their counterparts
An update to the 1996 film 'Twister', which centered on a pair of storm chasers who risk their lives in an attempt to test an experimental weather alert system.
Following a deadly viral outbreak, private military soldier Max Gatling leads a handful of survivors and a ragtag band of robots against an army of the infected.
A housemaid falls in love with Dr. Henry Jekyll and his darkly mysterious counterpart, Mr. Edward Hyde.

Three children accidentally get turned into fish after drinking a potion made by an eccentric scientist. When the kids end up in the sea, they must find the antidote within 48 hours or remain as fish forever.
A Turkish comedy film starring Ersin Korkut as a servant for a well-to-do family visited by legendary bloodsucker Count Dracoola.
Plaid-skirted schoolgirls are groomed by a secret government agency to become the newest members of the elite national-defense group, D.E.B.S.
DANGER DIVA is a cyberpunk musical/thriller about a hard rocking singer who is coerced into becoming an electronically enhanced new-music diva by her high tech billionaire patron.

Traumatized as a child, an awkward yet brilliant designer of surveillance gear obsessively chronicles his life using his own inventions, but when he unwittingly records something he shouldn't, he becomes the target of a deadly conspiracy.
In what was supposed to be a rendezvous, a group of vampires get trapped in a deadly house with no escape.
A farmer in space met with many difficulties he must overcome.
The curtain is pulled back on the millennia-old battle between the organizations of good luck and bad luck that secretly affects everyday lives.
Quarantining on a deserted barrier island, a gay couple is pushed to the brink by a strange disappearance and the arrival of three visitors - one with a secret that might ruin them all.
Crime thriller based on a short story by Jo Nesbo.
In Sicily, a blinded revolutionary escapes execution when his Manx half-brother takes his place.
A man steals from the rich in order to have enough money to travel back in time to save his family.

A geneticist takes his assistants to his old family home to locate the deadly product of his late mother's revolutionary research into rapid human evolution - his monstrous tentacled baby brother - before a mad scientist gets to him first.
Two women abduct an alt-right online troll in an act of vengeance but it doesn't go to plan.
A group of criminals commit several simultaneous robberies in different casinos.
Doctors Scott and Bach inject the dying Kyra Zelas with a formula which saves her life - but also renders her almost immortal and wickedly evil.
An Indian adaptation of Jane Austen's "Sense and Sensibility" focusing on two sisters of opposing temperaments.

movie_name: The Peppercorns and the Secret of the Deep Sea
synopsis: An unbeatable team of five teenage friends, the Peppercorns, unites to find out who is behind the kidnapping of a missing oceanographer who has discovered a means of getting rid of plastic waste in the ocean.

A bright young detective's life is redefined when she adopts the son of a murder victim whose killer she guns down in the line of duty. Fifteen years later, the killer's brother is released from prison and seeks revenge.
Jack Wilson has returned with the help of the Siren to take down Christopher Chance and his team.
A 10-year-old boy faces off against his bullies.
A Thai veteran of the Vietnam War and all around master of combat leads a group of men on a daring mission into the jungles of Vietnam to topple a dangerous drug lord and his cannibal army.
A sci-fi conspiracy thriller, based on real phone messages and testimonials from victims of mind control technology.

Following the death of their son, boomers Bill and Karen discover part of him still lives in the VR game Kingdom Of Reign. With only 6 weeks left before their son is lost forever, they go on an epic quest to find him.
It's the story of a naive man who came from village to city to buy a minibus and got scammed by a master swindler.
Eeswar is a motherless child who hates his father for remarrying after his mother's death. He falls for a local politician's daughter which lands him in trouble.

"Beer for My Horses" tells the story of two best friends that work together as deputies in a small town. The two defy the Sheriff and head off on an outrageous road trip to save the protagonist's girlfriend from drug lord kidnappers.

Olivier Rohan, a young doctor, has just opened a general practice. However, having only a small clientele, he continues to work in the hospital's emergency room. One night, he will witness the unnatural death of a young man.
The killing of a fiery young teacher sets Detective Mario Conde on the trail of a drug kingpin with ties to the high school he once attended.
A newspaper publisher and his Korean servant fight crime as vigilantes who pose as a notorious masked gangster and his aide.
The emperor's reign of terror expands. Heroic outlaw Ma Teng joins a squad of female rebels, whose leader is torn between family loyalties.
Plot is unknown at this time.
After a pandemic sweeps the world, six children remain abandoned on an enigmatic island. Their struggle to survive becomes paled by individual desires for each other and for power.

Being born fat and has dark skins, it feels like a curse for Rara, especially when she worked at the office that has surrounded by pretty girls. Her boss wants her to lose her weight, but there is a man who loves the way she were.
An aspiring writer is repeatedly gang-raped, humiliated, and left for dead by four men she systematically hunts down to seek revenge.
A detective matches wits with a group of thieves out to steal a priceless amulet.

movie_name: From the Earth to the Moon
synopsis: In 1868, American inventor Victor Barbicane develops a powerful military explosive that he also uses as fuel for a moon-bound rocket manned by himself and a motley crew.
Charlie is a 16-year-old orphan struggling to raise her two younger brothers when she endeavors to train a rogue horse she names Sylvester and turn him into an eventing champion.
After a cataclysmic event drastically reshapes the world, a small band of survivors will struggle to survive the burnt, hellish landscape.

After beating the 'Beasts', the 'Wild Things' won every game. In the final match they must win to claim the Freestyle Soccer Cup, they battle the 'Wolves of Ragnarok'. They travel to them, but the wolves have a secret weapon
Bret Maverick, needing money for a poker tournament, faces various comic mishaps and challenges, including a charming woman thief.
When noted anthropologist Dr. Ethan Powell, who left society to live in the jungle, is imprisoned for murder, it's up to young psychiatrist Theo Caulder to get through to him.

movie_name: The Arbit Documentation of An Amphibian Hunt: Aavasavyuham
synopsis: Joy is a man who seems to have a mysterious connection with nature. One day he arrives in Puthuvype, and the people there recount stories about him. No one knows where he came from and no one knows where he was going either.
A group of adventurers make off with 600 kilograms of gold in French Guiana, but when their helicopter crashes in the jungle, gold fever takes over.
White Point is a car chase movie taking place in a dystopian and frozen North in the future. Winter has lasted for more than twenty years, snow is everywhere, and the sea is frozen.
A bachelor goose must form a bond with two lost ducklings as they journey south.
A college lecturer flees to Paris after a scandal costs him his job. In the City of Light, he meets a widow who might be involved in a series of murders.
A woman and her child are victims of domestic violence. Their neighbor, a retired and dying man who has nothing to lose takes matters in his own hands.
When a singer-waiter is framed for murder, three elderly gentlemen risk all to prove his innocence.

A man is diagnosed with Psychosis and is advised by his therapist to make video diaries in order for him to analyze his mind further. Slowly, we watch the mind of this man go further and further insane.
The Hymn of a Broken Man. The story of Hymn who's lost his children and wife during the end times. His road to self discovery and realization of strength in numbers.
Cursed with a life of immortality, a samurai is tasked by a young girl to help avenge the death of her father. Based on the manga series by Hiroaki Samura.
Highlighting the ups, and downs of dating and romance in New York City all stemming from a monthly event called Playtime NYC.

movie_name: The Monkey King: The Legend Begins
synopsis: The Monkey King: The Legend Begins is the re-imagined version by Hollywood of the film The Monkey King: Havoc in Heavens Palace, the origin and birthplace of The Monkey King Story.
Sci Fi about an engineer in a multinational conglomerate who devises a machine to turn garbage into food.
Two men with extremely opposite views decide to duel it out to the death, with swords, just to make a point. Only thing is, the police don't take to the idea too kindly.
A love triangle oddly reminiscent of a Hollywood classic sends a husband into the depths of paranoia in his effort to stop his wife's alleged stalker.
A sci-fi history of mankind told from the perspective of angels. The Record Keeper, Raina, works in Heaven's administrative offices tracking events unfolding on earth.
Jake, an ex-Motocross champion, is set up for a crime he has not committed. He now finds himself running from the government, and must find the man who set him up and to clean his name.
Hayato gets hired by a shady model agency as a bodyguard for their main model, Kurenai Reo. Despite his nice looks, Reo is actually a loan shark and firmly believes that money can rule the world.

A woman gets engaged with her current boyfriend, a mysterious and secretive businessman, when she starts getting messages by who seems to be her old teenage love. Soon, she'll start finding out the dark trues of the two men.

Will and Maura decide to come to Ireland with their daughter and live on Maura's ancestral estate. But soon weird happenings around the house lead a local priest to confess that Maura's ancestors practiced black magic.
After witnessing the sudden tragic death of his father; a masked vigilante takes on the path of vengeance to go after the man responsible, the notorious criminal...Mr. Razi.

movie_name: The Strange Case of the Man and the Beast
synopsis: Dr. Henry Jekyll experiments with scientific means of revealing the hidden, dark side of man and releases a murderer from within himself.

Louisa Artemyeva is a singer, Prima Donna of the Opera theater for many years. One day she began to lose, one by one, everything in her life: her job, her man, her young admirer... She stays alone. What she will do?
After losing everything, a young man rebuilds his life and finds love in 1920s Shanghai -- all while rising to power in an organized crime syndicate.
An abused woman conjures up a spirit to take revenge on the men who have misused her.
This divine film brings together three different stories about death.
When a serial killer chases his next victim into the custody of small town sheriff, the killer gives the sheriff an ultimatum; his next victim or the residents of the small town.
The psychological thriller centers on a 16 year-old girl who moves to a sleepy seaside town with a deadly past, and discovers what's on the other side of death.
When a businessman who has had a double indemnity policy taken out on him dies mysteriously, his insurance company sends an undercover investigator to town to determine exactly what happened.

After a worldwide economic crash leaves society on the verge of collapse, a man with no family falls in with a group of hardscrabble survivalists and lands a job at a mysterious transport company that operates entirely in the shadows.

Surrounded by three overprotective brothers, a little sister can only dream of getting in a relationship with the boys' best friend, and as a result, their reluctance will soon drive him into the arms of another woman. But, can love wait?
Tim is a quiet man who has lost everything. His lover's murder brought his life into a downward spiral. We find him at his darkest hour as he is being led on a spiritual journey of life acceptance.
PULANG is about a man from a village who sails around the world hoping for riches as his wife waits for his promised return for - 61 years.
Several members of the International Rescue crew attend the maiden flight of Brains' revolutionary craft Skyship One, unaware that they are being lured into a deadly trap.
A physicist who invents a time machine must travel back to the past to uncover the truth about his creation and the woman who is trying to steal it.
Left for dead, a woman stumbles into the infamous desert crossroads and strikes a deal with the Devil to hunt down the Cartel who killed her husband and unborn child.
AN EX-CONVICT'S YEARNING FOR REVENGE DISSOLVES WHEN HE FALLS IN LOVE WITH A NUN.

An anonymous user posting prediction videos on the country's future goes viral as they end up being right. However, things take a turn when the masked user must get the help from the detective that's hunting him down.

movie_name: The Steam-Driven Adventures of Riverboat Bill
synopsis: Riverboat Bill, a young boy named Dave, and a fire-breathing Bunyip have adventures up and down the Murray River aboard their salvaged steamboat in early 20th century Australia, facing outlaws and unsympathetic lawmen along the way.
A man is brought in by an infertility doctor to supply him with his sperm, where he becomes the biggest sperm donor for his clinic.
A naive young man and a rich city girl fall in love. Her stepfather, however, doesn't approve of the match and will stop at nothing to split the pair.

Luke Skywalker joins forces with a Jedi Knight, a cocky pilot, a wookiee and two droids to save the universe from the Empire's world-destroying battle-station, while also attempting to rescue Princess Leia from the evil Darth Vader.
A gang of high class corporate thieves use blackmail to induce their victims to sell property at knock-down prices.
A constipated police detective solves crimes, hung over and from his bedroom window.
Lamia and Kenan love each other. When they turn back from Paris they visit Kenan's uncle. Since then things do not go as expected.

A University professor takes four archaeology students on a field trip to a remote Scottish island. With tensions already present in the group, they unearth clues to an ancient mystery that will threaten their lives.
An international crew of astronauts undertakes a privately funded mission to search for life on Jupiter's fourth largest moon.
In Ancient Polynesia, when a terrible curse incurred by the Demigod Maui reaches Moana's island, she answers the Ocean's call to seek out the Demigod to set things right.

To escape a dying Earth, a team of scientists pilot an Ark, destined for an exoplanet to start anew. But their precious Ark suffers complications along the way, causing its crew to fight for the survival of the human race.

Chu Sang-woo is the epitome of an inflexible and strict rule-abiding person. Jang Jae-young is like a semantic error in the perfect world of Chu Sang-woo. Will Sang-woo be able to work with Jae-young as an artist and engineer?
A young family are stranded at the Eden Lodge. The people they meet are being killed one by one. They must fight to save their marriage, their family, and most of all their lives.
A deadly survival run on a distant planet sets a group of unlikely heroes against the forces of a ruthless tyrant.
Aliens visit the solar-powered house of a middle-class family, and the house is suddenly sucked into a time warp that transports it back to prehistoric times.
A Captain must pay the price of a wrong decision when he leads the Valencia to its ultimate demise.
A violent thug plays opposing yakuza bosses against each other.

Ex-convict Quick wants to start fresh and focus on a career as a music producer. He is barely out of jail when his former partner in crime, Cash, already has plans to make some easy money and Quick is an essential part of the scheme.
Two best friends tragically fall in love with the same woman.
A young man finds love and settles down, but when his young wife spirals into depression they both have decisions to make.
A fastidious insurance assessor investigates a potential case of insurance fraud in Brighton and uncovers a murder.
After the death of his older Brother a young man learns that he has another older brother that he never met. He spends weeks tracking him down and falls in love along the way.
An explosive drama set against the world of street racing.

A team of criminals attempts to steal a valuable case from another organization, but many of the crew have alternate motives. Meanwhile, a former assassin is attempting to track down her old team in the hopes of bloody revenge!

40 kilos of heroin goes missing after a botched undercover transaction and the cops in the involved crime unit are getting killed off one at a time. As trust slowly fades away between them, Max has to deal with his own demons.
Disguised as an Austrian archaeologist, Moto helps unearth the priceless crown of the legendary Queen of Sheba and sans disguise defends it from a variety of thugs and criminals.

Four teenage boys from a rural town go to Tel Aviv for a fun night at a disco and inadvertantly stab a local youth. They are pursued by the police and a nearly retired detective who tries to save them from themselves.
Welcome to MYSTEE MAGIC...A Galactic Adventure Story with Science and Magic, Robots and Dragons, Romance and Galactic Conflict.

A chance encounter and evening of mutual gratification leads to a thrilling journey of disturbing incidents. A successful business man now has to deal with the deadly attention from a spurned acquaintance.
A young man's body and mind unravel in horrifying ways after a mysterious and alluring man moves into his apartment, forcing him to confront his deepest insecurities.

Japan, 2077: A female agent named Vexille is dispatched to Tokyo to investigate whether Japanese are developing robotic technology, which has been banned by the U.N. due to its potential threat to humankind.
A poison killer woman in a search and destroy mission against a strange spiritual leader.
Tianjin, a boy from the city, has to move to his father on the prairie of Tibet. There he meets a golden dog that helps him cope with the new challenges ahead.
Bix the Bug is a DJ who comes into possession of a Teslascope -- Nikola Tesla's legendary invention, which he claims was capable of receiving signals from Extra Terrestrial worlds.
Twin brothers revolt against tyranny in pre-Roman Italy and then come to a parting of the ways as they lead their people toward the founding of a new city.
A routine supply drop in deep space is compromised when the crew of the Cardano board The Demeter in search of answers to a catastrophic event.
A New York City based homeless boy turns into a notorious criminal after some local gangs kill his family.

Eight years after the disappearance of Cassandra, some disturbing incidents seem to indicate that she's still alive. Police, parents and Cassandra herself, will try to unravel the mystery of her disappearance.
A surgeon, feeling guilty over his daughter's facial disfigurement, for which he was responsible, kidnaps young women in an attempt to fix his daughter's face. Remake of the classic 1960 horror film.

Visiting grandma on her farm with lots of animals and other exciting things, but sometimes everything isn't just fun. Then it's good to use some fantasy magic. TV-series for three year old's going big time movie.
Grindsploitation 8: Drive-In Grindhouse part 8 of the Grindsploitation film series Faux Film trailers and shocking short horror films.
A super-rich NRI comes to India in search of a bride, only to fall in love with a village girl. But she just might be a small pawn in a bigger, deadlier conspiracy.

Daring British WWI fighter pilot James "Biggles" Bigglesworth and 1980s low-level business executive Jim Ferguson discover that they can time travel to each other's eras. They try to stop the Germans from changing the outcome of WWI.
In St. Tropez, French gendarme Cruchot and his men battle petroleum-drinking, human-looking, metallic aliens.
Chivalrous thief Lu Ping and detective Guo Jing catch a latent Japanese spy together.

Farhad works on some highly controversial tests. When he suddenly absconds with some results to a place named Heaven, his wife doesn't know the reason. She goes to Heaven to find Farhad - but she finds him in Hell.
A jaded assassin assigned to target a yakuza clan has 24 hours to find out who poisoned her and get vengeance before she dies.
When a career criminal's plan for revenge is thwarted by unlikely circumstances, he puts his intended victim's son in his place by putting him in prison...and then joining him.
A small group of British and German soldiers is trapped in the desert and has to try to work together in order to survive back to their own lines.
Jim is a test pilot. His wife Ann and best friend Gunner try their best to keep him sober. But the life of a test pilot is anything but safe.
A poor rickshaw driver finds himself helping a young woman and her son after the woman's husband dies suddenly.
When the world you know has died who will survive?

When a man has failed to save and protect his world from an ancient parasite, he leaves his home in search of a little girl in captivity who has the ability to destroy the parasite once and for all and determine the fate of the multiverse.

Two U.S. Marine investigators looking into a series of grisly murders in Manila discover that the crimes are tied to an amulet with a 400-year-old curse on it that has unleashed supernatural forces which can possess people.
A jungle beauty, conniving employees, mother's pressure to get married and memory loss complicate a wealthy male's life.
The rape of a woman in circumstances not clarified will be a trending topic in social networks.
Sequel of 'Attack the Block'.

Gwennan has always been unique. Her parents call it angst. She's an outcast. Friendless until Kyle who sees her. To the police, community and her therapist she is disturbed. Evil as seen through the eyes of a 16 year old girl.
A happily married couple, trying to advance their careers, is divided by an unexpected visitor who brings chaos and death.
An honorably discharged soldier returns home to New Orleans, hoping to break away from his upbringing as a trained prostitute, but his brothel-madam mother has other expectations.
Alexander (Taimak) leads a team of martial arts experts to save a beautiful, kidnapped queen. As things start to go wrong, they could get trapped in a Hell they never imagined.

movie_name: I Am Sartana, Your Angel of Death
synopsis: Sartana is falsely accused of robbing a bank, and must find the culprits to clear his name.

A group of military brats play out their adventures in the woods. They find a map to a buried treasure that thieves are after. But when one of their fathers is kidnapped, they must embark on a rescue mission as "The Rack Pack".
When the hurricane shuts down the ferry, a film team gets stuck in an isolated island hospital, known for a silent psychological war between the inmates and the staff.
Action-packed female protagonist undisclosed storyline.

Adrushyam is an odia-language thriller film directed by Rajendra Mohanta. It is produced by Samaresh Routray, Sambeet Acharya and Durga Kinkar Dash under the banners S3 Movies, DKF and Labanya Pictures.

A young father has to fight the monster inside himself before he can protect his family from becoming prey to an ancient killer.
A recently released ex-con gets involved in a fake kidnapping scheme that turns very real.

Mercenaries seize control of a remote resort hotel during a wedding and it's up to the best man, the groom and their drunken best friend to stop the terrorists and save the hostages.

Anavey, along with her naive sister Anastasia, form a cult of blood thirsty youths to put all the controlling adults who treat children unfairly in their place.

It's the year 2065, a man awakens in a room with no idea of how he got there. He must stay alive in order to save himself and his wife while trying to evade their captor who is hiding a deadly secret.

A boy haunted by visions of a dark tower from a parallel reality teams up with the tower's disillusioned guardian to stop an evil warlock known as the Man in Black who plans to use the boy to destroy the tower and open the gates of Hell.
An aimless young man turns to murder in order to satisfy the desires of his new girlfriend, a narcissistic blue jean fetishist.
A band of thieves steal from a Mexican bank and travel to Argentina to launder the money. Upon their arrival the plan goes south and it's up to them to figure out what went wrong.

A night Ragnhild can't sleep due to a storm, she discovers a horse in distress. The horse runs away, and the days after she is told that the horse is not real, but an old saying. But Ragnhild knows what she have seen.

A remake of the 1948 atomic-age film, "Krakatit", by the same director. A scrupulous scientist is in the throes of a serious ethical dilemma after creating a highly-efficient explosive which may bring immeasurable suffering to mankind.
A 13-Year Old Embarks On A Journey In Brookhaven While His Friends Try To Search For Him.
Two hitmen, one a novice and the other a veteran with poor luck, band together to find the "King of Killers" for whom there is a large reward.
An artificial intelligence escapes her spaceship to turn into a female ghost and challenges two blade runners to a galactic chase.
A band of 16th century conquistadors must fight for their lives when they realize they're going to be served as sacrifices to a god-like T-Rex.
At a Birthday party birthday boy Avinash was murdered by someone in the house. Who is the killer and what is the motive behind the crime?
A slobbering St. Bernard becomes the center of attention for a loving family, but must contend with a dog-napping veterinarian and his henchmen.
Without Witness is an unflinchingly intimate and wickedly plotted two-actor tour de force pitting a divorced couple against each other and themselves.
16 years of alcohol is about a skinhead named Frankie; his violent childhood, alcoholism and his love for Ska.

movie_name: Double Trouble and the Magical Mirror
synopsis: The discovery of a magic mirror allows Fred to realize his dream: his twin tidies up his room, eats without complaining and becomes first in class. But Fred did not keep his promise to keep this secret by revealing it to his friend, Émile.
A young girl who has an amazing ability to communicate with insects is transferred to an exclusive Swiss boarding school, where her unusual capability might help solve a string of murders.

Still guilt-ridden over the accident that took his family's lives, Eric Norris discovers that his body is host to a parasite from another world. Except, it is more than a parasite: it carries his DNA.

Herodias, spurned by Egyptian prince who is in love with Salome, has him secretly thrown in dungeon next to the Baptist. Herodias threatens to kill her lover if Salome does not ask for death of the Baptist.
The last words uttered by by a conscience-stricken crook dying on the Saint's doorstep lead the detective in pursuit of gold smugglers and the master crook known as the Tiger.

Asako lives in Osaka. She falls in love with Baku, a free-spirit. One day, Baku suddenly disappears. Two years later, Asako now lives in Tokyo and meets Ryohei. He looks just like Baku, but has a completely different personality.
A father and son, with help from their dog and parrot, chase down thieves who stole their valuable paiting.
Ajay tries to stay on an honest path even though his father is the chief henchman of a powerful crimelord

Just as Tessa makes the biggest decision of her life, everything changes. Revelations about her family, and then Hardin's, throw everything they knew before in doubt and makes their hard-won future together more difficult to claim.
The cast of a horror film go out for dinner with their director one night and they all exchange horror stories.
L.A.'s top Latino gang leader is release from jail on a technicality, swearing to kill both the cop who put him away and the priest who testified against him.
A journalist and aspiring policeman realises that his brother has been killed by conspirers. Later, he teams up with the rivals of his brother's culprits to bring them down and avenge his death.
With his livelihood on the line and the stakes higher than ever, a billiards player must face off against underworld kings to win back his pool hall.

A group of young people who have decided to celebrate the New Year in a different, unfamiliar for them a city. A chance meeting online friend of one of the guys, turns happy holiday on a dangerous adventure. Something went wrong.

Adèle's life is changed when she meets Emma, a young woman with blue hair, who will allow her to discover desire and to assert herself as a woman and as an adult. In front of others, Adèle grows, seeks herself, loses herself, and ultimately finds herself through love and loss.

Unanimity in the dissection of harmony. Conflicted people who seek comfort and consolation in a time of great distress and sadness. Add to that, their loose assemblage of a diverse group and family pressures.
A burned-out LA cop is sent to a Navajo reservation to bring back a murder suspect. The cop must traverse a forbidden desert territory and struggle against his suspect's mystical powers.
A young farmer's son is sent on a long and far away travel, to find out what really matters in life.
The Saint's asked to act as a bodyguard to the best-selling adventure author Amos Klein, a young woman who uses a male pen-name.
In a future where dying of illness is exceedingly rare, a terminally ill woman becomes a celebrity and a man with camera implants goes to secretly record her for a morbid TV show.
After a pencil-pushing clerk is humiliated and fired, he goes on a violent rampage.
"Weird Fiction" was a 2018 horror anthology movie, that has four spine-chilling stories.
A woman, a survivor of a failed murder attempt by the so-called "Half-Moon Killer", and her husband try to find a connection between herself, six other women, and the killer.
A disgraced royal finds himself linked to a circle of criminals to which he must escape.

The adventures of a young boy who returns to school after an absence of many days due to an accident. He has a loyal and true friend, his dog, with whom he spends endless hours of games and carefree abandon.

3 prisoners escape. 2 end up in Happy, Texas, where they're mistaken for a gay couple expected there to help with the small girls beauty pageant. As the 2 are paid $1000, they decide to stay until the heat is gone.
Following the loss of his family, a man attempts suicide only to discover upon waking that he can identify people who are about to die
Billy Zane Play Buddha in an amazingly spectacular 3D movies that will sweep the audience off its feet with an amazing story and Graphics similar to Avatar.
The horrendous spanish detective becomes a bodyward in his new third adventure.
A new kid in town assembles a fledgling rock band -- together, they achieve their dreams and compete against the best in the biggest event of the year, a battle of the bands.
In a chaotic future world where people believe in witches, a gig worker goes off the grid to help a young girl stricken with a contagious and disfiguring illness.
An unearthly fog rolls into a small coastal town exactly 100 years after a ship mysteriously sank in its waters.
A busy bank branch is under observation by a group of police officers during the banking hours under information of a possible bank robbery. However, they are in for a surprise.
The greatest currency counterfeiter of all time prints $250 million of perfect $20 bills before outfoxing an international police operation to ultimately walk free and turn his life around.
A diabolical woman runs a dangerous brothel for missing girls.
Worried that he costs too much to feed, Clifford runs away to join a carnival act and help win a lifetime supply of Tummy Yummies.
A merc is hired by the F.B.I. to track down a powerful recluse criminal. A woman is also trying to track him down for her own personal vendetta.

When the government finds out a young boy with destructive powers is in communication with extraterrestrials, a secret research facility agents must capture and make him reveal the alien's plan before they destroy the earth.

Steven Renegade is a legendary, all-American soldier who finds himself forced out of retirement as the government's last hope to stop a sinister plan to use stolen CIA cloning secrets to take over the world.

A young man, armed with a magical bow and arrows, embarks on a mystical journey through a mystical land to rid it of all evil and joins forces with an outlaw to take down an evil witch bent on claiming the magic bow for evil.
On another planet in the distant past, a Gelfling embarks on a quest to find the missing shard of a magical crystal, and to restore order to his world.

The story of five British soldiers trying to stay alive on the last night of the Afghan War, facing not just the Taliban, but also supernatural forces more terrifying than anything they've encountered before.

A slacker man-child accidentally transports himself into a multiverse of alternate realities when a seemingly normal garage turns out to be a portal to other, albeit only slightly different, dimensions.
Who is Bogan? That is the question that drives this movie about things not being as they seem.
Kesh a gifted scientist in the field of AI develops a program called Jack and Jill that can sharpen the physique and mental ability of a person in order to fulfill his father's wish
A blocked writer and a troubled young woman who meet over a phone-sex line go on a journey together.

John Baby, who is recouping from a traumatic accident, meets Nitin, a young boy who interests him with murder stories. When Baby explores the possibility of Nitin's stories by mapping the events, it matches with the real-time incidents.
A woman gets in way over her head when she's in the wrong place at the wrong time.

Mai is a teenage girl with telekinetic powers, which she only uses for fun. But when she gets a high score on a test designed to test if she has psychic abilities, a mysterious organization is eager to use her powers for their own gain.

A disgruntled white South African English school teacher decides to do something meaningful in his life and joins the anti-apartheid activists. He helps plant a bomb but it kills a bunch of civilians. He deals with the fallout.

movie_name: Young President and His Fake Bride
synopsis: At the wedding, Mo Jing Qian discovered that the bride was not Anshihui who he was going to marry, but Anshi Ning, a sister with the same appearance. Her sister had died, under the pressure of his family, he was forced to accept her.
A respected grocery shop employee in Prague is covering up for her manager's misconduct with whom she is having an affair; however, things will get complicated when a thorough auditor pays a visit.
A sheltered young loser goes on the worst blind date ever when he and his date must cover up the accidental murder of a crooked cop.

Vazgen "Vaz", a Mobster turned businessman, is pulled back into his past life, when his eldest son is accused of killing a Russian gangster. Now he must find a way to save his family and all that he's built.
A boy, Neve, sets out in search of his father and lands in a parallel world. Thanks to two mystery hunters, Bertolt and Francois, he will save his father from an evil being.
An undercover FBI agent must choose between the federal agency he swore to serve and the loyalty he's built with a corrupt record label executive he is assigned to investigate.
Eleven friends get together for a bachelor party, but the celebrations go awry because of a phone call and a death. A drunk cop steps into unravel the mystery.

Congressman Hale Boggs disappeared when his plane went down, in Alaska. His son, Tommy Boggs, wanted to know why, and how it happened. The assassinations of JFK and MLK make the conundrum a deadly maze of mystery.
A man's vision for a utopian society is disillusioned when travelling forward into time reveals a dark and dangerous society.
The couple finds a dead man at the hotel suite. It is a detective hired by the beloved husband. The minister must get rid of the dead body by all means. He calls for help his deputy.
Picking of episode 46 left off, Ryuki and four other Riders remain standing, but one of them, somewhat-related to Ryuki, threatens to speeden the deaths of the remaining Riders.
An old and sick man finds a smartphone: inside there are videos that tell the life of a woman.
A former gangster and his friends try to make a living as fishermen.

Inspired by true events. In 1968, a 12 year old tom-boy, Mary, wanted to run races, win a gold medal in the Olympics and chase horny toads. What she received were, life changing lessons from Sam, King of the Horned Toads.
A young chipmunk in the city undertakes a journey to return to the forest.
The eternal love story of The Devil and his Maiden, lived through two humans who found ultimate love: A complete union of the mind, the heart and the sex.
Space explorers trying to escape with select survivors of a post-apocalyptic Earth discover a 2nd Earth and Garden of Eden and in turn introduce sin, sickness and evil to a perfect world.
After gaining the power of invisibility; a man becomes a vigilante, in order to take revenge on those who have wronged him.
A scorned mistress makes a film for her ex-lover.

In a southern Mediterranean land, a modern Orpheus embarks on an initiatory journey through Los Infiernos (The Hell) between a devastating drought and a flood in search of water and the love of an enigmatic woman.
When the other students begin to undergo mutations, a lesbian couple must solve the mystery and save Tromaville High School.
Vijay and Anitha secretly love each other but are unable to confess their love for each other. Her father realises this and tries to separate the two. However, fate has other plans in store.

Private Investigator Somerset and Lieutenant Detective Mills merge together again to match wits and wisdom with either a crazed copycat or calculating killer living out the legacy of John Doe and the seven sins.
A young couple, faced with the painful panorama that the capital offers them, decide to try their luck in a town, with the exercise of a profession for which great titles are not necessary.

An evil zamindaar doubling as a dacoit in secret murders an honest police officer who gets to the truth. The cop's separated 2 sons grow up years later on opposite sides as a dacoit and a police officer seeking revenge.
Over two decades after their affair ended, a married man is haunted by the presence of his former lover.
After firing a colleague, the head of a PR company begins to question her lifestyle and values.

"SPOOK BRIDGE" is a horror film that follows a Reporter, Clyde Adams, a man in search of the cause of the recent mysterious deaths of teenagers on Spook Bridge. See RKDSmedia.com / SpookBridge.com for more info.
The Brighton Mob is a tense and twisting crime thriller in the style of The Usual Suspects and Reservoir Dogs, set in a world where no one is who they seem to be.

Türkan's lawyer suggests that the young woman make a fake marriage so that she can inherit her inheritance. Worried about taking the inheritance, Türkan tries to test the love of her ex-husband in this process.
A small-time gambler on the run from the law hides in his ex-wife's house, accidentally kills a drunken detective during a fight, and takes his ex-wife hostage during a shootout with the LAPD.
A mysterious new shop opens in a small town which always seems to stock the deepest desires of each shopper, with a price far heavier than expected.

Accused of killing his brother during adolescence, Salvador lives alone in the middle of Patagonia. Several decades later, his brother Marcos and his sister-in-law Laura, come to convince him to sell the lands they share by inheritance.
A middle-aged woman suddenly loses her sight while driving through unfamiliar terrains in a community where ethnic and religious tensions are at an all-time high.

Carson, a genius engineer, creates incredibly powerful technology only to have his thief ex-girlfriend Charlotte steal it and give it to the wrong people. Now, he must enlist her help to get it back. Turns out it's not that simple.
An orphan boy in 1830s London is abused in a workhouse, then falls into the clutches of a gang of thieves.
A funeral-speech writer gets a new lease on life when he meets a widow who commissions him to write a piece for her 8-year-old son.
A man's world crumbles after his addiction takes control over his life.

Myles Falworth wants to be a chivalric knight someday, but when he learns of his family's fall and the magnitude of the enemies who oppose them, he must learn to put aside childish things and become the man his family needs him to be.
A mysterious woman helps prevent a notorious underworld criminal from getting his hands on a set of strange coins that can tip the balance between life and death.
A mad scientist transforms himself into an aquatic killer.
Mothers and daughters re-discover each other and re-define their roles.

During an archaeological expedition on Bouvetøya Island in Antarctica, a team of archaeologists and other scientists find themselves caught up in a battle between the two legends. Soon, the team realize that only one species can win.
An accident victim makes a deal with a particularly hideous witch, in which he receives extraordinary ESP powers. He uses these powers to help the police solve crimes.
At large, to prove them wrong.

Mermer Family lives a double life working at their family owned restaurant while being undercover assassins for an international organization. After their secret is revealed, this dysfunctional family needs to work together to survive.

Manolo learns the techniques of his Master Cadona to participate in the "Brutal Kombat", a championship of fight to death against the best fighters of the world. Including China, Argentina, Mexico, Spain and Russia.
A dark fairytale about a missing persons detective who is forced to relive his worst nightmares as he searches the haunted forest for two lost children.
Amber must survive the night against her seemingly possessed family.
A high school student must hide the fact that he has become pregnant from his family, friends and the school faculty!
An insurance investigator tracks down an arson ring involved in insurance fraud.

With wounds still open from the recent end of their 5 year relationship, Drew and Beth decide to meet up for a quiet dinner at Drew's apartment to help solidify their newly found station as "just friends".
In a village outside Beirut, a mechanic receives many visitors who need to repair their cars. He soon realizes that he not only has to fix their cars, but has to fix them as well.
When the world is threatened by an ancient evil, the four adolescent turtles must reunite and overcome their faults in order to stand against it.

Four aging animals - a donkey, a dog, a rooster, and a cat - are rejected by their ungrateful owners and thrown out to the streets. Together, they drive a group of robbers out of their hut and live out the rest of their lives in peace.
Detective Ellery Queen's vacation is interrupted when murder strikes next door to his oceanside cabin.
Angela, supposedly reformed and living under an assumed surname, is working at a summer camp. However, when the campers start misbehaving, she soon reverts to her old ways.
They know when you are alone

When a women's husband is brutally murdered, she enlists the help of a paranormal expert to analyze strange phone calls from his phone and her investigations lead her to a group of swingers that expose her husband's double life.
A young, struggling actor becomes the most popular male escort for Manhattan's wealthiest women. What would you do to become famous?

Jason Voorhees is cryogenically frozen at the beginning of the 21st century, and is discovered in the 25th century and taken to space. He gets thawed, and begins stalking and killing the crew of the spaceship that's transporting him.
A small-town woman, fresh to the city, buys a second-hand Jaguar haunted by the ghost of a murdered woman and her killer.
An undercover detective uses a restaurant targeted by harassment by a criminal gang to infiltrate the gang and arrest its members.

A coming of age story about a troubled 16 year old girl in foster care in Hawaii, whose path to empowerment begins when a mysterious old man teaches her the ukulele - and she makes it to the World Ukulele Championships in Honolulu.

Gonzalo is in the middle of an exam. He doesn't care if he fails or passes, he doesn't care if his mother gets angry, even though that's what he wants. He doesn't like what's around him and has decided that his world is going to stop.
A cop turns vigilante after his family is murdered, exacting vengeance on the killers - and then on all criminals who have slipped through the system.
A young and beautiful department store saleswoman lives in the furniture section without anyone noticing.
The adventures of an investigator (Cagney) for the Bureau of Weights and Measures.
This film was inspired by the horrifying and mysterious crimes committed against the Gruber family in 1922 Germany.

Summertime. A cruising spot for men, tucked away on the shores of a lake. Franck falls in love with Michel, an attractive, potent and lethally dangerous man. Franck knows this but wants to live out his passion anyway.
Lan Jue (Gao Han Yu), a detective with half-alien blood, relies on the Gegula Star to go back twenty years into the past, where he searches for the owner of the ring and the demon in the nightmares.
A blind couple's marriage is tested when the wife is drawn to a blind writer.
A cosmic stone transforms a peasant girl into an adult superheroine, who then must battle a snake-haired woman's genocidal plans to take over the country.
In a near-future world, where individuals have their memories downloaded for backup, a man awakes in a body that is not his own.
Young woman to get married, sisters killer released from prison on a technicality, returns to stop wedding.
A family man struggling to hold it all together discovers a hidden parlor that offers a solution...sexbots.

Mike Hanson made a living convincing the public he could talk to their dearly departed but after a freak accident he finds that he can more than talk to the dead and something wants out from the other side.
Using equipment from a banned 1950s test, a group of students conduct a series of psychological experiments into telepathy, with horrorific consequences.
A man overhears a murder plot and telephones three different women, all who share the potential victim's name.
When the Queen of the Hard Rock Trolls tries to take over all the Troll kingdoms, Queen Poppy and her friends try different ways to save all the Trolls.
An unemployed singer hits a girl with a car he has just stolen. She has no serious injuries but falls in love with the handsome stranger.
Gather the family 'round the home screen for this collection of some of Moonbeams coolest and creepiest monsters. It's the greatest moments from some of our gnarliest kid-flicks all crushed together.
Marine lieutenants Dan and Jim fight bandits in the South American jungle, while competing for the attention of beautiful Joan Grant.
An incognito opera singer falls for a policeman who has been assigned to track down her fugitive brother.

A mute girl - Safi, lives in lives in a family where her brother and sister think she is a curse until when things turn upside down when poachers kidnap her siblings. With the disability, will she out-think the furious and save her family?
A team of brave explorers ventures into a forbidden forest inhabited by mystical creatures and guarded by ancient spirits on a quest to find a legendary treasure.
Following the death of her husband, a young woman is stalked by those responsible.

Glenn and Carlo are in the beautiful and exotic island of Bali where they work on writing a photo book. Glenn is in the grip of a mystical crisis, influenced by the magical rituals of the place, converted to Hinduism.
Lost in the paranoia of a sinister city, Uma senses she is being haunted by a presence, pulling her deeper into a world of nightmares.

The silver-haired samurai Sakata Gintoki investigates the disappearance of a legendary sword named Benizakura while his partners Kagura and Shimura Shinpachi try to find out what has happened to Gintoki's friend, Kotaro Katsura.
Action adventure set in Egypt about tomb robbers.
Six best friends find themselves at the wrong place at the wrong time. They fight for their lives against a serial killer who has more in store for them than death.

Three short films. Three women's harrowing journeys to find inner peace in their respective worlds, whether it is Earth (A Song For Swan), a parallel dimension (The Reve), or an alternate realm (Since).
Western / Thriller that takes place in Punta Indio, a ghost town in the middle of nowhere. A crime reveals the dark legend of a cursed diamond.
When a young man discovers the journal of an obsessed witness to a brutal serial killer, he opens the door to a world of terror.
Three magazine employees head out on an assignment to interview a guy who placed a classified advertisement seeking a companion for time travel.
Elliot, a troubled former successful writer decides to write about a missing wife and the following murder trial of her husband.
Based on the story by L. N. Tolstoy. Yunker Olenin, representative of the St. Petersburg's golden youth, in search of romance, travels from St. Petersburg to the Caucasus.
A journalist sets out to uncover the truth behind an incident, through the perspectives of different people, unraveling how they and their lives are intertwined with it.
Uncle David depicts the disturbing relationship between an Uncle and his nephew through to its sinister climax.
Defeated villain Sung Ching-Shu restarts his reign of terror, trapping a beautiful Mongolian princess. Only two swords, and two great swordsmen, stand in his way.

Set in Thailand, 3 Ages, tells the story of a woman during three stages of her life, as she deals with events in her past and the negative effects resulting from a broken relationship with her father since childhood.
Santa's clumsy son Arthur sets out on a mission with Grandsanta to give out a present they misplaced to a young girl in less than two hours.
After the event of Jill's killing spree. The murders are not over. They start with a bloodbath of slaughter. Lori must uncover the masked killer before the Prescott family tree will be finished.
A take on Clive Barker's 1987 horror classic where a young woman struggling with addiction comes into possession of an ancient puzzle box, unaware that its purpose is to summon the Cenobites.
Two brothers dig up a solitary grave late at night, causing the corpse to transform.

A widowed woman, Lori, attempts to get back into the dating scene; But her happiness is short lived when she falls victim to a man who calls himself The Butcher, and his fetish for dismembering women.
A boy surrounded by violence grows up to become an infamous gangster.

movie_name: Rolf Kauka's Once Upon a Time
synopsis: One day, Maria meets a prince who gives her a magic stone but then her stepsister steals it and throws it down a well. While trying to retrieve the stone, Maria falls in and awakens in a magical realm.

After Charlie survives a car crash that kills his younger brother, he is given the gift of seeing the spirits of his brother and others who he has lost, and must use his powers to save the woman he loves from impending disaster.
Byzantine Prince kidnaps a governor and plans to marry Serbian Princess to create a rift within Ottoman Empire. Malkocoglu is sent to save the governor and prevent the marriage.

movie_name: Dark Days at the Magna Carta
synopsis: A woman going to extreme lengths to survive and save her family. Paisley broke into the business by working in the CAA mailroom.
A penniless girl in the 1930's is taken in by a circus freak, and even as he falls in love with her, she begins to launch a career in the circus herself.

A depressed doctor, Shankar, is struggling to overcome the challenges in his family life, as he is tortured by a dark secret. Suddenly one day there is a murder in his home. Who is the murderer and what was Shankar's secret?
After a nuclear disaster, a couple inside a fallout shelter struggles to coexist with shifting landscapes and uncanny supernatural events, forcing them to make life and death choices to survive.
Ugo Defrais, after surviving a terrible car accident, finds himself gifted with the supernatural power of being able to travel thru the world of dreams.
An adventurous group of friends dare to break into the abandoned orphanage and quickly find themselves trapped and fighting against unnatural forces.

movie_name: The Man Who Stole the Sun
synopsis: A high school science teacher builds an atomic bomb and uses it to extort the nation, but cannot decide what he wants. Meanwhile, a determined cop is catching up to him, as is radiation poisoning.

movie_name: Pretty Maids All in a Row
synopsis: California State Police Captain Sam Surcher investigates a string of teenage girl murders at Oceanfront High School.
Six kids take a trip to the Grand Canyon, but instead find themselves in a whole other world.

Two boys travel a thousand miles to deliver three letters as a part of their film school assignment. However, little do they know that the journey they have embarked upon will give a new meaning to their life.
An adaptation of the Alfred Hitchcock classic Dial M for Murder. An Eastern Scenario is displayed in this movie.
Batman and Nightwing are forced to team with the Joker's sometimes-girlfriend Harley Quinn to stop a global threat brought about by Poison Ivy and Jason Woodrue, the Floronic Man.
A poor but beautiful woman sets her sights on rising to the top, and lets nothing stand in her way - including murder.
The Transylvanian vampire searches for a virgin sacrifice to resurrect his long-dead daughter.
The adventurous plan in Las Vegas.
Set in France in 1880. A series of murders is attributed to a Wolf Man.
A detective investigating the murder of a teenage girl begins to focus his suspicions on the three girlfriends of the victim, who call themselves "The Inseparables."

Following his dying mother's last wishes Tony Rizzi travels to Southern Italy to search for his long-lost half-bother but finds himself at the mercy of evil crime lord Sabino as he desperately tries to save his newfound family.
When a dark power enshrouds the Earth after a total solar eclipse, the scattered Sailor Guardians must reunite to bring light back into the world.
A social thriller centered on artificial intelligence.
German nature expert Willi teaches two good looking children how to have fun in nature.
Theirs is a LOVE STORY so revealing yet so full of emotional impact that tends to touch every string of the human heart.

It follows a veteran who is recovering from addiction. He returns to the intentional community she once called home looking for her missing friend, but finds that it has been infiltrated by an otherworldly force.

A guy's life is turned around by an e-mail that includes the names of everyone he's had sex with--and ever will have sex with. His situation gets worse when he encounters a femme fatale (Ryder) who targets men guilty of sex crime.
Foal and his friend John go on an unforgettable journey as they outsmart the tyrant King, catch the fire-bird and find John's true love upon the magic roads.
A group of teenagers go to a summer camp to get rid of the lack of technology. Various character stories happen until teenagers realize that summer camp is not what it seems. But it all ends well.
Eleanor and her parents are hunting big game, accompanied by her wimpish fiance. Ben Alleu Bey wants to add her to his 100-woman harem. Tarzan wants her too.
A psychological thriller about Charles Denevers' wild night in Seattle ending in involuntarily commitment at Harborview's psychiatric ward where his only escape is to free his spirit.

Young boy whose father was from Denmark and mother from a tropical island must live with his paternal aunt in Denmark. His skin color becomes an issue right away and he decides to escape and live in the forest.
Canada's most famous hosers, Bob and Doug McKenzie, get jobs at the Elsinore Brewery, only to learn that something is rotten with the state of it.
A gently told story of a lost soldier, heroic children, and a silver donkey as a good luck charm.
Four socialite old friends unexpectedly clash, and switch partners during a party and attempt to make each other jealous.
A premonition inducing drug could cost a group of med students everything they hold dearly, including their memories.
When an anxiety-ridden photographer dies from malaria, she has to race against time to escape from the grotesque beings in order to come back to life.

Inspired by the 1955 events that gave rise to the term "Little Green Men." A Kentucky moonshiner and farmer finds his homestead under attack from an apparent alien incursion that draws in the local sheriff to repel the violent invasion.
Vancouver Island scientists follow a theory to encounter aliens in higher dimensions but government agencies want to eliminate them and their research.
The ace cop of a totalitarian police force and a drifting android play their parts in a post-apocalyptic society. They are destined to fight. Their encounter will change them forever.
To save her ill son, a field mouse must seek the aid of a colony of rats, with whom she has a deeper link than she suspected.
A group of adventurers head to a primitive tribe in Africa to find a treasure of diamonds and a beautiful white girl who was lost years ago and was made the tribe's goddess.

movie_name: The Lost Treasure of Sawtooth Island
synopsis: Danny Quinn's dream is to prove his late father was right about a pirate treasure in the depths of Lake Michigan. This is a story of the incredible energy of the human spirit, and the determination of a young man pushed to the limit.
Road-movie from Montana to Wyoming. A gullible, innocent young man (Mulroney) assists a versatile girl (Taylor) on her long quest to get her brother out of jail.
