When a grave robber tries to barter with a strange antiques dealer, the two trade stories rather than goods. Tales of zombies, vampires, and ghosts are told upstairs while an unspeakable horror waits in the basement.
A young couple arrives at a mysterious mansion. Only one housekeeper lives here. The couple is killed the same night, and the other guests who arrive at the mansion over time will die the same.
An impoverished advocate faces challenges after he falls in love with a wealthy woman who has a look-alike courtesan sister.
A paranoid man begins videotaping the strange, unexplainable events happening around him.
After being released from prison, Tang Kat Yung exacts revenge on Li Ah Chai, in this sequel to Rich and Famous.
The Wanderer is the old king who is overthrown by his bodyguards, and he seeks vengeance for the murder of his queen while providing safety for the future of his comatose son.
The story of how a green-skinned woman framed by the Wizard of Oz becomes the Wicked Witch of the West. The first of a two-part feature film adaptation of the Broadway musical.
Plot kept under wraps.

Hani and her college friends are fond of playing pranks on other students. Their latest victim Puteri is so traumatized she almost kills herself. A masked killer starts to terrorize Hani and friends on the eve of her 25th birthday.

movie_name: Mega Monster Battle: Ultra Galaxy Legends - The Movie
synopsis: Ultraman and his comrades from M-78 (including a new Ultraman, Zero, the son of Ultra Seven) join forces with other allies to fight a massive army of giant monsters led by the evil Ultraman Belial.

movie_name: Don't Be Afraid of the Dark
synopsis: A young girl sent to live with her father and his new girlfriend believes that she has released creatures from a sealed ash pit in the basement of her new home.
The rivalry between two bounty hunters intensifies as they both attempt to track down a destructive device known as the "Hand of God."
With the help of a handsome young friend, a distraught young woman must figure out if she committed murder or not, while hiding-out in a rundown motel off a desert highway.
A scientist and his family return to the island of Rarotonga, the white goddess.
An adaptation of the famous Angélique character for the Ottoman Empire, involving sultan Deli Ibrahim (Ibrahim The Mad).
Kuroki, a journalist working for a newspaper, is investigating the clandestine sale of arms to Southeast Asia.
Kai, a woman born blind but granted "sight" with the help of an AI program called Bo(o). In time, Kai begins to question the influence that Bo(o) is having on her, and suspects manipulation.
A schizophrenic architect must embrace his madness in order to uncover the secrets of New York and prevent the Demiurge, an ancient Gnostic god that's imprisoned beneath the city, from escaping.

movie_name: Tsatsiki, Dad and the Olive War
synopsis: Tsatsiki's dad is forced to sell his beloved olive farm. Tsatsiki and his friends, Per-Hammar and Alva, has to find a way to save the olive farm from being sold to an evil corporation.
Will and Liz, Five Years later.
TRANSHUMANITY talks about us, about who we are as human beings and how different our life will be a mere 100 years from now.

A woman disappeared. After a snowstorm, her car is discovered on a road to a small remote village. While the police don't know where to start, five people are linked to the disappearance. Each one with his or her own secret.

Beautiful twin sisters living in London soon discover that the feelings and actions of one physically and mentally affects the other in drastic and often horrifying ways, in this updated retelling of A Picture Of Dorian Grey.

Around the time that the chief of police is elected the Most Popular Citizen of Valleby, a thief and impostor is released after two decades in jail and returns to the town with a revenge plan in mind.
Senior detective Yang Zhigang investigates the murder of a government official found dead in a Jiangcheng brothel at the end of World War II.
Two teenagers and a cat try to enjoy a quiet afternoon by a peaceful looking lake in Tel Aviv.

Cosmos is a bus driver traveling to Spain. After the bus breaks down at a rest area. Passengers are picked up by another bus, but Cosmos is left alone with his coach. He has no light, no water, and no food.

movie_name: Kamen Rider Saber: Trio of Deep Sin
synopsis: Eight years after the battle for the Book of Omniscience, the peaceful lives of Touma, Rintaro, Mei and Kento are troubled by a mysterious new Falchion who can seemingly erase people from existence altogether.
Three episodes of a police nature, one of them starring Maigret and the other Lemmy Caution.
A paid assassin working for the biker gangs of Quebec outsmarts both the police and the underworld for decades, committing 28 hits over 25 years.
In the 1800s a naturalist marries into a family of British country gentry.
An illiterate village girl defies the customs of her tribe, discriminatory to women, only to become the spark of a Literary Revolution.
When a deadly age-warping virus infects a race of vampires, the last remaining humans are forced to join them to save the innocent blood of a child.

A Halloween anthology. Katherine's husband died a year ago, she hasn't been out much nor seen her friends in a long time. She invites them over Halloween night to gather around and tell scary stories like they used to when they were kids.
The film tells the story of the Tarsans who used to live in the forest now living in the city. This film is inspired by the Tarzan story.
The President's daughter uses her extraterrestrial influence to spare the fate of a children's shelter in Los Angeles.
A young Frenchman arrives in Northern California looking to forget a lost love and ends up encountering various forms of feminine power.
In 1881, in Algeria, Michael Denning and Hector Servadac are fighting a duel when a comet brushing Earth takes the two men to the Moon where they discover a prehistoric civilization.
An emotionally damaged teen struggles to deal with a secret he can not tell anyone.
After the brutal murder of Damien's family he begins to seek out revenge on the man responsible.
A woman and her daughter emigrate from Mexico for a better life in America, where they start working for a family where the patriarch is a newly celebrated chef with an insecure wife.
A yeti-like monster is stalking the mountains of rural Mexico, sometimes displaying the powers of hypnosis. It ultimately plays a part in destroying two shady characters.

movie_name: Kanang Anak Langkau The Iban Warrior
synopsis: A film based on true story of Sergeant Kanang Anak Langkau, an iban warrior and the nation's most decorated war hero, who fought bravely during communist insurgency.
A murder witness becomes the target of a pair of sociopaths.

Lifelong friends Neil and Gilbert's undeniable bond is tested to the limits when Neil makes a magical wish that comes true. With the assistance of Neil's charismatic neighbor, Jimmy, and Gilbert's wild ideas, Neil endures one epic night.

High up on a mountain peak surrounded by clouds, a secret Yeti society lives in peace and harmony. One day, a Yeti witnesses an airplane crash; Inside lies "Smallfoot", a legendary creature that will rock the society to its core.

movie_name: All the Colors in My Darkness
synopsis: A desperate woman and her husband travel to a rural fertility commune where they fall under the sway of the group's enigmatic matriarch, only to become entangled in a web of long-buried secrets which reveal dark truths in both of them.

WW2, December 1942, four children on the run. Sarah and Daniel are Jews about to be deported, but hide in the cellar of Otto and Gerda, until they are discovered and their parents are arrested. They have to get to faraway neutral Sweden.
This drama is inspired on a real event in 1990 when 49 political prisoners escaped from a tunnel that took 18 months to dig.
A small group of video streamers rent out an abandoned theater as their base, the townspeople and local enforcement are not so sure of this group or their intentions.
Set in the Anti-Japanese War, Chinese archaeologists and patriots fight to protect the national treasure.

After Santa rejects his wife's idea for a line of eco-friendly toys, Mrs. Claus (Monica) leaves home to pursue her own dreams and ends up taking a job as a nanny to two young children in, of all places, Santa Monica.
Homicidal sheriff Thomas Jefferson Geronimo is tasked with escorting a mobster to Malta. When the prisoner escapes, Geronimo goes to catch him.

Vijay (chiranjeevi) has a habit of accepting challenges; his friend Chanti throws a challenge at him to kill a professor. The challenge turns ugly when the professor is killed for real and the blame falls on Vijay.

Ling is a fashion columnist whose ex-boyfriend died in a car accident. Debt collectors Fei and Ma are eyewitnesses on the scene and Fei is certain that Peter's death is more than just an accident. The weird and suspicious act.
One of the main players in Italian politics, Aldo Moro, gets kidnapped and murdered by terrorists. One judge finds evidence that sheds dangerous new light on the case.
A dangerous cocaine dealer embarks on a surprising journey by unwillingly duplicating his daily criminal routine through an extensive range of emotional behaviors.
It tells the story of of a mother named Cheryl whose daughter is nowhere to be found. Authorities and media dismiss her as a runaway while focusing on another missing girl, who is white.

Late-1960s suburban Canadian children work on building a rocket vessel, with the intention of delivering one or two neighborhood children to the moon, whilst dealing with social issues of the coming-of-age, orphan-hood and family veins.
On industrial relations and socialist competition. As always in Soviet films, labor processes develop against the backdrop of intricately intertwined love stories.

As the local mob destroys the life of a big family and leaves them on the brink of survival, a powerful, yet secret love burns between Marko, a local gangster and Angela, young daughter of the betrayed father.
An entertaining sci-fi thriller with plenty of action, drama, humor, and bits of gor, Lizard Boy raises questions about modern genetics while harkening back to the monster movies of old.
Betrayed on a high risk mission to uncover the key players in a terrorist network, Special Forces officer Simon Carter and the secretive Division 9 discover the enemy comes from within.
A neglected young man wishes to be invisible and the wish comes true. However in an attempt to get his ladylove, he gets in the bad books of police who wants him dead.

"DopeSmack" follows Alex Santos, a self-taught scientist, who develops a bulletproof suit and receives superhuman powers that allow him to battle super-villains, fight for his city, avenge his father's death and rescue the ones he loves.
A yacht in the English channel is helped to port - when the police arrive there are no crew, no papers and no clues. What is the mystery of the ghost ship?
A struggling young woman is implanted with an experimental AI chip. She must fight to survive when it takes control.
It tells the story of Maestro Mouse and his adventures as he traverses the globe, recruiting an orchestra like no other.

Everything changes for Aarav when he gets involved in a road accident. A wrong decision takes him on a journey darker than his wildest dreams. Loved by a father, pampered by a friend and chased by a cop, will he be able to find redemption?
A newly widowed mother returns to her father's isolated hotel, where a sinister folklore presence stalks the land.

A newly widowed man embarks on a sailing trip from LA to Hawaii and employs an eager young couple to crew his luxurious boat. Shortly after setting sail, the chemistry of the crew begins to shift, as does their original motivations.

When Tanju's mother is killed crossing the road, he begins a journey through the seven stages of grief. Living in the dangerous underworld of Mirpur, he encounters Murad - a corrupt policeman with a sinister plan for his young charge.
Amid a series of brutal killings of Indian agents in London, a RAW officer and India's Ambassador to Great Britain race against time to find the traitor within their own ranks.
Thor enlists the help of Valkyrie, Korg and ex-girlfriend Jane Foster to fight Gorr the God Butcher, who intends to make the gods extinct.
A group of thieves meticulously plans a daring heist to steal a priceless diamond from a heavily guarded museum facing intricate security systems and rival criminals who also seek the precious gem.
Shiva and Athulya try to make their long-distance relationship work. However, Athulya's colleague Karthik develops feelings for her, which complicates the bond between them.
A capuchin monkey helps Katie, a young teenager, overcome her depression after her mother dies.

movie_name: Do You See What I See
synopsis: An idealistic Australian student navigates rising political tensions at an elite college in the USA as a masked killer unleashes hell on Halloween.
Across different eras, a poor family, an anxious developer and a fed-up landlady become tied to the same mysterious house in this animated dark comedy.
A group of teens discovers secret plans for a time machine, and construct one. However, things start to get out of control.

Forest Scientist Sonia is torn from her ivory tower and thrown between the cross fires of an international mafia gang and multinational energy enterprises as she secretly conducts research in a restricted area in the Canadian wilderness.
The Chipmunks compete with the Chipettes in a round the world race.
A horror film based on an urban legend

Archaeologist Kirsten Scott travels to Slovakia to view a priest's diary, from the 1700s. It holds clues to a burial site, deep in the mountains. The thrill of discovery turns to horror, as the tomb contains something not quite dead.
A family struggles to repel a Caribbean evil spirit who haunts their house.
Secret agent Nam-kung infiltrates a North Korean operation in Japan that is responsible for kidnapping travelling South Korean and taking them to Pyeongyang
A San Francisco attorney (Dean Martin) is hired to defend a black militant accused of murder.
An Iranian jeweler who helped arrest a thief discovers that the culprit has been released from prison and is out for revenge.
Justin owes a debt to a ruthless drug dealer. A dangerous cult urges him to repay his debts by submitting to a gory and invasive procedure. Trading soft flesh for hard cash may be his only way out.
Ryan, a good-natured slacker, is tempted into a money laundering scheme while working for a lottery magazine. A capitalistic comedy that asks the question - when is "enough" enough?
People from various walks of life find themselves held captive in a desolate area surrounding a secret government installation rumored to contain extraterrestrial life.

An old Gothic cathedral built over a mass grave develops strange powers that trap a number of people inside with ghosts from a 12th Century massacre seeking to resurrect an ancient demon from the bowels of the Earth.

movie_name: Pettson and Findus: Findus Moves House
synopsis: The old man Petterson is trying to sleep but his cat Findus is keeping him awake, so they both agree that Findus shall have his own house. Based on the beloved books by Sven Nordqvist.
Van Helsing is called upon to help save a missing girl and her friends from a hoard of demons.

A young attorney cannot defend himself against accusations that he murdered his business partner, as he has no memory of the night it happened. A fraternity pin found at the scene of the crime becomes the key to solving the mystery.
A story that revolves around three sisters who live in their grandmother's home and the arrival of their thirteen-year-old half sister.
A group of friends try to keep their heads straight on New Year's Eve as unexplainable events begin to occur, causing hysteria, paranoia, and distrust between them.

A new, single, young doctor comes to town, taking over from a retiring doctor. The young women are excited and the old women have something to gossip about. He proves to be honest, competent and reliable. Who's the lucky lady?

One of the world's top bodyguards gets a new client, a world class hitman who must testify at the International Criminal Court. They must put their differences aside and work together to make it to the trial alive and on time.
Children who were held hostage in their elementary school tell stories of miraculous things, but many adults are skeptical that the Cokeville Miracle ever truly happened.

A young couple announces their wedding at a party with friends. The reactions of the latter reveal hitherto unexpressed sentimental flaws within the group. The following days, the tension rises to the surface.

Believing that a German spy has killed her new husband (Franchot Tone), a struggling chorus girl (Jean Harlow) flees to Paris where she meets and marries a World War I pilot (Cary Grant), whose carefree ways bring unexpected results.
In March 1914, a mining engineer named Richard Hannay tries to prevent Prussian Agents from executing a political assassination designed to trigger World War I.

On the day of his girlfriend's marriage, Gautam gets kidnapped by an unknown criminal. Bored on the way to the kidnapper's den, Gautam is forced to narrate his cute love story which is filled with loads of twists and turns.

Alexr is coming from the West to Belgrade for the restitution of his family's property and with the intent of making an opera. As pressure mounts, so does his obsession with his anarchist psychiatrist as he faces mental breakdown.
This portrays harmony and friction involving oriental and Mediterranean factions, both proficient at martial artistry, but one is dabbling in illicit dealings fronted by a nightclub.
In war-torn Eastern Europe, a mysterious businessman hires a group of mercenaries on a routine mission to protect him not knowing of the long-hidden secret that lies there.
A man becomes involved in a turbulent crime streak after kidnapping a woman
Follows two British officers, Harry Jones and Cedric Hill, who escape from a remote Turkish P.O.W. camp by using a Ouija board.
Sequel of 'Attack the Block'.
After a collision with a shipping container at sea, a resourceful sailor finds himself, despite all efforts to the contrary, staring his mortality in the face.
Business partners plan to gift a third of share to their children, if they marry, the offspring refusing to the marriage loses the portion. The children have other ideas.
When the coolest guy in school discovers that the new girl sees through his popularity and good looks, he enlists the class nerd to take over his social media accounts to add substance to his style.

Following his mother's death, the protagonist returns from the US to his ancestral home to fulfill his mother's last wish. Upon arrival he understands that the world of black magic and sorcery he heard as stories were not far from real.

Alain is a boxer in 1925 Marseille, France. When he doesn't take the dive paid to take by a mob boss, he has to split. He joins the Foreign Legion and is sent to Morocco. He makes 3 friends and they watch each other's backs.

A team of martial arts and weapon masters, led by the revenge-seeking Aika, hunt down and destroy yakuza organizations in Japan. When they meet up with the Black Bullet organization, however, they may have met their match.
Teenaged boy Ricky needs to uncover the mystery behind a murderous psychopath known as the Axeman.
A young man inherits the family home only to be hunted by entities fixed on revenge for crimes committed by his great grandfather 50 years ago.
Robot 13 is created so Adrian has a friend, but the metal marvel teaches the whole community what it means to have a heart.
When normal kids try to be famous, it becomes a comedy. And where there is a comedy, tragedy is not too far behind. A story about friendship and loss set in Arizona.
Feature adaptation of Hajime Isayama's manga about a monster hunter out for revenge.
An imprisoned criminal rats out his former boss for one last chance to reunite his family and become the father he never was.
A man visits a small town hoping to investigate the creation of a machine that is said to visualize your consciousness. Upon arriving he finds the machine has created controversy among the townsfolk.
Wrongly accused man fights to clear his name and uncover the real killer, as 'Damaged' streams it live on dark web in BLAMED.
When a group of friends come across an abandoned house in the barren desert, what follows is a terrifying tale of evil possession causing the friends to slowly turn against each other.
Greta's dad Tom is moving the family cross-country in a dented station wagon, promising a California paradise to his kids. All that's missing is Mom.
Follows a woman as her life gets upended when an engagement ring that was for someone else leads her to the person she's meant to be with.
Pursued by the big-time gambler he robbed, John Muller assumes a new identity, with unfortunate results.

A girl is about to inherit a fortune, but she is missing in Africa. Only then, family charges Congo Bill, an adventurer, to find her, and bring her back to civilization. He follows a legend about some White Queen, but his path is full of difficulties, by an inhospitable jungle, and the man who will lose the fortune if the girl is found alive.
A Las Vegas cabbie enlists the help of a UFO expert to protect two siblings with paranormal powers from the clutches of an organization that wants to use the kids for their nefarious plans.
A serial killer in Los Angeles celebrates Jack the Ripper's 100th birthday by committing similar murders and only one has a chance of stopping him.
Shot in one single take with no cuts, Rendez-vous is an original Mexican thriller about a couple who meet online.

movie_name: Don't Go Into the House by the Woods
synopsis: A young man goes to his parents house over the weekend and is scared to death when he starts to receive phone calls from a psycho who might be inside the house.
Two businessmen, a prostitute, a hitman and a gang of thugs all fight over the ransom money of a kidnapping.

A group of friends find themselves the captors of a sadistic madman when they stumble upon an underground torture chamber filled with unspeakable horrors while hatching a plan to get revenge on the bully who has been tormenting them.
A gender-swapped retelling of Charles Perrault's classic, where Cinderfella is visited by a fairy godfather to help him escape from his wicked stepmother and stepbrothers.
Juliette, a lone survivor of an apocalyptic era, fights to survive against hunger, thirst, a broken leg and strange, disturbing creatures that only come out at nighttime.
A group of Chinese youths living in Japan struggle to make their way in life and eventually find trouble with the local crime syndicate.
Accidentally sent to China, out little hero needs to not only find his way in a foreign place he suddenly finally finds himself in but also to help his friends before he can return home.

movie_name: The Girl Who Ventured West, a Johnny Appleseed Story
synopsis: After losing her parents, job, and relationship; Finn, a pessimistic paralegal struggling to find her own path, finds herself swept up in a westbound adventure of American Folklore, led by none other than a modern day Johnny Appleseed.

Story of a promising high school basketball star and his relationships with two brothers, one a drug dealer and the other a former basketball star fallen on hard times and now employed as a security guard.

movie_name: Eternal Love of Su-il and Sun-ae
synopsis: Sim Sun-ae leaves Lee Su-il and marries the rich man Kim Chung-bae. Lee Su-il takes a job with a Japanese moneylender to collect money from his borrowers. Soon, Sun-ae fell ill because she could not forget Lee Su-il.
When his father is murdered, erstwhile conman Nick Darrow asks the cops if he can go undercover to find the killers, and maybe even stop a crime ring that has been plaguing the police.
A gang of men are searching for an alien life form.
A trilogy of three improbable stories of horror and the supernatural are combined into this low budget thriller: "That's the Way to Do It," "Dreamhouse,," and "Do You Believe in Fairies?"
Two cops investigating the murder of a young boy become invloved in a very secret project involving alien life. Needless to say, the authorities don't want them to stick their noses into this.
After saying "no" on her wedding day, Joice leaves the Ivory Coast to start a new life in Guangzhou, China.

'Holidays' is an anthology feature film that puts a uniquely dark and original spin on some of the most iconic and beloved holidays of all time by challenging our folklore, traditions and assumptions.
A couple endures a series of mishaps right before their wedding day.
From the strange horizon he came - bringing justice to a place of violence and greed.

An exploration of British history, culture and society since King Arthur. It opens on two protagonists dressed in white presenting and arguing their views on the 10 rules that really govern Great Britain and the United Kingdom.

Astronaut Kathryn Voss, sole survivor of a disastrous space mission, is desperate to reunite with her terminally ill daughter but becomes a fugitive when the government discovers she's returned to earth with an extraordinary gift.
A man is given the choice between having fabulous wealth or saving an innocent man from the death penalty.
A magical helper instructs a young man on how to take everything in life and create something special in order to survive and prosper in a harsh and dangerous world.

When Belle, struggling with the loss of her mom, is sent to live with her grandfather, she soon becomes the savior of all living things! An old race horse and Atticus the dog change Belle's life, and in turn the life of those who love her.

Your digital life is for sale. Who's going to buy the power. Does the world know? Data scientists Simon and Lacey from The Fruity Advertising Agency attend a tech conference only to find their computer taken over by a mysterious force.

Miles Morales catapults across the Multiverse, where he encounters a team of Spider-People charged with protecting its very existence. When the heroes clash on how to handle a new threat, Miles must redefine what it means to be a hero.

movie_name: The Jester's Plane: A Curious Journey Down the Rabbithole
synopsis: 5 years after the actual tragic events, the Jester embarks on a curious journey down a mysterious rabbithole. A comedic conspiracy about the necessity of critical thinking.
An African game hunter sends his young son to school in London, but the boy is lonesome until he discovers the zoo.
An Adivasi 13-year-old from Telangana becomes the youngest girl in history to climb Mount Everest.

Tony is a Sicilian man whose job is to prepare bread with spleen. He undergoes a genetic mutation after being buried by a load of rubbish and his super-power consists in hitting the enemies with slices of spleen.
Patrik Bergman returns to Stockholm after a couple of years. He had to leave the capital when he was the suspect of a bank robbery.

movie_name: Eiga Hugtto! Precure x Futari wa Precure: All Stars Memories
synopsis: The Pretty Cures were attacked by a monster called Miden and it turns them into infants. Hana Nono, Nagisa Misumi, and Honoka Yukishiro worked together to stop this new villain and turning the other cures back to normal.
In a robot world, a young idealistic inventor travels to the big city to join his inspiration's company, only to find himself opposing its sinister new management.

A Danish man's girlfriend is killed by a drunk driver. After a stay at a mental hospital he decides to kill someone dear to each of the 4 men in the car. 3 police detectives try to solve the "random" murders.
The Autobots must stop a colossal planet consuming robot who goes after the Autobot Matrix of Leadership. At the same time, they must defend themselves against an all-out attack from the Decepticons.
A spacecraft carrying a group of space tourists crash lands on the moon, awakening a terrifying creature. The survivors soon find themselves fighting for survival in uncharted territory.
A killer terrorizes the small German town of Hainsburg. The police moves in to investigate the crimes and finds a suspect among a small group of teenagers.

A military base. An awkward soldier. A statue of Bach. And suddenly all guns in the area change into music instruments. Great mystery is immediately found by TV station. And soon the military base becomes a stage for huge TV show.
Writer Frans and his favorite character J.Kessels go to the Hamburg Reeperbahn to return a philandering crook to his wife and to finally fulfill Frans' pre-masturbatory sexual dreams.

Behind the appearance of a quite family hides an unsettling secret. Everything will change for Samuel, Neila and their daughter Vicky. A unique police commissioner has to deal with an something which would have been better not to reveal.

Husband and wife, Gunnar and Sonja go to a remote house in the Icelandic country side. Shortly after their arrival strange things start to happen that might jeopardize their marriage as well as their lives.

James Kane receives an unexpected invitation to attend Oktoberfest from an old girlfriend in Germany, and is soon plunged into the nightmare world of modern espionage where he must confront the demons of his past if he is to survive.

Thirty years after he killed a business associate, the godfather of an underground casino empire is murdered. His daughter takes charge of the family's business and wants to revenge him. Others are bent on revenge against her.
A couple hires a professional digger (underground structure explorer) to help them find their friends, who mysteriously disappeared in the subway.
When a dying planet need a hero, a child from the shadows must find the courage to leads us into the light.
An environmentally-friendly botanist discovers that she is part of a hidden magical world inhabited by fairies and elves.
As mass of solar storms causes tsunamis, volcanoes, and flooding, a city-dwelling family attempts to flee to the relative safety of a group of high-elevation caves several miles away.
A high-tech entrepreneur allows wealthy sportsmen to hunt inmates in a virtual-reality prison.
The desire of a 7 year old boy to be a member in a Chinese opera, his hard life at school and acceptance of his society.
In the year 2100, a filmmaker interviews his grandfather about the climate.
In this experimental update of Jack and the Beanstalk (ital), a streetwise pot dealer is catapulted on a mystical adventure when he trades his father's gold watch for a pair of psychotropic seeds.

A boy who has nothing and a girl who seems to have everything embark on an adventure following fake Santa in the middle of the night. That night all of their Christmas wishes come true, but not quite the way they've each expected.
An aristocratic family travels to the untamed land of the west to protect their dark secret.

A journalist attempting to solve a mystery in "Martial World" enlists the aid of a master fighter and a woman named Green Breeze. They go to a mysterious castle where they come across poisonous butterflies and a black-leather-clad killer.
After stealing a supernatural relic, a couple must outmaneuver the cunning sociopath sent to kill them.

Antonio and his son Pietro, alone in Milan to face cancer. Jaber, just fifteen, in Italy with a group of fellow countrymen. They will meet each others in the hospital. The disease is the pretext for a meeting.
A machine from a post-apocalyptic future travels back in time to protect a man and a woman from an advanced robotic assassin to ensure they both survive a nuclear attack.
A rodeo star goes up against a powerful casino owner to save the woman he loves in this romantic thrill ride set against the exciting backdrop of the National Finals Rodeo in Las Vegas.
A team of secret agents are sent around the world to track down and expose weapons of mass destruction and take down corrupt government officials and criminal king pins.
This serial told the story of the diamond heir loom of the Stanley family.
The story of Binnaz, one of the famous beauties of the Tulip Age, and the men in love with her.
A young writer who follows strangers for material meets a thief who takes him under his wing.
A shipwrecked captain saves a girl from a Spanish murderer by threatening to give him leprosy.
A British professor must find an ancient artifact as a ransom for his daughter's life.
When an ancient underground civilization and their snake-like guardian plots to reclaim the surface world, those of the surface fights back.

A group of spring-breakers find themselves on a single propeller airplane. Bad decisions and a brutal thunderstorm, result in a hellish, panic inducing flight, which leads to a crash into Open Water. This is where the true horror begins.
The mysterious murders of women keeps a city in fear.

One by one members of a special project team are being killed by telekinesis - the ability to move things with the power of the mind alone. The race is to determine which of the remaining team members is the murderer and how to stop them.

When three estranged friends are entrusted to scatter their friend's ashes in the mountains they met 30 years earlier; they must rediscover a past they've turned their back on, and remember what true female solidarity is all about.
An ex-con man and his five trained Dobermans help a Treasury Dept. agent stop a racketeer and his gang.
An officer aiming to infiltrate a drug dealing family uses a lady with a past and her son as cover to gain entry and uncover their secrets
A group of recovering addicts are taken on a retreat in the desert to work on their sobriety, only to find much more sinister forces awaiting them.

movie_name: The Private Lives of Pippa Lee
synopsis: After her much older husband forces a move to a suburban retirement community, Pippa Lee engages in a period of reflection and finds herself heading toward a quiet nervous breakdown.
Prequel to "5th of a Degree."
When a farmer's wife is brutally murdered by the ruthless bandit Bobby Durango and his gang of killers, Billy Rogers goes back to his old gun and starts to hunt them one by one.
A pair of detectives is assigned to investigate a murder, and discover a trail of corruption and criminal activity that leads right back to their own police department.
A female film crew journeys to Africa where a giant ape, Queen Kong, falls in love with the crew's male star.
A tough, slobby, honest cop tries to simultaneously take down heroin dealers and a corrupt businessman who murdered a burglar, even if it costs him his life.
A Nazi hunter in Paraguay discovers a sinister and bizarre plot to rekindle the Third Reich.
A lonely man called Dávid downloads an unknown software one day what can be used to rewrite reality and fate.
Young southerner Marco Russo moves to Northern Italy and finds work with the powerful Manzetti family. He then proceeds to stir the pot between the Manzettis and their top rivals, the Belmondos.
The story of the famous Saint-Poet Manjunatha.
An adaptation of Hans Christian Andersen's fairy tale "The Snow Queen".
The Henderson family adopt a friendly Sasquatch but have a hard time trying to keep the legend of 'Bigfoot' a secret.

An Epidemic has overwhelmed the nation and Andrew, a family man, suspects that his wife Julie might have it. His mission is to escape with his daughter before she gets infected, but his gangster brother poses a problem.

movie_name: Zhongkui: Snow Girl and the Dark Crystal
synopsis: Legendary Chinese anti-hero Zhong Kui, a young man endowed with mysterious powers who is forced into a battle among the realms of Heaven, Earth and Hell in the course of his attempt to save his countrymen and the woman he loves.
American airline pilot out for a holiday, finds a beautiful girl, a man's corpse, and a charge of complicity in murder, all in quick succession going Paris by Night.
When a teenager finds himself caught in a glitchy-glitzy reality with his onscreen male idol, he does all he can to be possessed by this man and ignore the violent clues of how he got there.
A delusional misfit becomes suicidal when his favorite TV show is cancelled. An agent promises to make him a TV star if he kills certain people, so he becomes "The Baby Mask Killer."

movie_name: For Whom the Alchemist Exists: The Movie
synopsis: A shaky truce between a group of kingdoms is maintained by a ban on practicing alchemists. However, a group of alchemists from these lands unite to enable peaceful cooperation.
On her 7th birthday, Princess Barbara discovers a magical book that transports her to Wonderland - an enchanted place filled with dragons and fantastic creatures.

Three childhood friends camp out in the desert. During the night, one of them is attacked by an unknown animal, so they decide to head to the nearest town, but, they get attacked by an army of demonic children.
A criminal has come out of hiding only to find that his old partner has become a priest and his girlfriend has been forced to marry a powerful mob boss.
Punk rock gangs and music groups clash with one another and the brutal police force in a futuristic Tokyo setting.
Two very close brothers, one autistic, spend their days living in fantasy together until a girl inevitably comes between them.
A neglected and frustrated wife looks for satisfaction outside her marriage and gets involved with a group of hippies.
A young Japanophile Belgian woman in Tokyo falls into a whirlwind romance with a Francophile Japanese student.
Seven year-old old twin brothers, separated during the Civil War in Tajikistan, face each other years later in a new war where one is an American soldier and the other is Taliban.

An ex-policeman returns to the town of his childhood and immerses himself into a deep state of narcolepsy that makes him hallucinate of a woman who seems to encourage him to disarm a police network of prostitution and women trafficking.
A romance blooms between Quattro (Beaumont) and Noza (Hernandez), two kids caught up in the illegal street car racing scene of Southern California.
It's the first night of their first tour for all female NYC punk band, The Nemesisters, and it might just be their last night on Earth.
The adventure of Cutie Honey, a super heroine who can transform into anything using her necklace to switch on and say "Honey Flash!".
A women's support group becomes the target of a misogynistic brotherhood.
A Yakuza smuggler gets involved with a Korean prostitute.
Believe it or not but the World is part of two different energies. "Good and Evil". What happens when they collide? Who wins? And at what cost?
Works of art are disappearing, stolen by a master thief, a master of disguise. Father Brown has two goals: to catch the thief and to save his soul.
Four assassins/college students meet for the first time to start their new assignment in Dallas.
To gain more subscribers, a controversial social media influencer stays at a cursed hotel to terrifying results.
A filmmaker, his girlfriend, his female colleague, and their rich Producer are to spend a weekend making a documentary within an isolated haunted cottage in Wales.

A Vietnam veteran with a psychic connection to sharks discovers their exploitation by the local aquarium and begins an underwater reign of terror to avenge them. The movie action scenes were shot using real sharks.
Strangers searching for a young woman's missing father arrive at a tropical island where a doctor desperately seeks the cause and cure of a recent epidemic of the undead.

Cinnamon colored, expressive button eyes and clearly showing the wear and tear of a dramatic lifetime. Theo tries to understand what all the commotion is about him. After all he is just an old teddy bear.
An assassin seeks redemption after being given a second chance at life.
Unable to cope with his wife's death, J.M. flees to his sister's desolate farm where he was married one year ago. There, he finds himself haunted by memories and visions of his dead wife, Andrea.
Plot kept under wraps.
A young woman who suffers a strange disease must travel to a mysterious island in South America, where the myths and the reality do not have differences.
Using his trained dog, a rookie cop tries to prove his friend innocent of a robbery, despite the police commissioner's objection.

A capitalist takes over a count's bankrupt estate to build a big fish based factory. However, his daughter gets the castle. Inspecting it, she's mistaken for the new maid by the young count. There's an attraction.

When an executive returns home to handle succession issues for his dying father's business, he uncovers a dark secret that threatens his life and the life of any person who seeks to expose the scientific horrors done in his family's name.
An ex-model gets caught up in lust, murder and betrayal when a gun-wielding man pays her a visit.
Five international thieves meet in Cape Town to steal the most valuable stamp in the world.

Manny Velazquez's first underground independent cult horror film about three students that are brutally murdered over the weekend as the students and staff are getting ready for the annual 'Wildcat Night', but the murderer walks among the peers ready to strike again, in this slasher flick.
A rough and tumble loser tries to survive a series of chaotic events in a world of booze, sex, guns and dingy motels.
Philo Vance, accompanied by his prize-losing Scottish terrier, investigates the locked-room murder of a prominent and much-hated collector whose broken Chinese vase provides an important clue.
Set during the War of Independence, the film is the story of a group of people trying to smuggle weapons to Anatolia.
A broken-down, faded musician struggles with the haunting memories of an abusive past and and makes amends the only way he knows how -- through blood shed.
Pocketman and Cargoboy both learn a dark secret that will change the future of Section 62. The Viper Sniper makes his move and proves to be more than the young agents can handle.
An aging lawman is convinced a mysterious stranger arrested in his small town is innocent. His investigation stirs up a hornet's nest that will change the town forever.

The Inspector is an immortal time traveler who traverses the farthest reaches of time and space, accompanied by his trusted Associates. Along the way, they solve mysteries, help the helpless, and do battle with various and dastardly foes.
A fungus brought from space threatens to grow and spread, devouring everyone in its path.

A queer lady holiday romantic comedy that follows the lives of three very different couples in dealing with their love lives in various loosely interrelated tales all set right before Christmas through New Years.
Victim of a plot which has resulted in his imprisonment in a Central African jail for two years, a French secret agent arrives in Paris to settle accounts.
A young boy, who has stowed away on a camping trip for the school wilderness club, must use his wits in order to rescue the club from a pair of kidnappers.
The story of Tevar revolves around the ideology of a woman's strength. Never underestimate the power of a woman, she is a riddle which can never be solved.
An idiot heir helps a wounded prince save the princess from forced marriage to a usurper.
Pablo returns to his home village to confront his fears.
A modern take on the classic fairytale, Alice in Wonderland, set in the North East of England.
Bob is coming to terms with his unsuccessful attempts at becoming an actor when he is bitten by a vampire named Susan - the daughter of a crazed vigilante slayer.
A team of astronauts land on an inhabitable planet and form a society. Many years later, a single astronaut is sent to the planet and becomes a messiah.
Astronaut, Doug Adams, comes back to earth after 10 years in space...to find humans are no longer top of the food chain.
In a corrupt, greed-fueled world, a powerful alchemist leads a messianic character and seven materialistic figures to the Holy Mountain, where they hope to achieve enlightenment.
A man tries to find out the meaning behind an obscure nightmare that is haunting him.
The cruel Tien Hu, with his many powerful alliances, oppresses an entire Chinese province, killing many of the hard working citizens.

movie_name: Mam diaw hua liam hua laem
synopsis: A man from Thailand moves to Bangkok, while staying in a relative's house a child ghost appears to him claiming to be his future son Dio. Dio is there to help his future father and his future mother fall in love.

A band of artifact hunters are in search of the lucrative Diamond Eye magic jewel. Their intentions are less than pure and in order save the world from this evil; a band of Thai martial arts experts are called upon to intervene.
In an era where aliens have invaded and conquered feudal Tokyo, a young samurai seeks work as he can.

A group of high school students are sent to Detention. Abandoned and locked in, images of Ghosts appear as they attempt to escape, only to find themselves connected to a past horrific death and made responsible for it with their lives.
Inger has lived a peaceful family life until one day vikings invade and she must survive. But a supernatural force will awaken.

A dim-witted busboy finds acclaim as an artist for a plaster-covered dead cat that is mistaken as a skillful statuette. The desire for more praise soon leads to an increasingly deadly series of works.
George has been given the contract of killing Rishin. Later, he realizes that his client and target are the same, as Rishin is a schizophrenic and wants to die.
Giorgio's poor parents sell their son to Milan to work as a chimney sweeper. There he joins the «Black Brothers».
Animated cartoon for children, based on various stories by Hans Christian Andersen.
After being attacked by a werewolf, a teenager believing it may have been his stepfather attempts to expose him.
A group of strangers are trapped inside a massive labyrinth cube and struggle to find their way out. A remake of the 1997 film, 'Cube'.
Any idea how to start a revolution?
Two powerful female warriors must journey across a post-apocalyptic land to fight a ritual duel, and fulfill an ancient prophecy.
Fritz (Nick Huber), Snark (Jacob Lyngle), and Bubbles (Griffin Strycharske) are thrown into a mysterious cryptozoological cult event and must stop the rising of an ancient, monstrous being.

Rain, a woman raised from childhood to be an assassin with a gold-star rating. When she becomes romantically involved with a civilian and a job goes south, she must keep the people she loves from becoming collateral damage.
It's the 23rd century, and the world's most dangerous criminal has taken over the maximum security prison on asterod Alpha 4. Caught in the middle are a petty thief and a prison transport pilot.
An all-guts, no-glory San Francisco cop becomes determined to find the underworld kingpin that killed the witness in his protection.
After a small earthquake in a tiny, quiet town, local citizens start to exhibit bizarre, violent and self-destructive behaviour.
Petty robbers on the run from gangsters and police end up in a town where they are mistaken for police officers.

In an economically devastated Alaskan town, a fisherman with a troublesome past dates a woman whose young daughter does not approve of him. When he witnesses the murder of his shady brother, he, the woman and the kid run to the wilderness.
Plot kept under wraps.
A woman arrives at a lonely mansion and finds herself mixed up with a lunatic who has built his own torture chamber, which is already crowded with victims - and he plans to make her his next one.
Kids are sucked into their TV and have to fight pirates to return home
While spending their annual vacation on a small Mediterranean Island, nine bourgeois family members are stalked and killed one by one by a mysterious killer.
Based on the popular novel by Francine Pascal, Victoria Martin and her mother just do not get along. It takes a curious incident for Victoria to realize that her mother was once also a teenager.
Two friends go on a surreal and hair-raising trip across Britain
Haunted by images, "deja vu", Karen Gold wanders through her life, finally guided by Mark Blackhawk, her broker's advice as he places her into destiny hands.
A film crew travels out to a village in Anatolia to shoot a movie. But after each were affected by a dream they saw, the remaining four team members decide to stay and investigate the incident.
After an accident, a chauvinistic executive gains the ability to hear what women are really thinking.

Malaal is the story of Shiva and Astha, two very different people from contrasting backgrounds who experience the innocence of love. Does their love find its destination or do they part ways? Stay on this journey to find out.
Two good-for-nothing brothers are embroiled in a conspiracy involving a political assassination and try their best to save the country.
After their plane crashes in Alaska, six oil workers are led by a skilled huntsman to survival, but a pack of merciless wolves haunts their every step.
A monster named Larry manifests itself through smart phones and mobile devices. Feature film version of the 2017 short film.
The Awakening in the Middle Kingdom of the Lycans,
1852 Munich. The Austrian Ambassador's son is to marry Annie Tomasini when he is in love with her sister Thérèse.
In this film, Lee Jeok-yo is a respected poet who cares fondly for his 30ish year old disciple Seo Ji-woo. The world of these two men is shaken when 17-year-old Han Eun-gyo comes into the picture.
A group of Irish noblemen kidnap girls in order to marry into their fortune and avoid becoming priests or soldiers.
In a dystopian future, the Vatican knows how to resurrect people. A priest discovers a conspiracy behind the resurrections and their possible link to a series of murders.
An alien crash-lands and is helped by a teenage girl and her slightly younger brother.
A young man and a woman meet various obstacles in their relationship. Their love, however, is stronger.
A woman becomes terrified of a strange man who stalks her from his window just across the street.
A partially under construction office tower is being haunted by a deadly presence which seems to target the building's architect.
A taut, economical policier-cum-gang-hostage thriller.

Probably the most famous puppet show for children and all ages. Mice who have to leave their school and immigrate because of a wild cat who wants to eat them up. Eventually the mice defeat the cat and go back to their home.
A former police officer calls two outlaws to help him to capture a notorious and ruthless bandit who murdered his family members.
Rumpelstiltskin tricks a mid-life crisis burdened Shrek into allowing himself to be erased from existence and cast in a dark alternate timeline where Rumpelstiltskin rules supreme.
Masoud takes his wife who has neurotic tensions to the asylum to take care of her but..
A film preservationist struggling with his relationship and career discovers a priceless motion picture artifact he thinks will solve all his problems.

movie_name: Para ligo, para ponto, para triha
synopsis: The dead end of a love triangle. A woman in love with two men, in a relationship where they can not touch each other and break their bonds.
A psycho who has contracted AIDS blames women for his disease, and begins to stalk and kill beautiful girls.

The Intellectual wears a suit and works hard. He grades papers and exercises at work just a bit to keep his body and mind in great shape. The lame chore takes a toll, and he tortures texts with fatal results. His guilt is too much for him.

Vampires rule the world for thousand years disguised as wealthy humans, while humanity has been relegated to middle-class, poor and miserable. Hopekillers use the suffering within the human blood to process their technology.
While he's a houseguest at an upper-class gathering, wealthy Jewish man Ferdinand de Levis is robbed of £1,000 with evidence pointing towards the guilt of another guest, Captain Dancy.
A road racing reckless juvenile delinquent city boy, without any parental control, finally met his match. It wasn't from a rival school or a faster car - It was a girl.
A trigger-happy outlaw goes on the run and a burned out, disillusioned cop gives chase. They end up head-to-head in a Los Angeles shoot out.

Years following the events of The Shining (1980), a now-adult Dan Torrance must protect a young girl with similar powers from a cult known as The True Knot, who prey on children with powers to remain immortal.
A boy meets a girl in an airport and falls in love with her, but he has only 2 hours to convince her.
A man journeys through apocalyptic Australia on a mission to charge his phone and re-connect with his missing wife.

movie_name: Sicarivs: La noche y el silencio
synopsis: A hit man receives the assignment to kill a woman. But what seems like another routine job gets complicated when he spares her life, and he has just one night to find and take out the people who hired him.
Xin Lan owns a declining MMA club. After being defeated, she asks a retired MMA superstar to combat on her behalf to reclaim her honor and rebuild the club.
Young writer moves into a house that slowly sucks the energy out of his body.
CONTENTS FROM A STOLEN BAG MOTIVATES TWO CROOKED COPS ON AN INVESTIGATION THAT QUICKLY GOES DOWN HILL.

movie_name: Big Fat American Monster: Operation KAIJU
synopsis: In the final stages of WWII the United States unleashes a giant fire breathing monster upon the Japanese cities of Hiroshima and Nagasaki, created by the Allies' top secret "Operation K.A.I.J.U" program.
Beautiful young women who work at the offices of a phone-sex company are being stalked by a psychopathic killer.
A scientist awakens King Arthur and his knights, and the forces of good and evil do battle once more.
Two poor sisters met a young owner of fancy restaurant. The younger sister fall in love with the young owner, even though the two sisters decided to kidnap him for ransom.
Mama O Chandamama is a Telugu Village love comedy, starring Ram Karthik as lead and Sana Khan as female lead.
How far would you go to save your soul? Noah is haunted by this very question when a shadowy stranger offers him a disturbing choice: kill or be killed.
Four teenagers escape to a deserted beach for a weekend of discovery, only to find that their dreams turn into nightmares

Nathan and Lucas are together for several years, and they understand they don't fit exactly to each other : they don't have the same dreams and ideas for their future - Their love will be strong enough to overcome the obstacles.
10-year-old Martin meets a cat, who turns into a boy who helps Martin to solve his problems which occured after he changed school.
Remake of Bigas Luna's cult horror modern classic 'Anguish' (1987)

Unscrupulous girl traders transport unsuspecting blonde girls from a nightclub in Amsterdam to a brothel in Havana. The young journalist Verena Linkmann wants to expose the slave trade, disguises herself as an available dancer.
A woman, Rose, goes in search for her adopted daughter within the confines of a strange, desolate town called Silent Hill.
Isabella Montoya is a Green Agent, an assassin employed by the government to eliminate CO2 emissions by eliminating the population, one sacrificial lamb at a time.
Chris Taro is sentenced to twenty five years in prison for aggravated robbery and felony murder. Placed in solitary confinement, he must find a way to cope within the 8 by 10 box he now resides in.
After 8-year-old Mia loses her mother, her family moves to Grandma's Montana ranch. In the woods, Mia discovers a unicorn colt: a magical creature that brings luck to anyone who believes in it.
Live-action adaptation of Roald Dahl's tale of a boy who sails to New York with the help of some insect friends inside a giant peach.
A deadly virus attacks the crew of a Saturn space station.
Following the disappearance of his girlfriend, a young man investigates a mysterious figure online who is believed to cause the deaths of those who 'friend' him on Facebook.
In order to stop a vampire from terrorizing the countryside, some locals decide to break into his coffin at night and steal his ashes. Complications ensue.
A Chinese special force soldier with extraordinary marksmanship is confronted by a group of deadly foreign mercenaries who are hired to assassinate him by a vicious drug lord.
On the night before Halloween, three strange events change the lives and deaths of those involved.
A deal between Mitch, a British gangster and the Mafia go wrong.
Stranded together on an industrial rooftop in the midst of a global pandemic, strangers Cillian and Ellen battle starvation, dehydration, and each other.
A riveting action adventure spanning Hong Kong, Philadelphia, the luxurious Amalfi Coast and into the heart of some scandalous hidden secrets.

Two friends plan to steal the sheep from the ranch where they work and make a killing selling them. When the plan seemed like it could actually work, Maria, a young girl learning her ways with men, appears to shake things up even more.
While vacationing in Los Angeles, Carmella finds herself in the midst of a crisis after her friend Molly goes missing, all while exploring the city.

movie_name: The Ice Age Adventures of Buck Wild
synopsis: The Ice Age Adventures of Buck Wild continues the escapades of the possum brothers Crash and Eddie who set out to find a place of their own. Together with the one-eyed weasel, Buck Wild, they face the dinosaurs who inhabit the Lost World.
A genetically-engineered world. All Layla wanted was to fit in and be happy. But her nemesis wouldn't let her.
Six men must complete various tasks before moving up the ladder in the crime world. Each more dangerous than the last.
A blackmailing Lady tries to force a millionaire's daughter to marry her crooked accomplice.
Two couples rent a vacation home for what should be a celebratory weekend get-away.
"Braveheart" meets "Gods and Generals."

movie_name: Mad Mission 3: Our Man from Bond Street
synopsis: A master thief is duped by lookalikes for James Bond and the Queen of England into stealing a valuable gem from a heavily guarded location then must help the police recover it.

movie_name: A Nightmare on Elm Street: The Dream Thief
synopsis: Thirty years after the dream child is born, high schoolers Milo and Zeiva face off against a mysterious fiend posing as Freddy Krueger while under the tutelage of the Dream Master, Alice Johnson.
When the Snow Queen, a lonely and powerful fairy, kidnaps the human boy Kay, his best friend Gerda must overcome many obstacles on her journey to rescue him.
A dead sea separates the almost-was and the art of letting go.
A man wrongfully convicted of murder escapes custody and goes in search of the real killer. The problem is that he only has one clue to go on.
Running away from his evil guardian Mombi, Tip runs off to the Emerald City, where he gets caught up in a palace coup with the Army of Revolt.
Balan, a businessman and widower, marries another woman after his first wife dies under mysterious circumstances. However, things get complicated for him when her body is found in his home.
About 3 wild girl, Alesya, Sofea and Hani who lead a hedonistic teen life. Their life is about to change when one of them fall in love with an Islamic preacher, Firdaus.
Subramania is sentenced to death for killing six policemen who were responsible for the murder of his father and sister. But officer Nandakumar decides to use his help to eradicate a terrorist group.
A single mom tries to break free from a mysterious organization that has abducted her.
The identity of a mysterious American diver by a British police officer, which leads to an investigation into a high-society family's links to international drug trafficking.
A senator's daughter (who can't help singing) follows her boyfriend West in the days of the California gold rush.
He lives in the shadows, she lives in the light, they want to escape both.
A lonely mother begins receiving romantic e-mails from a secret admirer, unaware that this perfect man is really a creation of her daughter who is trying to cheer her up.

Violinist Sydney Wells was accidentally blinded by her sister Helen when she was five years old. She submits to a cornea transplantation, and while recovering from the operation, she realizes that she is seeing dead people.

Sun Yat-Sen established Chinese Revolutionary Party. Shanghai revolutionary partisans want to find out the undercover in the party, so Zeng Shufan pretends to betray and get trust from Northern Government.

In a hot and politically challenged Cairo actress Aida and her neighbor, the aging diva Samiha, are thrown out on the streets. Together with the street smart Yassin, they try to find a place to live, forcing them to confront with their past.
In this touching adventure, a remake of the popular 1940 film, two Georgia young boys team up and befriend a feral bird dog, whom they train to participate in a field trials.
Follows three teenagers from Chicago who hijack their driver's ed car and embark on a journey down Route 66 to get to Los Angeles.

A young man promises his dying father that he'll be good and is rewarded with visions of fairies and a celestial being to guide and protect him in this world. A dark fairytale which mixes fantasy with reality.

Dozens of people begin dying daily in the city of Wonsan shortly after the outbreak of the Korean War. Fearing a plague, the United Nations asks that the situation be investigated before they will commit troops.
Dominic takes on the Irish mob that killed his son and left him for dead. Too bad they didn't realize he is a special ops trained professional who will stop at nothing to carry out his vengeance.
Two siblings kill a member of the mafia to save their father. Years later the children of the slain mobster search for their father's killer seeking revenge using advanced technology.
A boy with a Gun is a story of love and revenge from the perspective of the most unexpected hero.

Tom and wife lose their infant daughter tragically, then split and divorce. Tom finds his way back after nearly drowning surfing big waves. His discovery changes his life and reveals secret truths that transform the lives of others.
A mother and her young daughter move into a new house looking for a new start. But they soon realize that they will become part of a dark history.

The Underworld is ruled by organized crime syndicates, every crime lord wants to take control over the empire, but the Ramses family play by their own rules and they're about to bring a new order to the criminal organizations.
When a band of brutal gangsters led by a crooked property developer make a play to take over a local school, Master Ip is forced to take a stand.
Santa's clumsy son Arthur sets out on a mission with Grandsanta to give out a present they misplaced to a young girl in less than two hours.
The filmmaker has to go undercover and go through 3 trials in order to take down the mob boss known as Goldberg.
Plot under wraps.
A young man is unjustly accused of a robbery, and that prevents him of becoming a boy-scout as he so much wanted, as well as ruins her older sister's marriage, due to social prejudice.
An original space adventure.
The residents of vacation spot Seal Island find themselves terrorized by a pack of dogs -- the remnants of discarded pets by visiting vacationers.
A police superintendent plans to take down triads who are disrupting the social order.
Based on the classic novella, "Le petit prince", by Antoine de Saint-Exupery.

When a lifeguard catches wind of a dangerous anomaly off the coast of San Diego, she commissions a band of unlikely heroes to assist her on a suicide mission to save the west coast from total destruction.
Wong Fei-Hong and his once-rival, now friend, find themselves and their martial arts schools pitted against a rival school which uses a Kung Fu expert from the North to do their dirty work.
A young man is driven mad by his obsession with the repulsive diseased eye of the old man who cares for him.
On the day of her wedding, Precy who has the soul of Stefanie seek the help of Kim Atienza. The solar eclipse happens once every two years. The five waited two years for the eclipse to happen.
Before boxes are unpacked in their new home, newlyweds Tim and Emily, find themselves playing a very creepy game of hide and seek with a vengeful spirit.
An English doctor tracks a sadistic vampire that kidnapped his wife in hopes to save her before she falls victim to the vampire.
A man, Mel Waters, finds a strange bottomless hole on his property.

A summer in rural Oahu takes an exciting turn for two Brooklyn-raised siblings when a journal pointing to long-lost treasure sets them on an epic adventure with new friends, and leads them to reconnect with their Hawaiian heritage.
A bunch of misfits and gangsters embarks on a journey to find a lost and stolen diamond.
Three children combine super-powers to become the super hero Sigma and battle an evil alien sorceress.
The secretary to a psychiatrist finds herself caught up in the murder of a patient's wife and realizes that her life is also in danger.

movie_name: The Ornate Anatomy of Living Things
synopsis: A bookstore clerk living in Manhattan discovers a museum run by a strange old man that exists solely for the purpose of studying his life.
A pair of bank robbers knock off Bohemian tenants in search for their stolen loot.
The story about a sinister magician-dwarf, physically unable to love a woman. His wife's betrayals and an obsessive isolation drive him to despair.
A starship crew in the 23rd century goes to investigate the silence of a distant planet's colony, only to find just two survivors, a powerful robot, and the deadly secret of a lost civilization.

movie_name: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past
synopsis: When an evil long thought gone returns, it is up to Link and Zelda to seek out the Master Sword and stop the dark wizard Agahnim.

A boy from the village was murdered and a dog saw that killer and told Rois about the murderer but Rois could not talk to anybody about the murderer because nobody would care about a madman and country's law will not accept his speech.
Caught in the midst a blizzard, two survivors must stay alive in harsh climates.
A raging god of battle and a master samurai duke it out in a series of sword fights in a remote temple.
Private Targets is about a new elite classified fugitive tactical unit created by U.S. government track down, capture or eliminate America's most violent and rustles fugitives wanted dead or alive.

movie_name: Kiss the Girls and Make Them Die
synopsis: In this spoof of spy films, CIA agent, Kelly, is in Rio De Janeiro spying on a wealthy industrialist, David Ardonian, who secretly plans to turn the world sterile and repopulate it with his harem. UK spy, Susan Fleming, helps Kelly.
A disabled young by is granted a wish that allows him to become a superhero.

movie_name: The Girl with All the Gifts
synopsis: A scientist and a teacher living in a dystopian future embark on a journey of survival with a special young girl named Melanie.
A gloved killer murders women during the shooting of a movie.
The mummified body of Imhotep is shipped to a museum in London, where he once again wakes and begins his campaign of rage and terror.
Jr. and his friends get super powers again but goes horribly wrong.
A dying filmmaker makes one last movie. It goes badly. Oh, and there's a man-eating tree.
A man seeks revenge on the supernatural demons who killed his family. Based on the graphic novel written by Peter Siegel and illustrated by Brent White.

Three boys decided to set up a fake fashion shooting to tempt some top models in a far away house in the woods. On the fake set things go as they planned, until someone decide to perform a séance on the ruins of an old pagan temple.

Royal Marine Officer Michael Richards meets his first love Angela Bridges just before a ceremony at an English chapel but even though they are still in love he knows a secret which could part or reunite them forever.
A man who drowned comes back as a living dead. Hiding this fact from everyone, he tries to fulfill his bucket list before he runs out of time.
A neighborhood Fourth of July celebration is interrupted by a ferociously bizarre anomaly who overpowers a family in order to teach them how to become better people and more compliant citizens.
A scientist has discovered the secret to bringing the dead back to life in the laboratory of his private clinic by transferring the souls into the body of a fresh corpse.
A police chief sends his son to prison for explosion of a bridge.
A patriarch (Nedumudi Venu) of a royal family whose descendant was murdered, assigns the task of finding the culprit to two of his police officer nephews - Vivek (Jayaram) and Kishore (Indrajith).
After losing her husband to a senseless killing, a NYC cop takes the job of a small town sheriff to protect her estranged daughter, unaware of the towns dark past.

The Enterprise is diverted to the Romulan homeworld Romulus, supposedly because they want to negotiate a peace treaty. Captain Picard and his crew discover a serious threat to the Federation once Praetor Shinzon plans to attack Earth.

A doctor risks his own life to save his wife possessed by the spirit of a seductive peasant girl from ancient Greece.

A disgruntled phone company employee develops a device whereby those answering a phone can be murdered, and it's up to Nat Bridger to stop the killer.
RoboCop returns to protect the citizens of old Detroit but faces a deadly challenge when a rogue OCP member secretly creates a new, evil RoboCop 2.
A sleepy outback town in Australia is hit by unsolved, chilling murders like they've never seen before.
In order to be able to buy a gas station, a young couple run a speakeasy. Complications arise when the husband loses their money to bookies.
As allied POWs prepare for a soccer game against the German National Team to be played in Nazi-occupied Paris, the French Resistance and British officers are making plans for the team's escape.
Strange events happen in a small village in the north of Germany during the years before World War I, which seem to be ritual punishment. Who is responsible?

A young Russian girl is forced into a life of prostitution in Czarist Russia, and she and a British journalist find their lives endangered when she reveals to him information regarding the social crimes rampant in her country.
A masked vigilante who discovers the dark side to heroism. Going after the nation's most notorious super criminal leaves Sparks' life and reputation in ruins.
Sequel to the film "Mad Max: Fury Road".
The movie is based on the popular character from DC Comics.
Jesus Morales is an expert hitman, he's in congress to kill his former Congressman boss.

Jordi travels to La Palma to fulfill a promise, there he will meet Linda - They will never leave the island.
A sassy feline helps a family resolve its problems.

Two former thieves reunite to rob the biggest thief they know -- Moctesuma Valdez, a TV infomercial guru who's made millions selling worthless health products to poor Latino immigrants. When none of their affiliates want to go undercover as day laborers to pull off the heist, the two men turn to the real thing for help.

movie_name: The Santa Clause 3: The Escape Clause
synopsis: Santa, a.k.a. Scott Calvin, is faced with double-duty: how to keep his new family happy and how to stop Jack Frost from taking over Christmas.

Former musician and gunslinger El Mariachi arrives at a small Mexican border town after being away for a long time. His past quickly catches up with him and he soon gets entangled with the local drug kingpin Bucho and his gang.
A sexy mystery about temptation and primal forces set on a mystical island in the Bermuda triangle.
A Mexican-American Mafia kingpin is released from prison, falls in love for the first time, and grows introspective about his gangster lifestyle.
An American artist's obsession with a disturbing urban legend leads her to an investigation of the story's origins at the crumbling estate of a reclusive painter in Ireland.
Fast living Los Angelenos are targeted by the Central Intelligence Agency during Operation Midnight Climax, part of MKUltra.
Dr. Henry Jekyll experiments with scientific means of revealing the hidden, dark side of man and releases a murderer from within himself.

movie_name: Ultraman Ginga S: Showdown! Ultra 10 Warriors!!
synopsis: Etelgar curse the mind of Arina and used her power to seal 7 Ultraman then Haruno Musashi alongside with Ultraman Zero find UPG headquarters and help Ultraman Ginga and Victory to free other Ultraman and defeat Etelgar

A van carrying crores of cash. One rainy night in the outskirts of Mumbai. Unaware of each other, three stray gangs cross paths on the hunt. Unfortunately, all of them have the same plan. Will they bite the bone or will they lose to greed?
The story continues with Wuba after he parts way with his human parents Tian and Lan for his own journey. Peace has not been restored in the monster world after the death of the evil monster king.
An allegory about humankind progresses from a savage state to a civilized form, that is only a cover for its innate barbarism.
Heintje Fleming beschließt, sich auf die Suche nach seinem Vater, einem Rennfahrer, zu machen.
An American pilot impulsively joins His Majesty's Royal Air Force in Britain in an attempt to impress his ex-girlfriend.
A historical epic inspired by true events that took place in The Kingdom of Dahomey, one of the most powerful states of Africa in the 18th and 19th centuries.
A young man is confronted by his past when he visits his childhood summer house.

movie_name: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
synopsis: To save Earth from an alien probe, Admiral James T. Kirk and his fugitive crew go back in time to San Francisco in 1986 to retrieve the only beings who can communicate with it: humpback whales.

movie_name: If You Believe It, It's So
synopsis: The story of a crook who achieves regeneration through association rather than reformation through faith. It is a slow and arduous process till he realizes his way-of-life is not life's best way.
An alcoholic Border Patrol Agent, on the take, seeks redemption by rescuing a Venezuelan refugee from the very cartel that smuggled her across.

Joe's a suburban convenience store clerk with big dreams of becoming a cowboy so he packs his boots and relocates to South Texas to learn from the real deal. His idea of the mythic cowboy is quickly shattered however when he finds himself holed up in a town that survives on a human smuggling trade.
Former Police Sergeant Barnes becomes head of security for Senator Charlie Roan, a Presidential candidate targeted for death on Purge night due to her vow to eliminate the Purge.

In a wedding ceremony they did not let the children to enter and send them to a shack in the end of the garden. There the kids find that they smuggling drugs so decide to ruin the wedding and this is the beginning of the adventures.
A contained psychological thriller about a man's descent into madness, based on the short story, based on the original Liberty Magazine article IN THE MIDST OF DEATH by legendary author Ben Hecht.
Sunny Palomattam, a successful businessman in Singapore, enjoy his life with his girlfriend Sandra Valookaran. However, he is unaware that Sandra is a spy hired by his business rival Mohammed Ali.
The hero of the story is a student called Gabor who, together with his buddy Suki Balazs, spies under the cruel Ali Pasha's nose. Gabor loves beautiful Leila, daughter of the turkish nobleman Gul.
A married woman's affair comes back to haunt her when her obsessed lover infiltrates every part of her life.
An army captain is on a mission to track down and destroy a terrorist gang and deactivate the sleeper cells under its command.
An astronomer discovers the Dream Galaxy and with it, the girl of his dreams.
The Mississippi River adventures of a young boy and a runaway slave.

A glorious excursion in the realms of fantasy - magic - romance - laughter.
The shop assistant in an electronics store, May Bao, is a good-natured fat man, always ready to help those who need it.

A maid witnesses a murder at an upscale hotel and a policeman is assigned to the case, but it soon becomes clear that important people don't want the case solved.
In modern times, the last descendant of St. George is hunted by a dragon from middle earth.
Sammy Silver struggle to trade his criminal ways for a married life after he falls in love with a single mother.

A young sailor finds himself trapped in the labyrinthine mansion of his occultist uncle, along with a number of eccentric and mysterious relatives who all seem to be harboring a dark secret.
