After a dangerous top-secret formula is stolen, a government agent traces the thieves back to a mysterious island and a secret-society of Ninja's.

Garrett, an emotionally-troubled young man, is sent to a clinic, whispering soothing promises of perfection. By planting characteristics directly into his own body, he's relieved of his dark visions, but pays the price for purity of mind.

Intent on winning a competition in place of her distinguished late father, beautiful young heiress Dale takes on the guise of a man and competes in his spot, embarking on a car race that crosses the unforgiving Sahara desert.
An anthology of three Edgar Allan Poe stories: "The Case of Mr. Valdemar," "The Cask of Amontillado" and "The Tell-Tale Heart."

15 years after mild-mannered Jody was abducted, tortured, and left for dead by a group of sadistic college classmates, a chance encounter draws her into a world of revenge, secrets, and serial killers.
Bill and Ginny are invited by a naturalist friend to take care of his home in Africa while he is away, and they find themselves adopted by three orphan elephants.

A poor man and his son are going to the desert to work and bring money for their family. But one day the son is deceived by a mean ogre who wants to eat him and his family. Now the son has to find a way to save his family from danger.

A damaged homicide detective (Johnny Messner) must prevent a grieving father from unleashing a "robotic virus" that he believes will destroy the terrorist cell that murdered his son, but at an unimaginable cost.
A pair of hip, sexy thieves foil an arms dealer's plans to sell a nuclear bomb to terrorists and have fun doing it.
When Detective Mike Hoolihan is called to investigate the shooting of leading astrophysicist and black hole expert, Jennifer Rockwell, she is affected in ways she struggles to comprehend.
A likable guy pursues his office crush with help from his evil talking pets, but things turn sinister when she stands him up for a date.
An unhappily married woman becomes the mistress to a sleaze-ball who introduces her to a group of satanists who are willing to kill her rich husband.

movie_name: If These Walls Could Talk #2 the Stage Play
synopsis: Well, the Walls Family is back at it again, and many things have taken place since the last gathering. What is Mother Mabel and her gang up to this time around?
As Terry McGinnis returns to Gotham, he must become Batman to fight the forces of evil, bringing him face-to-face with villains such as The Phantasm and The Black Mask.

In Chicago, a crime syndicate tries to take over a labor union by killing its blow-whistler treasurer and framing the honest union boss for the murder.

After the mysterious crash of a millionaire's private airplane, three scientists secretly harvest the dying man's brain and keep it alive in a laboratory in order to communicate with it through telepathy.
A family's dull life in a rural outback town is rocked after their two teenage children disappear into the desert, sparking disturbing rumors of their past.

Intuition takes place with workaholic relationship therapist, Dr. David Francis, who tries to help Kenny deal with his trust issues. The Doctor fails to realize his patient is having an affair with his fiancée Karen.
One of the greatest and bravest incident from the life of The Great Maratha King Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj where he defeated Afzalkhan with his brilliant tactics and courage.

A young scientist is caught in a life and death struggle when a deranged feral dog bites one of her team, and a mutating contagion, transforms them into a savage beast with an insane lust for human flesh.

An evil warlock now rules the magical planet Ressear. To conquer her fallen empire Sofia Hayden must find the legendary Royal 4 reincarnated bodies.
Orphaned raccoon, Sly Cooper, discovers that he comes from a long line of highly-skilled, international thieves. Based on the 'Sly Cooper' video games.
Three women of different generations living in a waning industrial town, struggle to restore meaning in their life

A photographer who's afraid he's slowly losing his grip on reality is seduced by a disturbed married model. She claims it's their destiny to be together. Her husband disagrees. The photographer starts having a strange feeling of deja vu.
A chain of events changes Vinod's life - from honest journalist to black marketer to an underworld Don and a Racketeer in order to combat Vardhan.
Everyone's favorite nursery rhyme characters come magically and musically to life in this animated adventure based on the classic holiday tale.
A photographer named Andrew Kaleen incidentally gets wrapped up in a series of murders delivered through clues in the form of 35mm film.

When Jake London (or Lon to his mates) returns from his last tour in the Middle East, he discovers his borough is under the control of a mysterious new crime syndicate that come out to prowl under the full moon.

A group of unsuspecting college students embark on a mission into the forest in hopes of finding evidence of endangered species. What they don't realize is they have wandered onto the feeding grounds of a vicious and calculating predator.
Two ditzy waitresses accidentally witness a murder at their diner after hours. Now they are on the run from the mafia who are chasing after them to silence them forever.
A look at the life of Jorge Mario Bergoglio, form his early childhood days in Argentina to his becoming Pope Francis.
Kermit the Frog, The Great Gonzo, and Fozzie Bear are reporters who travel to Britain to interview a rich victim of jewel thieves and help her along with her secretary, Miss Piggy.
A priest disobeys church law to track down the vampires who kidnapped his niece.

Vincent's life is on hold until he finds his wife's killer. Alice, his neighbor, is convinced she can make him happy. She decides to invent a culprit, so that Vincent can find revenge and leave the past behind. But there is no ideal culprit and no perfect crime.

movie_name: The Curious Incident of the Dog in the Night-Time

A harsh colonel of paratroopers neglects his family after falling in love with a chess player, the sister of one of his paratroopers that got injured because of the jumping punishment given by him.

This is the story of a most unusual romance in which a man of many faces and yet a man without a name who enters the life of a beautiful and rich heiress, Rita and partnered her in an exciting game of hide and seek.

The mystery revolves around 5 young people in a hill station resort. Something starts to haunt them without revealing it's presence, while it creates a death trap for them.Will they make it out alive?
Based on millennia old Bulgarian tradition and myth, the Kukeri are humanity's defenders against vampires and supernatural powers.

movie_name: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Origin VI - Rise of the Red Comet

Fleeing a murder charge, a busboy and a nightclub singer wind up on a spooky Caribbean island inherited by a young woman.

movie_name: Against the Wild 2: Survive the Serengeti

The Looney Tunes search for a man's missing father and the mythical Blue Monkey diamond.
A semi-reboot of the Kick-Ass franchise focusing on Patience Lee picking up the mantle of Kick-Ass from David Lizewsk.
A US Army colonel in France tries to track down an escaped sex maniac.
A troubled young woman takes up residence in a gothic apartment building where she must confront a terrifying evil.
Hyun-jin, moved into a worn-down apartment in a small town, has trouble sleeping at night due to the noise from her next-door neighbor.

A workaholic father must race across town in order to attend his son's recital and save his marriage.
Two boys from a small town find their courage tested when they accidentally stow away aboard an airplane owned by the mob.

Flora Hawks is in love with the overseer of Tarzan's African estate. After a search for a legendary city of diamonds, Tarzon races with his pet lion Jad-bal-ja to save Haws from being sacrificed to a lion-god.
This is the adaptation of the New York Times best seller by Rick Riordan.

Thai filmmaker Sompote Sands returns with a sequel to "Krai Thong", in which a man can turn himself into a horrific man-eating crocodile.

A rock'n roll heroine is born, a marriage saved, villains foiled, and the world watches as a young boy from an impoverished shanty town holds the dreams and hopes of an entire community.
Tom Sawyer and his pal Huckleberry Finn have great adventures on the Mississippi River, pretending to be pirates, attending their own funeral and witnessing a murder.

The story of this film is based on actual facts, the murder of actress Maria Alves, and the investigation that ensued, covered by Reinaldo Ferreira himself. Ferreira also wrote a novel based on the same facts.

movie_name: The Quest for the Golden Feather
synopsis: A group of adventurers embarks on a quest to find a mythical golden feather said to grant its possessor great fortune and power while facing mythical creatures and ancient curses.

After an arduous divorce, Debra vacations at a quiet off-season beach to decompress and forget about men. Immediately, triplets hit on her, until she finds out she's been had, and engages in a fun and intriguing game of tit for tat.

movie_name: Twenty One Twenty One, to One Hundred Years

In 1946, just after World War 2, bandits rule the countryside of Siam. The notorious Bai rises to become the king of bandits and police chief Yodying has been ordered to apprehend Bai dead or alive.
The movie discusses the Social, and unemployment issues facing the Egyptian youth during the present time.

A professor and four graduate students journey to a house in the mountains to investigate paranormal activities, but the experiment goes awry after an alien entity starts attacking them.
A group of Asian prisoners is recruited, trained, armed and sent to Vietnam to destroy a cache of American weapons left behind after the Vietnam War, before the Vietcong discovers its location.

movie_name: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - Asakusa Arc
synopsis: Tanjiro ventures to Asakusa, Tokyo for his second mission with the Demon Slayer Corps.
A couple elopes to get married and set up home hoping that just love will do the trick - but that's just the beginning of their story.

In 1944, an Allied spy must find and execute a Berlin scientist who discovered the way to build an atomic bomb. Things get complicated when memories of love and quantum mechanics get intertwined in the chase.
A crew of men who do the high-wire work of fixing the electrical grid are hit by a sudden deadly storm.

movie_name: The Legend of Timm Thaler or The Boy Who Sold His Laughter
synopsis: The devil tricks a little boy off his laughter in exchange for assured wins in all his bets. It depicts his journey after the deal with the devil, how he loses his soul bit by bit with each win.
A road trip comedy about three friends who travel across the country in a Wiener Wagon to beat up a popular daytime talk show therapist.
A World War II-style "war game" setting the wealthy customers against skilled mercenaries goes awry when the simulated war gets too real.

Rapid reaction detachment team tries to track down a mysterious safe which contain a treasure trove of dirty secrets - also that is wanted assassins and other forces
Three teenage friends must break into a mysterious house in their neighborhood after they suspect their friend has been kidnapped by a family living in the house.
A traveling family falls victim to a group of mutated cannibals in a desert far away from civilization.
Five down-on-their-luck strangers must band together to steal back winning lottery tickets worth millions from a wicked mafia boss.
A rollicking comedy ever to hit the screen.

Hannah joins an online chatroom, where she meets a boy she quickly falls for and things quickly go from great to terrible.

Two 20-something club hopping women in LA are at first glance living the good life of partying and casual sex, until they are revealed to be scarred by a childhood abduction and driven to take revenge on every man who crosses their path.

Inspired by True Events - Naughty Kids make phone calls to young girl's house; only to find out that they are getting dragged into bigger problem.

Doug and his pal Skeeter set out to find the monster of Lucky Duck Lake.

Five friends take refuge in a 'convent with a past' after their car breaking down abruptly midway in a forest. Do the uninvited guest survive the odds and challenges of normal vs paranormal, homophobia vs homosexuality?
Hagen develops disturbing nightmares and soon can no longer distinguish between dream and reality.
A crippled circus acrobat is torn emotionally between two ambitious young trapeze artists, one a talented young American and a less-gifted but beautiful Italian.
Three apparent murders and a pair of imposters disrupt the lives of an engaged couple.
In 1945, during a 48-hour leave, a soldier accidentally meets a girl at Pennsylvania Station and spends his leave with her, eventually falling in love with the lovely New Yorker.
Finding one's way in modern America.
A computer-scientist/novelist reunites with his childhood friend, hacks into government databases, and faces the dire and fateful consequences of the mystical actions he obtained as a child.
A mild-mannered doctor develops a taste for blood after the hiring of an assassin to kill his wife gets the attention of a gang of corrupt cops.
A former movie queen and her daughter both compete for the attentions of a young man.
A man seeks revenge against a space ship that killed his wife.
Ella is under a spell to be constantly obedient, a fact she must hide from her new stepfamily in order to protect the prince of the land, her friend for whom she's falling.
A bitter story about tender love and its cruel betrayal set in Russia of the 19th century.
Two college students kill their roommate and make it look like a suicide.

Mugsey And Sasha Fight The Last Battle With Milo Jackson Now Aware The Worlds Fate Is Now Within There Hands. But Mugsey And Sasha Have Failed To Tell Becky Hart The Real Plan. A Choice That Will Destroy Her Life.
A honey-trap Mossad killer comes to the rescue of her disavowed CIA lover being hunted by the CIA, MI6 and the Mossad, as he fights to expose a corporate syndicate's takeover of the global media.
After a spell goes wrong, Merlin and Arthur find themselves stranded in the modern day.
A computer scientist scans dreams with a computer.

5 months after failing in Hollywood, Danny is dumped by his girlfriend, unemployed and can't finish the deed. On his 30th birthday he reconnects with a High School acquaintance and forced to re-examine his life.
Based on the existence and abandonment of more than 10,000 military dogs at the end of the Vietnam War.

Aliens come to Earth seeking scientists to help them in their war.

The countess is married, and the ghosts are still in the Spessart. Her husband becomes an astronaut and the story involving time and space traveling starts.

movie_name: Allan Quatermain and the Lost City of Gold
synopsis: Allan Quatermain once again teams up with Jesse Huston where the discovery of a mysterious old gold piece sends Quatermain looking for his long-lost brother, missing in the wilds of Africa after seeking a lost white race.

movie_name: The Slipper and the Rose: The Story of Cinderella
synopsis: A musical retelling of the classic tale of Cinderella. In the tiny kingdom of Euphrania, the King and his court are anxious to get Prince Edward wed. But Edward wants to marry for love.

FBI Agent Steve Blair finds himself caught up in Cold War espionage when he boards a plane heading west. Some sensitive papers have disappeared and Steve must keep tabs on a suspect without giving himself away.

movie_name: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Silver Chair

Suzu is a shy high school student living in a rural village. For years, she has only been a shadow of herself. But when she enters "U", a massive virtual world, she escapes into her online persona as Belle, a globally-beloved singer.

Adventurous and bold mother of two, PENELOPE, struggles to strike the balance between her artistic aspirations and motherly responsibilities in this playful look at modern-day motherhood and the difficulties families face everyday.

Bring the feel of the Drive-in home with this Grindhouse anthology. Featuring three tales of horror delivered in a format that's sure to quench the thirst of any fan of the 70's and 80's Drive-in classics.
A story about two sisters who were saved from a carriage mishap by two men during a town festival.
Magic abounds: Hunter and Jesamine unleash havoc on a towns bully with the help of a sorcerer's diary, and a mischievous monkey apprentice Fred.
As a result of a drug experiment, Misi will be able to travel through time, but only if he drinks from a special homemade spirit.

Two ex-cons try to frame the good-guy detective who sent them to jail. However, a group of kids shut the gangsters' operations down with the help of some friends from the animal kingdom.

synopsis: A young girl develops a clever plot so she doesn't have to move away from her friends.

Follows the adventures of Aang, a young successor to a long line of Avatars, who must master all four elements and stop the Fire Nation from enslaving the Water Tribes and the Earth Kingdom.

movie_name: Oops, Ups & Downs: The Murder Mystery of Humpty Dumpty
synopsis: An elite member of society's egg-shaped body was found on the west side of town. The mystery of his death investigated by a fantasy township in 1945.

A hospital nurse becomes an "international girl", a prostitute who caters to foreigners with hard currency.
Romeo, a hopeless romantic with emotionally-fueled impulsiveness, meets Juliet, an abused and desperate girl looking for anyway to escape. Together, destined for tragedy.

A young girl, Noa, suspects her new nanny isn't from this world. Noa fights to reveal the nanny's identity, which is more twisted than she imagined in this dark fantasy tale.

When four struggling band members stop at a lonely roadside cafe for a slice of pie they find themselves imprisoned in the deranged cafe owners bizarre art collection and must battle a sinister force with an appetite for souls.
When her mother inherits an old guesthouse in a sleepy town in Brandenburg Maja is less than happy. There is, however, the local legend of a ghost - could the stories be true?
A True based story of a girl on a Journey to succeed in the Hollywood industry.
Ordinary people meet in a laundry service in Budapest, Hungary and they share the same thing, their dirty secrets.
Students fear for their lives as mutant deadly killer bees invade. Horror and panic sweep the campus. Will anyone survive?
An American reporter goes to the Australian outback to meet an eccentric crocodile poacher and invites him to New York City.

A suffering husband grapples with the decision to use illegal technology to delete the memory of his wife's murder, while a relentless young woman pursues the dangerous criminal who botched her father's memory erasure procedure.
Romance and fantasy mix in this comedy that shows how a heaven-sent cupid tries to seal the romances between two pairs of young lovers.

In a world where families are limited to one child due to overpopulation, a set of identical septuplets must avoid being put to a long sleep by the government and dangerous infighting while investigating the disappearance of one of their own.
Two young adults who are coping with the deaths of their partners try to move forward with their lives and start a relationship with each other.
The magical inhabitants of a rainforest fight to save their home, which is threatened by logging and a polluting force of destruction called Hexxus.

A woman dies, leaving behind a mournful family and a shocked young husband. Missing from the funeral was Curtis, whose grudge might have been buried with the dead girl if he hadn't found that letter she mailed on the last day of her life.
When the crew of the Enterprise learn of a Federation conspiracy against the inhabitants of a unique planet, Captain Picard begins an open rebellion.

When Chuck and Woodsly are accidentally entered in the FUR BALL RUN, they have to figure out how to put their paws on the pedal to compete against a pack of seasoned drivers from across the animal kingdom.

A movie producer, director and assistant take the Trans-Europ-Express from Paris to Antwerp. They get the idea for a movie about a drug smuggler on their train and visualize it while taping the script.
A man's story, Solitude and communication Following a woman's trail Memories, Human insight and lyricism

Wry, cynical and full of off-beat humor, 'Apocalypse, CA' is the story of friends as they prepare for certain death at the hands of a massive asteroid, sex-inducing drugs, a three-hundred foot giant, and a horde of other absurd problems.

movie_name: Krisi and the Legend of Mt. Shasta
synopsis: Krisi, a 19 year old singer in Sacramento, gets tired of the rat race and heads for the hills. After adopting a pet deer, she starts exploring Mount Shasta, where she runs into its legendary dwellers, the Subterranean People.

movie_name: Long Arm of the Law: Part 4
synopsis: The story of gangsters versus police, focusing on the difference between how both factions act depending if they're coming from Hong Kong or Mainland China.
A dark drama starring an unexpectedly maniacal Stepán Kozub and an unstable heroine played by Pavla Gajdosíková.
Detective Alicia Gould, investigating the murder of a client's father, decides to go undercover to an asylum.
An American insurance investigator goes to Hong Kong to retrieve a famous diamond stolen by a local criminal organization.
Harry Morgan has returned to earth after being abducted by aliens fifteen years earlier. He's there to save his son from the aliens who are hot on his tracks.

When the master of martial arts, ex-gorkha soldier, uncovers widespread sex trafficking network in his own backyard in Los Angeles, with the help of runaway victims, he orchestrates a massive attack on the traffickers.

After an apocalyptic earthquake, a studio executive is making his way by foot from downtown LA to the San Fernando Valley to find his family and has to reluctantly team up with an unusual traveler going the same direction.

movie_name: El fantástico mundo de María Montiel
synopsis: A girl and her fantasy universe in a brick oven.
A young couple with a newborn baby don't realize that the nanny they hired is a magical nymph who sacrifices infants to an evil tree.
A psychiatrist becomes obsessed with one of her young clients with multiple personalities.

Joyce is alone in her luxurious apartment in Morocco, trying to cool down during a heat wave but also suffering from anxiety and sexual frustration. She holds a party, goes to the beach, and meets her physician. But where's her husband?

movie_name: The Case of the Stuttering Bishop
synopsis: An improbable stuttering bishop from Australia asks for Perry's help in proving the identity of the legitimate heir to a millionaire.
A policeman tries to protect a young woman against a hit man, when she flees New York after witnessing a mob killing.
The driver for a Baja drug lord/Jefe steals a valuable car. Jefe hires a "bounty hunter" to deliver the driver and car. Many other gunmen are interested in the car and driver.

A couple struggling to conceive visit a miracle doctor as a last hope for having a child. The wife gets pregnant, but after the initial joy comes horror, as she slowly discovers the nightmarish truth behind the doctor's success.
A nightclub entertainer and the man she truly loves conspire to end a black marketeer's tyrannic rule.
Three skiers stranded on a chairlift are forced to make life-or-death choices, which prove more perilous than staying put and freezing to death.
In a post apocalyptic world with its own rules;Tisha, an assassin and organ dealer with a dark past, seeks revenge for a crime that marked her life.

When her birthday wish magically summons wacky Hollywood actor Drake to her small Midwestern town, Sophie has to figure out how to help him fit in until she can get him back home. But Drake is more interested in helping Sophie stand out.
A daring parrot recounts how Robinson Crusoe came to be stranded on a tropical island.
A daughter from a secret wife returns home. But is she whom she claims to be?
Ulrich Mott, an ambitious social climber, marries a wealthy widow in Washington D.C. in order to mix with powerful political players.
Humans on board the spaceship, Streaker, with a number of dolphin-like species are sent a cryptic message from Earth to go into hiding.
A canoe trip down the river Kolpa becomes a journey of discovery for three female students.
In a post-apocalyptic land, a man rebels against a corrupted society in search for a cure against the deadly disease that killed most of humanity.
Changes can be more than skin deep.
They say the darkest hour is just before dawn, and at the Sunrise diner it's very late indeed. Four couples find themselves at an out-of-the-way 24-hour diner, but they are not all that they seem.
A young girl goes on an adventure with the Easter Bunny. Amanda walks the woods trying to find a treasure, but little does she know that her day will be full of wolves and evil plumbers.
A reclusive conspiracy theorist enlists people from his small town to help him make a low-budget movie about his experience encountering aliens while working as a geologist for the US government.
In a world where zombies outnumber humans 10,000 to one, it is impossible to tell the difference between men and the monsters.
Two bumbling magicians help a Middle Eastern prince regain his rightful throne from his despotic uncle.

A successful ambitious business mogul known as "The Broker" alters the practices of marriage and divorce by implementing short-term contracts for married couples but soon he sees the pros and cons of his own method within his own family.
When a small rustic town comes under siege from a series of unexplained violent murders, a U.S. Marshal risks his life to save a fatherless family caught in the middle of the crisis.

A troubled private detective discovers his destiny during a last-ditch investigation and finds himself in the fight of his life, colliding with six strangers, and a bizarre revelation that ties him to the battle of good versus evil.

Alfi (Raditya Dika) is an employee who works in Mr. Jeremy's (Tarzan) company. He falls in love with his boss' daughter named Amira (Pevita Pearce). Helped by his friends in the office, can Alfi date his boss' daughter or lose his job?
Six elite hunters pay to hunt down a man on a deserted island, only to find themselves becoming the prey.
A love story between a girl who loves reading books, and a boy who has previously checked out all of the library books she chooses.

A policewoman returns with her young daughter to her hometown to care for her dying mother. The murder of a young girl will keep her there longer than expected. She will try to solve a case that no one seems to care about.

Torture, drugs, mob war and a hail of bullets could not stop the G.I. Executioner as he became a one man execution squad. They tried to kill him, drug him, torture and pervert him, but they could not stop the G.I. Executioner.
In this thrilling family film, two kids discover a huge egg that hatches to reveal a hungry baby T. Rex dinosaur-but an evil animal dealer wants to steal the creature and sell it.
Alex, an advertising creative, wants to be a dad at any cost, but his wife is a lawyer on top of her career and being a mother isn't part of her plans. An unexpected guest will challenge their love.
Cosplayers Stuck in a Zombie Apocalypse of Anime Proportions.
A Jewish carpenter battles public humiliation and disgrace when his fiancé tries to convince him that she's pregnant with God's son.
Couples split up after a comment at an LA dinner party sets up arguments about how truthful partners are in their relationships.
Three inseparable childhood friends are just out of college. Nothing comes between them - until they each fall in love, and their wildly different approaches to relationships creates tension.

movie_name: Warkop DKI Reborn: Jangkrik Boss Part 2
synopsis: Dono, Kasino, and Indro's adventure continues. They have to search for the treasure to pay their debts. They travel to Malaysia as their first destination, but the bag with the codes to the treasure is switched with a Malaysian woman's.
Prince Adam is sent to the world of Etheria to find his long abducted sister, Adora, and awaken her to her own destiny.
When a city is burnt to the ground its survivors set forth to rebuild it concealing any scars it left behind.

A retired mathematics professor spends his days writing, when one day he comes across a young injured girl with no home or history. As he takes her in and cares for her, he begins to suspect that she is the reincarnation of his late wife.

The genius hacker Hex runs the "white hacker" club Better World. As he discovers the hackers that ruined his father's company he need all the help he can get from his club members in order to take them down.
A paranormal investigator, George Coetzee, gets a tip from a bar fly about a very scarce frog species in the Tankwa Karoo, a very desolate area in South Africa. What he finds is not what he expected.

In the Ming dynasty of China, Shen Lian (starring Chang Chen), a secret police of corrupt government, is trapped by the conspiracy on a mission. To prove the innocence, he seeks the truth with a girl called Bei Zhai (starring Yang Mi).
Lady Winsley, an American novelist, is murdered in Büyükada, an island in the Prince archipelago in Turkey. Inspector Fergün arrives from Istanbul to head the investigation.
A man lives alone in a worn down industrial facility, working under surveillance on something called Projekt X.
A young woman who has raised a giant gorilla from an infant brings him to Hollywood years later seeking her fortune.

movie_name: Shen ying fei yan hu die zhang
synopsis: Having wiped out both the Shaolin and Wu Tang, the Butterfly Clan's objective is clearly the destruction of any and all rival factions. A wushu knight, and his rag-tag followers move in to challenge their oppressors in a deadly battle.
By the time daughter and son-in-law have their second child, mother-in-law learns not to be so domineering.

On their anniversary, she wants romance, he wants weed. Set in Jamaica, they take a trip full of stalker skinny-cats, nip slips, trips, falls, bearded fireworms, boogers, poop, tinkle accidents and weed. Comedic hilarity ensues.
A private detective is enlisted to find out who shot a dog and threatened its owner, but before long he's also involved in a kidnapping and murder plot.
An honest cop fights his corrupt superiors and crooked polticians to exact justice

In 2003, a group of thieves broke into an allegedly airtight vault in the international diamond capital of Antwerp, Belgium and made off with over $ 108 million dollars worth of diamonds and other valuables.

The world is crumbling but a family team of private detectives take cases brought to them by those in desperate need and vow to equalize them. These three women handle the cases and the business of the truth as if lives depended on it.

A band of mercenaries led by Captain Curry travel through war-torn Congo across deadly terrain, battling rival armies, to steal $50 million in uncut diamonds. But infighting, sadistic rebels and a time lock jeopardize everything.

In a modern and free madhouse Rocco, the president of the mads, declares freedom of sex. When Queen Cleopatra comes she forbids him everything. These two fight until he kidnaps her and the film goes on the sea and mountains.

The Tyler brothers are ruined by the local bank, so they decide to rob it. But one brother is killed, and Jesse goes to jail. After being released, he enlists the aid of gunrunner Billy Rat to offer his last brother The Last Fair Deal.
An international Smuggler is caught in the crossfire of a war between two corporate giants, and targeted for execution to gain control of his cargo.
A wrestler and a bookseller disgraced by life fall in love with each other.

movie_name: Batman: Return of the Caped Crusaders
synopsis: Batman and Robin of the 1960s live action series are back in action to take down their fiendish foes united once more against them.
An angry and directionless young man reluctantly enlists the help of a local psychiatrist to assist him in confronting damaging past events.

The mythical treasure of the Romanovs are traveling secretly through Greece, destination unknown.Three ordinary people, a security guard, a desperado and the head of a children's camp will be confronted by the "Diamond curse".
An uncompromising, visionary architect struggles to maintain his integrity and individualism despite personal, professional and economic pressures to conform to popular standards.

The Sun of the Sleepless. The film is about a doctor named Gela Bendeliani (Elgudzha Burduli) and his wealthless family in Tbilisi in Soviet Georgia. In the film Gela Bendeliani has an unlimited capacity for generosity and forgiveness.

Three best friends try to get 'internet famous' by filming their own survival show out in the woods. A weekend trip to accomplish this project turns deadly when a mysterious and very foreign visitor ends up in their neck of the woods.
Three friends persecute a gang of criminals from Harlem to the parties of the High Society of London.
Peraustrínia 2004 is an animated movie recorded entirely in the Catalan language.
A young woman is killed by her treacherous husband and returns as a vengeful ghost.
Adaku finds love in a hopeless place. Will her love be strong enough to surmount all challenges?

A mysterious curse takes over an electrician's life, shattering his work and family. With only the cryptic instructions of a botanica sorcerer, he struggles to complete impossible tasks in the mythical underbelly of Los Angeles.
Movie about a friendship of two children - a girl and a boy during the last day of summer holiday.
A mega tech company creates a high end gaming system utilizing "organic intelligence" by extracting human consciousness from their victims.
A notorious secret society known as Spermula plans to return from the future and conquer Earth by neutering the male population.
The story of a real 18th-century French actress, leading lady of the Comédie-Française in Paris, who was believed to have been poisoned by a love rival.
Based on the short film, Radiate.

Comedy and Romance amongst American sailors in a pre-WWII tale of antics during shore leave chasing high society ladies. It's a common tale where a confident sailor bets he can get the girl but inevitably falls in love with her.
A homicide detective brings his partner out of retirement to help catch a serial killer whose crimes are based on the children's game Hangman.

Parallel storylines tell the current state of affairs for two ex-lovers: Nora's a single mother who comes to care for her terminally ill father; holed in up in mental ward, Ismael, a brilliant musician, plots his escape.

Raised as an oversized elf, Buddy travels from the North Pole to New York City to meet his biological father, Walter Hobbs, who doesn't know he exists and is in desperate need of some Christmas spirit.

Two wanted women decide to rob their wealthy psychotic friend who lives in the fantasy world they created as children; to take the money they have to take part in a deadly perverse game of make believe.
When a serial killer confesses his sins he finds his biggest prize to date when Detective Verone is assigned to the case. As victims are unearthed more than hidden secrets are dug up.
It's just another night for Steve, a Rideshare driver, until one of his fares goes on a crime spree across the city with 5 different stops.
The quirky adventures of Hayflower and her little sister Quiltshoe.

Logan's life takes an unexpected turn when his pregnant wife was murdered by an organized crime society. Overwhelmed with guilt and nothing left to live for, Logan sets out on the journey for the ultimate revenge.
A young girl uncovers the mysteries of animal communication.

Village lad Vishnu is happy-go-lucky, with his life revolving around watching movies at a tent screening hall. Then, he falls in love, but just when he decides to get married, she goes missing. Can he piece his life back together?
While investigating the assassination of the Chief Minister, a CBI Officer is herself found guilty of this killing.
A dystopian thriller set in the year 2030 that sees the world in a permanent state of economic recession and facing serious environmental problems as a result of global warming.
Separated by a checkpoint, Palestinian lovers from Jerusalem and Ramallah arrange clandestine meetings.
Teenage Ferco falls in love with Rosalba who's already in love with Rafael. To impress Rosalba, Ferco learns to drive his father's plane, hoping this will win her over from Rafael.
A young woman moves from the French countryside to Paris and begins a passionate love affair with a feminist leader in this drama set in 1970s France.
Adapted from a sci-fi book.
A grieving widow summons her dead husband back from the grave with disastrous results.
Follows a group of five teens heading off to a cabin for a "romantic" weekend. They are hunted down by The Lashman for being unruly teens and disturbing his peace.
James Bond's loyalty to M is tested when her past comes back to haunt her. When MI6 comes under attack, 007 must track down and destroy the threat, no matter how personal the cost.
Torchy Blane and Steve McBride try to nab a gangster by tracking his moll.
A troubled, kind hearted young girl must stop the bulldozing of her Gran's strawberry farm by an ambitious mayor in order to save her best friend - an orphaned koala named Smooch.

Inventor creates drug that allows people to live in their wildest dreams. Now, the drug is no more, and everyone who was on it is under house arrest. Garp learns to connect with himself, and in that, to take action.
Abducted and confined in a room by a gang of sadistic men, a pregnant woman tries to escape, against insurmountable odds.
A woman in a hypnotic state recounts to two doctors the details of a horrific experience from her past life that began with the mysterious and sudden disappearance of her husband.
A weekly editor-in-chief, Yu Li, uncovers a series of evil deeds through her investigation.

Osami, a soldier-of-fortune from Japan, joins with priest Ensai in a quest for the ashes of the great Buddha. Their journey takes them to a kingdom in the Middle East, where they find intrigue and romance in the court of an evil king.
A man is shocked when the antique idol that he is trying to smuggle out of the country suddenly comes to life.
Villagers in Andhra write 'O Sthree Repu Raa' on their outside walls to prevent ghosts from visiting their home. Is this custom based in fact or myth?

An ex-army major is kidnapped by terrorists in the Philippines, demanding ten million dollars worth of diamonds. Michael, a Vietnam vet who served under him, goes on a solo mission determined to rescue him.
An ultraconservative security guard suffers a debilitating stroke and is assigned to a rehabilitative program that includes singing lessons with the drag queen next door.
A nameless man must travel through dimensions and kill the same person over and over again.
Jessica and David Clausen are an upstart couple who come face to face with the Supernatural after inheriting a beautiful townhouse in New York City's West Village District.

movie_name: Carl's Car Wash: The Movie - Super Simple
synopsis: Carl is back, with even more vehicles needing a cleaning! Some are big, some are small, and some aren't even cars at all! Join Carl and his fantastic car wash, as he washes a race car, mail truck, skateboard, and even an airplane!
Three bone-chilling tales make up this film, from a divorced woman being terrorized in her new home to a babysitter in a serial killer's midst.

A country boy who always wanted to fly becomes a Double Ace during the Korean War. Upon capture he is held as a Political Prisoner. Finally released and seeking out POW comrades who never returned home, his real war begins.

Reincarnation goes horribly wrong releasing dark forces across time. Basia accesses parts of her mind that should never be tampered with. Past lives merge with present as her reality becomes distorted, she fights for her very existence.
Sara, a straight arrow schoolteacher, meets Virgil, an easygoing tattoo artist, and finds herself choosing between her comfortable life and a life of freedom and adventure.

When a vile creature sets out to destroy the calm, and the world as we know it, and to keep the world from going into complete chaos, one city at a time, has to prove he is the one who can stop this vile creature, and right the wrongs,
Rival Mongol chiefs battle for leadership of the tribe.
In the future where dormant powers awaken in certain people, a secret organization is formed to hunt these people down. A mysterious powerful boy Quon will stop at nothing to end this persecution.
A police officer, constable Punyasoma hunts an underworld gangster who is involved in a kidnapping of a rich woman.
A reporter uncovers an amazing medical plot.
Kashiram, shattered by the death of his children in an accident, resorts to alcohol to numb his pain. When the police find an intoxicated Kashiram with a dead body, his life takes a drastic turn.

Khaidi Garu is a Indian Telugu film, directed by Om Sai Prakash and Produced by M Venkatadri Naidu and S Aadi Reddy. The film stars Mohan Babu, Krishnam Raju, Srihari and Laila in lead roles. The music of the film was composed by Koti.

When scandals and cover-ups in the Catholic Church and NYPD unearth the dark secrets of two friends, a priest and a narcotics agent, one sets out on a journey for forgiveness, the other for redemption
A convict seeks revenge on the partners who cheated him of his treasure share.
After moving to a new neighborhood, a mysterious man starts introducing his landlord to the hobby of collecting crime statistics.
Two men went searching for ghosts, but they found themselves instead...
Plot is under wraps at this time.
Where does good end and evil begin? When do good intentions do no good? There's a fine line between good and evil. If pushed to your limits would you cross over into evil?
A social satire in which a man realizes he would have a better life if he were to shrink himself to five inches tall, allowing him to live in wealth and splendor.

When New York actor Paul Cole is beaten and left for dead in 1950s Ohio, he loses his memory and finds himself stranded in a mysterious small town where he struggles to get back home and reclaim what he's lost.

A penniless and suicidal, singer-songwriter crashes her car into a Texas, roadside motel. The motel's owner, a retired military officer, makes her fix the damage or face jail. Fierce opposites, they begin a journey of redemption and hope.
Plot kept under wraps.
A year in the Sami boy Ante's life. His dream is to become a reindeer owner like his dad, but in the autumn he has to attend school, where he struggles to adapt.
When Andy finds out he's on Santa's "naughty list," he pulls together a group of "naughty list" kids to get the presents they think they deserve.
A family who moved into a remote mill house in Ireland finds themselves in a fight for survival with demonic creatures living in the woods.

When, by phone, the Sociologist provides advice on counter subversive torture, he vaguely feels that previously the Intelligence Officer, the Special Operations Officer, and the Painter-Narrator believed in Latin American and world peace.

Brothers Dai and Kei are summoned by peace-loving spirits to stop an angry demon from destroying Tokyo. When they become separated, Kei?s mission is to save his brother and restore harmony between human and spirit worlds.
After their van breaks down in the middle of nowhere, the women of a volleyball team must fight for their lives against a group of degenerate hunters.
A circus arrives in town, but an evil sorcerer threatens to destroy it. Only the clown Cepillín can save the day.
When a teenage girl witnesses a plane crash, she talks with one of the injured passengers...only to find out he was actually killed in the accident.
A fearsome swordsman, Kain, crosses the barren wastelands and comes upon a town where two arch enemies fight incessantly for control of the town's only well.
A women suspects that her new next-door neighbor is up to no good.
Gangster's girlfriend hangs out in a Las Vegas hotel with her cop protectors while she waits to testify.

In the 19th century, a bullied, disfigured man dubbed Iguana flees from abusive locals, finds his own island and declares himself tyrant of his new domain. A man and a woman get stranded there and become victims of his new sadistic nature.
Set in a dystopian future London, a young woman battles an unknown virus to be reunited with her long lost love, against insurmountable odds, and nameless horrors that lurk around the dark streets.
Ejected 20,000 years away from their civilization by a black hole, 3 scientists, a pshychiatrist, and a mechanic, decide to explore the universe rather than go back to earth.

In the not too distant future, Earth is attacked by a foreign enemy. With help from an alien ally, mankind must rebuild on a new planet but one man assigned to the job has a personal agenda that could jeopardize the entire mission.
A cursed gunman and his nemesis, a sadistic sheriff, enlist a fearless bounty hunting woman to track a legendary serial killer who they believe was spawned by their childhood sins.
Aly is an artist and poet who loves Layali and they decide to get married. But one of Aly's friends rapes her after drugging her. She punishes herself by working as a dancer at a modest nightclub.
A designer drug touted to increase intelligence is tested on high school kids with horrifying side effects.

Peter has it all, a fabulous home, a beautiful wife, and a successful career, until he discovers his wife, Kendra, is having an affair with an Alien. He must race against UFOs and Men In Black to find Kendra before she causes an apocalypse.
A crew of Los Angeles cops form a helicopter squad that tracks down a powerful drug lord.

Reynaldo and Martín Del Hierro are witnesses of the murder of their father by Pascual Velazco, as they grow up they're poisoned by the desire of vengeance by their mother, but once they get it it'll change their lifes forever.
A young girl falls in love with an experienced soldier.

movie_name: Digby: The Biggest Dog in the World
synopsis: Digby consumes a bowl of Project X, a liquid growth formula. Soon he becomes a sheepdog of gigantic size.
After losing everything, a desperate ex-con poses as a woman during Royal Ascot's 'Ladies Day' in an attempt to rob a crooked bookie and win back his family.
A socially awkward driver and a weary passenger try to make it to their destination while being haunted by a supernatural threat.
Two unlikely friends set out on a mission of revenge.

A man (Micheal) searches for his legacy, a way to be remembered forever. In a time of desperate financial trouble, a mysterious stranger shows up with an answer to Micheal's needs. Desperate and curious, he accepts.

This sequel to "Yossi and Jagger" finds Dr. Yossi Gutmann reminiscing about his love ten years after his death. When he encounters a group of young soldiers, one of them, Tom, reignites his romantic feelings.
Seven college kids take a shortcut on their way to a party and unfortunately end up in Wormwood, where the spirit of the Headless Horseman hunts them one by one.
An elite group of soldiers on a covert mission to retrieve a scientist from an underground lab encounter an ancient evil in the facility.
Iancu was part of the boyar family of Amza Jianul. Outraged by the iniquities to which the "stupidity" was subjected, he becomes an outlaw alongside Mereanu.
What happens when an East coast nerd runs into 3 West coast witches? Find out as all mayhem breaks loose in this comedy horror.

movie_name: Jemiyah Jones & the Vampyre Ghost Ship
synopsis: 15 year old English girl continues her adventures, this time in the realm of the Vampyre.
A worldwide epidemic encourages a biotech company to launch an organ-financing program similar in nature to a standard car loan. The repossession clause is a killer, however.
Sivaji, a stage artist, finds whereabouts of his daughter who disappeared two decades ago and finds out that the kidnapper, Gayatri Patel, is an exact lookalike of him.

It seems that Jack's hockey skills translate directly into tearing up the halfpenny and popping sick grinds. With his new buddy Ben by his side Jack takes off on a cross-country skateboard competition tour with hilarious results.
A humorous and heartwarming story about a boy who is charged with protecting a thousand-year-old dragon.
An unemployed ex-bureaucrat by day becomes mentor to two young vigilantes at night.
A police captain needs to balance between protecting the last remaining witness in a trial, and his rapidly disintegrating love life.

As she investigates the disappearance of a young boy in a struggling farming community, a tenacious child protective services officer uncovers a web of mysterious cult rituals and confronts her own traumatic past.
Two soul mates, who have only met in their dreams, must find each other on in order to defeat dark forces.
With help from his friends, a boy (Wyatt Bowen) trains a dog to compete in an annual event.

movie_name: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
synopsis: A master call Fire Cloud is a bad guy, he wants to fight people but a hero from China don't like it and stop him. People is save again.

Sent to spend the summer on a remote and mysterious island, brothers embark on a thrilling treasure hunt to restore their family's lost fortune.
Rajeev, who is from a broken family, tries to find happiness in his college life. But Vishnu, Rajeev's opponent in college, plots against him.

A charismatic thief makes friends with a bankrupt baron who comes to live in the thief's slum. Meanwhile the thief seeks the love of a young woman, who is held emotionally captive by her slumlord family.
A group of former Encyclopedia Brown-style child-detectives struggle to solve an adult mystery.
In a secluded Mennonite religious community, a single mother haunted by terrifying nightmares soon realizes that she may not be the only victim of a greater evil.
A fresh-out-of-college criminologist, finds himself pit against an evil mastermind, whom he can only outdo by using his wits and courage.
Three Italian brothers go on a journey to discover their family fortune.
Three former associates turn on each other when they suspect one of them has stolen money, beginning to hunt each other.

Two extremely nerdy brothers are hell-bent on winning the laptop of their dreams, but in order to do so they must, in only 48 hours, get a kiss from two gorgeous girls who are completely out of their league.

A young man with telekinetic powers comes to stay in an old house inhabited by two sisters and there he has to face supernatural phenomena that reach their culmination when he is saved from dying by an old man murdered some time ago.
The story of a couple who are forced into marriage after an upheaval.
A military veteran and former mercenary named Frenchy is haunted by his childhood, as well as his past in the military.
