Once the alliance between two kingdoms crumbles, a princess struggles to save her enslaved people from annihilation. As twin brothers vie for the princess they both desire and the right to be King of Babylon, will true love conquer all?

Vilambaram is a 1987 Indian Malayalam film, directed by Balachandra Menon. He also appears in the lead role. The film stars Sukumari, Thilakan and Ashokan in other roles. The film had musical score by S. P. Venkatesh.
The Munsters travel to England after Herman discovers he's the new Lord of the Munster Hall.
A team of assassins travel to other dimensions.
Being a mortuary cosmetologist, Min-Hsiu is used to seeing dead bodies until she accidentally spots a female corpse - her high school teacher Miss Chen Ting.
After catching wind of valuable prohibition-era whiskey hidden on an island, Thomas Waters embarks on a quest for liquid gold and ends up on the priceless adventure of a lifetime.
A story of revenge. A writer trapped in his car receives a call from a murderous stranger. He only chance for survival is to invent a new ending for himself.

Hanuman is the most lovable baby monkey one can imagine. He meets Tom who comes to visit the temple in the Valley of Monkeys and tries to protect it from the robbers. A warm relationship develops between the two.
Two children on holiday in Alderney, along with two local children catch men stealing bird eggs on the uninhabited island of Burhou but discover more than they bargained for.
A Turkish folk singer goes on a tour and falls in love with one of his young fan in Izmir. He later finds out that her sister also has a crush on him.
A group of gamers go on the ultimate quest for Nerdvana.

Some gravity-defying being is killing women in Sydney, Australia, and removing their eyes. The only hope of catching the fiend lies in a hapless man with a psychic link to the killer, who is soon suspected of the crimes.
15 years after the birth of her monster, Yanka turned her life around and became a policewoman. But new murders and bloody crime scenes put her on the trail of a new evil. And he's coming to get her.
6 medics fight for their lives when they are wrongfully accused of spreading an AIDS epidemic in a children's hospital in Benghazi, Libya.
Pink Teddy is the dark story of a young office worker, chosen amongst corporate criminals, to deal with corruptors in the city of Melbourne.
An orphan girl dreams of becoming a ballerina and flees her rural Brittany for Paris, where she passes for someone else and accedes to the position of pupil at the Grand Opera House.
A beloved Pastor works to serve his 'flock' and save his 100 year old church. In his dedication and desire to do so, he crosses boundaries that are not to be crossed.
Bad bank robber falls in love with granddaughter of miner he and his men planned to rob of gold, has change of heart.
Two independent adult actresses attempt to find meaning in their work and relationships; one with her best friend, the other with her worst enemy.
A sexy crime syndicate who pull off "impossible jobs" by posing as high class escorts, plot to heist a billion dollars worth of black market merchandise from the most ruthless men on the planet.
An old magical book in one world exerts a mysterious effect on another.

The door of time opens between the swordsman who wants to seize the legendary divine sword at the end of the Goryeo Dynasty and those who chase after an alien prisoner imprisoned in a human body in 2022.
In the Redwood Forests of California, a multi-millionaire lumberman and his two young grandchildren encounter two gnomes who are supposedly the last of their kind.
An Indian soldier tries to exact revenge on those who had wronged him is backed by the emotional support of two women.

The Holy Maiden of Hell, Ashura possesses immense power that can destroy humanity. Buddhist monks trap her in a deep cave to keep her from falling into evil hands. Kindhearted Abbot Jiku grants her wish to enjoy the human world for 7 days.

movie_name: Rosie and the Artifact of Life
synopsis: A story about a young deer, who seeks to become a wizard, and a bear, once a legendary hero, who set out on a journey to protect an artifact with power capable of destroying the whole world.
A winter diving trip in Norway turns into a desperate race against time for two sisters when one of them becomes trapped at the bottom of the ocean by falling rocks.
A powerful witch's spell changes a lovely girl into a mule destined to die so that she will rise from its carcass before the world to rule as Pan's child bride.

When Mala is presumed to have died in a car accident after being suspected of murdering Lady Hiramani, Mala starts a new life and calls herself Nayantara. Things get complicated when Nayantara is accused of murdering her husband Shekhar.

A mad scientist uses an army of androids and a device that can disintegrate metal to try to steal microchips containing top secret information. The government dispatches a beautiful female agent to stop him.
A Gardener counts himself lucky when he is hired to tend to a large estate owned by the seductive lady of the manor, but everything is not as it seems as strange things begin to happen.

After a worldwide nuclear war, where 68% of the male population was wiped out and virile men becoming a rarity, Sam Hell, a scavenger and a highly virile man, is assigned to help rescue a group of fertile women kidnapped by humanoid frogs.

When corrupt Roman leader Tiberius arrives with a giant army to claim the Silk Road, Huo An teams up his army with an elite Legion of defected Roman soldiers led by General Lucius to protect his country and his new friends.

In this remake without remembering how they got there, several strangers awaken in a prison of cubic cells, some of them booby-trapped. The prisoners must use their combined skills if they are to escape.
A team of highly trained operatives embarks on a perilous mission to infiltrate a heavily fortified enemy base and rescue a captured ally.

A group of women who have been wronged by various men or groups are given a chance at vengeance. One woman, once beaten to a miscarriage, trains these once mistreated women to become artful...                See full synopsis »
An Irish fisherman discovers a woman in his fishing net whom his precocious daughter believes to be a selkie.
A man is blamed for a murder that was actually committed by his wife.

A factory town is covered by chimney smoke, and as the townspeople haven't see the sky in centuries, they no longer believe that stars exist. A chimney sweep and a friendly monster named Poupelle decide to prove that stars are real.

The intersecting stories of three people who face difficult choices in life-changing situations are used to illustrate the theories espoused by Henri Laborit about human behavior and the relationship between the self and society.

A French UN delegate has disappeared into thin air, sending reporter Moreau (Jean-Pierre Melville) and hard drinking photographer Delmas (Pierre Grasset) on an assignment to find him. Their only lead is a picture of three women.

Nikolay (main character) wakes up every time in different places and he doesn't know whether it is a dream or not. Each time he tries to drink coffee after wake up but something goes wrong by different reasons.
A noble underachiever and a beautiful valedictorian fall in love the summer before she goes off to college.

In a future ruled by attractive people, mutant terrorists kidnap a rich man's daughter to claim rights for the ugly. Escaping police, the mutant leader crashes into a planet of crazy miners where no women live.
A couple's search for the truth about a homophobic crime in Russia.
A former gang member who believes his daughter is the only one who save his community from an curse uttered by a rival gang member in his dying breath.

movie_name: Pokémon Ranger and the Temple of the Sea
synopsis: Our heroes must protect the Prince of the Sea, Manaphy, from the evil pirate Phantom, and return the young Pokémon to the Sea Temple with the help of the the People of the Water and Jackie the Pokémon Ranger.
A Han man named Zhong Ken, Insisted on becoming a singer of the story of King Gesar. Eventually because of the encountered people and things, gradually put down the obsession.
A detective goes in search for the villain responsible for several burglaries and a murder.
All the animals are off on their annual picnic, except for Bor the Wolf. Just then an army of termites invades the peaceful forest.
An exchange of personalities, between a Neapolitan gangster and a ten year old girl.

A group of heavily armed hijackers board a luxury ocean liner in the South Pacific Ocean to loot it, only to do battle with a series of large-sized, tentacled, man-eating sea creatures who had already invaded the ship.
Josie Laurene is a spy who months ago made a terrible mistake when she let international secrets slip through her fingers. Now, she's on a mission to get them back.
Arjun and Shivan have a liking for Parvathy, their classmate. A fight breaks out between them over the girl, and to avoid further complications, Arjun's father sends him to Kodaikanal.
A deadly encounter with Bigfoot forces two former enemies to join forces to survive.
A soldier with a history of PTSD finds himself caught up in a small town's serial killer investigation.
When their adoptive mother is gunned down in a store robbery, four brothers decide to investigate the murder and find the killers themselves, but not all is what it seems.

Aagman depicts the story of East Indian indentureship in Trinidad and Tobago. It features the trials that four different characters faced and what contributed to them leaving their homeland to venture into a new, unknown future.

The untitled crime thriller will chronicle the real-life escapades and escapes of charismatic criminal Faïd, whose obsession with Hollywood films inspired his career of armed robberies and breakouts from prison.

Two friends try to re-unite by going on a road-trip to the forests and mountains. Their attempt to reconcile does not go easy due to the secrets they hold, and a shocking revelation ends their journey.
Following a serious skydiving accident, a man discovered the power to fly - But what interests in the current society that a man knows how to fly ?
A heavily addicted smoker is unprepared for the true price he must pay when he asks a guru's help to kick the habit.
A C.I.A. Agent is used as a pawn in an insane woman's plan to steal a Polaris submarine.
A cat and mouse game between a sociopath criminal, a young female detective and a mystifying businessman.
A team of experts travels deep into the mountains to find a dangerous creature.

The "Gorchlach" is an ancient esoteric artifact of Celtic origin that will take the two protagonists Guglielmo Corsaris and Rachel Blackwood into an adventure between past and present, history and legend.
Two newspaper reporters battle a plot by the evil Dr. Grood to conquer the world.
A group of lucky draw winners win a dream vacation on a seemingly idyllic island resort, only to discover themselves trapped on an island infested with deadly snakes.
A small town police chief awaits the arrival of a gang of killers.
A playboy in the medieval times discovers his divinity towards Lord Krishna.
After a car accident in England, an American develops amnesia and tries to find his true identity, using various clues, but ends-up in the midst of a mysterious murder.
Bill Reardon, a private detective, is working on a case involving stolen items from a local jewelry store. The case takes a different turn when Bill's prying wife wants to help catch the crook.
A group of friends travel to a remote Canadian island to hunt, only to be attacked by giant killer animals which have populated the place.
Agent Rude Buay is confronted with an impasse as three high ranking members of the Dragon Drug Cartel once assumed dead, return and team up with ex-convict Johnny Too Bad.
An abused woman conjures up a spirit to take revenge on the men who have misused her.
Kang Jin-kyu is imprisoned for killing a man who had wronged him. However, his mental anguish increases when he learns that his son has betrayed him and joined the gang of his enemy.
Two Security Guards must be survive one night in a closed factory when years ago many workers was killed on strange circumstances.

The psychiatrist Anna go on holiday with her daughter to the South of Italy where her father lives. Anna meets an old lawyer friend who asks her to run a psychiatric examination on a man who killed in a moment of homicidal madness.
In 1964, a group of scientists create a portal that takes them to a barren, mutant inhabited, Earth in the year 2071.
What if you were eleven hours away from being executed for a murder you didn't commit, and the only way to save yourself was to go back in time, and commit the murder?
An amnesiac trying to put his life back together is increasingly suspicious of his own past.

Honest Plush Brannon is a con-man thrown out of the Barbary Coast in San Francisco in the 1880s and headed for the gold rush region of Nevada. He discovers a real mine which lead to several complications.
"A newspaper predicts the deaths of a man's (Hiroshi Mikami) family members and friends.

A group of Russian tourists go on a shopping spree to the neighboring Finland - only to be attacked by the Finnish cannibals. We focus on a middle-aged woman and her teenage son who is shooting the film, as we watch it, on his cell-phone.
The humorous adventures of the notorious Scottish highwayman and thief Davey Haggart during the 1820s in Britain.

In the dying days of World War II, Nazi scientists hatch a desperate plan to turn the population of New York into flesh-eating zombies. The only man who can stop them is DICK DYNAMITE: killing is his business and in '44 business is good.

A French convict in the 1930s befriends a fellow criminal as the two of them begin serving their sentence in the South American penal colony on Devil's Island, which inspires the man to plot his escape.
A young man meets a girl who might be a ghost, but matters turn serious when his friends start dying under mysterious circumstances.
A mourning mother and her newly adopted son's mysterious secrets become revealed as they battle together through what they believe to be ghostly encounters.
In this intimate exploration of identity, trauma and power, a young woman seeks out her birth mother, inadvertently triggering a string of events which change both their lives.
A pawn tries to get rid of a traitorous minister, Qin Hui, when he leads an army to the border for talks with a Jurchen mission.
A lonely teen's friendship with a free-spirited British neighbor pushes her to break free of the bonds of childhood.
A rehabilitated drug addict kills a baseball player in self defense, threatening her chances of regaining custody of her children.
A former police detective, still recovering from his alcohol addiction, is seemingly drawn into L.A's criminal underworld after stumbling upon a local drug ring.
In a country far away from home, eight different lives connect to begin the adventure of an overseas Filipino child in the middle east. Eight lives, eight stories, each has their own struggles.
Two young brothers are drawn into an intergalactic adventure when their house is hurled through the depths of space by the magical board game they are playing.

movie_name: Professor Layton and the Eternal Diva
synopsis: Layton and Luke are caught up in an adventure, when a masked figure steals an entire opera house and forces those in attendance to play a high-stakes game. The winner will receive eternal life, but it could mean death for the losers.

movie_name: Jiaoren of the South China Sea
synopsis: On Chen Shui's wedding night, his bride's kidnapped by jiaoren, people from Chinese mythology who produce pearls from tears. He sets sail to a small island in the South China Sea and finds out true reason for jiaoren's violence for humans.

Experienced British spy must retrieve a defecting Soviet scientist from Turkey. When a pretty female innocent bystander gets kidnapped by mistake by his enemies, he feels responsible and decides to help her as well.

An asocial, obese German woman lives in a large city. Unfortunately despite her kind and intelligent personality, she has had a lot of trouble making a connection with people, until she gets a crush on a handsome subway conductor.
A man struggles with the daily issues in his life. The situation changes when he befriends Faby, who helps him in solving all the problems.
The lone surviving thief of a violent bank robbery is sprung from a high security facility and administered an experimental drug.

The origin story of the mythical Greek hero. Betrayed by his stepfather, the King, and exiled and sold into slavery because of a forbidden love, Hercules must use his formidable powers to fight his way back to his rightful kingdom.
With Louie away, Slip turns the Sweet Shop into an escort service that attracts the attention of bank robbers.
Newly released from prison, Jack searches in vengeance for the girl who put him there.
When Carol's father, a company chairman begins investigating the murder of a company executive, he is brutally murdered, leading her to seek revenge.
An English Duke from 1876 is inadvertedly dragged to modern day New York where he falls for a plucky advertising executive.
Soldiers from the Soviet Union's once mighty Red Fleet look to liberate their people from a former ruler's dark, brutal legacy.

After a failed heist for the Al Millennium, team Erwin rendezvous at a mysterious building to escape the authority, however after odd events they soon realize that a greater threat might be from within.
After their boat mysteriously sinks, a group of friends, with no supplies and strange happenings, try to trust each other long enough to survive.
In order to find his kidnapped girlfriend, a hedonistic college student must face a dangerous mafia group and a satanic cult that believes he is the re-incarnation of Lucifer.
A psychologically disturbed matriarch presides over her damaged family of bank-robbing misfits.
Geng Han is a geek who encounters a pair of criminals in a video game and ends up going undercover for the police in this Chinese actioner.
In Africa an explorer is the reincarnated lover of the 2,000-year-old White Queen.
Four Catholic school girls face killer nuns, gangsta Jews and giant lobsters.
A young couple are stranded in a remote location for several days without food or water, while a massive, giant, madman stalks their every move, proving it impossible for them to escape unscathed.
Film noir parody with a detective uncovering a sinister plot. Characters from real noirs appear as scenes from various films are intercut.
The early life of Elizabeth I, from her childhood until her accession to the throne of England in 1558.
A pretentiously artistic director is hired for a new Broadway musical and changes it beyond recognition.

The Moorish general Othello is manipulated into thinking that his new wife Desdemona has been carrying on an affair with his lieutenant Michael Cassio when in reality it is all part of the scheme of a bitter ensign named Iago.
In a world where crime doesn't take a day off, Jack is a cop, ready to uphold the law even if that means breaking the law.
Marine atomic tests cause changes in the ocean's ecosystem resulting in dangerous blobs of radiation and the resurrection of a dormant dinosaur that threatens London.
A woman looking to start over moves into a new apartment, only to find that she is not as alone as she had believed.
A lonely child musters the strength to protect a lost unicorn from evil scientists.
A young rebellious girl hooks up with a biker gang. Her mother hires a private detective to find her and bring her back. The detective goes undercover as a biker to search for her.

Miguel ha tenido una vida dificil, desde el crimen que le quitó la vida a sus padres, hasta el encarcelamiento de su hermano y su asesinato dentro de la prisión. Con el tiempo cobrará justicia por su cuenta.

Adapted from Ron Arias' novel, The Road to Tamazunchale, Fausto Tejada, is in the final chapter of his life. Still full of imagination, this remarkable everyman blurs the realities of memory, time and space, changing lives for the better.
Fictionalized chronicles of Eugen Sandow, "The Strongest Man In The World" and highest paid entertainer at the turn of the century.
In the deepest, most remote part of the Amazon, a treasure is hidden. A treasure so valuable that men would kill for it, women would undress for it, and entire armies would fight for it.
A former gangster makes it big in Hollywood, but his old life catches up with him.
A fantasy/drama - "Vincent" tells the story of young bullied teenager who meets a haunting stranger who has the power to change his life forever.
Adaptation of the Millerworld comic book series of the same name.
A story of a charming and cunning fox who helps a love-struck blacksmith to bring laughter to Emma, a young woman who never laughs or smiles.
A British medical doctor fights a cholera epidemic in a small Chinese village, while being trapped at home in a loveless marriage to an unfaithful wife.
A fugitive toy-maker on the run from a vengeful bounty hunter finds refuge in a town with a dark secret and a very serious rat problem

In the 1920's, rising starlet Cassidy Capri is troubled after discovering a series of tijuana bibles made of her. Driven away by her anxieties, she stumbles on the Carnival Desoto, a sideshow attraction of mystery, murder, and monsters.
A famous detective is invited to a swanky party at an elegant mansion, but before the night is over he finds himself involved with gangsters, blackmail and murder.
Prisoner to the mystical powers of the ancient Infernalius, Arius embarks on a journey to hunt the one marked by the ancient sword, in exchange for his freedom.
A man and a woman are compelled by a mysterious higher power to lose themselves in each other.

Biopic of Constantine the Great, set between 293-312 AD, from his days as Tribune to his accession as Roman Emperor of Gaul under the tetrarchy system and ending with his battle against the usurper Roman Emperor Maxentius in Rome.
A film delivery man promises a beautiful young woman to deliver a film reel on time to a movie theater. But the the whole city seems to conspire against him.

A sequel to mystic thriller Karthikeya (2014), which deals with the personal problems of Karthik and how he comes out of them. His pursuit of the truth leads him to find out the power of Indian ancient system and Tatva of Lord Sri Krishna.
When business becomes pleasure at a massage parlor, someone has to lose.
Astronaut discovers plots of sabotage within the space agency.

movie_name: The Knight of Shadows: Between Yin and Yang
synopsis: A legendary demon hunter (Jackie Chan), tracking down beasts that enter the human dimension, assisted by a lawman protégé and a motley group of friendly monsters.
A man wanting to stay in the US enters into a marriage of convenience, but it turns into more than that.
XuanYuan the Great Emperor tells the legendary story of the ancestor of Chinese people: Ji Di. Ji Di lived in the Yellow River basin about 5000 years ago.

movie_name: Intô kokuhaku: Aniyome no nureta gogo
synopsis: Hikaru Momota, a freelance photographer, returns to her parents' home for the first time in a long time after receiving news of her father's death. Unbeknownst to Momota, her older brother has married.
A young couple is thrust into a deadly game of cat and mouse after they trek deep into the wilderness on a honeymoon canoe trip and become targets of a vengeful family.
Orbiting a planet on the brink of war, scientists test a device to solve an energy crisis, and end up face-to-face with a dark alternate reality.

Obsessed with perfecting his craft, young gemcutter Danilo visits the mystical Copper Mountain to uncover the secret behind its infamous attraction - the Stone Flower, a stone carving so captivating that no one can leave after seeing it.
A writer's fictional alter ego wants to take over his life...at any price.

This teen dance drama is about a young hip hop artist who is rejected by his old dance crew for heading off to college before a major competition. As result, he assembles a ragtag crew to face off against his former friends.
Earth's mightiest heroes must come together and learn to fight as a team if they are going to stop the mischievous Loki and his alien army from enslaving humanity.
One completely unexceptional man. One emotionally unstable robot with a huge spaceship - and many, many, many aliens. On a mission to save (or destroy) the Galaxy.

A man becomes obsessed with finding his missing wife, drowning in the nostalgia of a 16mm home movie of her, and letting his grief gradually consume him until he gets caught up in a sinister occurrence.
A card cheat is threatened with exposure into joining a criminal enterprise that Holmes believes is controlled by Professor Moriarty.
Chelsea, a high school track star comes clean about sexual misconduct with her coach only to find out her confession might be too late.
An animated film based on "The Village Of Horror" Creepypasta posted on the Creepypasta Files Fandom website.
A New England sea captain in the 1880s arrives at his fiancée's sprawling Texas ranch, where he becomes embroiled in a feud between two families over a valuable patch of land.
A deadly shape-shifting alien infiltrates a country house occupied by two lesbians, and proceeds to study their behaviour, for a sinister purpose.
Shekhar marries Sharda, but soon he is arrested by the police for the murder of a woman named Hemlata, with whom he was involved. He is later tried in the court by his disapproving father.
Dad of 4 wins a ski trip from a newspaper and the 5 travel to Norway with a press photographer and have fun.
What happens when a psychopath meets an all-American family of psychopaths?
The curator at the Museum of SuperNatural History must protect the world's best-kept secrets.
A bandit leader kidnaps the wife of the policeman who killed his sister, but later falls in love with her.
Honest police officer, Dev, tries to fight the corrupt system prevalent in Daulatpura because of a powerful criminal. He vows to end the tyrant's hooliganisms and bring peace to the town.
Atrabilious follows Steven Joyner as he tries to solve the mystery behind his son's sudden, tragic and potentially fabricated death.

A depressed young adult wakes up in a familiar place but doesn't know why they are there. After encountering a socially confident version of their self, they begin to explore the possibility of a parallel universe.
A group of thieves breaks into a chamber expecting to find paintings, but instead they release the count himself, who travels to New Orleans to find his nemesis' daughter, Mary Van Helsing.

In a little town of Texas, USA., a powerful storm causes the return among the livings of a dangerous serial killer, Jason V., assassinated by a Vietnar War veteran during an ambush. A furious, bloody and deadly carnage follows.
Paddy, leaves prison with the hopes of regaining his old life.
Toto and his friends must rescue his egg children after they're taken away for a gourmet food event in Africa.

A new teacher comes by transfer to an elementary school in Athens. He will distinguish a student which can't read, write or do arithmetic, and will help to discover some other talents he has, and will give him an incentive to try to learn.

The director of a horror film invites the cast and crew to watch the first cut; things take a dark turn as they begin to notice some scenes that were never filmed. What happens on screen has consequences in the real world.
Quien dijo que eran el sexo débil?. Cuatro valientes y aguerridas mujeres pelean contra una pandilla de criminales que quiere apoderarse de una valiosa fórmula de un cientÍfico.

movie_name: National Lampoon's Ratko: The Dictator's Son
synopsis: The son of a dictator travels to the U.S. to attend college.
Behind every crime is a story.
When a popular video game streamer plays a haunted game, he faces deadly consequences for himself and his fans.
A celebratory cliff jump turns to a nightmare injury which turns to a fight for survival on a remote island with no way up or out.
A group of teenage girls on a religious retreat in the mountains soon discover their misdeeds will not go unpunished as they fight to survive the evil that lurks in the darkness.
A lonely accountant seeks direction when she catches her lover in an affair.
Purim: The Lot' tells the dramatic story of the Jewish rebellion against Persian persecution as described in the Old Testament Book of Esther.
In the face of almost certain death the twins Sara and Kim must battle the elements to escape the deepest grave on earth - the challenger deep.

Dima and Oleg gets stranded in the middle of a huge marsh after their boat drifts away. To survive they must deal with the water, the weather and the wildlife. Things got a little hectic after they raided and overtook a poachers' cabin.

movie_name: The Man with the Blue Beard
synopsis: A woman on a trip to Panama discovers a dark past her lover doesn't want her to know about.

Nine-year old George, son of British settlers, is kidnapped by Iroquois and raised by the chief who adopts him. Later he gets the chance to return to his family but refuses because he has discovered that the palefaces are the true savages.

Xane, an immortal vampire, returns to the past to save his former self, Titus. Xane must rescue Titus and stop him from inheriting the curse. Xane is able to save his loved ones, but the broad strokes of time cannot be altered.

A woman is sexually assaulted by a serial rapist wearing a hockey mask. She and other victims form a squad that targets would-be rapists, all the while searching for the mask wearing maniac that raped them all.

Ivan Brovkin doesn't fit into life of his village as he constantly does something wrong. After yet another failure he has to join the Soviet Army where he finally begins to improve. Meanwhile he writes letters home to the girl he loves.

Bill Moore already has a lot, but he wants more, much more. One morning he arrives at work to find a card waiting for him. Its message is just one word: MODIFIED. From that moment on, Bill's life begins to change.
A sage travels to the past and collects a set of legendary swords, which he brings to life as a gang of talented but dysfunctional young men, to fight a battle against evil.
After experiencing a traumatic loss of a colleague, Saanjh starts seeing a mysterious girl in his dreams who takes him through the seven stages of grief.
Despite the admission of guilt from a death row inmate days away from his execution, a young journalist suspects he took the fall for the true killer still at large.

When the murdered body of a high school girl is found naked with a strange mark on her forehead, which is to prevent the vengeance of her spirit, Detective Khan from DSI is assigned to investigate the case.
CIA Agent vs. ninjas in a battle for a chemical weapon.
A British professor must find an ancient artifact as a ransom for his daughter's life.

Enter a world of mystery, possession and shadows in an anthology of short horror themed tales woven into a full length feature presentation. Even the most shocking stories are based on true events. Starring horror legend Tony Todd.

In a magical prison for fourteen hundred years, Tal is released and grows up in the early 20th century, with powers he hides. When the sorceress that trapped him allies with the Nazis, he must use them to defend England. He'll need help.
After Dexter is confronted with robots who wish to "destroy the one who saved the future," he uses his time machine to see how he saved it.

Intrigues and entanglements before Prince Paris wins the heart of beautiful Helena. It all happens in the small kingdom of Arcadia at the time of the Trojan War. Swedish version of Jacques Offenbach's operetta of the classic Greek myth.

Centers around a couple who sails into the ocean to commit suicide but are interrupted by the arrival of another mysterious vessel. Before long these two people who were ready to die are fighting to stay alive.

In 1870s Transylvania, scientist Dr. Callistratus is put to death by villagers who wrongly believe he's a vampire. However, his horribly disfigured henchman, Carl is on hand to orchestrate a life-saving heart transplant.

Tokyo, 1934. The boss of the clan that controls gambling agonizes and some of his followers propose to Nakai to take his place, but he refuses the offer and suggests they choose Matsuda, who is in prison.
The Royal Theatre offers a unique immersive movie experience to patrons looking for excitement after being in lockdown. Places are limited, as are your chances of making it out alive.
An apocalyptic horror-action thriller.

movie_name: The Case of the Curious Bride
synopsis: Perry interrupts his vacation plans when an ex-girlfriend, now newly married, asks him to help her with murder and bigamy charges.
Two newlyweds buy a small private island in the British Virgin Islands and live a happy life without the comforts of modern society.

Zizu suffers from wasting his body and his health is ridiculing all around him. Zizu wants to become a sports hero to be a source of pride for the son of his sister Samir, who takes a higher example of his uncle.
An ugly guy in spandex (supposedly an alien) befriends Spain's youngest psychopath.
Set in the 1490s, William Frost, a magician, struggles to fathom a trick called Phantasma.
After the death of Dr. Frankenstein. His creations escapes and taking over the village.
A private detective gets more than he bargains for when he encounters Philip Swan, a performer whose amazing illusions captivate the world, but they are not really what everyone thinks.
A classical pianist's chilling first-person account of an unexplained and terrifying supernatural being. Based on actual video diary footage of the events.

A troubled private investigator plagued by strange blackouts and visions takes the case of a young scientist after a break-in at his apartment reveals a connection between her estranged husband and his own repressed trauma.
Traumatized by their experiences with boys, they form a man-haters club and pledge never to look at guys. But everything changes when they meet guys who make them realize what love is all about.
Gulubú, a territory of the fantasy world inhabited by the student cow, the wizard and other characters from the stories and songs of María Elena Walsh.
Based on the non-fictional novel "Dadagiri Dinagalu", an affluent youth is dragged into the 1980s Bangalore underworld to save his love from his conspiring father.
Sequel to the hugely successful Ripper:Letter from Hell.
Based on a poem by Rumi, tells of the silent love of a young man for an unknowing girl.

A girl and a young man manage to succeed in the world of music overcoming some difficulties.

A murdered woman returns to life as a shape-shifting ghost who can transform into a wolf.

The Street Angels are always at work. Raphael, a street Angel, arrives to collect his next assignment, only to be given a message that he can take a holiday for the first time in eons...if he can catch the train on time..

After the disappearance of her mother, Sophia falls into a journey, leading her to her destiny.

Banished to the mortal world, a warrior has to slay a demon to return to the heavenly realm and become a god.

A single mother who is a renowned hired killer finds it difficult to achieve a balance between her personal and work life.

Story of a group of drag races and the young boy and girl who join them.

movie_name: A Connecticut Yankee in King Arthur's Court
synopsis: A singing mechanic from 1912 finds himself in Arthurian Britain.
A young musician hopes to marry his beautiful Indian girlfriend, but his plans hit a snag when her family learns he's Pakistani.

Widowed Klara James, which has a son Robert, is adored by Captain Frank, but he wants her married to a count, which ultimately is recognized as a spy.
When a vigilante border patrol turns fatal, a man flees on horseback to Mexico, seeking forgiveness from the victim's father.

A man spends one night alone inside a haunted theater for a large cash prize. Will he live until morning?
Wrongly condemned for killing his wife, a man finds himself in a mysterious institution where he is sentenced to relive her death for eternity.

movie_name: Someone Wants to Talk with You

A group of expat criminals are coerced into a suicide mission behind enemy lines to destroy a game-changing chemical weapon developed by the Nazis and Japanese during World War II.
Inspired by the article "A Kiss Before Dying" by Pamela Colloff, published by Texas Monthly.

War correspondent meet an alluring, enigmatic woman at a cocktail party, before a dangerous power play engulfs the two.

Agent Agni, a highly trained and deadly field agent is entrusted with the mission to gather Intel and eliminate Rudraveer, an international human and arms trafficker who has been off the radar for ten years.

In a small Town in the early 1900's there was once a legend about a Sickle Man, this killer was brutal and would only kill because he was told too! But who told him to slaughter, was it Supernatural? The legend lives on!
Prehistoric animals emerge from a science lab and tear up most of Los Angeles.
A motley crew of professional thieves plans the robbery of a Monte Carlo casino vault.
Two criminals find themselves stuck in the middle of the desert, after their car strikes a wild Mountain Lion.
In 1930s Italy, a veteran World War I pilot is cursed to look like an anthropomorphic pig.
Feature film inspired by Sun Tzu's ancient document of military strategy.
Events unfold after a devastating earthquake in Los Angeles.
A bereaved son relies on his late father's surreal disclosures to decipher the strain in their relationship, family secrets, and a life not yet lived.

A devolved heroin addict is provoked by a documentary filmmaker to leave his dark existence to reconstruct with her the events that led up to his father's disappearance twenty years ago. their dreams.
Detectives struggle to unravel a difficult homicide while having to cope with political obstacles and dead end clues.
The Clash Continues as Pushpa and Bhanwar Singh continue their rivalry in this epic conclusion to the two-parted series.
A young girl being forced into an arranged marriage by her well-meaning but controlling mother, tries to find ways to avoid each man brought to her house, with the help of her friends.
The evil Brand X joins a supermarket that becomes a city after closing time.

Nicholas Peterson is madly in love with his fiance, Bryan Lane. But when Bryan Lane's drug addiction leads to several other crimes and fleeing from the law, Nicholas is faced with the struggle of whether to tell anyone or keep quiet.
Set in a futuristic London, a band of thieves looks to restore hope to the city's impoverished population.
After surviving an invasion on her peaceful homeworld, a beautiful avenger must stop a powerful psychopath from gaining immortality and rescue her kidnapped sister.

After a freak, on-set accident, a Christmas-hating movie producer finds herself trapped inside one of her Christmas romantic comedies and is forced to employ her knowledge of the genre to find her way back into reality.
An amateur boxer runs errands for a local gangster but revolts against him after the gangster kills his friend and his conscience is awakened.

When a murder remains unsolved, 3 boys suspect and harass a reclusive indigenous man. One boy decides to break the cycle to make amends, however the inertia of past actions bring multiple characters to a crossroad and thrilling climax.

movie_name: The Girl in the Spider's Web
synopsis: Young computer hacker Lisbeth Salander and journalist Mikael Blomkvist find themselves caught in a web of spies, cybercriminals and corrupt government officials.
An arson investigator goes undercover to break up a ring that sets fires in order to collect the insurance.
The crew of the ship Serenity try to evade an assassin sent to recapture telepath River.
In just 3 days, three cases of Smiling Murder shock Hong Kong. The young detective Wang Bu'er and his buddy Huang Feihong embark on an investigation full of excitement and unexpected events.

A cult erotic drama from the perverse imagination of Alain Robbe-Grillet, SUCCESSIVE SLIDINGS OF PLEASURE delves into the twisted mind of a young woman suspected in the stabbing death of her roommate Nora.
Several Russian students try to catch Blair Witch in the woods of the Leningrad region.
A fierce and calculating mother drags her two sons into a rampage of violence and bloodshed in order to improve her standing among the city's organized crime families.
A modern day immigrant story which follows the journey of Mashka, a young Russian woman trying to make it in the US, after finally escaping from a sex-trafficking ring.

A gang of 4 Danish criminals are ordered by Færingen to steal a bag from a safe. When they see DKK4,000,000 in the bag, they keep it for themselves and head for Spain. They end up in a ruin of an old restaurant on Jutland and renovate it.
Pony and Pigeonboy tells a story of seven-year-old girl Pony who doesn't want to go to school, and big-mouthed Pigeonboy who has solution to all possible problems.
In the dying Southern town of Gruesome, a sheriff seeking redemption and his disabled deputy clash with a prejudiced Judge over a series of grisly murders.
Nine-year-old Paulo stumbles upon a photograph of Miguel, the grandfather he never met, sets out to track him down and eventually meets him, at which point the magic begins.
Robinson Crusoe spoof, with touches of Peter Pan. Shipwreck victim lands on a desert island, finds a friendly native and has to fight pirates whose leader is Captain Hook himself.
A group of rebellious San Diego skateboarders who take it upon themselves to investigate their town's paranormal activity and wind up embarking on the adventure of a lifetime.

Kofi and Billie's unraveling marriage splinters into entangled affairs in this sexy, sophisticated romantic drama. Kofi finds solace in a younger woman who idolizes him while Billie begins a steamy affair with her female colleague.
A woman afflicted with paralysis all her life gains the use of her limbs little-by-little as a result of romance.
Two sisters diving in a ruined underwater city quickly learn they've entered the territory of the deadliest shark species in the claustrophobic labyrinth of submerged caves.
A socially awkward driver and a weary passenger try to make it to their destination while being haunted by a supernatural threat.

movie_name: The Swan Princess: A Royal Wedding
synopsis: Princess Odette and Prince Derek are going to a wedding at Princess Mei and her beloved Chen. But evil forces are at stake and the wedding plans are tarnished and true love has difficult conditions.
A psychiatrist makes multiple trips through time to save a woman that was murdered by her brutal husband.
A misfit ant, looking for "warriors" to save his colony from greedy grasshoppers, recruits a group of bugs that turn out to be an inept circus troupe.
Many interested parties are after the loot from a factory payroll heist but the mobster who hid it has amnesia after undergoing experimental brain surgery in the prison hospital.
Females fighting with other in a yakuza gang.

A terrorist cult sets out to kick off the apocalypse with a series of novels designed to brainwash their readers, but the world's most notorious spy is sent to track down and kill the author responsible.
After his swamp is filled with magical creatures, Shrek agrees to rescue Princess Fiona for a villainous lord in order to get his land back.
Richard Burton plays a Scottish Army officer put in charge of a disparate band of ANZAC troops on the perimeter of Tobruk with the German Army doing their best to dislodge them.
A sheriff investigating the disappearance of a young girl from a small island discovers there's a larger mystery to solve among the island's secretive, neo-pagan community.

A young science graduate stuck between career choices travels to the snowy mountains of Kashmir to find answers, where he encounters a look-alike killer and his subconscious desires come to life, guiding him towards his decision.
A small girl goes blind when her Mother is murdered.

The story of Joseon's tyrant king Yeonsan who exploits the populace for his own carnal pleasures, his seemingly loyal retainer who controls him and all court dealings, and a woman who seeks vengeance.
Unsure of her own existence, Monica attempts to influence her partner to commit a murder in hopes it will answer her existential crises.
James and Ashwinikumar are secret agents from Ringania and India fighting to stop the villains hell bent on world domination.
The story begins when Tien Tien is about to be born. Her father was fighting the demon who has stolen lots of children. Her mother is killed and her father has taken up the fight.
In South America the wife of the president's son loves the leader of a revolution.
A specially trained squad of guinea pigs is dispatched to stop a diabolical billionaire from taking over the world.

Tales of the Riverbank tells the story of three friends - Hammy Hamster, Roderick Rat and GP the Guinea Pig - who, having swept down the river in a violent storm, embark on an epic journey in search of their lost homes.
Mr. Moto goes undercover to find out who has been blowing up oil wells and trying to gain total control of all the oil leases from a petroleum-rich Middle Eastern country.

Through a forged will, a crook assumes control of a valuable estate. He poses as the brother of a dead man, and endeavors to dispose of the deceased man's two daughters, one of whom is in love with the forger's son.
Karmachakra is a first Indian anime film. Announced in 2017 by Studio Durga.
A reporter and his girlfriend investigate deaths surrounding a hotel where several prominent people go to have sex.
After her brother mysteriously vanishes from the Mexican desert, a young woman sets out to uncover the otherworldly truth about his disappearance.
A diverse team of scientists on a research expedition fall victim to an alien infection.
In 1941, the IRA plans a campaign to coincide with the planned German invasion of England. Dermot O'Neill finds it easy to get into the IRA, but can he get out?

In 1992 the US Navy closes its base at Subic Bay. A trio of Navy SEALS are involved with island women. Hawk, an idealist, the amiable Bladon who is deeply in love with a prostitute, and the increasingly mentally unbalanced Stryzack.
Illegal military grade assault rifles heat up Houston's mean streets and causes deadly tension the cops, robbers and those straddling the fence in between the two.
The police use a gangster's son to get to him.
Two stepsisters are overlooked for marriage by the prince and embark on an epic journey, realizing that their own perfect fairytales might be different from what they originally thought.

movie_name: Tales of a Fifth Grade Robin Hood
synopsis: After a young boy in an under-funded inner-city school discovers the head of the school board is stealing money from fundraisers, he organizes his friends together to get that money back where it belongs.
The story of a scheme to double-cross and steal money from the syndicate, and a police commissioner's efforts to investigate homicides in the city of corruption.
A shipwrecked lass sets up housekeeping on a desert island and rescues a female native from certain doom, thereby winning herself a Girl Friday.

A new mega shark threatens to destroy humanity. The government creates an exact robotic copy of the shark, either equal to or greater than the original. Now they must fight to the death while people and whole cities get in the way.
After Brooklyn receives a mysterious call for help from her ex-girlfriend, she ventures deep into the abyss, trying to find her lost love before she's consumed by a terrible danger.

Drug dealer Guo-hao hopes to make big money by an unknown cocaine deal so that he and his girlfriend can leave their life of crime behind. But he soon realized that the whole thing is not that simple.

This is not your ordinary "popculture-nihilistic-genXadults and millennials-with-guns-screwing-people-over- black comedy- action- drama film". Well, to be honest, it is. And the infinite theme of love.
This is a vehicle for the Polonia Brothers' very early work to be shown from 1983 to 1985.
The alcoholic Zapote discovers that his sister has to work in a cabaret and, among other things, shows her charms to many men in order to maintain him.

The Chinese military must battle an unimaginable and unstoppable super-massive creature that is devastating Shanghai, while the civilian and scientific authorities search for a solution before it threatens the world at large.
A home invasion turns deadly when the would be robbers and their targets are held captive by the mob.
During the brutal Iraqi invasion of Kuwait, a group of Kuwaiti resistance groups gather in their home, just to be discovered by Iraqi military forces, attacking the house and facing them with tanks.
A self-indulgent and vain publishing magnate finds his privileged life upended after a vehicular accident with a resentful lover.
Explores the dual themes of friendship and loneliness. Sanaka and Paromita are mother and daughter-in-law who, despite differences in age, backgrounds and temperaments, build a strong bond together.
A violent police detective investigates a brutal murder that might involve a manipulative and seductive novelist.

When the girl bully at his new middle school makes him feel like an alien, 11-year-old Jake Galloway is forced to get a grip on the superpowers budding within him in time to stop her from taking over the world.

It is the story of two types: Moltes a criminal in prison and Reggio one of the guards. Crazy adventures happen when following a winner ticket to Africa, they competes in a rally and are chased by the Turk, a sworn enemy of Moltes.

Ghahvee " Story's main Character Sets off to achieve his greatest desire which is being a butterfly. Ghahvee in order to achieve his desire has to make a deal that leads to various problems for him and his Friends. Mean while.
A former Marine stands in the way of the Straw Hat Pirates.

In an allegorical female driven film that intimately explores the idea of growing beyond violence, a tight-knit group of vampires crashes into the twenty-first century when their master awakes from decades of sleep.

movie_name: Artie Filbert is Comin' to Town!
synopsis: Plot kept under wraps.
Johnny, an ex-Marine, and Evelyn, a chance acquaintance, find themselves caught up in a plot involving Nazi spies in California.

Inspired by the story of the battle of Dovra monastery in 1822 in Veria, Greece, the love story of two young Greeks unfolds as they prepare to secretly get married in a church that is surrounded by Turkish troops.

Prathyardhi revolves around a mysterious case of a missing person Vijay.Sub inspector Krishna considers it a case of murder and police arrest the suspects.What happens when an unexpected rival springs out with new revelations?
A senior high school girl is dragged into mire of porn video trafficking. Police detectives try their best to strike the criminal rings.
They both wanted to leave so they did. However once they stumbled upon the artefact, their ambitions changed. But would it go to plan?
In 2024, 88-year-old Suzanne uses deep-fake technology to recreate her deceased husband Edouard, but is he still the same?

An Elf is left behind by Santa to help rescue the Harper family from a lousy Christmas. The Elf and the family get more than they bargained for, as the kids help the Elf discover his special powers and true identity as a budding superhero.
M.I.T. professor John Koestler links a mysterious list of numbers from a time capsule to past and future disasters and sets out to prevent the ultimate catastrophe.
In a world where people are discriminated based on their birthplace, a resident of the much-reviled Saitama Prefecture embarks on a revolutionary campaign to improve things for his home.

movie_name: Legendary Equestrians: The Story of Edward D. Brown and the First Black Horsemen
synopsis: The plot revolves around an African American jockey-trainer combo in post-antebellum America along with his apprentices, whose love for horses and a desire to settle into a new world leads them on a journey of a lifetime.

movie_name: Frankenpimp's Revenge: The Romeo and Juliet Massacre
synopsis: Cartoonist: Romeo Montague, a skilled (dying, bloated and drunken) former vampire-killer and his star-crossed bad-girl-with-a gun-partner: Julie Crapuletti, returns in this campy, erotics sequel to the infamous cult-classic:'Frankenpimp'.

Mothra and her fairies return to Japan to warn mankind that they must return Kiryu to the sea, for the dead must not be disturbed. However Godzilla has survived to menace Japan leaving Kiryu as the nation's only defense.

A tale of an underdog mistreated by his family, given kung fu instruction from an unlikely source, and redeemed when he comes back to take on foreign champions in a tournament staged before an imperial audience.
Captain Drummond becomes a prisoner when he intents to protect a beautiful heiress of an espionage organization.

A kidnapped US Ranger is implanted with an explosive device. Either he accepts his fate as determined by his puppet master in a war against drug and arms dealers, or he can stand up for what he believes in.
Shivali, a young and true devotee of Lord Shiva, had no idea that her life would change on her 20th birthday after discovering her origin of being a shape-shifting serpent.

Rita is the daughter of a family carrying and ancient blood with extraordinary abilities. Every 100 years they need to sacrifice to protect the people. The destiny brings her to a rocky vertical mountains where the monsters lives.

Scooby and the gang face their most challenging mystery ever: a plot to unleash the ghost dog Cerberus upon the world. As they race to stop this dogpocalypse, the gang discovers that Scooby has an epic destiny greater than anyone imagined.
The ancient war between humans and a race of giants is reignited when Jack, a young farmhand fighting for a kingdom and the love of a princess, opens a gateway between the two worlds.
Plot kept under wraps Son.

After an unprecedented global pandemic turns the majority of humankind into violent "Infected," a man gifted with the ability to speak the Infected's new language leads the last survivors on a hunt for Patient Zero and a cure.
A young, traveling salesman, whose mode of transportation is a flying vacuum cleaner, must go to Hell to save his parents when they are kidnapped by the Devil himself.
A look at the 17-25 December 2013 corruption scandal in Turkey, from the viewpoint of the Erdogan government.

Sweety meets Sanjay and both fall in love with each other. After dating for a while, they attend to a party where Sweety gets to see the true colors of an intoxicated and flirtatious Sanjay, making her wonder if he really is her true love.
A young girl moves to a village populated by anthropomorphic animals.

movie_name: The Day It Came to Earth
synopsis: A glowing meteor falls into a secluded pond into which Mafia hitmen have dumped the body of one of their victims. Students from the local college use the pond for a swimming hole. Then the fun begins.
A man, with the help of a friendly police and a lady reporter, stops a huge drug deal.

A puppet master who struggles to write his next play and his relationship with his daughter as a father and also as a master. Films key narrative is Karla and her journey to writing a story and seeking the meaning of happiness.
A 400-foot (122-meter) dinosaur-like beast, awoken from undersea hibernation off the Japanese coast by atomic-bomb testing, attacks Tokyo.
Marco Polo Jr., the descendant of the legendary explorer, goes on a daring journey in search of his own destiny.
In a fantastic quasi Georgian (18th century) world, a fanatical religious sect "The Holy Exaltation" have taken control.

While leading the Third Crusade, King Richard the Lionheart (George Sanders) battles treachery in his own camp as well as the Saracens and their charismatic leader Emir Hderim Sultan Saladin (Sir Rex Harrison).

Strongman Maciste must battle the one-eyed Cyclops monster that is ravaging the land of Sadok, while at the same time fending off the advances of the evil Queen Capys, who wants to do a little ravaging of her own.
A musical version of Charles Dickens's story of a miserly misanthrope who is taken on a magical journey.
When the owner and operator of a luxurious island invites a collection of guests to live out their most elaborate fantasies in relative seclusion, chaos quickly descends.

After being shot, Tom awakens from a coma to discover that fragments of his smartphone have been embedded in his head--and worse, that returning to normal teenage life is impossible because he has developed a strange set of superpowers.
Spoiled socialite will learn a lesson after her father asks her to work in a family homeless center.
In 1997 the Anderson family vanished from their home without a trace. No bodies were ever found. For 17 years the house has remained undisturbed... until now.
Raja, a jobless youth, and his well-educated brother Ramesh fall in love with Latha, a distant relative. The two brothers compete against each other to win over Latha's love.
A boxer wins a championship but he is injured and forced to retire. After that he falls in love with a blind girl.
A group of medical researchers discover a way to bring dead patients back to life.
When the only thing a bullheaded inventor cares about is winning, he risks losing more than just the contest.

Piel, a 7 or 8 year old boy, is alone on the desert planet Perdide, only survivor of an attack by giant hornets. Calling for help, Piel's father's friend Jaffar keeps contact with the kid and hurries across space toward Perdide.
A film crew arrives at a village and is soon haunted by supernatural beings, during their shoot of a horror movie.

The evening of his break-up with Cath, Sam is victim of an inexplicable phenomenon where he loses consciousness for few hours later. Could his heartbreak be related to the hypothesis of an alien abduction?
A time traveler is accidentally sent into another dimension where Only aliens live in.

Out on parole, a wannabe Country-Music-Sensation plans on fleeing Canada for Nashville, but when a crooked-cop accuses him of killing her drug mule, she gives him an ultimatum: take his place, or go back to prison.
Romance and fantasy mix in this comedy that shows how a heaven-sent cupid tries to seal the romances between two pairs of young lovers.
Evicted from her San Francisco apartment and stranded in her car near Golden Gate Park, a woman makes a secret plan to defend her right to stay in the city she loves.
Chen Buo was born in Taiwan to a Chinese mother and a Caucasian father, an American soldier. As a result, he is harassed by his fellow students and turns to a life of crime when he grows up.
A legally blind woman is being held captive, and must use her limited vision and heightened senses to discern her location and defeat her captor.
A group of young people are trapped in an evil village.
A Turkish comedy film starring Ersin Korkut as a servant for a well-to-do family visited by legendary bloodsucker Count Dracoola.
An exotic plant in a downtown flower shop convinces the storekeeper's meek apprentice to resort to gruesome measures to keep it alive and make it grow.

Victoria, 8 year old girl whose mother just passed away, relocates with her father in a small mountain village. She finds solace in the adoption of a puppy of unknown origin found in an isolated farm.
An actor (John Phillips) is wrongly taken as a professional killer by a band planning to murder the Governor. Then he is hired by the Security Dept. to try to unmask and to catch the leaders.

Scar Island: A place where murder, evil and mayhem have never looked so sexy. A crash landing leaves a group of 30 prep school girls stranded on a deserted island where they confront themselves and each other in a fight for survival.
Story of university students who make a discovery that awakens an army of demons.
A rogue cop turned spy is thrust into a conspiracy of industrial espionage when an agent from a rival spy cell goes after the same objective.

A man awakens with fatal injuries and the total loss of his memory. Yet somehow, he begins to heal stronger than before. He must choose to use his new powers as either the man he was destined to be or the hero he can now become.
A successful businessman develops a hatred towards women as a result of his troubled childhood, which involved the separation of his parents owing to his father's affection towards a prostitute.
"Whoever die first, the dead one must tell to the live one how is their journey of death."
Raising her two daughters, Saritaji "Rekha" fears that history might repeat itself when both of them fall for the same guy.
When a famous author is assaulted in a shady part of the city, Hannah and her team investigate. They stumble upon a prostitution network involving college students.

An emeritus professor of Celtic folklore leads a group of international graduate students on an expedition into the highlands of North Ireland, but an archaeological discovery and misguided ritual conjures a menacing, mythical force.

A fragile young woman, who has tried to escape the dark past of her family, is forced to return to her family's estate. She must relive her previous traumas and confront the true source of her family's guilt.
Mythical creatures are cast down to Earth in human form, where they must find their way back into Heaven.

Grandmother Velma Johnson airs her Public Broadcast TV talk show Our Voice to the black community, by accident unfolds an organization of neo-blacks conducting secret meetings with Africa's notorious dictators proclaiming Hitler's beliefs.
A bullied girl becomes friends with a new kid during a break, but when classes start up again, their new friendship is nearly ruined when the bullying continues.

When a mercenary group takes a lavish wedding hostage, they have no idea what they are in for as the Maid of Honor is actually a secret agent ready to rain hell-fire upon anyone who would ruin her best friend's wedding.

movie_name: Detective Conan: The Time Bombed Skyscraper
synopsis: The detective genius Conan must solve a series of bombings or his true love will die!
João, mounted on his horse Cruzeiro, and in the company of a wanderer named Tahiel, enters a large city in northeastern Brazil to face the one who took his lands and ended up with his family.
A wealthy divorcée falls for a charming Parisian, but her insanely jealous ex-husband will do anything to get her back.

The abduction of a young American, the son of a wealthy businessman. But when the three kidnappers and their hapless victim get lost in the mountains, they end up spending the night in an abandoned cottage that is under a gypsy spell.
In Bangkok, private eye Vincent Calvino searches for the killer of computer wizard Ben Hoadly.
Abused wife of a mobster, who runs a luxury brothel, tries to get the insurance investigator, hired by her ex-lover to track her down, to help her kill her husband and get the insurance money.
A wrongly-convicted English gentleman goes from galley slave to pirate captain.
A remote village in Kerala hires a hunter to kill a ferocious leopard.
After splitting with the Joker, Harley Quinn joins superheroines Black Canary, Huntress, and Renee Montoya to save a young girl from an evil crime lord.
After an accident in a nuclear plant strange things begin to happen: animals like rats become bigger and bigger, attacking human beings, and other weird occurrences.

Hope Douglas has a dream but her parents have thrown her into battle between playing sports and dancing ballet. When a tragedy strikes, Hope has to make a difficult choice that will decide her fate - which way does she go?
Three thieves escape from a heist, one of them killing the other two. He is sheltered by a prostitute and sought after by the police, but only after ten years his true motivation unravels.

movie_name: The Occasionally Interesting Anti-Adventures of an Unnamed Girl
synopsis: An imaginative girl breaks free of her suburban life and enters a fantastical world that turns out to be darker than she could have ever imagined.

movie_name: Arnold Fink and the Great Candy Adventure
synopsis: When Halloween lands on a Saturday, four twelve-year-old boys plan the ultimate day of trick-or-treating. The only problem is they'll have to contend with a group of rowdy teenagers bent on egging them and stealing their candy.
A workoholic man falls in love with a beautiful woman who seeks his help, until he discovers an uncomfortable truth about her, which could disrupt their relationship.
When a young woman's car breaks down in back country Oregon, she finds herself at the mercy of a paranoid conspiracy theorist, who assumes she's a government agent.
A former female assassin is on a mission to repentance taking down a mythical assassin organization running since the dawn of time.

The investigation of the murder of ambiguous architect Garrone takes Police Commissioner Santamaria to the Turinese high society, but the results are unclear. In the meanwhile, another murder takes place.
A group of officers of the Russian Imperial Guard prepare a revolt in December 1825, when about 3,000 officers and soldiers refused to swear allegiance to the new tsar.
A pathologist develops a bond with a nine-year-old boy whose mother is arrested twice for her suspected involvement in the death of her first and her second husband.
This movie is about the beauty of childhood spent in the country side

Ex-American Raiders Special Forces Commander Captain Robert Tomlin finds himself tasked to uncover an ancient mystery, hidden deep within the multiverse. Captain Tomlin and his band of brothers must unlock its secrets to save us all.
A lonely boy discovers a mysterious egg that hatches a sea creature of Scottish legend.
An uplifting romantic comedy about 'plain Jane' Sylvia who's enticed by a gorgeous guitarist's charms to take Flamenco lessons. The sexy rhythms move her feet, and Sylvia begins to blossom.
After discovering skeletal remains near the creek, a young group of friends find themselves uncovering what appears to be a decades old, unsolved crime.
A psychic researcher and his assistants investigate a series of murders of beautiful young women.
In Whithren, a line of women pass a recurring dream through multiple generations.
A group of friends go to school, and then a girl named Julia goes on a date with her friend. She talks with her Poppa before she goes out for advice.

movie_name: The Curse of the Mummy Cat
synopsis: A bounty hunter with no name, a gang of lawnmower bandits, two archaeologists, a Spanish witch - these misfits have one thing in mind - finding the mummified remains of a young man's feline companion.

When a divorced mom tries to start dating again, her kids and dog set out to sabotage the dates. They are successful until her high school sweetheart shows up...a comedic battle ensues to sway their mom's heart back to their father.
A life-size blow-up doll develops a soul and falls in love with a video store clerk.
The hardest part about moving on is saying goodbye.
A young widower returns to his hometown to search for answers to his wife's murder, which may be linked to the ghost of a deceased ventriloquist.

A biographer researching a book on a pilot who died during the test flight of a new plane falls in love with the pilot's sister. As he uncovers more about the test flight, people connected with the case begin to die.
A gang leader who roamed the Nile Valley of Egypt in 400AD, spreading terror and violence turns priest and sets an example of holiness and repentance.
Wrestling trainer puts himself in charge of a singer's love life when the singer is jilted by a rich girl.
After an EMP attack, two men must stop an evil warlord from controlling the water supplies to Los Angeles.
In Agatha Christie's most twisted tale, a spy-turned-private-detective is lured by his former lover to catch her grandfather's murderer before Scotland Yard exposes dark family secrets.
The ladies are back for more mysterious fun in this sequel to the hit comedy/mystery Porches and Private Eyes.

Movie costume designer Choon-hwa and shaman Lee-hwa live in the same house with their sister-in-law. In order to resolve the grudge against Choon-hwa's husband and younger brother's death through sexual intercourse.
A rogue agent risks everything when he decides to track down the mysterious man who brutally executed his father in front of him when he was a child.
High-school seniors on their way to prom are hijacked by a psychotic killer. As he tortures the teens, they turn on each other to survive.
A suave swinger and a cool chick have one half of a treasure map, the bad guys have the other half. Who will get the goods?
Lars is a young polar bear who finds the big, frosty world just a little overwhelming. Then he meets Robbie, who's funny, friendly, and a seal!
The guy wakes up one morning and realizes that the world has changed. The sky is green, there are no people, and nobody understands what's going on.
A 14 year old Asian-American computer nerd embarks on a whirlwind adventure through the Amazon in search for his long, lost father who went missing during a scientific expedition in Peru.
Two criminals escaped from prison abuse a family which takes bloody revenge later.

When Martín and Sol try to solve the enigma of a missing neighbor, they will discover that nothing is what it seems, that your hearing can trick you just like your imagination and that the heart is a double-edged weapon.

movie_name: Martian Successor Nadesico - The Motion Picture: Prince of Darkness
synopsis: In this follow-up to the Martian Successor Nadesico anime series, a 14-year-old, genetically-engineered genius captain of the new Battleship Nadesico must fight an organized Martian Successor attack.
The monstrous offspring of a violent crime grows up in seclusion on a remote island, where a boat-full of hapless teens have shipwrecked, unaware of what's lurking in the woods.
Grumpy Dad dislikes Christmas while mum and kids strive to save Santa from animated villain's captivity through solving 8 digital riddles.
A federal witness runs away and a team of government agents track him down, but when they take a shortcut on the return trip, they're attacked by zombies.
A man mixes his everyday life with his dark and wonderful unconscious world. His humanity lurks constantly and notions of reality or dreams are lost.
A space capsule crash-lands on Earth, and the astronaut aboard disappears. Is there a connection between the missing man and the monster roaming the area?
A brilliant but disturbed scientist freezes his children alive, while he races to cure their deadly genetic disease by decoding the DNA of the immortal Turritopsis jellyfish.
While coping with the loss of his father, a nine-year-old germaphobe rescues a stinky dog from the shelter and is transformed by his slobbering new companion.
Roommates is about two college students, Patrick and Dana, who live together in an apartment just off campus.
Welcome to the 1 percent.

In the ancient world of Alanon, magic is not only a reality, it's power. A civil war has been waging for a thousand years between two factions. Those who worship the dark forces, and the Defenders of the Light.
