Astérix and Obélix compete at the Olympics in order to help their friend Lovesix marry Princess Irina. Brutus also tries to win the game with his own team and get rid of his father Julius Caesar.
Two married couples are always asked when they get pregnant. However, after 8 years of waiting, the pregnancy they had hoped for had yet to come.

In 2022, Carson Napier funds a private venture to Mars, but his ship is pulled through a wormhole and he crash-lands on planet Amtor (new Venus) where he must rescue the princess Duare from a host of alien races and creatures.
Deep within the Heart of this Woman is a Story Encompassing All Human Emotions.
In-control businesswoman Janie is falling apart of the thought of becoming a mom. Will a chance meeting with an angel be an answer to prayer?
A woman's husband with a perfect life cheats with her sister with extreme consequences befalling them all.
World-famous cryptozoologist Dr. James Ferro leads an expedition into the jungles of a vast island populated by dangerous genetically-engineered creatures.
A work-from-home Malayali IT Engineer starts hearing the voice of his daughter from the future, trying to help him change the course of the world.
Skypirate Filibus commits robberies from her airship, while a dedicated detective attempts to put a stop to it.
Professor Mors has made a name for himself as a hypnotist. He shows great interest in the very young Claire Raven, a daughter of a good family. Mors puts Claire under hypnosis.

movie_name: Os Lúminas e o Mistério das Nove Gargantas
synopsis: As they try to save the shelter where they live in from eviction, a group of teen misfits must find a treasure that is held in a cave by a mystic figure.
Sent to a dude ranch in the west to recover her health, a New York actress falls in love with a ranch owner recently acquitted of the murder of his wife.

Two Schools - one for the rich and one for the poor. Two rival gangs. Two rebel leaders and their epic tale of romance, rivalry and friendship. Prof. John Abraham, who guides these youngsters as they step from adolescence to adulthood.
Independent cabbie Matt Nolan is primed to let his fists and handgun deliver payback after a big taxi firm uses intimidation and violence to squeeze out small-timers.
An Indian queen asks her bodyguard to steal back gold taken from her by the Indian government during The Emergency period in 1975.
Ratan, an auto driver, decides to take a stand against a corrupt MLA's whims.
A poor boy who saved a rich girl from drowning is adopted by her family, but he grows into a money-hungry ruthless businessman who would step on others to get to the top of the social ladder.
Prehistoric man Tumak is banished from his savage tribe and meets pretty Loana, who belongs to a gentler coastal tribe but he must fight caveman Payto to win her favors.
A young woman and her friends with the help of the FBI fights back a clan of serial killers.

Based on real events which saw two lighthouse keepers stranded for months at sea in a freak storm, the film tells a tale of death, madness and isolation; a desolate trip into the heart of human darkness.

Three alien beings - a Sontaran officer, a Draconian nobleman and a Human mercenary - find themselves transported to a remote asteroid by a mysterious alien who wants to test their worthiness for his race's master plan.

movie_name: Tintin et le lac aux requins
synopsis: Tintin and his friends visit Professor Calculus at his country laboratory, only to find him and a pair of local children threatened by criminals after the inventor's work.
A man suffering from insomnia is tricked into buying a drug, Lucia, that makes his desires come true in his dreams, blurring the line between fantasy and reality.
A group of friends takes a trip to the mountains to reconnect and have some fun only to cross into the realm of myth, madness, and horror.
The 12-year old Jasmine travels to Curacao to visit her birth village. This is only one of her many bucket list items she wishes to accomplish.

Chicklet is a sixteen-year old tomboy who's desperate to be part of the in-crowd of Malibu beach surfers. She's the typical American girl - except for one little problem: her personality is split into more slices than a pepperoni pizza.
When the head of a statue sacred to a village is stolen, a young martial artist goes to the big city and finds himself taking on the underworld to retrieve it.
Helen wants her son to marry a governor's daughter, ignoring the fact that he is already in love.

In a modern-day Romeo and Juliet, Mikey James, a street hustler raised on the streets with his two brothers, goes to work for the Fasano family as he desperately tries to find a way out of his hustling lifestyle.

At a Danish town-council vote, a new individualist breaks party-line voting against bulldozing old houses in the center. That evening he meets Don Olsen in a pub. They get drunk and nothing will ever be the same again.
Venky tries to right his wrongs by involving his family and also convince the girls side without getting messed up in between.
Plot details are under wraps.
Four quadrant family film.

A young woman's hunt for her missing sister ends at a rundown bed and breakfast in the Hollywood Hills run by an ill-tempered woman called Mommy. Disturbing messages left by former guests suggest unsettling secrets lay buried there.

movie_name: Tex and the Lord of the Deep
synopsis: Based on the adventures of the hero Tex from the comic strip by Bonelli. An interesting spaghetti-western/fantasy movie that blends magic and mythology with six-guns and stagecoaches.
A group of environmentalists arrives at a faraway tropical delta where toxic waste is being dumped. However the water also hides a giant crocodile. The corrupt local officials don't help much either.
In the aftermath of a mysterious and violent farm incident, a public health student seeks to uncover its origins, but her efforts run into direct conflict with the interests of those in power.
The story of Carl Merryweather who believes he experienced an alien encounter at 10-years-old and is now trying to reconnect with the UFO at the same location.
An imaginative person finds his desired partner by building a female shape for interior decoration at his working place.

Axel, the magician, raises a boy into adulthood. When Axel dies, it's the young man - son of a murderer, and well tutored by a magician - to keep on the tradition of guarding the Daughter of the Golem.
A story of Vienna following World War I, in which the butchers became millionaires and the aristocrats became beggars, told against a background of mother-love and sacrifice.

Based on the Chinese novel 'Journey To The West' in which the monk, Samjang goes to the mythical temple to study but finds that he must escort the Princess Cheol-seon safely through a variety of fantastic dangers.

Seyed, a teacher exiled to the village, advises Dad Mohammad, who, like other villagers, could not pay his master's due to the drought, to stay there instead of leaving the village and resist the tyranny of Khan.

Michael has to take summer class in French, a class trip to France, to graduate high school. He is, however, mistaken for an agent and people try to kill him. There are 007 style cars, cuties, crooks etc.
A woman's life is in dangerous because of the secret of hidden gold in the house left by her parents.
During an international rally two contestants find a hidden painting in the door of their car. In order to not get removed from the track riders do not report to their team management.
When shy lawyer Graham Forrest hires a call-girl for his birthday, things get far more complicated than he ever imagined.
Cool black private eye John Shaft is hired by a crime lord to find and retrieve his kidnapped daughter.

movie_name: The Secret of the Ice Cave
synopsis: A group of treasure-seekers embark on a expedition into high adventure as they race to discover what's really located in the mysterious ice cave.

Follows the President of the United States along with her key staff who are on a flight back to Washington, D.C., when they receive news that a Zombie apocalypse caused by a new vaccine is rapidly spreading throughout the country.
Comedy about the people in an apartment building.
Guinevere's quiet weekend in Big Sur turns twisted when the local lumberjack's wife becomes fiercely envious of her.

Rumor has it that the house of Prague hide secret obtain the philosopher's stone, and complex multi-level labyrinth of underground tunnels and cellars keep many unsolved mysteries and untold treasures.
An alien trying to escape from NASA is befriended by a wheelchair-bound boy.
Ben Falk takes a position as teacher. It's quite a blow for him when he finds himself confronted with the total chaos of life at school.
A young adopted boy, Dolfje, turns into a werewolf at his 7th birthday. Supported by his bigger brother and chased by a mysterious organisation he has to find out how to live a normal life.
Bamse and his friends go to the Arctic to rescue Skalman's scientist friend Beanka who has gone missing. On the way they are joined by the deceitful Kattja who wants the reward money.

A man who would never cheat is asked by the woman he loves to have sex with someone else to save their relationship - a compromise which may ultimately destroy them, as love becomes corroded by jealousy.

When honeybee hives start dying off and bodies start piling up in a small, Northwest Florida town, the local coroner is forced to team up with the apiologist who left her at the altar years ago, to try to solve this deadly mystery.
A paranormal adventure story told through still image photography and audio.
During the unstoppable alien invasion of 2022, one man flees through a wormhole to 1992 in hope of changing the future. But attempt after attempt is made by someone there to catch and kill him.
A mutated giant octopus wreaks havoc on a California seaside community.
Follow three women suspected of a crime committed ten years ago.

A group of scientists have developed the Resonator, a machine which allows whoever is within range to see beyond normal perceptible reality. But when the experiment succeeds, they are immediately attacked by terrible life forms.
An ex-convict and a woman fall in love, after she shoots her police Lt. boyfriend dead in self defense, and falsely leads him to believe that he did the shooting.
In present time a now broken up Xavier and Carlie remain friends, however Carlie announces that she will be leaving the country which causes both to rethink their feelings for one another.Xavier

movie_name: Captain Nemo and the Underwater City
synopsis: When Captain Nemo saves the passengers of a sinking ship and takes them to his Utopian underwater city he discovers that not all of his guests agree to remain there forever.

The near future. Like tomorrow. In a world marked by closed borders, corporate warriors, and a global computer network, three strangers risk their lives to connect, break through the barriers of technology, and unseal their fates.

The scientist father of a teenage girl and boy accidentally shrinks his and two other neighborhood teens to the size of insects. Now the teens must fight diminutive dangers as the father searches for them.
A serial killer begins to spiral totally out of control as three women interact with him in very different ways.

A ten-years-later continuation of Hal Hartley's "Henry Fool", where Fay Grim (Posey) is coerced by a CIA agent (Goldblum) to try and locate notebooks that belonged to her fugitive ex-husband (Ryan). Published in them is information that could compromises the security of the U.S., causing Fay to first head to Paris to fetch them ...
A suspense horror film set in a small coastal town where, after a series of gory murders commited by mobs of townspeople against visiting tourists, the corpses begin to come back to life.
A telephone operator ends up drunk and at the mercy of a cad in his apartment. The next morning she wakes up with a hangover and the terrible fear she may be a murderess.
In 1980s Chicago, a 10-year-old sets out on a quest to get the Christmas gift of his generation: the latest and greatest video-game system.
Carol meets David one year later, taking her into a growing chasm of horrors in which the everyday reality, seems to give way to the dream's of past nights.

Four brothers committing crimes with a promise among them to stop someday. When a deal goes south, the older brother says it's enough, but the other three disagree and recklessly do business with a wanted crime lord.
A clumsy policewoman trains hard enough to avenge her father's death.
While preparing for a camping trip, Fred Flintstone is enlisted by the Bedrock Secret Service to capture a criminal mastermind after a spy who looks like him is injured on the job.
Sebastian is a police constable suffering from night blindness undergoes frequent transfers. When a murder takes place on his watch, how will he solve the crime?
Three episodes (40,41,42) of the TV series "Ramar of the Jungle" edited together and released as a feature.
With his livelihood on the line and the stakes higher than ever, a billiards player must face off against underworld kings to win back his pool hall.

Mai, a ribbon dancer from the countryside arrives in Saigon and befriends Kim, a street dancer. A promise of a better life leads their dance crew to the big competition, but a romance with a rich kid threatens to derail Kim's plans.
An Alaskan romantic comedy.

The first woman drafted into combat leads a perilous and unprecedented expedition into an enlarged human cell to obtain the cure for a vicious pandemic that has stricken her son and ravaged the world.
District attorney Hummeltofte is crazy about cars. He is also a stubborn opponent of women behind the wheel.
Four young people spend a night in a haunted mansion.

Despite his devotion to his hometown of Salem (and its Halloween celebration), Hubie Dubois is a figure of mockery for kids and adults alike. But this year, something is going bump in the night, and it's up to Hubie to save Halloween.
An important judge is threatened by a group of neo-nazi terrorists. His daughter fells in love with the policeman who is supposedly protecting her.
A US Army colonel and a civilian woman supervising him must track down stolen Russian nuclear weapons before they're used by terrorists.
Brother-and-sister heirs to a planetary kingdom face danger as they embark on a journey of self-discovery.
The pinups on a calendar in an auto repair shop come to life and start taking revenge on the misogynistic mechanics who work there.
Shot in one single take with no cuts, Rendez-vous is an original Mexican thriller about a couple who meet online.
Feature film adaptation of the short film "Lunatique" (2016).
Ambitious young woman wants to get into TV news. She borrows a small camera from a friend and obtains incriminating pictures that two former East German spies are after.
A Science-Fiction Epic based on Ancient Hindu Mythology.

The tale of Ratnakara, an average middle class guy in his late twenties, who is stuck in a house with his mother, Saroja. Just when things couldn't get any worse, Ratnakara gets a phone call that turns his life upside down.
A team of surveyors in Siberia enlist the help of native Evenk guides to solve a string of disappearances on the dreaded mountain Yambuy.

Tormented and bullied people can access a special website, run by a Hell Girl who will enable them to take revenge on their torturers. The price for such a service is only that the person must join their torturer in damnation.
A young married couple leave the city in pursuit of their truth.
A group of teenagers escape from an island that's been mysteriously cutoff from the mainland by the government.
A student must face off against bullies and overcome hurdles, both academic and romantic, to win his college's coveted Student of the Year trophy.

Four people find themselves stuck on a haunted antique bed where leaving means suffering a gruesome death. Plagued with frightening hallucinations, they must figure out the bed's secrets before they are ultimately picked off one by one.
More than 2,000,000 Americans are victims of home burglary each year. How safe is your neighborhood?
A dog has its soul swapped with a human and falls in love with its beautiful owner.
A young thief with a history of grand theft auto becomes an informant and helps police bring down a criminal enterprise involved in the smuggling of hundreds of exotic super cars.
Three twenty somethings discuss the recent passing of a mutual love.

In ancient Mongolia, two sisters kill themselves after their father's army is defeated by invading Chinese troops. Their spirits are resurrected in modern times, but now they have become murderous vampires.
A sweet blind girl Zooni meets a flirty Rehan. She ignores her friends' warnings. It's her time to discover life. Is she making the right love choice?
Feature film adaptation of the short film about an Air Force jet that jet breaks up over the desert due to mysterious circumstances.

An investment banker wakes up inside a room to find out he has been kidnapped by a fanatic patriot who wants to bring back all the black money by Indian politicians all over the world into the Indian treasury.
A Russian plane makes an emergency landing at an airport in the middle of the steppes. Shortly after, one of the passengers, carrying a valuable cargo in his cabin bag, is found dead.
A woman hires a poker dealer on his hitman website to kill her boyfriend and his two sons so she could be heir to $75 million fortune.
Jerry is a con man whose actions have led to separate from his family. One day, he helps Ravi, an escaped convict, evade the law and soon teams up with him to carry out a big heist.
A sea captain receives $40,000 from a crook, and the crooks try to steal it from him.
A story of Shivani Shivaji Roy, Crime Branch, who sets out to confront the mastermind behind a child trafficking mafia.
Charlie is in charge of her family's Motel for the week. Suddenly she takes a unique interest in the only guest, a girl in town for a bikini contest, she was called Sheila.
Giant robots from Venus invade Chicago. Stranded in the deserted city are strangers Frank and Nora.
An old man teaches a young man to live in the forest and to understand the wild world.
A young woman finds herself attempting to discover a young girls past, in order to safeguard her future.

On a business trip to Nashville, Brennan finds himself reunited with the "Girl" who had previously broken his heart. Now, for one weekend in the city's music scene, a past and present romance will be reborn and challenged.
When Ellie loses her husband, seeks grief counseling from a local pastor, but her conflict begins when she falls in love with him.
A team of hardened detectives come face to face with evil as they investigate a killing spree in San Bernardino California.

After a convoy of American soldiers disappears, a special ops team is deployed to rescue them. They soon encounter an army of gigantic scorpions, spiders and snakes that have come to Earth from another dimension.

Jo gets out of prison after 15 years after a big heist, and most is changed in his old neighborhood. New gangs and different lives. He's even got a son, which he didn't know about. He is back, and that stirs up the neighborhood.
Local teenagers are holding a Halloween party at a supposedly "haunted" old mill, but find out that one of the partygoers who is dressed as an alien is actually a real alien.
A young schizophrenic who felt threatened by a presence he was unable to define turns up gruesomely dead in his bathtub.
A paralegal in a criminal law firm, loses his job and is gradually pulled into the South London criminal underworld.
Michael Denison plays a lawyer investigating kidnapping charges against Dulcie Gray. Based on a novel of Josephine Tey.
A college dropout settles for a mundane part-time job at a coffee shop the same night an ancient evil awakens.
NYC, 1972: After a bloody mob war all summer, the 5 mob families keep the peace at Sinatra Club with Gotti's upcoming silver heist as a joint venture.
When a shopping mall is taken over by a gang of organized crooks, it's up to a mild-mannered security guard to save the day.

Finding a summer job after high school is tough. For Anthony, he finds a job opportunity get 'shot' right at him. He takes full responsibilities and excitement in helping an Italian mob king deliver packages to the mobster customers.
A girl is always punctual,disciplined. Her husband love her but the fact is he is not a disciplined and totally reverse with her wife.
A group of Song Dynasty loyalists aim to rescue Prime Minister Wen from a Tartar prison. Set during the Tartar rule in the 1300's.
In 1999, a battle takes place between two factions of divine warriors for the fate of the world.
This epic movie follows young shepherd David taking on the mighty warrior Goliath against all odds. Filmed in North Africa and London.
Of an unforgettable story of tenderness pathos and love.
When an ambitious young lawyer takes on a big case against a powerful and ruthless executive of a large pharmaceutical company, he soon finds himself involved in a case of blackmail and corruption.
On the brink of war, Lt. van Hauen is summoned to take command of the cruiser, but due to unforeseen events, he is wrongfully convicted as a traitor.
A man with an asthmatic voice telephones and assaults clerk Kelly Sherwood at home and coerces her into helping him steal a large sum from her bank.
Four dead bodies are recovered from a deserted location. IPS Officer Devdas, who is known for his work, investigates the case with the help of Noushad.
A farm girl falls in-love with a chain-gang convict working at a nearby highway construction site and sets-out to help him when he escapes.
Aqila, 9 years old, will learn to read the Qur'an in a Iqro method, which is fun, rhythmic and sung lightly. Aqila's experience inspires her mind of the greatness of Allah who created the universe.
A photographer plagued by horrific nightmares in which he kills the young female models he shoots is shocked to discover that there is a serial killer in his city who is targeting attractive women.
This is a story that shows the potential dreams and teaches kids to never give up
Lily thought her summer was ruined until she meets and builds an unbreakable bond with a young horse named Pistachio, proving destiny can be found in places you least expected.
A love triangle develops between a young student, an older barmaid, and a married artist.
A horrifying story of a shaman's inheritance in the Isan region of Thailand. What could be possessing a family member might not be the Goddess they make it out to be.

Renovations-A Place For Hope follows the lives of three teens as they face challenges dealing with abortion, bullying and suicide. Our story shows how God intervenes with their lives to guide them to make the right choices.
An Interpol agent in Hong Kong battles a ruthless gang of counterfeiters.
Carola Königswerth is a great art lover. At an exhibition of Alexander Frey's works the artist admits that she is his personal muse and inspiration. Frey begs her to model for him.
The popular children's tale about a donkey, a dog, a cat, and a rooster who are on their way to the slaughterhouse when they get a lucky break and escape.
Three men in London compete for the love of a dance-hall girl.
A soon-to-be police officer takes a path of crime after his father gets attacked by hoodlums.
During the winter season, a family camping in the woods, and a group of camp counselors training in the same forest both find themselves being killed one by one by an unhinged psycho.
The evil Brand X joins a supermarket that becomes a city after closing time.
The reappearance of notorious criminal Paul Sanchez becomes an obsession for a young police officer who will do anything to catch him.
Gold, greed and wrath surface in a deadly beach town.

Sophie (30) decides to hike 500 kilometers through the Arctic region of Norway. She wants to get away from the pressure everyday life. But life at home doesn't seem to understand her desire to go be by herself.
Two women are linked by a morbid passion. Their idyll is shattered by a seemingly inexplicable murder which, after an attempt to blackmail, follows another.

Ashley lives in the fast lane until a handyman invades her life and she's directing a Christmas play for underprivileged kids. She finds her soulmate and they might live happily-ever-after--unless her stepbrother gets her killed.

The incredible story of amateur sailor Donald Crowhurst and his solo attempt to circumnavigate the globe. The struggles he confronted on the journey while his family awaited his return is one of the most enduring mysteries of recent times.
Scandal in the property business.
A young boy learns he is part of a powerful race of psionic humans who must fight the normal humans determined to keep them from Earth.

A group of misfit classmates, break into their school gym and unwittingly unleash a host of terrifying evil spirits -- diabolical forces that are hellbent on destroying them all before they can discover Ashland High's evil secret.
Pooda Johnson is celebrating his last weekend on house arrest with a kickback (party) that could jeopardize the very freedom he's celebrating.

movie_name: It Couldn't Have Happened (But It Did)
synopsis: When a play's two producers are murdered, the playwright tries to solve the crime.
Family-patriarch Jack Byrnes wants to appoint a successor. Does his son-in-law, the male nurse Greg Focker, have what it takes?

Johnny "Skidmark" Scardino is a free-lance crime-scene photographer and part-time blackmailer. When his associates begin to turn up murdered, he has a very short time to discover the killer before it is his turn.

Adventurer George M. Dyatt is sent to find a fellow adventurer, Colonel Percy Fawcett, who went missing in the Amazon jungle in 1925 while searching for the lost city of Z (changed to El Dorado in the movie). Based on true events.
A young journalist receives three strange photos of his fiancée. He tries to find out who any why sent him these pictures.

Three rescuers search for missing tourists in a cave. After hours of searching, they find an ancient treasure. After they take everything, the vault's guardian poisons their minds with greed, leading to their destruction.
Special Insurance-Investigator Dan Kennedy and his wonder dog, Tarzan the Police Dog, are called in to investigate the persistent robbing of a shipping-and-storage warehouse in Los Angeles.
An estranged wife shows up after a nearly 7 year disappearance to prevent her husband from marrying his new love, and someone kills her.

movie_name: Gaia, Envoy to the Council of the Fourth Dimension
synopsis: A time-traveling guardian must save Earth
A psychotic man who was persecuted in his youth for having a hump on his back, is now out to stop bullying, the hard way.
In an isolated hospital in the high ranges of Kerala, an autistic patient with special skills piques the interest of a psychiatrist, whose investigation into her past leads to startling revelations.
A hardened detective teams up with a skilled marksman to take down a drug lord who has the city in his grip.
The film tells the story of Sodabuddi, who spends his life wastefully. He has two romantic encounters and the audience gets to relive these tales, until the climax throws in a complete surprise.
An arrogant Texas millionaire hires four adventurers to rescue his kidnapped wife from a notorious Mexican bandit.

movie_name: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Voyage of the Dawn Treader
synopsis: Lucy and Edmund Pevensie return to Narnia with their cousin Eustace where they meet up with Prince Caspian for a trip across the sea aboard the royal ship The Dawn Treader. Along the way they encounter dragons, dwarves, merfolk, and a band of lost warriors before reaching the edge of the world.
When returning from a trip through the desert, a group of friends drive unknowingly into an alien invasion.

A man who travels through time comes to experience the unbelievable tale of his and Hera's adventures in a story traversing millennia, spanning from ancient Egypt to ancient Greece, to the future, and back to modern times.
When a best-selling author has a midlife crisis, he returns to his coastal hometown and embarks on a wild adventure in a desperate attempt to reclaim his youth.
"Silver Fox" is a hilarious action comedy about a top NSA agent, Ric Gonzales. After proving himself to be smarter that the NSA director, he is recruited for a new assignment.

A realtor is lured into buying a haunted house by a vengeful enemy. However, he is killed under strange circumstances. His brother, a tantric and a Sanskrit professor, comes to investigate the matter.

Godzilla vs. Wolfman consists of a werewolf appearing in Japan, which becomes irradiated and grows to enormous size. This giant Wolfman encounters Godzilla in the countryside, and the two monsters battle.
A man who believes he can travel through time falls in love with a handicapped woman and finds redemption as his past and future catches up with him.

Two parallel stories about characters trapped in illogical endless spaces: two brothers and a detective locked on an infinite staircase, and a family locked on an infinite road - for a very long time.
After an attack in Cavalier, California, Mitch Chase suffers a tragedy that puts him on a dangerous track. Will he be able to move on or will his symbol die with his humanity?
Shallow, rich and socially successful Cher is at the top of her Beverly Hills high school's pecking scale. Seeing herself as a matchmaker, Cher first coaxes two teachers into dating each other.
Four Third-World Christs try to stop the American industrialist John Brahms in Glauber Rocha's experimental film inspired by Pier Paolo Pasolini's murder.
A group of friends looking for a good time decides to play an online game, but are totally unprepared for the terrifying results if they win or lose.
When a rich but cantankerous dowager on an isolated estate hires an engaging handyman, her niece/companion becomes suspicious of his motives.
Set in a Chicago neighborhood nearly a decade after an occupation by an extraterrestrial force, 'Captive State' explores the lives on both sides of the conflict - the collaborators and dissidents.
After being rescued and brought to an island, a man discovers that its inhabitants are experimental animals being turned into strange-looking humans, all of it the work of a visionary doctor.

After his ex-fiancée's sudden and mysterious suicide, a jilted bridegroom seeks answers. What he finds, makes him question if he ever really knew her. And then he begins to see her face everywhere he goes.
When a recovering drug-addict named Massimo is bitten by an ancient, shapeshifting monster, he must fight to save his girlfriend Tien from the same bloody fate.
The story of this animation takes place in Tehran in year 2121 AD and is about the life of Akbar Agha (Mehran Modiri) and deals with social and cultural problems.
In New York City, a single mom captivates her new neighbor, a much younger man.

Detectives Leah Bishop and Dorian Grey of Caledonia Interpol discover that no one can die. Loosely based on the Scottish folkloric tale, Death in a Nut, Pure Dead Brilliant is a fantasy-horror tale of love, loss, and redemption.
A goblin helps a miller's daughter spin straw into gold, asking in return for her first child, in this amusing 'teaching play' about greed, envy and helpfulness.

Tokyo, 1934. The boss of the clan that controls gambling agonizes and some of his followers propose to Nakai to take his place, but he refuses the offer and suggests they choose Matsuda, who is in prison.
A group of sex-crazed cave people are being harassed by a Tyrannosaurus Rex. While they try to figure out a way to deal with this threat, they have sex and eat a lot.

Abhiram is a fun loving guy staying with his parents in London. 8 people won the contest of an opportunity to tour Europe. Uma is one of them. Abhiram likes Uma and acts as a tour companion for them during their stay in Europe.
Teenagers stumble across a prehistoric caveman, who goes on a rampage.

movie_name: The Place Promised in Our Early Days
synopsis: In an alternate postwar timeline, Japan is divided into the Union-controlled North and the US-controlled South.
As part of an initiation into a club called the Sisters, a young girl must spend the night in a mausoleum.
Where a people's honor is at stake, there are no cowards, only heroes. Theirs is not to win or lose, theirs is freedom at any cost.
When the kidnapping of a spoiled socialite goes bad, the antagonistic group is forced to take refuge in an abandoned Inn Deep in the woods.

In the age of social media, teenagers tell the story that they want people to see, with each video more daring than the next. But in this small town, a series of staged "murder" videos are turning very real.

A man who can enter and manipulate people's dreams is recruited by a government agency to help cure the President of the United States of his nightmares about nuclear war but stumbles upon an assassination plot.
The story revolves around the death of Poornima Rao, a senior executive in a reputed IT firm, who dies jumping of the high raised IT tech park while taking a selfie.
A police inspector and a London returned crime journalist, amongst others, are baffled by a modern day Robin Hood, who robs the rich and distributes the wealth amongst the poor and needy.
Film ballet. An ancient Chinese legend tells of the love of a brave young man Yanchang Liu and the fairy Shengmu San, the keeper of the inextinguishable magic lantern.
A seductress prostitute lures her clients into a specific room which is numbered as 302. What she does with them once they are inside remains a mystery.
A young woman struggles for independence and identity in a small Florida tourist town.
A writer starts to descend into madness after him and his wife move into a house in the beautiful rural countryside of Illinois.
Feature film based on the SEGA video game franchise.
A ruthless college student resorts to murder in an attempt to marry an heiress.
A con artist roams the town of Camorr with his scheming followers. Based on the fantasy series by Scott Lynch.
Sequel to Disney's live-action version of Aladdin.

synopsis: Nobita and his friends enjoyed playing in the Kingdam of Clouds which was made by Doraemon's tool. But before they knew it, they wandered into the another clouds which extinct animals lived. "Sky human" explain they protected the animals.

Eve has married the man of her dreams but when they return to live in the house willed to him by his first wife who died under horrific circumstances, it becomes a waking nightmare as Eve falls into a spiral of suspicion and madness.
A troubled teenager is assigned to an animal-rescue shelter over the Christmas season as part of his community service.
A woman tries to attract her reincarnated lover from her previous life but eventually turns to the aid of an evil sorcerer who rules over a tribe of cannibal midgets.
After an incident at the Bar, new staff has created a real shake up that leaves things a little bloody.
Irvine Lester is an AT repairman. In order to make a living with his sister, he is secretly fighting in AT gambling matches and intentionally losing the games for money.
A woman is raped in her apartment. José a neighboring journalist and his friend Sancho will try to help her by seeing that the police do not come to their aid and the authorities do not do their job.
One of director Koto's bloodiest, most evocative, skilfully orchestrated fight scenes, Poetic, gut-wrenching and, at times, very moving.

A statue of Venus with a human mind falls in love with a statue of David. Eros jealously controls the sculptor's mind to destroy her. Libera's songs and Tempei's piano lead the story in a poetic way. Libera play the Angels to comfort her.
Two young women inherit their grandfather's detective agency and reluctantly team up to solve their murders.
Story of four people in Sopot in 1933, mysteriously brought together to an old villa to reenact a murder ritual that took place 36 years earlier.
"Terrorgram" was an anthology of three horror stories linked by a sinister delivery boy. The stories are "Heroine Overdose", "Pandora" and "Veteran's Day".
Literary adaptation of Dante Alighieri's novel.
A story about an aspiring professional singer and a rock singer who collaborates in a song. As they work on their song, they start to develop feelings for each other.
Officer Chan investigates an apparent group suicide, in Kowloon, and uncovers a cult that goes by the name of The Church of the True God.
A young man is torn between his friends in town and his father's ranch.
Way over budget and weeks behind, a struggling film director tries to put together the last missing scenes in order to finish his movie before he's shut down for good.
Little Dreams is the story of a boy who dreams of becoming an artist. With his imagination and the help of his magic sketchbook his little dream turns into a big adventure.

movie_name: A Viking Saga: The Darkest Day
synopsis: Hereward, a novice monk, must deliver the Holy Gospel of Lindisfarne to the safety of the Iona monastery, while being pursued by a Viking death squad hell-bent on its capture.

A woman Sudha, before leaving for a month-long holiday, instructs Sumit to regularly feed her pet fish. But when she returns home, she is shocked to see her house in an utter mess. What could have happened?
Convicted of a crime he didn't commit, Confederate soldier, Percy Harris escapes and makes his way home to find it's not possible to escape fate.
A first-time mother-to-be seeks solace in the remote Moors, only to pit herself against a horde of sinister rabbits that threaten more than her new garden.
Two siblings are whisked away by an intelligent fairy to become part of a real life game they must complete before coming back to the real world.
An estranged couple must survive an attack by a deadly beast in an isolated woodland.
A cave-dwelling man sets out to track down the killer of a homeless boy, and bring him to justice.
Agent J travels in time to M.I.B.'s early days in 1969 to stop an alien from assassinating his friend Agent K and changing history.
A remake of Richard Connell's famous short story, "The Most Dangerous Game," about a madman who hunts human prey on his personal island habitat.
A sibling music duo rises to fame in the 1990's after inheriting cassette recordings of their grandmother's unreleased songs.
The son of a schizophrenic mother and abusive father must unravel the mystery of his frightening visions before he succumbs to madness.

After police arrest a homeless mute, they soon discover that he could very well be a serial killer holding the answer to a 30 year old murder mystery locked inside a bizarre fairy-tale world within his mind.
He's tried a thousand get rich quick schemes and come up empty. This time...Bill Parker hits the jackpot. Then again...he may have run one con too many.
The family of a dying man celebrates his wake while the man is still alive, showing their darker, selfish ambitions and trying to take the best part of the inheritance.

Benju tells his ex-girlfriend Angie about the crazy adventure he's just been through: when he broke into the home of the daughter of the president of an awful radio station, he was kidnapped and beaten.

ORAH, a Nigerian immigrant taxi driver in Toronto, agrees to launder dirty money for her boss in exchange for bringing her son over from Nigeria. When the plan goes horribly wrong, Orah takes matters into her own hands to settle the score.

Our unlikely hero, Marco, must join forces with a motley crew of monkey pirates and set out on an action-packed rescue mission. Get ready to go overboard with the wildest, craziest, zaniest primates this side of the Caribbean.
A beautiful Pakistani woman has to make choice between her true love or an arranged marriage by her family.
THE SERPENT-HAIRED VIXEN SOWS FEAR AND TERROR AMONG THE TOWNSPEOPLE AND CITE DWELLERS ALIKE.
The film was loosely based on the fairy-tale with the same name by I. Shestakov and was dedicated to the memory of fairy-tale film director Aleksander Rou.

A group of four amateur adventurers who specialize in exploring remote and forsaken places pay a visit to Shookum Hills, a town in the remote Appalachian Mountains, which was abandoned decades ago due to a mysterious coal mine fire.
The robbery of the Mona Lisa painting from Le Louvre.
The monster of a man's recurring nightmare turns out to be real when he and his friends go on a weekend trip to a remote area.
This drama follows the relationship of a heartbroken woman and a young immigrant girl who has lost her mother at the border, coming together just before Christmas.

Two brothers connected to a mysterious women with dangerous ties surrounding a boat accident. Val delves back into life with Lee Anne. Driven by her demons, Lee Anne draws Val into her fantasies, threatening everything Val loves.
A drug addict scrambles to track down $8 million of heroin while pursued by the city's rival mob bosses.

Shortly before the end of civilization, mankind manages to overcome death. By transforming their minds, they are able to regain a foothold on a faraway planet. Were it not for the host bodies, developing their own consciousness.
7 Kids train hard to defend the legendary Footballfield of the wild guys to Fat Michi and the Galactic Footballers.
Two grave robbers steal Robert Johnson's guitar, only to have the Devils curse visited upon them.
A detective searches for the body of a femme fatale which has gone missing from a morgue.

At the turn of the 20th Century amongst tension between China and Japan, a Japanese swindler in Shanghai plans to profit by selling weapons. He steals arms from the Japanese military and sells them to the rich Chinese.
A medical student's sense of identity fractures when a family death opens a door to his repressed memories.
Raúl Ruiz's fabulist modern-day riff on Robert Louis Stevenson's classic novel.
Two teenage boys try to help a tiny spherical alien get back to its mothership, while the army and a devious petty crook pursue the creature for its wonderful powers.
Catherine finds herself in a web of deception and lies when she finds out that the fiance of her friend Aiswarya might not be as "Gentleman" as he seem.
The film tells the story of a violent and passionate love between two ambitious teenagers in the background of nowadays Montreal.
Space aliens arrive on Earth with their giant shark and intend to take over the planet but they must first destroy Gamera.
A sponge diver hopes to make enough money to buy his own boat and marry his girlfriend. A rival diver, however, has other plans for him.
Asha and Arvind are in love but are not allowed to marry by her astrologer father. They start living together and plan to start a family without getting married, but fate intervenes.
A boxer must lower of Ring to face his demons He advances until going into in a nightmare. In bottom of a tunnel there is a corpse of a young girl.

Lakshmi discovers her son Varun is gay, the fact she could never accept, changes her whole life upside down. While Varun goes out and finds his love Karthik, his life isn't as happy as in the past. There comes a day, Lakshmi decides to find her lost son, will they ever meet again? My Son is Gay, showcases the dark reality of acceptance prevailing in our society.
Lilly is a makeup and FX influencer hoping to expand her audience by live-streaming from a notoriously haunted house.
A commercial flight from Athens to Thessaloniki was hijacked by six young communists who asked the pilots to fly to Yugoslavia.

The police suspect smuggling, theft and black-market racketeering of insulin after investigating the murder of a user. The superintendent suspects someone only known as Nålen (the needle) to be behind it all.
Gabriel the archangel fights to bring light back to purgatory - a place where darkness rules - and save the souls of the city's inhabitants.
Two friends on a road trip pass through a town where aliens are landing and feeding upon some of the civilians.
A former U.S. soldier returns to his hometown to find it overrun by crime and corruption, which prompts him to clean house.

After her last encounter, Ellen Ripley crash-lands on Fiorina 161, a maximum security prison. When a series of strange and deadly events occur shortly after her arrival, Ripley realizes that she has brought along an unwelcome visitor.
Half-Indian girl brought up in a wealthy household is loved by the son of the house against his family's wishes and loves another Indian employed by the household.
A reporter discovers a bank run by demons, hell-bent on crashing the global economy.
A man who wants to let go of life [Duval] falls in love with an angel who longs to be human [Watkins] and is inspired to live again.
The remnants of a massacred cavalry troop and ragtag group of stagecoach passengers fight for survival against fierce Comanches at a desert ruin.
Korean folk hero Hong Kil-dong is back to save the day, this time he must seek out a golden blade to defeat the Evil Demon king plans to raise an army of demons to take over the world.
A humorous take on Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's classic mysteries featuring Sherlock Holmes and Doctor Watson.

Christer lives in a small town, a recently divorced taxi driver and church-yard attendant. But then a young couple arrives, Marie and Erik, and Christer starts a new life. He finds the mysterious Marie totally bewitching.

Macius was 9 when he became king of a small country. The young Macius quickly realizes that running a kingdom is not child's play, especially when the general of the armies tries to take advantage of his naivety.
The movie "Blind Shaman" will recreate the journey to find the light for the eyes of Tinh Lam (Huynh Lap) and the intertwined causal stories that Tinh Lam must go through to better understand life.
A group of fun loving, dim-witted college kids fight for their lives when their wild and crazy "semester at sea" turns into a comedic Poseidon Adventure when their party boat is hit by a tidal wave.
Italian tailor Mike Esposito makes suits for mafia Don Piano and falls into a moral dilemma.
A security guard's dreams come true when he is selected to be transformed into a cybernetic police officer.
Private detective Maxwell Archer sets out to help a young RAF pilot accused of a murder he didn't commit.
Two college friends attempt to undue some of the most infamous crimes and re-write American History.
A troubled young man (Qualls) goes on a journey to meet an author whom he feels has a strong hold on his life.
A modern day re imaging of the classic by Stanley Donin set in Japan.
Britta must face her fears at her school's Christmas pageant while Holly Boy, the spirit of the season, must battle the forces of evil.
An attorney's wife is determined to fight the evils of addictive substances.
A circus family encounters hard times and family strife, but is brought into the limelight through their chance encounter with a polar bear cub.
Three teenagers spend their holidays in Frombork and start their first relationships there.
Two assassins agree to work together as one tries to avenge his wife and the other collects a reward for a job.
Mufti Mohammad, former leader of a revolutionary team, wrote hieroglyphs before died. Only Kakababu could understood this.Now Kakababu and Santu going to Mishawr to solve the mystery.KBBO-AINOS
One of those "gangsters-drafted-into-the-military-do-the craziest-things"
A young woman is involuntarily committed to a mental institution, where she is confronted by her greatest fear - but is it real or a product of her delusion?

A bored young woman in a sleepy community called Spearfish starts receiving photographs of brutally murdered young women. Are they real or staged? The culprit is either a serial killer or some creep with a sick sense of humour.
Graduate student Calliope Girard's orderly life is thrown into chaos by unexplained seizures that unlock buried memories of a violent past.
A secret agent leads a team of elite operatives on a difficult mission.
As the Roman empire crumbles, young Romulus Augustus flees the city and embarks on a perilous voyage to Britain to track down a legion of supporters.

The Fate of Cysalion is a live-action musical that blurs the line between film and theatre. It is the centerpiece of a high fantasy saga that tells an epochal story of heroes, villains and ancient powers.
In the final battle, The Chosen One returns to stop his sworn enemy.
A newly married woman struggles to getting acquaintance with her in-law's house members and become the apple of the eye of the family.
A paper chasing young hustler who finds himself trapped in a world of money, sex & mayhem.
An aspiring artist/ex-con and affirmed bachelor is about to risk everything by painting himself into a corner with the forgery of a 15th-century masterpiece, and by falling for the wrong woman.
"What's Up Tiger Lily?" meets mystery science theatre in this hysterical satire of homophobia and science fiction.
A documentary crew follow the down spiral of a family on the verge of losing everything.
A lawyer is hired to defend an old college friend accused of murdering her husband.
A dull married couple, separated by their enlistment during World War II, reunite after three years to find that they have become very different people.
With tense psychological elements, this visual poem blends nature with music, and human weakness with perspective. Growth is captured in this fantasy of three individuals on a challenging journey.
Max journeys through a nonlinear perplexing aftermath of a world that was lead to destruction by a company that promised humans immortality.
The survivors of a plane crash in a remote area are attacked by blob-like alien creatures that turn their victims into blood-thirsty vampires.

This is about a boy brought up among bandits - can he have a change of heart? It is about rule of law, humanity, sacrifice and bravery. A band of orphans come together helped by a doctor and a policeman to take revenge.

A young woman joins a photo shoot on a tropical island as a model and falls for the artist. Dad, who's a cop, arrives to check up on her. When one of the models ends up dead, he looks into it. Are the models being used for sex tourism?
Welcome to Atlantis, where royal guardsmen wear uniforms that could easily be from the wardrobe of Ming the Merciless and some unfortunate slaves are turned into bovine-headed beasts.
A Hindu/Sikh family face challenges when their adopted son falls in love with a Muslim girl.
After his brother dies in a car crash, a disgraced MMA fighter takes over the family nightclub and soon learns his sibling's death wasn't an accident.
A young woman is murdered in the White House. Homicide detective Regis investigates while Secret Service works against him. He's assigned agent Chance. She eventually cooperates after a man's framed.

A young women with a supernatural ability to see images from the future is on the run from a secret organization that have plans for her that she wants no part in. Unsure of who she can trust, here options are limited. Will she escape?
Strangers on a bus find themselves fighting for their lives when one of them reads from a Gothic book and brings to life six dead serial killers who proceed to hunt them down one by one.

Brian Connors, of Connors Financial, finds errors in his clients account. Unaware of the dangers his business have put them in, a suspicious wife and his daughter find themselves defenseless when they become the hunted.
A scientific genius invents equipment that tests the erotic levels of people. He sets out to find subjects for his experiments.
A straitlaced turn-of-the-century father presides over a family of boys and the mother who really rules the roost.

movie_name: Si Baleleng at ang gintong sirena
synopsis: In this comedy/fantasy film, orphan Beleleng runs away from the orphanage, gets adopted by a millionaire, is kidnapped for ransom, and is rescued by the golden mermaid, Perlita.
A famous jazz saxophonist's life is forever changed after he is accidentally shot.
RAVENOUS follows an ambitious twenty-something who brings his new girlfriend on a camping trip with his best friends, not knowing she's a cannibal.

movie_name: If I Die Before I Wake
synopsis: A suburban family is held hostage and terrorized by three intruders while their sixteen year-old daughter first hides, then exacts her own brand of terror on the assailants.

A 3D anthology: Chicken Game, a black comedy, Second Account, an erotic melodrama, and Lucid Dream, a sci-fi thriller. One can witness an extension of the genre of 3D films that are often limited to horror, action, and blockbuster films.

A man is haunted my sins of of his father when he and his ex-wife become trapped in a derelict sanitarium for one night. A series of ghostly visions push our heroes to point of madness. Can they survive until dawn?

When Mother Malkin, the queen of evil witches, escapes the pit she was imprisoned in by professional monster hunter Spook decades ago and kills his apprentice, he recruits young Tom, the seventh son of the seventh son, to help him.

The film Akkammana Bhagya is about an ill-fated village woman and her struggle towards the welfare of her family. The story is set in an Indian village from the preindependence era and deals with woman's empowerment.
A high school reunion changes everything for a young assassin trying to get out of her line of work.
Things go wrong for a high ranking mobster when he doesn't proceed by his boss's orders.
A tough cop with a hard childhood deals with a city full of criminals.
A child of a middle class home with solid moral values is lured into a world of crime and corruption.

movie_name: Oops, Ups & Downs: The Murder Mystery of Humpty Dumpty
synopsis: An elite member of society's egg-shaped body was found on the west side of town. The mystery of his death investigated by a fantasy township in 1945.
A king makes a pact with an ancient demon and after years of ruling his kingdom in peace, the demon has come to collect. Now a group of rival gladiators must fight for the survival of the kingdom.

A mafia boss's wife is on the run from her husband and the Irish mob. But when she discovers the U.S.Marshals protecting her have been infiltrated, she turns to a ex-special forces operative to help her survive.

Narasimha, a physically disabled waiter, who is suffering due to his psychological wounds by his schoolmates. Narasimha is a weak repressed person,who is seeking revenge with help of a Japanese Samurai executioner Kazu Yamaguchi.

movie_name: We Have Always Lived in the Castle
synopsis: Merricat, Constance and their Uncle Julian live in isolation after experiencing a family tragedy six years earlier. When cousin Charles arrives to steal the family fortune, he also threatens a dark secret they've been hiding.

When her colleague is accidentally shot into the year 8888 and sent to a prison on the Moon, scientist Chloe Trustcott must travel to the future and get arrested herself to plan a prison-break in order to save her.
A poor young man finds a lamp with a genie trapped inside. The genie promises to grant the man three wishes if he frees him from the lamp.

The story of a Greek from 1941 on. Hniochos, still a student is captured by the Italians and imprisoned. In prison he will take the first hard lessons and acquire a life stance in the light of energy. He escapes and becomes a guerrilla.
To pay off their gambling debt, four best friends kidnap an organized crime figure having mistaken him for a wealthy businessman.
A cop pursues the Mob for revenge as well as personal honor.
An expedition goes in search of a party lost the year before.

With all the picturesque glamour of the 1940s, "The Pardon" recounts the unlikely true story of Toni Jo Henry. A grisly murder leads to a series of sensational trials in which she pleads her innocence; she was executed in Louisiana, 1942.
A wretched piece about a promiscuous woman, who has affairs with every man she meets, including her daughter's boy friend.
A shiftless loner finds that he suddenly has something worth living for, as he tries to protect the enigmatic love of his life from the men who want to do her harm.
A police sniper teams up with a hot-headed rookie to take down his former friend and teammate, who is exacting revenge on the police force.
An Army draftee with a good memory makes sergeant and saves the day.
Base on real events Yanga is story of a village of slaves that raise against of the Spanish empire before of the independence of México.
The fight between good and evil comes down to one last battle.
She, leader of a religious sect, leads a group of people. All live together in a claustrophobic place. The arrival of a mysterious character changes everything.
The film follows Grace as she finds a connection to a cult predicting doomsday and the arrival of a spaceship, and Gravity, who flees New Zealand to try her luck as an artist in New York City.
An anti-religious, nightmare ridden psychiatrist becomes obsessed with the possibility that his fear of the Christmas season may be supernaturally substantiated.

A banker and his college girlfriend, following her sudden reappearance after having been missing for fifteen years, are assisted by a mysterious organization in fighting off an unstoppable group of relentless and shadowy figures.
Super Bao, an innocent and passionate steamed stuffed bun, goes through untold hardships and finally grows into a great hero who saves the world of foods.

Psychologist Margaret Matheson and her assistant study paranormal activity, which leads them to investigate a world-renowned psychic who has resurfaced years after his toughest critic mysteriously passed away.
A man experiments within the burgeoning field of cryogenics during the 1960s.

Heloise is a woman with a dark and twisted past; with a sexually abusive father, a cruel mother that forces her to become a child bride; and DIONA, a vision of hatred and rage that manifests itself with her whenever Heloise is afraid.
This all-American couple moves into their first apartment together. What is first considered the deal of a lifetime quickly turns into a curse that they could have never imagined.
A woman becomes immersed in a brutal love triangle when an unwelcomed admirer kills her abusive husband even though she's already having an affair.
A woman inherits a resort hotel in space.

movie_name: On a Dark and Stormy Night
synopsis: Friends gather on Halloween Night for the last party of their lives.
American reporter doing a story on Swedish nightlife gets involved with a drug-addicted nightclub singer.
A Tango dancer and a rabbi develop a plan to enter a dance competition without sacrificing his orthodox beliefs. Family, tolerance, and community are tested one dazzling dance step at a time.
A group of kids must find a pirate's treasure hidden in Iowa, while avoiding others who are also trying to find the loot, in order to save their town.
When an island populated by happy, flightless birds is visited by mysterious green piggies, it's up to three unlikely outcasts - Red, Chuck and Bomb - to figure out what the pigs are up to.
A goblin is sent to Earth to behead students and turn their bodies into demons.
A fun-loving young woman is murdered after trading bedrooms with her wealthy friend. Her ghost seeks aid from Topper to find the murderer.

Hsu Shao-chiang stars as a veritable "Spider-Swordsman" - master of the "Silkworm Style" - in this eye-filling, mind-bending martial arts phantasmagorical which truly warrants the description: "unforgettable."
A woman recently released from prison seeks revenge on those who did her wrong.

Alona (Miya Nolasco) feels suffocated by her mother's overprotective behavior. Deprived of male company, she answers the first guy who counts her. In trying to control her daughter, the more she is losing her now.
A well respected Detective must face the consequences after he reneges on a deal he made with the Devil.

Two childhood friends, a New York hairstylist and a would-be musician, get caught up with the mob and are forced to deliver $50,000 to Australia, but things go haywire when the money is lost to a wild kangaroo.
Adventurer Allan Quartermain leads an expedition into uncharted African territory in an attempt to locate an explorer who went missing during his search for the fabled diamond mines of King Solomon.
Teiko's new husband disappears on a business trip. She discovers a pair of mysterious postcards hidden away in a book that may be clues to his fate.
In the Bezonians social club in North London, A group of down and outs scheme, plot and dream of becoming rich and breaking out of the monotony of their dreary and financially impotent lives.
Brought up in an uncultured family, a boy who is unaware of social etiquette's must struggle to adjust in a society that he does not even know how to live in.

It's 2025 a leading psychologist has transformed the penal system, prisoners are kept on islands where conflict and death is instigated to facilitate advancement to society. Raoul a robot guard tries to help five innocent prisoners escape.

movie_name: Allahyar and the Legend of Markhor
synopsis: Set in the northern regions of Pakistan, the story follows Allahyar, a young boy who ends up dealing with circumstances he never thought possible. The movie aims to shed light on the preservation and illegal hunting of wildlife.
A doctor poisons his dying friend and is framed by his valet for poisoning his wife's first husband.
Plot under wraps. Sequel to "Maleficent" and "Maleficent: Mistress of Evil".
The life of Lee Seung-man, a freedom fighter who struggled to liberate Korea from Japanese rule
In 1970s rural Ireland, the murderer of an IRA safe house operative, must be stopped before executing his master plan.

movie_name: The Time Machine (I Found at a Yardsale)
synopsis: Robert Moore [Johnny James Gatyas] buys a box at a yard sale that turns out to be a time machine. He travels to the future and rescues a slave named She-Ba [Amy Henry]. Together, they go on many futuristic adventures.
Two reluctant warriors avenge a town in the ancient Greek era.
A bioweapon leaks in Eastern Europe and spreads west. It mutates in a quarantine area, creating a killer monster. Can a group of cops stop it and the new virus?
Four childhood friends travel to Goa for a fun-filled wedding of their friend but their trip turns into a nightmare when they become involved in the murder of a stripper.

Faced with both her hot-tempered father's fading health and melting ice-caps that flood her ramshackle bayou community and unleash ancient aurochs, six-year-old Hushpuppy must learn the ways of courage and love.
A Catholic teacher meets an atheist journalist, whom a group of Catholics and Priests believes has been chosen by the devil to be the Antichrist.
Vengeance drives a tough Detroit cop to stay on the trail of a power-hungry auto magnate who is systematically eliminating his competition.
In Johannesburg, an American parole breaker unknowingly picks up a rental car that will tie him to a web of corrupt local police.

movie_name: The Peppercorns and the Curse of the Black King
synopsis: Mia and Benny are two enterprising kids from Hamburg with a passion for investigations. On a trip to the Gruber family farmhouse in southern Tyrol, they discover that the farm has been hit by the Black King's curse.
A photojournalist navigates the seedy underworld of political corruption, fetish pornography, and summer camping in an attempt to stop a toxic form of MDMA that melts users from the inside out.

Teen Josie tries to make sense of a frightening world in which a sleep condition blurs her dreams into waking life, and comes under the sway of her sister Samantha, whose dark web of secrets she must unravel.
Based on True Events, "Catch me if you can" meets "BLOW".

The Swedish Princess Yrida enchants the spectators of Germany with attractions of the Circus Busch and is discovered by Maharaja Gowan, who gives the circus an engagement in India in order to be closer to her.
A young girl meet a young guy that want to be a gangster. They fall in love and you follows his minds struggle what to do.
When a young female undergraduate, driving home for the holidays, is kidnapped, she must escape from the trunk of a car after her wealthy family botches the ransom drop.

When an evil corporation threatens to unleash the black plague, Evan Grail, is recruited by his grandfather,Max, into the order of the Black Knights - a secret band of warriors who have been called upon in the past to fight evil

A young sailor saves a woman from drowning. The woman turns out to be a rich heiress; unfortunately for the sailor, she was only pretending to be drowning so that another young man she had her eye on would save her.

Emily is sent to work and live in the Sovereign's castle. She manages to escape into the woods, where she meets some lively hookers. Together they become «Robber Girls» taking a stand and fighting the patriarchy.
When a martial arts expert discovers the existence of an illegal slave trade in the 1930s, he goes to great lengths to overthrow it.
After a devastating nuclear war, the last fertile woman on Earth joins forces with a tough renegade warrior to fight a team of deadly cyborgs and save the human race from extinction.
After failing to protect his king, a highly skilled and faithful knight must transform into the Black Knight to save the kingdom.
A mysterious old man and a dark past made up of classic cars, beautiful women and the excesses of his youth.
The son of a fundamentalist pastor becomes addicted to an irresistible witch. If he gives in to his temptation, he will be doomed to eternal life on the dark side.

movie_name: Friday the 13th Part VIII: Jason Takes Manhattan
synopsis: Jason Voorhees is accidentally awakened from his watery grave, and he ends up stalking a ship full of graduating high school students headed to Manhattan, NY.
When robbers hit Frankenstein's castle, teen pals Bibi and Tina hunt for the crooks, then devise a plan to save the neighbors' failing ranch.
A passionate holiday romance leads to an obsessive relationship, when an Australian photojournalist wakes one morning in a Berlin apartment and is unable to leave.
When a couple of retired mercenaries meet again, they decide to take advantage of their past skills and plan to rob a casino.
A young man, Guy, discovers the woman he's been sleeping with is not only married, but married to Burt Walker, a notorious low-level crime boss.
An elderly widow befriends an orphaned juvenile delinquent.

movie_name: Peter Pan 2: Return to Never Land
synopsis: In London during World War II, this is the story of Wendy's daughter, Jane, who is kidnapped by Captain Hook and Peter Pan must come to the rescue.
A group of LARPers get pulled into a magical realm where their powers become real. Now they must slay the demon, save the goddess and find a way home.
Deals with young adults going through intense subjects including on line bullying and human trafficking and how God intervenes in their lives.

Eva, a mysterious doctor, searches for an answer to her urgent dilemma as she unravels Dr. Anmuth's Book of Vision. Stellan gets involved in her life and is forced to confront his own nature as she faces the biggest decision of her life.
Montu is a local thug with a golden heart and Roma is a doctor. Both fall for each other. her colleague Dr. Ranjan is out to destroy their lives and nearly succeeds but Montu and Roma fights back .

Five friends take their hours with petty crimes. Are persuaded by a tough gangster and his seductive girlfriend to rob a bank. When they are caught, they are condemned to spend a year and a half in Glen Mills, an experimental reformatory.
A boy and his stepmother fear for their safety after an eerie creature resembling the boy's recently deceased father visits them.

The very very secret agent Cochon is back, this is Part 3 of his adventures. Relentless, he continues to look for the spy with a huge ass, it seems that he found her this time, she is hiding in a crater, Copermic, on the Moon.

Simon Templar (The Saint), is a thief for hire, whose latest job to steal the secret process for cold fusion puts him at odds with a traitor bent on toppling the Russian government, as well as the woman who holds its secret.

With his rich friend's disappearance having become the focus of an intense media circus, the detective has to save her life and find out who is behind this kidnapping.
Astronauts returning from a voyage to Mars are caught in a time warp and are propelled into a post-Apocalyptic Earth populated by mutants.
The true life story of Jim Quillen, whose tough upbringing takes him from loving son and protective brother to brazen criminal, daring escape artist, and youngest inmate on Alcatraz.

An original script based on the Amazon Top 50 Bestseller, THE WILD ROSES is the sweeping tale of 3 women who find themselves caught up in swashbuckling high action, comedy and romance to save a 1600s France and its child king.

After a family is involved in an accident, they take refuge in a secluded inn where they free a girl locked in a basement without knowing she's an ancient evil spirit.
After a clumsy painter indirectly becomes the witness of a murder, the murderers chase after him in order to kill him too.

A grandfather in a remote outback town travels 200km to the ocean on his mobility scooter to fulfill his wife's dying wish.
The story of the three Melody sisters growing up during the depression. Narrated by Francis Jane Melody. Written by M.T. Arnold.
In an arid and poor region of Brazil, bikers search for a miracle to make it rain and save the land, risking their lives.

An unknown virus begins spreading and within weeks it engulfs the entire planet. Upon the death of its host, the virus would reanimate the corpse until it was no longer able to support itself. Soon, the planet was infested with the undead.
A woman turning 50, is facing the biggest change in her life.

An Independent Feature Film shot entirely on GoPro exclusively for people who love craziness.
Bibi and Tina make friends with two young refugees and an Albanian schoolgirl on the run from her family who wants to marry her off.

Steveo a rising star in pro boxing is forced into crime when his wife's medical bills put them in debt. In prison he is deeply remorseful and pushes for early release. He is offered a second shot in the ring, but it comes with a price.

Four teenagers vacationing at a cabin for a weekend are suddenly thrown into a life or death situation when an apocalyptic event occurs.

An unorthodox Texas Ranger finds himself tested to his mental and physical limits when he must rescue his wife kidnapped by the brutal hands of the Mafia in Palermo, Italy, only to discover she is not the woman he thought he had married.
Young farm girl LAURA accidentally releases unspeakable evil lurking in the swamps. It's now up to Laura that will evil raise again.
A young professional woman suddenly discovers unexplained harm coming to those who have wronged her.
A mysterious young artist and her husband, a retired soldier struggle to forge a future together as their tormented past twists their relationship into a devilish nightmare.

A chief police inspector's first hand witness testimony impeaches someone of an intelligent service crime. Some hitman who is officially dead, but concealed by an intelligence agency, has been involved in a political treason plot.

A dead crook's sister weds the heir to a gold mine but leaves him when he gives it to the niece of his brother's partner.
At the behest of local revolutionaries, a mercenary enlists four specialists in various combat styles to help him rob a Mexican Army train carrying $500,000 in gold.
An American man marries a Serbian immigrant who fears that she will turn into the cat person of her homeland's fables if they are intimate together.
A Parisian criminal gang fall apart after challenges to the gang's leader lessen his influence.

An adventure story centered on the search for a mystical artifact lost in the heart of Africa.
A group of friends find themselves inside a bathysphere and awake in Atlantis. With the help of the King of Atlantis, they do their best to recover the Titanic.

An F.B.I. Agent teams up with a tracker to pursue a murderer after he vanishes into the mountains and infiltrates a hiking group.

In a world where dreams are sold as commodities, a lonesome man finds himself entangled in a web of delusions when he finds an old dream that was banned about a young woman named Kiki, who had mysteriously died 30 years prior.

A Miami cop learns that her father, who was the sheriff of her small hometown, has been murdered by an armed gang that has taken over the town. She brings four of her Miami cop friends to help clean out the town.

Two people struggling to find their way in and out of unhappy relationships and unhappy lives, whilst a foreigner to the love equation struggles to comprehend their love-fueled decisions.

A recently jilted dancer follows her ex-boyfriend to his new home, where she insinuates herself into his new relationship.

When her child is diagnosed with a rare genetic disease, a determined mother vows to give her child the best life possible with the support of her family, whatever it takes.
The unsettling tale of a childless couple who provide a home for unwanted, troubled teens.

Two English comic book geeks traveling across the U.S. encounter an alien outside Area 51.
A kidnapped businessman, finding out that no one is willing to pay the ransom to save his life, befriends his aggressor.
When some of his crew are captured by the Spaniards in Rio De La Hacha, pirate Captain Peter Blood enters the city in disguise in order to free his men from Marquis De Riconete's prison.
Douglas is kidnapped by the bunch of teenagers for being involved with Jenny, a girl from their school but Jenny is missing from her home. Everyone is looking for these two..

A cop who becomes a hitman for a group aimed at eliminating those who are above the law finds his world turned upside down by a single a devastating blow.

Delinquent students sent to a reform school stage a major heist.

synopsis: Three Stories.

A 600 years old marriage document causes an emotional bond between two neighbors making the two kids of them to plot to find a way for connecting their parents with each other.
In 2050, a cop benefits from a program virtually granting immortality. But everything is changed when he wakes up in somebody else's body, to quickly realize that this 'mistake' was made on purpose.
Former Police Sergeant Barnes becomes head of security for Senator Charlie Roan, a Presidential candidate targeted for death on Purge night due to her vow to eliminate the Purge.
A group of passengers traveling around the Mediterranean on a luxury liner enjoy various adventures and become romantically involved with each other.

On the New Years Eve of 2000, a cinema presents its last show before closure. Unfortunately, Satan arises, who is very unsatisfied with the modern movie quality, so he creates a gory bloodbath inside the cinema.

Young twins kill accidentally their baby sitter, parents decide to hide the truth until the young girl's family try to find her, The twins' father has to kill them one after the other to protect his kids.

A rich man's son gets lost at a very young age. His father searches for him in vain and dies after few years. Years later, three men come to the palace, each claiming to be the lost son. Which--if any of the three--is the real lost son?
A 9 year old girl through her passion for stories makes her divorcing parents fall in love all over again.
The story of New Zealand's Robert "Rob" Edwin Hall, who on May 10;1996, together with Scott Fischer, teamed up on a joint expedition to ascend Mount Everest.
Plot kept under wraps.

Still reluctant to call it quits on her dying marriage, a conventional Athenian housewife gets caught up in a whirlwind romance with a successful man. Will this deliciously dangerous affair lead to true love or sharp disappointment?

While on a journey to find a way back to their universe, a group must survive the advances of unknown creatures all while the world they inhabit begins to fall apart.
An Italian policeman goes undercover to break up an international heroin smuggling ring, and butts heads with a hot-tempered Interpol agent assigned to the same task.
The earliest atomic tests in New Mexico cause common ants to mutate into giant man-eating monsters that threaten civilization.

movie_name: The Untitled Work of Paul Shepard

Video footage is recovered revealing campers having a terrifying alien abduction experience.
High school student Ling Xiaoyu is recruited by Anna Williams of G Corporation to transfer to Kyoto University and gather information on a student named Shin Kamiya.

synopsis: The Z-Fighters must contend with Lord Beerus, the God of Destruction, but only a God can fight a God, and none of them are Gods. However with the creation of the Super Saiyan God, will the Z-Fighters be able to defeat Lord Beerus?

synopsis: An archaeologist must stop her demon-possessed sister from killing a camp of female survivalists in the Texas wildlands.

A high caste Brahmin household adopts an orphaned lower caste girl, but when a young man from their caste wishes to marry her without knowing her lineage, caste differences flare up again.

A beautiful girl on a passenger ship is suspected of murder.
"It is absolutely wrong to believe that other people are in a position of undertanding our deepest feelings." - Mishima
An architect goes to bed with a seductive stranger only to awaken beside the corpse of his boss.

After discovering that his wife is cheating on him, an insomniac aerospace engineer accidentally meets, and tries to help, a beautiful model on the run from some extremely dangerous people.
A backwoodsman comes to Detroit to get a job and earn money to buy an outboard motor.

Fear is more deadlier than the virus itself

A singer of tangos is kidnapped by a flying saucer and taken to Madrid, London and Paris.

Goopy wants to sing, and Bagha wants to play the dhol. They meet accidentally and are helped by King of Ghosts. With newly endowed abilities, they land in kingdom of Shundi, where their adventure begins.

A meek middle-aged man finally takes justice into his own hands.
During a mission in the Middle East, a group of US soldiers destroy a statue out of boredom only to then be visited by something the next day.
A cursory look at contemporary America aided by: Pie, whipped cream, supermodels and Jesus.

Space captain Harlock, the latest in a family of proud aerial warriors, begins his journey to free the oppressed Earth from the despotic Illumidas Command.

A village belle turns on to become an aspiring actress, but later she was exploited by some reasons.

A woman returns to her hometown following the death of her fathers second wife, which leads her to uncover dark family secrets.

A group of friends come together to celebrate their lifelong friendships and the death of their best friend.
