A mad scientist, who discovered the secret of eternal youth by draining of blood from a young woman, gets executed. His ancestor moves into the home, eventually discovering the scientist's body. He revives him, and the terror continues.

The adventures of two half-time crooks, a dead body and a bird.
It's here at last. a wonderful package of dances, songs, romance and comedy galore in the best musical ever filmed.

When a woman's boyfriend dumps her for a younger girl, she hatches a scheme to get revenge by going after the girl's former boyfriend.
Sometime in the distant future, a fledgling band gets an opportunity for a breakthrough, if they can make it in time to a faraway planet to perform in a very popular club.
The Lone Wolf tracks down Nazi spies in London during the German bombing.

After defeating all criminals in her small town, a superhero-for-hire finds herself bored and unemployed until the emergence of a new villain leads her on a mission of self-discovery while attempting to save her small town once again.

A couple struggles to visit all four of their divorced parents on Christmas.
A man forsakes wealth to wed a tomboy whose father was ruined by riches.
When a man is held hostage in a twisted version of suburban San Fernando Valley, he slowly uncovers the reason for his capture and the miserable fate that awaits him-and humanity-unless he acts.
This story revolves around Panchhi, who is psychologically distressed and wants happiness in life. However, his life takes a turn when he is charged with murdering a girl whom he loves.

When Junior, an overprotected preteen worm, is accidentally brought up to the surface, he must face a risky journey back home, while learning the great powers of self-respect, trust and true friendship.
A world-famous pianist loses both hands in an accident. When new hands are grafted on, he doesn't know they once belonged to a murderer.
A monk is expelled from a monastery because the historical equivalent of Playboy was found under his pillow. He falls in with a gang of villains, who hire him because of his Kung Fu skills.

movie_name: The Legend of Timm Thaler or The Boy Who Sold His Laughter
synopsis: The devil tricks a little boy off his laughter in exchange for assured wins in all his bets. It depicts his journey after the deal with the devil, how he loses his soul bit by bit with each win.
Two families (lifelong best friends) are destroyed because of one text message sent at the worst possible time.
Stéphane is an emotionally distant but professionally dedicated violin restorer whose cold heart is tested when his employer's new girlfriend, a beautiful violinist, falls for him.

A policeman gets killed and the short-staffed police chief sends for a few experienced officers to support him in his fight with organized crime. Meanwhile, a conflict between local gangster groups escalates.
Plot kept under wraps. Described as a heart-warming sci-fi film inspired by films of the 1980s.
A young girl and her dog make a daring journey into the wilderness where she discovers the true meaning of nature, sacrifice and life.

Dave Skylark and his producer Aaron Rapaport run the celebrity tabloid show "Skylark Tonight". When they land an interview with a surprise fan, North Korean dictator Jong-Un Kim, they are recruited by the CIA to assassinate him.

In a galaxy far, far away. - but not really. It is a time of conflict. Math teacher David Dudek, along with Sigurd and Ørjan have been kidnapped by General Grevost, but hey, it is David. Getting out of there will be no problem.

A policeman white blood cell, with the help of a cold pill, must stop a deadly virus from destroying the human they live in, Frank.

The discovery of a severed human ear found in a field leads a young man on an investigation related to a beautiful, mysterious nightclub singer and a group of psychopathic criminals who have kidnapped her child.
A documentary-style drama about the "Fouke Monster", a Bigfoot-type creature that has been sighted in and around Fouke, Arkansas since the 1950s.
This "home invasion" movie takes a hard turn when the protagonist escapes her home and flees into the darkness, leading to a night of weird twists, strange characters, and intense violence.

A man on the run is trying to cheat death but ahead of him lies an uncertain path that brings his sanity into question. Is he on the run from supernatural forces seeking to destroy him or is he on the run from himself?
Dorothy, saved from a psychiatric experiment by a mysterious girl, is somehow called back to Oz when a vain witch and the Nome King destroy everything that makes the magical land beautiful.
A true crime author races to save his son from a kidnapper who wants the author's severed hands as a symbolic pledge that he'll never write again.
A beautiful young woman is a daring master thief. She meets the young millionaire Thomas Babbington Norton, while fleeing from the scene of her latest theft.
The British send an American and a war hero to kidnap and hide an oil-country prince.
When an American diamond trader's Russian partner goes missing, he journeys to Siberia in search of him, but instead begins a love affair.
A couple of friends work for a taxi driver to rob his passengers, but they feel like they are being ripped off.
A disgraced former air traffic controller is called back into service when the airport's traffic control system malfunctions.

In an alternate reality, children learn how lucky they will be (their "frequency"), knowledge which shapes their destiny. The unluckiest boy must parse the mysteries of free will in order to pursue his forbidden love of the luckiest girl.
An aging gambler and womanizer returns home after 20 years, haunted by the suicide of his friend.

Three female ninjas are recruited by the government to recover a gold treasure robbed by a gang. They go undercover, sometimes nude under bed covers, to investigate and achieve their end, fighting and killing men in unusual ways.
Zafar, a young and rebellious writer, comes to Mumbai to try his luck in the Bollywood film industry. He soon falls in love with a starlet and loses himself in the intoxicating world of glamour.
In 1994, a young couple enters the world of the music industry, and subsequently the world of drugs.
A rich woman who introduced herself as a country girl.

movie_name: Hanggang sa kabila ng daigdig: The Tony Maiquez story
synopsis: The true story of the love, life, and music of one of the greatest composers of our time.

A South Seas skipper fights off thieves and pirates who are after a lost treasure.
The Ivan's psyche is affected when he becomes the lover of a young married woman.
No man can serve two masters.
When Shiloh's abusive previous owner, Judd Travers, tries to retake Shiloh again, Ray tries to find a way to end the rivalry and open up the hidden kindness within the town drunk.

Nothing is what it seems. When beautiful Alexandria is denied a promotion a heated argument turns deadly and she frames her boss's husband for the murder. A cat and mouse game with 2 detectives assigned to the murder investigation follows.
A corporate magnate marries a woman and uses a stand-in to consummate the marriage.
A modern aircraft carrier is thrown back in time to 1941 near Hawaii, just hours before the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor.
The star-crossed desert romance of a cloistered woman and a renegade monk.
While on a project outing in an abandoned military zone, five college students accidentally release a long kept secret weapon with a nightmarish purpose.
Happy Endings weaves multiple stories to create a witty look at love, family and the sheer unpredictability of life itself.

In a new twist on the classic tale by Edgar Allen Poe: Allen is a notorious 1920's outlaw, haunted by a cowardly choice to leave his partner in crime, Lenore, dying so that he may flee capture. His soul shall be lifted nevermore.
An arrogant prince cruelly punishes two boys for an unintentional mistake. The action propels the boys into different directions and ultimately leads to a battle of good versus evil.
A blind American writer living in London stumbles upon a criminal conspiracy involving kidnapping and extortion.

movie_name: The Boy with the Golden Pants

Centers around the shooting of Charles Stuart and his pregnant wife Carol in Boston on October 23rd, 1989.

A country bumpkin (Dong-shik) goes to Seoul in order to bring his older brother (Young-shik)back to the country. Little does he know Young-shik is a petty crook involved with a prostitute (Sonia) who is servicing American GIs. Then Sonia comes onto Dong-shik...
A light-hearted coming-of-age story of a lovable 60-year-old-man.

Duped by former Army pal Paul Hoplin into building a time-bomb, New York shop owner Jim Molner and his family become hostages of Hoplin who uses bomb-threats to extort money from airlines.

Wanted by the Chinese mafia, a New York City bike messenger escapes into the world of parkour after meeting a beautiful stranger.
When a group of kids has their candy stolen by a teenage bully on Halloween night, they must band together and rally the entire neighborhood to retrieve their stolen candy and save Halloween.
After being wrongfully accused of a fatal hit-and-run, a man finds himself hunted by cops and criminals alike as he attempts to find out who has stolen his identity.

Sharmili, a Bride to be gets kidnapped by a Bhaiyaji who asks for 5 crore as ransom. Confusion strikes when family finds a letter which says she has eloped with her lover. Has Sharmili been kidnapped or has she eloped with her lover?

The sequel on the big screen to the cult series of Alexandre Astier, an offbeat version of the legend of the Knights of the Round Table. Hidden in Rome, King Arthur plans his comeback to oppose the army of his former friend Lancelot.
Juan, Maria and Pepin's best friend is falsely accused of stealing some money. The three children decide to check it out and find the real thief.

Five crew members are forced into an escape pod built for four after their starship is destroyed. Just as rescue seems imminent, an alien creature boards their craft and attacks them.

A fun camping trip turns into a desperate fight for survival after two kids witness a horrific event in the wild. They have to endure the elements and wildlife and they must also find a way to reach civilization before it's too late.
Based on a famous fairytale by Yuri Olesha.
A folk tale set in the hills of Wales during the industrial revolution.

After a hideous crime in a mansion by the forest, where a group of young people was found murdered, a suspicious clown tries to prove his innocence to the investigator that found him covered in blood.

A Latinx surreal sci-fi drama set in the present.

Two inventors head to propose a machine for easy soap packaging while evil capitalist tries to destroy the machine and gaslighting friends.

A down-on-his-luck sea captain goes treasure hunting for a wrecked Spanish galleon that is rumored to be cursed by God and protected by supernatural forces.
A free-spirited woman in her 50s seeks out love at L.A. dance clubs.

synopsis: A fortune teller blackmails a beautiful widow whose husband has recently died.

When a serial killer emerges in Hong Kong, Nam, an energetic and conscientious policewoman, swears to catch him. Jack, a spineless constable, is impressed by her bravery and decides to secretly protect her.
A son seeks to avenge the murder of his father.
A cheetah born in a zoo will never know what it's like to run at 70mph (120km/h), thus will never be a complete cheetah.

Atom and Eve are consumed by their addictions in a perfect dream world. But when an anonymous stranger calls on them, a darkness begins to enter their lives. Now they can no longer differentiate reality from fantasy.
In the not too distant future where cyber terrorism has infiltrated society, advanced robotic couriers known as SYNC's are tasked in transporting valuable data between locations.
Three friends take a vacation in the Swedish wilderness. Unaware of what ancient horror that awaits them.

A gang of gangsters led by a man named Marcos takes the famous forger Camilo out of prison, with the intention of making him work for them on a large forgery.

After her father contracts a supernatural illness, a young aristocrat named Margaret Trelawny enlists the help of a gentleman lawyer to save her father's life.

A hard-working young man meets and falls in love with his sister's bridesmaid. He soon finds out how disturbed she really is.

Twelve-year-old Peter Hatcher almost has it all, with just one massive problem: Fudge, his 3-year-old brother. When Fudge runs away under Peter's watch, an epic family adventure across NYC ensues.

Brilliant and handsome physics student John Loh must find a way to use the ghost frequency of "19 Hz" (19 Hertz) to re-open a doorway to another world after his Professor vanishes during an experiment.

Following a ghost invasion of Manhattan, paranormal enthusiasts Erin Gilbert and Abby Yates, nuclear engineer Jillian Holtzmann, and subway worker Patty Tolan band together to stop the otherworldly threat.
We end consuming, desperate and alone. A portrait of weakness, experience and redemption.

Thyagaraja, a saint and a poet, overcomes many hurdles in his life, including grinding poverty to emerge as the greatest Carnatic music composers of all time.
A troubled married couple and their long-lost friend become ensnared in a supernatural phenomena while vacationing at an isolated beach house.
To prevent the decay of humanity, a former digital spy and friends must pull off an elaborate heist.

Mourning his dead child, a haunted Vietnam War veteran attempts to uncover his past while suffering from a severe case of dissociation. To do so, he must decipher reality and life from his own dreams, delusions, and perceptions of death.
Roberto Ramirez (Carlos Gardel) is a gambler who meets Alina (Imperio Argentina) and takes the decision to change his life.

In The Fantastic Magic Baby, director Chang Che weaves a wild and woolly yarn about how the legendary Monkey King and Goddess of Mercy battle and defeat the child god Hung Hai-erh then point him down the road to righteousness.

Mother told you not to pick up strangers, but what if pick up strangers is part of your job?

Katelyn and Kelsey Winters, two sisters distracted by an argument, unknowingly travel through a stretch of isolated wilderness plagued by mysterious disappearances.
Friends, Raj, Rahul, Aditya and Jignesh, are fun-loving engineering students. When Simran does not accept Raj's love, he along with his friends goes to Saurashtra to attend Aditya's sister's wedding.

A futuristic action thriller where a team of people work to prevent a disaster threatening the future of the human race.

What if someone could remember?

Andi Frightley loves her dog Max so much, she'd go through hell to see him again. Unfortunately for her, she may just have to.
After a scientific experiment leads to the creation of a clone of Mewtwo, he sets out to destroy the world. Ash and his friends then decide to thwart Mewtwo's evil plans.
Two Chicago firefighter brothers, who don't get along, have to work together while a dangerous arsonist is on the loose.
Ignorant Do-shik has to finish high school before taking over the family gangster business. He starts at a private co-ed high school in GangNam, Seoul. Disguised as a 19 year old, he gets bullied.
An amnesiac discovers himself leaping through time between 2000 and 2002 as his past returns to him.
In an era where aliens have invaded and conquered feudal Tokyo, a young samurai seeks work as he can.
Felix is a friendless achiever in high school whose life changes after the arrival of the half-American Snyder brothers, entangling him in their dark ambitions.

A carefree teen, rescued by a mischievous dolphin, forms a unique bond with the dolphin and its reclusive researcher and soon becomes the guinea pig for a computer chip that will give humans dolphin-like abilities.
A violent thug plays opposing yakuza bosses against each other.

movie_name: Dolly the Sheep Was Evil and Died Early
synopsis: Young student Nikita suddenly gets into the past where he meets his own young parents, new friends and even a true love.
In anthology style, a group of writers tell horror stories during a pitch meeting.
A man is caught up in a web of deceit and violence, while fighting his own demons, disturbing inclinations and a dark past.
A Brazilian western about Cabeleira, a feared killer living in the countryside of Pernambuco State in the 40's.
A man is conflicted when he falls for a free-spirited woman that he knows that his mother will not like.

If you thought life was normal, Then you thought wrong - Gregory thought the same, until one Halloween night when a piece of candy that had fallen from a UFO into his bag of candy,changed everything from normal, to The...Strange.
During a Los Angeles earthquake, An FBI agent with Parkinson's disease works with his partner to to hunt down a killer who has been their target for years.
A set of three stories, each concerning a woman's difficulty with her husband.
A detective falls in love with an aspiring actress whose dark family secrets are revealed as he attempts to solve the murders of her father, brother and her two recent lovers.
Vanessa, a woman in mourning, takes a solo trip to clear her head after the death of her friend, but her self-care vacation plans change when she's met with an out-of-this-world situation.
A political drama about Stalin's prison-camp system in Russia.
A group of ordinary French survived a nuclear war and found themselves in the face of what was left of civilization.

Josh and Ling were expecting a boring vacation visiting each of their parents at an archaeological dig in China. But the new friends soon discover they're right in the middle of an adventure when they find a Chinese Golden Dragon.
This movie is about a phony, irresponsible and idle man who finds a 500 rupee note which teaches him how to work hard and live a dignified life with self-respect.
Sreedharan, a simpleton tries to impress his nephew 'Ashwathi' and decides to marry her, but under several circumstances he came to know her tragic past and helps her.
Jerimiah Johnson was a strange boy growing up. He could never decided what he wanted to be. Now he has chosen to be a ranger and help people to die.

In a quest for to "find herself," 18-year-old Bria signs up for a group tour of Central America. But when she meets seasoned backpacker, Rowen, she ditches her group and joins him on a journey way off the beaten path.
Perky dance student, Mi-hye--nicknamed "Jjang-gu"--falls in love with a journalism major named Jin-ho. However, she becomes the target of a trio of jealous, would-be kidnappers
A woman discovers that she is the descendant of Athena, the Greek goddess of wisdom and war.
Commissioner Maigret's new case. At the rate of his further service in the police.
They're all saying it: WALASTIK, they're all singing it: DOWNTOWN--together it's "WALASTIK sa DOWNTOWN"; together it means WHAT A PICTURE.
The Saint returns to London and with the help of an American pickpocket and a beautiful adventuress breaks a counterfeiting ring.
Couple of lovers want to steal the income of a popular soccer game, at Maracanã Stadium, in Rio de Janeiro.

A single mother becomes trapped inside her own vacation rental and must piece together clues from the various guests who have stayed there in order to figure out who assaulted her and hopefully survive.

movie_name: The Mystery of the Diamond Belt
synopsis: A crook poses as a Lord to rob a merchant and holds a detective captive in his cellar.
A WWI English officer is inspired the night before a dangerous mission by a vision of Joan of Arc, whose story he relives.
The Telugu version of the trilingual horror-comedy wherein a husband finds out his wife is possessed. The Hindi version is Tutak Tutak Tutiya (2016) and the Tamil version is Devi (2016)

Hitting the Wall, is the story of an injured athlete and his struggle to recover and return to the track in hopes of qualifying for the U. S. Olympic track team. This film explores the concept of a purpose and pride in life.
A battle is on to save the soul of a woman who must decide whether or not to become a vengeful spirit.
When something big happens at Drama High, the girls and guys come together to fight the terrible creature. Then, they dance the night away.

A modern woman, whose youthful appearance leads people to believe she is her daughter's sister, divorced several times, is about to marry a man who is a fortune-hunter, against the wishes of her daughter and, especially, her outraged son.

The head of a drug company mysteriously disappears, after taking credit for a new anesthetic that actually resulted from the work of several doctors, and his surgeon is found strangely murdered by a surgical instrument.
A crazed doctor performs gruesome experiments in his search for a youth serum.
A private detective tries to find a missing girl, who disappeared during a mysterious scientific research.
Piet du Bois is a miner who wants to buy a farm. He meets a Bushman and his wife buying their land and expelling after. The Bushman exposes a legend about a fabulous hidden treasure.
Cayenne, French Guiana: When a teenage drug mule absconds with a bellyful of product, a corrupt cop who traffics cocaine must find the kid without blowing his cover or getting killed by the cartel.

movie_name: Girara no gyakushû: Tôya-ko Samitto kikiippatsu
synopsis: In 2008, all the world leaders are together at a G8 Summit meeting in Japan. A meteorite crashes into the heart of Sapporo and releases the monster Guilala. The monster rampages through Sapporo, leaving death and destruction in his wake.

A young woman comes to in a roadside diner with no idea where she is or how she got there. Split between two timelines, she gets taken on a violent journey as she seeks out the person responsible for her lover's death.
A lady cop infiltrates an all-female criminal gang.
Adaptation of the graphic novel, "The Chronic Argonauts" from New Baby Publishing, based on the original H.G. Wells short story.

A young man returns to his hometown as a farmhand, hoping to reconnect with his estranged boyfriend. When a shadowy killer begins a bloody rampage on the night harvest, he finds that his ex-lover's family secrets may destroy them both.

Jonna (19) is leaving her small town just after finishing her education, going to the big city, enjoying big city life until she is attacked by a man at night. She is saved by the 30 year old woman Piki, and falls in love with her.

movie_name: K-20: The Fiend with Twenty Faces
synopsis: Set in a fictional Japanese city in 1949, a master criminal hones in on his latest victim.
An average soldier is caught up in the cogs of an inhuman war machine during the First World War...

Aj begins having dreams of his parents' death. He decides to go back to the spot where they were killed, accompanied by his brother and his brother's family. But legend has it there is something mysterious roaming these woods.
A hacker joins a Hollywood film production as an actor to bring down the ruthless celebrity producer, who killed his girlfriend. However, he finds himself facing the underworld mafia.

Lee and his wife Susan accept the invitation of mysterious Diane to visit her secluded desert estate. Tensions arise when the couple, unaware that Diane is a vampire, realize that they are both objects of the pale temptress's seductions.
Amelia Earhart's granddaughter Ember and her best friend Trinity must navigate through time and space across bizarre dimensions to find the tyrant who took their parents.
Tarzan's son, Jack, escapes captivity and retreats into the jungle with an ape, where he finds love in unexpected places.
Nichols, a hardened New England detective unflinching in his pursuit of a case where nothing is as it seems, one that begins to dismantle the illusions in his own life.
No Justice tells the story of a British black girl and an African American girl who get into an altercation with a white police officer in Los Angeles. The altercation takes an unexpected turn.

A popular young student finds herself accused of a series of murders that have occurred on the college campus. Her boyfriend, a reporter for the local newspaper, knows she didn't do it, and sets out to prove her innocence and catch the real killer.
Tony and Mr Bartholomew try to stay ahead of the game as the net closes in.
A story of an ill-fated OFW (overseas Filipino worker) whose hopes are once more afloat by a genie - the one that he's been waiting forever.

The adventurer Clint travels across Borneo with a bunch of rogues and geologists on the search for a diamond mine. Trouble with the natives begins when the diamonds are found because diamonds are holy stones to them.

In the early 19th century, lived a dark mysterious crooked nose witch that practiced black magic in a Victorian farm house tucked away in the deep forest. Ninety three years later, a modernized family move in and conceive a child.
A reporter meets an actress whose producer is a presumed-dead thief, and stakes his reputation on predicting the next crime.
A drug-dealing teenager tries to break free from the trade before college, but gets dragged back in when a deal goes south.
The poignant, coming of age story about a group of eleven year old girls in their final summer before middle school.
A getaway driver's skills are tested when a heist that goes awry.
An oceanographer diving in the Bermuda Triangle discovers an undersea world.
As the Mayan kingdom faces its decline, a young man is taken on a perilous journey to a world ruled by fear and oppression.
It is about limerence of Dhruv (played by Bohra) resulting from an obsessive attraction to Ananya (played by Banerjee).

Brilliant and handsome physics student John Loh must find a way to use the ghost frequency of "19 Hz" (19 Hertz) to re-open a doorway to another world after his Professor vanishes during an experiment.
3 old school friends get together again in Barcelona for the heist of their lives. Desperately driven by a perverse feeling of righteousness, they shall unleash stunning violent action over the city.
An animated retelling of Charles Dickens' classic novel about a Victorian-era miser taken on a journey of self-redemption, courtesy of several mysterious Christmas apparitions.

movie_name: The Lunnis and the Great Fairy Tales Adventure
synopsis: Fantasy is in danger. The evil Crudo has discovered the way to finish with the Magic Book, the book that contains all the stories invented by Mankind. A 9 year-old girl, is the chosen one to save it with the help of her friends The Lunnis.
On an island beach a woman vows to avenge her brother's death at the hands of a pirate leader. With help, the woman spies on the pirates and then gets a job as bodyguard to the pirate leader.
A struggling actress confronts her quarter-life crisis by leaving New York City and returning home to win back her high school sweetheart.
Set in a futuristic authoritarian state, a loyal government official makes a startling discovery that causes her to doubt her allegiance.
In South America, after Jeff Dawson and Dutch Peterson's oil rigs are dynamited by local bandits, the two partners resort to risky transportation of nitroglycerin to raise money.
A young Spanish aristocrat must masquerade as a fop in order to maintain his secret identity of Zorro as he restores justice to early California.

Movie progresses through three different phases in the life of Davis George, a forest officer. He leads a contented life with his wife Sara and son. Certain unexpected tragedies wreck the smooth flow of their life.

Boxing trainer Claus works a second job as a collector for loan shark Holger in order to pay off his own debts. He is assisted by Igor, a 'Jaws'-like tough guy. Trouble arises when Claus falls in love with hot-tempered Laura.
An Iraq war veteran teams up with a wealthy business owner in Texas.
Arjun dreams of skating. Can Arjun follow his dream and be a champion?

movie_name: As Long as There Are Women
synopsis: Three friends are looking for the woman of their dreams. Three different women deal, in a different way, with love, marriage and their future.
A street-wise Latina is torn between her Bronx gang and the woman she loves.
Student girl goes to a mansion in Petrópolis, Brazil, to babysit two children, while their parents are away for the weekend, and is terrorized by anonymous phonecalls originating in the house.
The discovery of a corpse threatens to unravel a bumbling local politician's campaign for governor of Colorado.
An incident unrelated to a nightmare entangles the misfortune of a group of innocent and unlucky victims.

Cassie Wright, a retiring porn star, along with her assistant Sheila, sets out to trump Annabel Chong's record by filming herself having sex with 600 men. As the men wait their turns, secrets, double-crosses and death all play a part.

A successful novelist rents a house to write his new book only to discover that the house has a violent history, as it belonged to a powerful warlock and his sensual witches. Memories from the house will start haunting his nightmares.

Terror grips a small mountain town as bodies are discovered after each full moon. Losing sleep, raising a teenage daughter, and caring for his ailing father, officer Marshall struggles to remind himself there's no such thing as werewolves.
A modern day tale of love, black comedy and scientific daring, The Abomination tells the story of Adam, a man brought back to life by an eccentric but brilliant scientist, Archimedes The Alchemist.
Derek gets sucked into a gothic cult that turns out to be vampires. As a vampire now, he must figure out who he is and what side he serves. In the end will he be good or bad?
Two young couples returning from their ski vacation chased by a devilish cult.
The hidden powers that run the World, exist in all ages and will exist forever by changing their names and appearances through mythological characters.
A murderous barber and his equally psychopathic friend, a baker, the barber and baker hatch a plan to murder and make human pies to be sold in his shop.

The Pet Pals are put to the test when the Evil Crow Witch is determined to drain the canals of Venice. Armed with a touch of magic, the Pet Pals combine their strengths to uncover the secret code before the Evil Witch does.
2002: A low grade MI6 desk officer inadvertently discovers deliberate flaws in the evidence being compiled to invade Iraq, and tries to expose the truth.
An immortal woman reconnects with a love from her past life.

Toni, a journalism student, transfers to a new college, where several female students begin to disappear under suspicious circumstances. She decides to investigate, which makes her the mysterious killer's prime target.

movie_name: Shen Jing Dao yu Fei Tian Mao
synopsis: Two feuding bounty-hunter families have to team up to track down a criminal couple.
A biker gets a job at a turkey farm and agrees to act as guinea pig for some chemicals that need tested, failing to anticipate the murderous side effects.
An air hostess gets involved in Naples, against her will, in the in-fighting amongst rival gangs.
Feature version of the 1936 serial "Shadow of Chinatown."
Storyline is being kept under wraps.

After witnessing a murder, a father and daughter clean-up crew, must survive through the night. Meanwhile, two detectives are on the case as they try to piece together the remains left behind by the killer.
It's about a country doctor that comes to the city while a clinic is built in his home town....he rubs off his care and compassion on others at the hospital with his humor and wit.
Hell knows no forgiveness.

Buster is an aspiring magician battling his status as a geek. Making things more difficult is his small size. This movie chronicles Buster's unique way of dealing with bullies, school, his first job and girls.

A punk rock romance portraiture of present day America. This teen / coming-of-age film utilizes iconic American imagery to examine the people's reaction to the campaign and inauguration of Barack Obama.

As her world is shrouded in darkness, a young girl must overcome her fears and travel to a mysterious city of light, save her father from a dangerous scientist and prevent the destruction of her planet.
The lives of a British broadcaster, a young Michigan couple and Shanghai father are all connected by their convictions that the world is going to end soon.
Plot undisclosed. Described as a live-action fairy tale musical comedy.

After the murder of a fellow classmate, 17-year-old Erin Sawyer must face the revelation that someone very close to her is responsible for the murder spree happening in her hometown of Redwood Springs.

An affectless writer is lured to a couples weekend getaway by his wife and friends, only to uncover a tumultuous secret and a perilous obsession that threaten to change the course of his life in intense and surprising ways.

During a hot summer in 1990, a young man, Ray, moves into his aunt's Venice Beach home to find his direction in life. While there, he is befriended by some local criminals, a group of five brothers that soon become his surrogate family.

Yan is haunted by fleeting images of what she believes to be dead people. Soon, her suspicions are confirmed when her therapist Jim begins seeing the same things and the two begin to unravel a mystery that leads to a forgotten past.

The human government develops a cure for mutations, and Jean Gray becomes a darker uncontrollable persona called the Phoenix who allies with Magneto, causing escalation into an all-out battle for the X-Men.

The rise of Peter Marshall, from modest Scottish upbringing, to New York seminary, time in Atlanta churches, his marriage, appointment as chaplain of the US Senate, and early death at 46. Based on real events.
Ex-Garda, criminal psychologist Ethan Pierce returns to Ireland to hunt down the sadistic killer who murdered his wife and unborn child years before.
Manorama, wife of an irrigation minister, tasks Satyaveer to find if her husband is cheating. As Satyaveer starts investigating, he gets trapped in a web of lies and must uncover the entire truth.

In a remote Irish village, police are called to the scene of a bloody massacre, but they ignore the lone survivor's claim that the house was responsible for the carnage that killed her parents and brother.

After losing contact with a clandestine energy research facility, a powerful venture capitalist contracts a private team of elite military operatives to retrieve a physicist who holds the key to an unprecedented alternate energy source.

Young aristocrat Arnaud de Maule hires female private detective Claude Alphand to investigate a strange cult, the Church of the Final Revival, that tried to recruit his girlfriend Chloé, who then disappeared, and it now stalks him.

movie_name: The Kid Who Would Be King
synopsis: A band of kids embark on an epic quest to thwart a medieval menace.
A zealous vigilante looking to clean the internet of sin targets a group of teens that broadcast misadventures on their chat room.
Two homeless girls find an lost old man in the streets of Salvador, and are willing to help him. But they start using him to get alms from people.

A pair of New York City detectives is faced with a moral dilemma when offered a tremendous sum of money in exchange for catching a killer and turning him over to the victim's family instead of the criminal justice system.
After a routine mission goes awry, MI6 is attacked by the evil and mysterious Forest Labs, James Bond gets sent on an unofficial mission to put a stop to their plans.
Brian tracks down his mysterious grandfather.
A group of teenagers in a small Midwest town discover an old prophecy that sets off a series of terrible events.
A glorious excursion in the realms of fantasy - magic - romance - laughter.

When the man who left a package in his care is murdered, detective Tim Diamond suddenly has every major gangster in the city after him. With only the package and the help of his little brother, he sets out to unravel the mysterious plot.
The Inmates is a story of old school 10th class students settled on different countries, they struck on one situation from that what they faced and how they escaped from the situation.

The direct sequal to the movie "The Dream" A guy who brutally have murdered by an extraordinary creature just got his life back - but not for free. Can he escape from the terror of his dreams or he going to get stuck in it?
Multiple stories about people living in an apartment complex intersect - among them, a girl who enjoys shooting strangers and one of her victims reflecting over his death.
Vasu, a young medico, after rescuing one of his patients from a murder attempt finds out that his pregnant wife is abducted, and the kidnappers demand the patient he saved in exchange for her safety.
A group of astronomy students get more than they bargained for after finding an injured alien who is being targeted by a group of bloodthirsty CREATURES!.

An idyllic town is thrown into chaos when two powerful Pokémon, Dialga and Palkia, cross paths and battle, distorting the dimensions of time and space. The only hope comes from Darkrai, a shadowy Pokémon shunned by the townsfolk.
In the distant future, a small waste-collecting robot inadvertently embarks on a space journey that will ultimately decide the fate of mankind.
An insomniac man who lives in a sterile urban environment has a strange waking dream one night in which he experiences a surreal adventure incorporating wild nature and sexual freedom.

Supernaturals in LA and their savage instincts, clan turf wars, and scientific experiments, while a group of photojournalists are documenting sudden appearances of both Earth's mystery beings and unidentified entities from the skies.

The undercover agent with dragon tattoo Kowloon continually helped the police to solve mysterious cases, which made him known as a rising star. However, his impulsive personality dragged him into endless troubles.
In 1979 a UFO is spotted over Ukrainian territory in the Soviet Union. A squadron of MIG23 fighters are dispatched to intercept it.
A romantic comedy based upon a couple who are down on their luck, but through some Divine intervention experience a wonderful chain of events.
On the eve of his father's one year disappearance, teenage filmmaker Dillon Larson experiences an alien encounter while visiting his uncle's farm.
The story is about a strict police officer who relocates to a hilly village on the Kerala-Tamil Nadu border. Few normal incidents that take place suddenly appear to be abnormal.
In a distant point of time, a man alters the world he knows when he tries to sell lemonade.
Cue's a murderer who doesn't want to be. It's not his fault though, something is commanding him to be the way he is.
After the disappearance of the estate librarian, and the murder of another, Kerrigan is summoned by the lady of the manor to solve the mystery, and maybe find the Claydon treasure.

movie_name: Thalassa, Thalassa! Return to the Sea
synopsis: A group of young boys, and one girl, find and steal a Jaguar convertible, and decide to drive to the sea. What starts out as a lark deteriorates into a rather grueling journey.
A group of friends reunite for a holiday at a recluse cabin in the woods.

movie_name: The Pediland Murders (The GillyGutz Chronicles pt2)
synopsis: 14 year old Cynthia Guts escape Bedlamite prison to return home and purge the town of Pediland of its syndicate of pedophiles.
An actress, a dancer, a psychic and a rocker come to Los Angeles to chase their dreams. They get hired at a marijuana dispensary as delivery drivers and get caught up in a criminal world.

John steals money and a bracelet/temporal dislocator from a Chinese antiques shop. Fleeing, he triggers the device and goes minutes back in time. The time travels result in new Johns and they form the Mega Time Squad.
Alexandre Dupré is a con artist, accidentally involved in a hunt for microfilm, containing a valuable invention of a recently murdered French scientist.
A suspense thriller that revolves around a pregnant woman who carries a lot of mysteries about her pregnancy, and her relationships with the people around her.

A specimen canister ejected from Russian MIR Space Station's accidentally opened releasing mysterious invisible creatures with an insatiable appetite causing them to reproduce. Can Gail escape by hiding in a cabin with wanted bank robbers?
A group of friends go on a road trip to the famous area 51, but something they are least expecting happens.

movie_name: What a Difference a Day Makes
synopsis: The successful politician Robert is going on a romantic weekend trip with his pregnant girlfriend Katharina as a unexpected old friend of Robert,Wolfgang suddenly appears on the surface and start to stalk the couple.
Kutty is a good-hearted soul, but unfortunate incidents tend to portray his ruffian side whenever he encounters the girl he loves. A bizarre incident brings them closer and yet keeps them apart.

Clara, a young girl with the ability to heal insomniacs is being exploited by her aunt, Marta. When Omar, a new neighbor befriends Clara, they spawn a friendship that causes events beyond their control to set in motion.
An evil magician seeks to gain power by obtaining a magic rose. A peasant boy and a Prince join forces to stop him.
A young man returns to his hometown after years of being gone to get revenge on a gang that ruined his life.
Mete is a stupid guy who fights for world peace.
A friendly vampire girl goes to school and meets humans, who together open a blood donation club.

Haru is living a disintegrated married life with her then high school teacher, Yuichiro. After Yuichiro's sudden death, Haru meets his mistress, Shiori, who was also one of his students. Fueled by jealousy, unexpected events begin...
A contract worker in Sudan is abducted by mercenaries and his lover in India awaits his return.
A surreal, apocalyptic nightmare fantasy on the George W. Bush years and the effect they have on protagonist, BlueMahler, his family, and his life.
Rafting expert Gail takes on a pair of armed killers while navigating a spectacularly violent river.
Something wicked hangs above the city - and it wants all of us to suffer with it.
Young newsboy is hunted by a bank robber who thinks the boy has his lost loot.
Pierfrancesco "Checco" Zalone, a failed entrepreneur, seeks a new life as a waiter on a holiday village in Africa, but the appearance of ISIS forces him to travel again.
A super-powered boy helps a wheelchair-bound policeman in his attempt to bring down a mob kingpin.
Two down on the luck friends turn to selling drugs with a corrupt cop, and learn that drugs are not the only thing they are trafficking.
THE LAPID BROTHERS APPEAR IN THIS ACTION-ADVENTURE FILM.

When Simon Daniel, a wandering Archaeologist, learns that his friend, Santhosh, has disappeared while looking for a lost treasure in an mysterious estate, embarks on a journey to find him and complete the mission.
The bumpy love lives of four Amsterdam couples intersect during the days leading up to Dutch national holiday Sinterklaas.
Char Divas Premache explores the true meaning of love through a series of relationships starting from a misunderstood childhood romance.

Ultraman Moebius is joined once again by Ultraman, Ultra Seven, Ultraman Jack, and Ultraman Ace, as well as three later Ultramen (Tiga, Dyna, and Gaia) to fight more powerful versions of familiar Ultra Monsters.

The government, military, and police forces have been dismantled. When violence nearly ended the human race, a group was formed to change the direction of humanity. But whether humanity can survive rests on The Last MonoMyth.
A recovering opioid addict ex-model teams up with an Internet conspiracy theorist to save her sister from two sinister paranormal children with black eyes.
After an emotional exchange between a Lebanese Christian and a Palestinian refugee escalates, the men end up in a court case that gets national attention.

movie_name: The Boy Who Saw the Wind
synopsis: A boy has a powerful gift, a war hungery government comes to use him to create a weapon. He learns the origins of his power and units a people to over throw the evil government.

A young man, Diego, harbors a prurient interest in a visiting migrating cousin of his, while that cousin, Beto, seeks employment and to comprehend his strange new surroundings including a woman there.
An ex thief and his girlfriend are brutally killed by a group of his former associates. He is then resurrected as a female to exact revenge on their killers.
Expensive diamonds are stolen but before the thief can fence them he is strangled by ex-con Cueball, who then takes the gems and continues murdering people he believes are trying to swindle him.
During quarantine Film Maker Mark MacKaye decided to remake The Last Man on Earth within 30 days completely by himself.
Kumokiri Nizaemon, a former samurai warrior, has abandoned his class to become the leader of a gang of thieves. He leads his outlaws in an attempt to rob the castle of his former clan.
A group of young film students run into real-life zombies while filming a horror movie of their own.

Aiming for the top, law intern Rick tells his boss that he'll do anything--such as driving the boss' cute niece from Miami to Los Angeles and returning three days later well-prepared for the the bar exam.
A man sets out to fulfil his mother's last wish after serving his term in a juvenile detention center for a murder he did not commit.
A fantasy story centered on a magical film projector.

When four elementary school rockers transform into teenagers from an experimental fertilizer, they learn that growing up too fast is a lot harder than they expected and can take you on a path away from your friends and dreams.
A newly appointed Senior Inspector finds herself against very powerful goons and having people from her own department against her.

Iowa farmer Ray Kinsella is inspired by a voice he can't ignore to pursue a dream he can hardly believe. Supported by his wife, Ray begins the quest by turning his ordinary cornfield into a place where dreams can come true.
When a U.S. Intelligence Agent is unable to bring a ruthless drug baron to justice, he resorts to hiring a contract killer. But the man with whom he is put in contact turns out to be an old friend.

(1937, Republic) Alan Baxter, Andrea Leads, Owen Davis, Astrid Allwyn. Captivating story of two brothers, one good, one bad. The good one becomes a lawyer while the bad one resorts to crime and ultimately...

In the year 2044, a mutation of the plague brought annihilation to three-quarters of humanity. Those who remain have organized themselves in distant shelters, outside, gangs of looters control the territory.
The sad love story between singer Keti and student Nika.
A troubled Army veteran emerges from isolation when his younger brother is recruited by an extremist militia.
Two young women are engaged in various erotic experiences.
Teen Miles Morales becomes the Spider-Man of his universe, and must join with five spider-powered individuals from other dimensions to stop a threat for all realities.
In a magical undersea world where dragons rule and humans are feared, a naive young dragon forms an uneasy alliance with the sea's greatest enemy - a human girl.
Frigga, who tries to balance her risky job as a security manager in the Kiirunavaara mine with her family life

When Liu Feichun serves as the police commissioner of Xiangyang County, a woman in the city is killed and her heart is stolen. Liu hurried to the crime scene and encounters Long Chongjiu who disguises himself as a roving doctor.
An adventure story centered around four kids who learn that their local candy shop owner is a wicked magician in search of an ancient talisman rumored to be the source of eternal youth.
Naa Bangaaru Talli explores the consequences of sex trafficking, testing the vulnerability of trust in human relations.
Doraemon and friends look for a famous thief after he stole Doraemon's bell.
A man arrives in a small town, claiming to be there to hunt for monsters.
On the large beautiful estate Næsbygård resides the widower and landlord Martin Kaas.
After mistakenly helping Chang-qing, the sister of ruthless Mongol chieftain Liang escape capture by Song forces, Mu-bai sets out to make amends by assassinating the Mongol warlord single-handedly.
Told in a fractured time line, Icharus Broken is a brave look at the collision of love and the search for happiness streaming across intertwining lives.
The wife of a French diplomat in Bangkok, Emmanuelle embarks on a voyage of sexual discovery.

In a harrowing future where man has bred itself with technology to defy the laws of nature. A religious extremist gifted with immortality, threatens to crumble the pillars of society by incurring Rapture.
The small town of Paris, Australia deliberately causes car accidents, then sells/salvages all valuables from the wrecks as a means of economy.

A hyper-hipster 1980s horror comedy about a group of teenagers that discover a mysterious abandoned building where bad things happen. Shot in Wisconsin for $6000, Blood Junkie is a refreshing new vision in DIY independent film making.

movie_name: The Seven Deadly Sins: Cursed by Light
synopsis: Meliodas and his friends jump back into action when the new era of peace is threatened by a powerful magical alliance that could spell the end for all.
