movie_name: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
synopsis: Gandalf and Aragorn lead the World of Men against Sauron's army to draw his gaze from Frodo and Sam as they approach Mount Doom with the One Ring.
Three women past their prime become young again with help from a magic mirror in this fantasy comedy film.

A young pilot witnesses the unintentional murder of her two sons (by a rich, drunken couple driving carelessly) and, following a court's decision not to press criminal charges, she decides to get her revenge.
After a misunderstanding among their parents, two brothers turn against one another.
An excursion turns bloody when the students cannot longer find their way out of the forest, not even with the elephant tusks they've come for. They die mysteriously.
A desperate gambling addict. A ruthless team of con men. One point five million dollars. Let the game begin.

A single woman's best friend makes her call a man who had put his ad up in the newspaper. When they meet they both lie about their interests, later on finding out the truth about eachother the hard way.
The ghosts of his murder victims won't let him forget.
A nine-year-old girl gets a pig named Oink as a gift from her grandfather.
A group of friends are stranded in the woods, surrounded by aggressive killer fish.
Unstoppable. Relentless. Secondary sight. Inescapable vortex. Run.
A fairy tale of all Czech fairy tales about the proud princess Krasomila who refused to marry King Miroslav.

movie_name: The House at the End of Time
synopsis: A mother tries to solve the mystery of a haunted house. A remake of the 2013 Venezuelan film.
Randy, an antisocial drug dealer in college, faces an existential crisis when his abusive relationship with his boss pushes him over the edge.
In a mystical parallel world, a young Pardisian prince makes a tragic mistake, throwing the entire kingdom into chaos and risking their immortality.

The last bastion of Europe the Kingdom of Hungary is falling to the devastating Ottoman invasion. One last castle still standing strong just when both the invaders and the defenders have to face the common enemy.
Two friends and a chirpy teenager take a road trip from Bangalore to Kochi.
The story of a protective brother and his five sisters.
A hotshot reporter and a young doctor team up to investigate a series of grisly murders and a mysterious sample of synthetic blood.

Barbara adjusts to her new life behind bars, her crimes start to haunt her. Her new cellmate Evelyn is about to start an obsessive and ghostly friendship with her, one that Barbara cannot escape from.

Cheerful, festive and glowing Yolki will give you all the festive moments. With a smile we will watch the adventures of the heroes and together with them we will look forward to our New Year's miracle, which will soon come to our house.
A peaceful alien planet faces annihilation, as the homeless remainder of the human race sets its eyes on Terra. Mala, a rebellious Terrian teenager, will do everything she can to stop it.
A fear-obsessed freelance cameraman (Shinya Tsukamoto) investigates an urban legend involving mysterious spirits that haunt the subways of Tokyo.

England. Green and pleasant though it may be, it has a history of buildings dating back hundreds of years. It is one such house that beckons to be assessed for a new TV show presented by none other than Laurence Lovejoy.
At age 50 from the fall of a mysterious and unidentified object, there are many urban legends and myths about the Zone, the area of 10 square kilometers located in northern Italy.
Anna and Emilie are 14 and 15. They are sisters and orphans. Hardly have they been in their new home when a strange event turns their world upside down.
While local authorities seek answers in a string of gruesome murders, the boyfriend of a slain victim discovers the killer's secret is a creature from a different realm.

In the year 2080, in a world recovering from catastrophic nuclear war, an elite Spec-Ops team is sent on a rescue mission into a top-secret military research facility after a rogue employee takes a group of scientists hostage.

Fan movie based on Warhammer 40k universe. A holy Inquisitor is sent to a distant planet to inspect rumors of heresy. A band of mercenaries is hired to find the heretics' base in an abandoned industrial complex, but something awakens.

Awakening to her new life as a modern-day vampire, a young girl must learn how to survive and who to trust as she reconciles the mysteries of her past with her nightmarish visions of a future in which she is the predator.

Joan and Margie are best friends at their oppressive Catholic high school when Margie's thirst for vengeance begins to spin out of control - unraveling their sanity, morals, and friendship as they struggle for forgiveness and normality.
A fertility clinic visit becomes an unfathomable nightmare for a woman who's impregnated with the devil's DNA.
An orphan little girl befriends a benevolent giant who takes her to Giant Country, where they attempt to stop the man-eating giants that are invading the human world.
The story of a boy raised by gorillas.

Sammy Buford has a difficult time connecting with people on an emotional level. After several unsettling discoveries and events, he begins to feel what he has never felt before... what it truly means to be alive.
When private detective Marco Santis is called to look for a missing reporter, he finds out that his estranged step son is missing too.
Two men embarks upon a space race. Their efforts are hampered by aliens who clone the heroes to keep them from exploring further.
A cinematic menage-a-trois between a photographer, a rentboy and a transsexual call girl.
A journalist takes his son with him to investigate pirate activity off the coast of Florida. But he gets stranded on a mysterious island--where he might not be alone.
A human becomes an unlikely rising star in the biggest fighting tournament in the galaxy that's dominated by alien species.
A detective investigating a man's death in the mountains meets the dead man's mysterious wife in the course of his dogged sleuthing.
A secret rescue mission to a newly discovered planet gives the ultimate answers to the Universe.
Young driver Speed Racer aspires to be champion of the racing world with the help of his family and his high-tech Mach 5 automobile.
Following her father's death, a British teen-aged heiress goes to live with her guardian uncle who is broke, and he schemes to murder her for her vast inheritance.

movie_name: Te yi gong neng xing qiu ren
synopsis: In a battle over a magical egg, Sandra Ng and her evil uncle accidentally turn a monkey into a human.
The lethal Shih Szu as the title swordswoman, who is out to avenge her father's death at the mid-autumn festival.
A crazed sniper is set to kill spectators at an L.A. Coliseum football championship game and the police race against time to eliminate him.
The endearing efforts of a divorced, simple baker to capture the attentions of a bourgeois society woman.

As Travis decides to become fully committed to his new fiance Vanessa, he meets Destiny, who he can't help falling in love with. His confused heart if forced to make a decision between his two love interests.
A Chicago private detective returns back home to Louisville, Kentucky, to help her father fight mobsters.
A film director whose life crumbles after the suicide of his Hollywood starlet girlfriend becomes obsessed with a lifelike robot that appears to be her exact duplicate.

Brianna married a man she thought would protect her forever. But soon discovers Vincenzo has a dark secret and an evil family with connections controlling his narcissistic sociopathic traits and will go to any lengths to keep the secret controlled and hidden.

A Containment team, lead by the reckless Lt. Brantner, is tasked to find & terminate Lt. Drake Morris, a disgraced solider and mentor of Brantners who has gone rogue and in-hiding somewhere in the post-apocalyptic wasteland.
Based on Alexandre Dumas Fils novel.
A group of students form a dangerous cult.
With the promise of a multi-million dollar contract, local models are lured into a dilapidated shack disguised as a nightclub and forced to fight to the death before a pay-per-view audience.
An epidemic of yellow crawling brains threatens the lives of inhabitants in a recluse Northern Quebec town.
A dog looks to discover his purpose in life over the course of several lifetimes and owners.

movie_name: Leonardo da Vinci and the Soldiers of Forever
synopsis: An idea that re-imagines Leonardo da Vinci as a member of a secret society and places him in an action-adventure story involving lost civilizations and Biblical demons.

Two aliens steal a doomsday device from another world and abscond to earth. The device is Mr. Armageddon, a living embodiment of destruction who intends to destroy the planet. A ragtag group of high school students stand in his way.
A small-time wiseguy teams up with the most delinquent small-time criminals to payback the leader of the gang that betrayed him.
A family's home is haunted by a host of demonic ghosts.
Private eye Harry Wills investigates the theft of secret documents by a professional gang of thieves.
Space Marines are sent to investigate strange events at a research facility on Mars but find themselves at the mercy of genetically enhanced killing machines.
A gentle, sweet, funny, romantic story of love in later life following a couple in their sixties, Dave and Fern, who get to know one another over the course of 23 dog walks.

The events surrounding the unsolved police case in which guests of a mountain hut come face to face with terror, when the mysterious force that stalks them in the dark, violently knocks on the door of their consciousness.
Private investigator Philip Marlowe helps a friend out of a jam, but in doing so gets implicated in his wife's murder.
The story of how the planet's first interstellar ambassador tries to stop a full-on alien invasion.
During World War I, a German spy and a French spy meet and fall in love.
This film belongs to a psychological-horror genre. It revolves around a young researcher and take the audience through his mental and physical journeys.
Emil is a young boy that dreams about owning a dog and he starts working so he can save up to buy one. Meanwhile his family are dealing with money problems.
In future Tokyo, a young woman in the privatized police force tracks down her father's killer while battling against mutant rebels known as engineers.
Wretched is the riveting tale of one woman's perseverance through unbelievable horrors.

movie_name: The Garden of Sinners: Paradox Spiral
synopsis: A teenage demon hunter uses her mystical powers to investigate supernatural events.
A trained chimpanzee plays third base for a minor-league baseball team.
After a family's daughter is kidnapped by marauding raiders, their benevolent android sets out to get her back.
Dramatized biographical movie based on the life events of living legend singer Runa Laila, portrayed by herself.
Three young martial arts masters emerge from the back streets of Hong Kong to help the powerless fight injustice.

An scriptwriter heads off to Nantucket to find some inspiration for his latest, overdue, assignment. He becomes embroiled in small-town hi-jinks of murder, sex and violence, when he decides to pass off the local weirdo's script as his own.
Friends John, Kichu, Roopesh, Bava and Babumon decide to have a party on New Year's Eve. However, a series of events leads to a lot of unpleasantness and a rift between John and Kichu.
Enter a magical world of magical kingdoms, heroism and...dragons. From the Moonbeam family film library comes this charming fantasy clip collection designed to whisk you away to another world.

An 1800s Western spoof where the adults are off chasing the Indians and thus leaving the children behind and while their parents are away, the children take over the affairs of the town including its government.
Chuan Tai, master of the Shaolin School, hopes that if he can win the annual martial-arts tournament, he can help the villagers, who are under the tyranny of an evil security squad.
Rachel wakes up to discover she is trapped on an island and must survive while being hunted by the madman Zaroff, a Russian game hunter.
A disparate group of mystical misfits intertwine with an otherworldly, genderless apparition through fantastic and carnal dreamscapes.
Two escaped killers take hostages and hide in a Nevada mining ghost town knowing that an atom bomb is scheduled to be tested there the next morning.
A spoof on Lethal Weapon (1987), other movies, TV commercials etc. 2 unlike LA cops investigate a cocaine in girl scout cookies case.
The giant monster, Raki, must defeat Nemesis before he destroys the world.
Steven thinks his time defending the Earth is over, but when a new threat comes to Beach City, Steven faces his biggest challenge yet.
From International Fantasy Artist Dorian Cleavenger comes 4 stories of the bizarre and macabre in this unique journey of altered realities.
A successful woman in love tries to break her family curse of every first marriage ending in divorce, by dashing to the alter with a random stranger before marrying her boyfriend.
Mount Hopeless is a comedy about isolation, creature comforts, and escaping this rut we call Life.

movie_name: In the Neck of the Woods
synopsis: A College road trip couldn't get any better when seven close friends decide to go camping in the woods. They encounter a spirit whom at first appears innocent. What was supposed to be a low key vacation might become their worst nightmare.

Nicole tries to escape her past by moving to a secluded farm with a mysterious couple she recently met. They promise her a better life and a new way of looking at the world through their dangerous and unorthodox occult beliefs.
Shankar and Chanchal earn their living by doing road shows. Once, Shankar sees Natasha on a circus poster and dreams of working with her. He gets an offer to work in the circus in Russia

movie_name: Shin Chan: The Adult Empire Strikes Back
synopsis: When a new threat regresses the minds of the adults of Kasukabe back into children, its up to Shinnosuke and his friends to reclaim their parents from becoming trapped in the nostalgia of the 20th Century.

The incredible story of amateur sailor Donald Crowhurst and his solo attempt to circumnavigate the globe. The struggles he confronted on the journey while his family awaited his return is one of the most enduring mysteries of recent times.
A post mortem photographer and a little girl confront ghosts in a haunted village after the First World War.
Dr. Diane Landry (Cassandra Schomer) creates an alien-human hybrid to fight off a malicious group of invaders from space.
A sadistic taxidermist, inspired by The Divine Comedy, uses the body parts of his victims to create an Angel.
Feature Sequel to Promise of Retribution. Plot Summary in development
How the pursuit of an Indian cricket legend's Ferrari makes a young boy's dreams of playing cricket at Lords a reality.

Javier has episodes where he goes into a trance and a prosecutor investigates crimes that seem to be related to him. Searching for answers with a doctor, he discovers unexplained history in his life and a past that haunts him.
It is said that every investigator has a crime that haunts them, a case that hurts him more than the others, without him necessarily knowing why. For Yohan that case is the murder of Clara.

Five college students along along with a cab driver (Who is Husband of one of a student) finds themselves in the surrounding of three newly made and amateur ghosts who desperately wants to come back to life.
Fellow tenants in a high rise are extremely irked by Anton's trumpet playing until they learned it has magical powers beneficial to them.

While Miss Marple is on vacation in a luxurious Caribbean resort, a fellow guest confides he has evidence that another resident of the hotel is an unscrupulous serial murderer but is poisoned before he can reveal his identity to her.
Husband and wife con artist infiltrate an organized crime syndicate.

The USS Essex is travelling in the furthest reaches of the known Universe when it encounters a gigantic creature. After pirates steal their cargo and most of their supplies the crew decide to capture the creature.
In a future world devastated by disease, a convict is sent back in time to gather information about the man-made virus that wiped out most of the human population on the planet.
Ghonsyam,a troubled fisherman meets a twistic tale which surrounds agony and love
A travelling writer with a secret, arrives to "Suburbia" to spend Halloween with a strange individual, known as the "Hollowman".
After secretly installing hidden cameras in their users' cable boxes, a group of cable company employees finds their voyeuristic scheme ruined when they inadvertently film a violent murder.
Two close friends spend their lives stealing. The mafia unites against them.
Trapped in a time loop that constantly repeats the day of his murder, a former special forces agent must unlock the mystery behind his untimely demise.
Thanks to her ability and her legs, Claire McIntyre rises in the business world.

movie_name: Down to the Sea in Ships
synopsis: Story of the lives of the people in a small Quaker community and the adventures of a whaling ship.
Two sisters running a small hotel in Spain kill female tourists whose morals do not meet their strict religious standards.
A beautiful, blonde American girl arrives in London ostensibly to join a band, but discovers that the band have disappeared leaving her stranded and alone in a strange city.
A career pickpocket artist makes the deadly mistake of lifting the wallet of the wrong man...a serial killer.
A female serial killer escapes from prison to go after the one victim that got away.

movie_name: The Night Is Short, Walk on Girl
synopsis: In this comedy about one epic night in Kyoto, a college sophomore goes on a series of surreal encounters with the local nightlife, all the while unaware of the romantic longings of her classmate Senpai.

The disembodied head of Pancho Villa, kept in a glass jar in a research institute, is the narrator of several short stories from his own life, stories that might or might not have happened but are the stuff of legend.
There are two roads: the wide one leads to perdition, the narrow one is not easy to follow, but it leads to happiness.
A detective and a psychoanalyst uncover evidence of a satanic cult while investigating a young woman's terrifying past.
Two friends and business partners find their lives turned upside down when strange circumstances lead them to be the temporary guardians of seven year-old twins.
A knight in a suit of golden armor battles with a magical beast out to destroy the world.
The super agents Tiburón, Mojarrita and Delfín must protect a large diamond.
A group of ambitious YouTubers arrive at an isolated English farm to uncover the story of the infamous Legend of the Pigman. Can they debunk the myth - or will they unleash the beast once more?
Drizzle/Zeng Jing tries to start a new life after she had betrayed her gang and hid the remains of monk.

A content creator kid from Hong Kong is left to his grandfather in Boyolali, Central Java, while his parents prepare to move to Jakarta. He then met new friends and they plan to make a film inspired by the legendary lightning catcher.

movie_name: Department Q: The Keeper of Lost Causes
synopsis: Police inspector Carl Mørck is put in charge of a department of cold cases, joined only by his assistant Assad. They dig into a case about a missing woman.
Six people are lured into a small Deep South town for a Centennial celebration where the residents proceed to kill them one by one as revenge for the town's destruction during the Civil War.

Following the unexpected death of her father, a deaf teenager moves in with her godparents, where she discovers the cruel behaviour of their daughter may be indicative of a dark secret within the family.
In 1897, residents of a small Texas town are visited by a benevolent extraterrestrial being whose presence divides the community.

movie_name: Home with a View of the Monster
synopsis: Dennis and Rita arrive home to a series of mysterious events.
A secret American spy mission tries to overthrow Castro's Communist regime in Cuba during the early days of the Kennedy administration.
A woman disappears during a Mediterranean boating trip. During the search, her lover and her best friend become attracted to each other.
During a stakeout, an L.A. cop kills a doctor who presumably pulled a gun but the coroner's inquest finds no gun, forcing the cop to look for it to clear his name.

A filmed production of the musical 'Miss Saigon' for its 25th anniversary, performed live at London's Prince Edward Theatre, in London's West End. Including the 2hr 20minute production and a bonus 35-minute "25th Anniversary Gala" which included stars of the original cast, Jonathan Pryce, Lea Salonga and Simon Bowman.
A serial killer preys on the exceptionally gifted in order to inherit their talents and become Nietzsche's modern-day Uberman.
Since Nick's arrival, Weston has been plagued by fear and murder. The unprepared police force has proven to be an asset to Nick, and the small town has become a safe haven for his dark deeds.
The movie features the lives of six different persons from different strata of the social life of the city, interconnected due to unexpected events beyond their control.
Andrés returns to Santiago after several years to face a tragic event.
A drug empire crumbles from within.
A small desert town is terrorized by a powerful, seemingly possessed car, and the local sheriff may be the only one who can stop it.

After being left at home when her mother goes on a business trip, a young girl witnesses a woman being kidnapped. With the help of a veteran New York detective, she undauntedly attempts to solve the kidnapping - no matter what it takes.

Dante goes on a journey through the first and worst part of the afterlife, Hell. Virgil guides and protects Dante on his dark journey descending circle-by-circle to the center of the Earth, and out into Purgatory (sequel).

Still haunted by his past, Tommy Jarvis, who, as a child, killed Jason Voorhees, is sent to a secluded halfway house in the countryside, where the killing of a young man triggers a brutal series of murders in the area.
The story of a young couple Shokoofeh and Peiman who has committed a rubbery. They go to Bandar Anzali in north to meet a guy unaware that their greed is not without a risk.

movie_name: 3 Bahadur: The Revenge of Baba Balaam
synopsis: 3 children now have a task of defeating babe balm who is rising again.

James "Sandman Slim" Stark, a fast talking, hard-boiled, supernatural vigilante, escapes from Hell to avenge his girlfriend's murder and hunt down the magicians responsible for getting him sent "downtown."

The murder of a crewman while ashore in Hong Kong leads his friend and shipmate to partner with a local to find the killer. The murkier back alleys are explored and periodic fights break out as someone wants their investigation to end.

Palmira looks after her drunkard father and survives by running errands for her neighbours. Her dream is to have a bicycle and one day she takes one that has been abandoned by its owner, starting trouble.

When a solar flare hits the International Space Station on a collision course with Earth, it is up to Astronomer and former NASA Astronaut Jess Denver and Air Force Colonel Sam Adler to team up and save humanity.
The ancient gods have fallen to earth and after a long exile discover there may be a way home.

The Snow Queen created the world of eternal winter where the polar wind cools human souls and clearness of lines obscure emotions. A girl named Gerda, her pet ferret Luta, and Orm the troll must save her brother Kai and the world.
A hospital nurse is recruited by the police to watch a household where a suspicious death has occurred.
Abandoned by their husband/father, a traumatized woman and her disturbed stepdaughter hire a drifter handyman at their secluded estate while a series of murders begins.
British children help a young refugee boy by hiding him from the authorities.
A woman plots revenge on her former boss.
A goat and tiger game between a man and women.
IN3DRAGON (The Unseen Fist) offers non-stop martial arts action, love, romance, thriller and comedy. This is the best action movie from the award winning superstar JJ Stomp.

A woman wakes up locked in a small room with no memory of how she arrived there. Unable to escape, and tormented by a series of paranormal entities, she must uncover the riddle of who she is and how she got here.

movie_name: Back to the Future Part III
synopsis: Stranded in 1955, Marty McFly learns about the death of Doc Brown in 1885 and must travel back in time to save him. With no fuel readily available for the DeLorean, the two must figure how to escape the Old West before Emmett is murdered.
A motley crew of university students set out on a journey in pursuit of a mythical form of hash, confronting a series of encounters that begin to unravel the myriad realities of rebellion.
The cat Findus decides he wants to write a letter to the King, because Pettson says that kittens don't wash or pay rent. While Findus waits for a response, he and the old man decide to go on a trip.
Vishwas Rao is raised by his mother who wants him to become a police officer while he wants to become an actor.

A husband cheats on his disabled wife--who has been paralyzed in a car accident--with her sister. When the sister is murdered he is accused of the crime, but it turns out that he may not be the killer after all.
When a family emergency forces a troubled teen to do the wrong thing for the right reason, a community discovers the meaning of forgiveness.

Young advertising executive Mack Maddox (C. Thomas Howell) is on a career fast-track. Happily married with a young daughter, Mack seems to have it all... until a bizarre series of events make him the target for murder.

Serge Perrin lives in Paris, without housing, without work. But Serge wants to exist and break his loneliness. When he pushes the door of a police station his great adventure begins. He finally finds a first role.

movie_name: A Night of Horror: Nightmare Radio
synopsis: Rod, radio DJ, hosts a popular horror-themed show packed with tales of terror for eager listeners. When he receives alarming calls from a horrified child things start to feel off.

Ever since her brother died, Lupe has lived an agoraphobic life at odds with her teenage son and her superstitious Mexican mother. It takes a drastic Day of the Dead ritual to wake her up and teach her the value of saying goodbye.

Philip Sanderson awakens to find himself in a hospital. He soon finds himself in the middle of a bloody war between monsters that look like everyday people and the small band of resistance fighters who know their true identity.

The Holy Maiden of Hell, Ashura possesses immense power that can destroy humanity. Buddhist monks trap her in a deep cave to keep her from falling into evil hands. Kindhearted Abbot Jiku grants her wish to enjoy the human world for 7 days.

The Dream Journal, animated with hobbyist 3D software, weaves together deep-web imagery with hardboiled detective story tropes and repressed libidinal fantasies to create a nightmarish vision of an internet addict's unconscious.
As a Washington, D.C. psychiatrist unearths the origin of an alien epidemic, she also discovers her son might be the only way it can be stopped.

The title refers to the government's plan at the time for putting an end to a lucrative racket, kidnapping. When Hudson and Norris enter a country house to get out of the rain it turns out to be a kidnapper hideout.
A widowed U.S. President running for reelection and an environmental lobbyist fall in love. It's all above-board, but "politics is perception," and sparks fly anyway.

The pressures of fame have superstar singer Noni on the edge, until she meets Kaz, a young cop who works to help her find the courage to develop her own voice and break free to become the artist she was meant to be.
A writer buys a typewriter which brings out his deepest and darkest desires.
A family is cursed Morgann who keeps coming back to take their souls in return to spare a life
A man awakes in a virtual correctional system, where he is forced to make amends for his sins.

Michel Racine is a feared president of Assize Court, as strict with himself as with others. Everything changes when he meets again Ditte when she's selected as a juror in a criminal trial over which he presides.
A spoiled brat who falls overboard from a steamship in the 1920s gets picked up by a New England fishing boat, where he's made to earn his keep by joining the crew in their work.

A sex bot named Malice is attacked by a creature with tentacles. After it has its way with the bot it destroys it, but Malice comes back to life with the ability to spread life to other bots like a disease.
A kind of Italian Robin Hood leads a fight against a tyrant and his henchmen.
In the 25th century, a time when people have designations instead of names, a man, THX 1138, and a woman, LUH 3417, rebel against their rigidly-controlled society.
A federal agent investigates when inconsistencies turn up in the photographic evidence of several murders recorded by mobile robotic cameras.
After getting rejected on his wedding day, Shiva moves to Chennai, where he falls in love with Sandhya. However, she does not love him and gets engaged to Pratap.
A man who is trapped in a cave with a cursed copy of the game of life plays the game in the cave as the evil events of the game unfold on an unsuspecting family of Mormons.

The accidental discovery of a big fortune hidden in the apartment of a deceased man will fill the heart of a real estate agent with greed and dreams of a luxurious life, but the neighbours think otherwise.
Christine Levitt goes to extreme lengths to become famous, to the dismay of her friend...Billie Cooper.
There's nothing quite so romantic as spending one's youth in a foreign land.
The son of a charcoal burner was once prophesied as a child to marry the daughter of a king. The king tries to prevent this by all means.
A study of the political and religious fanaticism in Malta in the 60s.
A struggling street musician finds himself the target of an animal welfare investigation that threatens to take away his beloved cat at Christmas.
A business woman reluctantly joins forces with her inventor ex-husband, who has built the world's first commercial flying car.
A story of 4 techies, a social media addict, and a CBI officer, whose lives are blessed with happy-go-lucky moments until they are heavily struck with a terrorizing incident.
Guy marries a vampire and accepts her after learning how she got that way.
In an unknown future, the earth has been destroyed by man and the air is polluted with a mysterious virus that turns humans into zombies.

A girls weekend in a remote cottage in the Ardennes. Relationships are put into focus - do the four girls know everything about each other? The filming of the 'best youth book' of 2012 written by Mel Wallis de Vries.
A special-ops soldier hunts down and kills the terrorists who slaughtered his family.
With his cop companion shot and killed by terrorists, Reno The Dog pairs up with tough cop Jake in thwarting the criminal organization.
Crew get stranded on a large, abandoned space ship while solving the mystery of what happened to the ship.
Extra-terrestrials launch a nation-wide assault on Australia, much to the bafflement of the rest of the world.
Two friends join together to strike oil during the Oklahoma oil boom of the 1920s, and wind up fighting over the same oil wells and the same girl.
Dorcha tells a curious talk about Death, Demon and Deception channelled through Changelings, Witch craft and everything in between..
The Pittsburgh Pirates' brash and abusive manager receives the help of an angel to win games and become a better person in the process.
A poor southern family must deal with a wily stripper and a psychopath attempting to manifest the Antichrist into their bathroom.
It all started one fateful night when a young Ernesto, had an encounter with Jesus Christ, himself. Now eighteen years later can Ernesto's faith help Ben (his brother-in-law) before it's too late.
A con artist takes on Manhattan's billionaires.
This is a true to life story of Leonardo Manecio, alias Nardong Putik, who ended career on October 10,1971, was he a robinhood or a fugitive of the law.
Öztürk family planning a pleasant weekend break go to countryside. They will soon find themselves in a chaotic dilemma that pushes the limits of reason.
When a logger discovers a brutally mutilated body in the forest, he goes into a catatonic state and gets the unexpected help of Death herself.
Zel, a lonely young man's life changes when his enigmatic neighbour offers to help him overcome social anxiety.
High-school students Wanda and Sully must work together to investigate SRC president Jonathan's affairs and bring him down after discovering he's potentially involved with an embezzlement scheme.

Life has been handing Greg some tough ones lately. He's lost his job, his girlfriend is pregnant and the bills are piling up. Then he receives an offer that seems too good to refuse, but it's a rabbit-hole he's about to tumble down.
A failed novelist struggles to reconnect with his son, win back the love of his life, and avert the apocalypse.

Miriam, Derek, Ian, and Jenny are overachieving high school students doing everything by the book. Straight A's, sports, yearbook, band, and - when coursework allows - planning and executing elaborate murders.
A South African creature horror centring around attacks by the fabled Tokoloshe.

Two Eleven is a movie about a group of friends down on their luck, who re-unite to plan their 10 year high school reunion. Once they put aside their basic differences, they conjure up an outrageous scheme to get away from their problems.
Kingship knows no Kinship and there can be only one Emperor in Aurangzeb's world. In Gurgaon, to bring down a criminal the law has to think like one.

In every generation, a torch passes from father to son. And that timeless dynamic is the beating heart of Tommy's Honour - an intimate, powerfully moving tale of the real-life founders of the modern game of golf.

A girl is sent to live with her uncle on his estate when her parents die. There she discovers much intrigue, family history and secrets and personal baggage. In particular, a screaming child and...a secret garden.
A teenager with teleportation abilities suddenly finds himself in the middle of an ancient war between those like him and their sworn annihilators.
A man goes in search for redemption and closure somewhere near the north cape.

Jenn (straight) and Matt (gay) are best friends from college who are now in their thirties. Single by choice, they decide to fulfill a youthful promise to have a child together--the old-fashioned way.

An Italian girl, with the ability to see into the past when touching objects, and an American teacher travel from Italy to Spain to uncover secrets from Francoist Spain linked to the real events of the "lost children of Francoism".

movie_name: Not the Most Careful of Girls
synopsis: This movie is about a Seattle prostitute whose life is redeemed.
The "origin" movie of the title Ultraman, who befriends a little boy named Musashi and fights an updated version of a classic Ultra-foe, Baltan-Seijin.
The adaptation of Hans Cristian Andersen's tale filmed on a white background. It is also the first Croatian movie in color.
A horror film about a man who travels into the heart of a post epidemic city to get help when his girlfriend gets infected.
A detective is trying to find the cause of a string of suicides.
A Yugoslavian spoof of Dirty Harry and James Bond movies. A young inspector called Crazy Head goes after bandits that do not hesitate to use all kinds of vicious means in their shady ventures.
Two veteran New York City detectives work on a case of serial executions of criminals who escaped justice.
The monstrous offspring of a violent crime grows up in seclusion on a remote island, where a boat-full of hapless teens have shipwrecked, unaware of what's lurking in the woods.
The life of Apostle Paul from the New Testament. This extremely rare and hard to find film chronicles Saul of Taurus as he becomes born again as Paul the Apostle.

A FINALIST in The Monthly Film Festival 2021. On the verge of losing her family business, an audacious antiques dealer agrees to break-up an engagement for a wealthy socialite. Everything changes when she meets her match.
A luggage mix-up at the airport brings together the lives of two friends preparing for a badminton tournament with a woman on the run from a gang who killed her sister.
A home invasion on Halloween night turns deadlier for the intruders as hidden secrets and dark truths are revealed about the house's occupant.
Race car driver Walkaway Madden signs up for the big Manilla 1000 off-road race through the Philippines jungle. The photojournalist C.C. Wainwright comes along for the ride.
Every day at 6 pm a serial killer kills a different person. Police officer Helena Rus decides to find the killer by researching about 18th century history of the city.
After waking from a coma, a woman begins to question her reality.
A man goes on a shamanic journey to Canada after making an impulsive decision.
A look at how a painter and a successful actor spend their last day together before the world comes to an end.
A group of students and their chaperone are used as a cover for a heist on the high seas. Together, they thwart the thieves and save their school from closing for good.

movie_name: I Wish I Knew What Christmas Was
synopsis: A young couple struggle with the mental health issues of their daughter who runs away from home. A very special friend arrives who helps to bring her back.

Scooby and the gang face their most challenging mystery ever: a plot to unleash the ghost dog Cerberus upon the world. As they race to stop this dogpocalypse, the gang discovers that Scooby has an epic destiny greater than anyone imagined.
Two brothers one of them is police and other is ganster finds each other years after and one of them doesn't know that they are brothers.
A dark fantasy epic that follows a young woman whose determination to survive will ignite a revolution. Her rare gift may be the key to ending two centuries of conflict and deceit.
King's Gambit is an Independent, live-action feature film set in present-day Florida about Bryce, a man who uses a mystic journal to alter the world around him.

As a wave of murders remains unsolved, the FBI enlists the help of Hanson, who finds himself embroiled in a desperate and dangerous fight between the authorities, a vigilante, and the Reserve he calls home.
A grim retelling of the television series "The Vision of Escaflowne".
A veteran cop and a thief team up to take down a kidnapper who murdered his prisoner thirty years ago.
Shunned by everyone for being the son of an evil warlord, a teenager seeks to defeat him with the help of his fellow ninjas.
"I will not love it anymore. It is all my fault." A dramatic love story between a blind man and woman.

movie_name: Bound for the Fields, the Mountains, and the Seacoast
synopsis: Summer 1937 Japan begins a war with China. Militaristic moods are growing in the country. A group of Japanese schoolchildren do not understand the militaristic hysteria of adults.
After falling head over hooves in love with Giselle, Elliot's road to the altar takes a slight detour when Mr. Weenie is kidnapped by a group of pampered pets determined to return him to his owners.
After a plan to rob an old man goes awry, Logan tries to help Mary Spencer clean up the mess. But is Mary's home life as normal as it appears to be?
New oriental adventures of three friends. They free a woman from a harem, fight against oil tycoons and look for a better future.

movie_name: Treasure Island Kids: The Monster of Treasure Island
synopsis: In The Monster of Treasure Island, the kids and adults on Treasure Island battle to save themselves from a terrifying monster and in doing so learn to accept newcomers as friends.
When a young waitress gets bullied by her boss. She finds a way to put a spell on him to get her revenge.

David is a very successful business man and a great provider but his wife leaves him. On his way home one day he finds a homeless woman beat up in a alley. His life changes the moment he stops his car to help this woman

Biopic of Constantine the Great, set between 293-312 AD, from his days as Tribune to his accession as Roman Emperor of Gaul under the tetrarchy system and ending with his battle against the usurper Roman Emperor Maxentius in Rome.
When a legion of demons are unleashed in a hospital, a veteran nurse who suffers from PTSD, must fight her way through 9 floors of hell before the demons claim her very soul.
An iconic Australian story of family, friendship and adventure, between a young boy and a scrappy one-of-a-kind dog that would grow up to become an Australian legend.

A group of bad boys are terrorizing the campus scene with several students found raped and murdered. Brenda (Amalia) survives and her boyfriend (Jess), a policeman, does his best to find the criminals.

movie_name: Associés contre le crime: L'oeuf d'Ambroise
synopsis: The Beresfords are tasked with finding what happened to a Russian heiress who's mysteriously disappeared.

movie_name: Far til fire og onkel Sofus
synopsis: Uncle Anders has a twin brother who lives in the US. His name is Sofus and on his 70th birthday he decides to go back to Denmark and celebrate with his family. Unfortunately Uncle Anders and Sofus don't get along well.

movie_name: Karen: the B-Horror Movie Drinking Game
synopsis: A group of swingers meet for their annual camping trip, but this time they are stalked by a serial killer.

movie_name: The Policeman from the Cock's Hill
synopsis: The adventures of a skillful Belgrade policeman who proves to be equally successful as a caring father.

A croupier is murdered in a Mexico City gambling casino and the Lone Wolf is suspected. Sharon Montgomery, wife of diamond merchant Charles Montgomery, becomes involved in a jewel heist, in which again the Lone Wolf is a suspect.

Sameer and Nargis, after overcoming all odds, find a ray of sunshine when little Nandini enters their lives and their family is complete; But their happiness is short-lived. In a bizarre twist of fate, Nandini goes missing.
A massive influx of glacial melting triggers a new ice age in the Northern Hemisphere, forcing a family to make their way across the ice-covered landscape before they are frozen out for good.
Through mysterious eyewear, a blind woman can see ghosts. Glimpsing Death itself, she must discover why it has come for her.
A neurologist visits an incarcerated serial killer living in exile to study his brain and discovers the horror that lurks behind his violent impulses.
A tomboy and college jock have been best buds since daycare. Their friendship gets tested with a series of events and proves that even the strongest relationships break.
A man condemned to death and on the run has a last intense sexual relationship with a porn actress.

movie_name: We Put the World to Sleep
synopsis: Adrian and Duru get lost in the characters they play in an apocalyptic film and embark on a secret mission to end the world for real. Second entry in Adrian Tofei's trilogy which includes Be My Cat: A Film for Anne (2015) and Pure.
An actor and a chef fathom a plot to fix a horse race and attempt at capitalizing it, while striving to tackle two of the hitmen responsible for the scheme.
The New Life company provides unique new experience of virtual adventures, but the players suddenly face their revived fears.
Meet Kenneth. He thinks he's got the moves. He thinks he's got the swagger. He thinks he can spit bars. But in reality, he's a WASTEMAN!

Virginia will do the impossible in order to rescue her little daughter who has been abducted. After an accident, she has the chance to live one day more to save her. On her path, she will find out that there are worst things than death.
After an experimental bio-weapon is released, turning thousands into zombie-like creatures, it's up to a rag-tag group of survivors to stop the infected and those behind its release.

In a future where the polar ice-caps have melted and Earth is almost entirely submerged, a mutated mariner fights starvation and outlaw "smokers," and reluctantly helps a woman and a young girl try to find dry land.
In this low-key thriller, a community of Oregon winegrowers in need of revenue grow marijuana in order to finance their vineyards.
Tulyev is arrested, but this does not prevent him from playing a dangerous game with the enemy. The second part of the Soviet spy saga.
Two stranger's minds are connected by a bizarre and fatal "telepathy". They have to run through different layers of freakish plots to survive.
A young actress rehearsing for a play about human trafficking begins to relive terrifying scenes that may be dreams -- or an alternate reality.
A merc team called "The Librarians" is hired to find the missing granddaughter of one of their closest friends, and they'll have to go against a ruthless Miami mobster to get her.

Four teenage boys find themselves incarcerated in an institution for juvenile delinquents that functions as a prison in every respect. Their stories, with tragic endings for three of the four, are interwoven in the film.
Nerdy comic book aficionado Roberto Rodriguez battles low self-esteem, loser friends and vicious high school bullies as he vies for the heart of Cristina, the hot new girl from Madrid.
A best man (Wilson) stays on as a houseguest with the newlyweds, much to the couple's annoyance.
Upon returning from his trip, Grilo (Antônio Estevão), a powerful mobster who commands the crime in his region and discovers that he is bankrupt due to a coup by his rival Macarino (Telmo Souza).
A guardian angel has 24 hours to convince a soul that life on Earth is worth the effort.

A delusional Artist kills people, mangles their faces into "artwork", puts his artwork on t-shirts and sells them at underground concerts. Authorities hunt for a serial killer as our Artist seeks new faces to make famous.

A widower haunted by the distressed ghost of his recently deceased wife is visited in his dreams by a psychopomp who teaches him about the spirit world and soul guiding through stories of death and the supernatural.
An ancient legend becomes reality when a discovery drives Auri into the middle of a struggle between powers that decide the fate of worlds.
Friends on a weekend excursion take a path into a forest that leads to death and destruction.
A young girl, Noa, suspects her new nanny isn't from this world. Noa fights to reveal the nanny's identity, which is more twisted than she imagined in this dark fantasy tale.
In a post-apocalyptic society, a budding revolutionary must survive one final task to complete his training.
A struggling quantum physicist develops a time travel technique that results in his being hunted by a cutthroat pair of repo agents.
A former police officer tries to prevent his daughter from getting married to a man who is a murder suspect.
A man and his wife are vacationing on the Tuscan coast in 1912. When the wife is murdered, the husband sets out to find a young woman who looks just like her, in order to keep her memory alive.
A down on his luck former drug dealer is forced by a corrupt LAPD policeman to sell 100 kilos of confiscated marijuana in one weekend.
Hugo Vartán has run out of ideas for his new book. One day he finds out his roommate's boyfriend witnessed a murder, and he sets out to investigate what happened to use the story for his novel.

A spiritualist medium holds a seance for a writer suffering from writer's block but accidentally summons the spirit of his deceased first wife, which leads to an increasingly complex love triangle with his current wife of five years.

Four female freestyle, sensual dancers win the PowerBall lotto. They and Leo, the 7-year-old "brother" of the youngest dancer, go on a journey to celebrate. Along the way, shocking secrets unfold that threaten to destroy all.
Dice is out of jail, having just lost his older brother. Based on a true story from the streets of Compton, California.
Suspense Thriller and revenge Story
Two young women accidentally bring back the Sanderson Sisters to modern day Salem and must figure out how to stop the child-hungry witches from wreaking havoc on the world.

Unaware of the local Hooded Strangler lurking around her door, poor Helen Doe decides to visit her aunt but, instead, winds up at the "House of Horror on the hill." There, she and six other Tortured Females are held by white slavers.
A model poses nude for men's magazines and acts in slasher movies. Her psycho bodybuilder boyfriend gets jealous and starts killing other men.

Terrorists kidnap the Russian Prime Minister's 2 kids, take Chernobyl nuclear power plant and threaten to blow up a reactor. 4 Universal Soldiers go in but are no match to a Next Gen. UniSol Luc (Jean-Claude Van Damme) goes in but faces 2 NGUs.
The owners of a luxurious Tuscan villa welcome crowds of betrothed couples and their guests attending beautiful and sometimes bewildering weddings.
The origin and rise of the most famous Dominican wrestler of all time, Rafael Sánchez aka Jack Veneno, and his arch-nemesis, José Manuel Guzmán aka Relámpago Hernández.
A group of high school outcasts band together to stop a vicious werewolf terrorizing their town and local drive-in theater. A Horror-Comedy in the vein of The Monster Squad, for a new generation.

A Cinderella story: in snow-heavy forests the heroine battles against her evil stepmother for her dream of meeting the handsome prince. This is a breathtaking ride featuring brilliant archery and a gorgeous palace ball.
In a dark and cold Helsinki, an unlucky taxi driver Veli-Matti struggles to maintain relationships with his children and estranged wife. Sometimes, losing everything is just a beginning.
Badly needing money for the treatment of his ill mother, pathologist Tibor Malkáv accepts the proposition of a stranger to murder someone he doesn't know a thing about.

This thriller follows two sets of couples, Franklin and Bella Sloane and Rod and Carol Everett, as they end up trapped in the Sloane house during a snow storm. Soon they begin to be picked off by a mysterious killer.
Two troubled girls, who come together as friends through their imagination of art, creating their own fantasy world where they can finally be free.

Force of the Trojans will embody the spirit of the original Harryhausen films with all the fun, vibrant action, epic scope and dedication to craftsmanship that has made Ray Harryhausen's films timeless.

movie_name: Pillywiggin and the Lost Shadow Boys
synopsis: In the battle for control of the realm, evil won. All the boys were captured and erased from memory. But they live.
A nerdy vet gets help from a genie to catch the attention of the woman he loves.

movie_name: Deep Astronomy and the Romantic Sciences
synopsis: Grace is a robot incognito whose primary function is to represent humanity based on a generalization created from all social media and wireless communications. Rudy is her final test.

A naive, idealistic prince from the Green-Gray Forest kingdom...a stubborn, exiled princess of the Glass Mountain...a lazy but inventive commoner...join forces against a wily, power-hungry king of the Lowland Coastal Meadows.
When a prominent banker is murdered while on a hunting trip, the dead man's daughter, Gwen Kingery (Anne Nagel), calls in private eye Lance O'Leary (Dick Purcell) to investigate.

A former Marine who lives life on the edge as a rookie firefighter falls for a divorced woman he rescues, but struggles to rescue himself in a mysterious and revealing journey towards self-forgiveness.

When the Universe decides what it wants, it's pointless to resist. With his family's life at stake, Joseph Steadman finds himself the unwilling test subject of a maniacal scientist in a battle that could save the world, or destroy it.
Unpredictable black-comedy road-trip thriller.
This is a new development of Alterego focused in fiction stories loosely based on politics, economy and news in LATAM and US.
Baby, it's cold outside. So come inside where it's full of hallucinatory time-travelling Gold Rush cannibals instead.
Follows the life of a youngster from college to his marriage.
The world is not the world.

movie_name: On a Clear Day You Can See Forever
synopsis: A troubled young woman who visits a psychotherapist to help her quit smoking undergoes hypnosis and finds herself reliving a tragic Victorian romance from a past life.

Boundaries between good and evil have been blurred, two young lovers try to get out of a nameless city ruled by Evil. Just as their plan seems to be coming together, a mysterious stranger puts them on a dangerous course.
A reinterpretation of the Camelot legend, where a guy named Kavin Matchstick meets the wizard Mirth and inherits a baseball bat with magical powers.
A woman in a hypnotic state recounts to two doctors the details of a horrific experience from her past life that began with the mysterious and sudden disappearance of her husband.

movie_name: Journey to the Far Side of the Sun
synopsis: The European Space Exploration Council sends two astronauts to explore a planet similar to the Earth but located on the opposite side of the sun.
Berlin-Neukoelln. The ghetto... supposedly. A young boy's inadvertent decline into the drug business. From math-nerd to drug-dealer. More description than drama.
A recently-returned Vietnam POW loses his family and his right hand during a violent home invasion, and seeks retribution against those responsible.
In the wake of 5 other High Schoolers disappearing from their hometown, Harris, Will and Norman must work together to find their friend and bring him back home.

The Ukrainian batiar (Lviv's subculture) from Lviv falls in love with the daughter of a Polish noble. To save her he joins the Polish uprising against Austria in Lviv in 1848. In the result he becomes a hero of the revolution.

In a post-apocalyptic world where half the population is dead or missing and the sky is full of autonomous drones, a 16-year-old boy named Kitch sets out to find his father, joined by DR1, his drone companion.
A POOR MAN CHAMPIONS THE CAUSE OF LAND REFORM FOR THE PEOPLE OF ISLA PIUING BATO IN TONDO, MANILA.
A restauranteur teams up with a police officer and his ex-con brother to avenge the death of a friend's daughter.
Boy tries to rescue the Ginseng King from an evil 3 headed king to save his mother, who has been bitten by a Nazi zombie.

After his brother got eliminated in Hard Ticket to Hawaii (1987), a crime lord triggers a ruthless hunt against all agents responsible, and the remaining agents will have to avenge their fallen comrades.
Will time and space be on her side?
A father and son on a weekend hunting trip encounter supernatural horror in the woods.
To protect herself from a stalker, a popular singer hires a bodyguard but then falls in love with him.
A diplomat's wife takes the blame when a spy kills her husband, thinking her lover did it.

movie_name: Exercises in Solitude: An Audio/Visual Opera in 3 Movements
synopsis: A character study about creative yearning and how elusive an artistic outlet becomes when dealing with isolation and the onset of mental illness.
When the head of a powerful criminal organization is released from prison, he must take steps to squash the small gangs that sprang up during his absence.

Shunned and forgotten, a rebellious space explorer leaves his home in search of a sustainable planet fit for his dying son. An allegory for existential thinking within a closed-off, thought-free society.
A teen, Iaan Saige crash lands over the Pacific Ocean 20,000 years ago.

Although Cao Shun is a descendant of a Mojin, his father never taught him any skills. One day, an evil man entered the village and picked Cao Shun to help him find a mysterious treasure. If he refused, he would kill the village.
When an island off the coast of Ireland is invaded by bloodsucking aliens, the heroes discover that getting drunk is the only way to survive.
In 1802, during Haiti's struggle for independence from Napoleonic France, an American lawyer seeks a client's daughter living on the revolution-torn island.
Matthias lives in Berlin. Matthias likes techno. Matthew likes Matthias. Matthew wants Matthias. Matthew wants to be Matthias.
In a coma, a cartoonist finds himself trapped within his own underground creation and must find a way to get back, while racing against his popular but treacherous character, Monkeybone.
The protagonist, who's a bit rough around the edges, falls in love with the sister of a friend, but the road to romantic bliss is not to be a smooth one.
Maro, the daughter of shepherd Panos, is in love with his son, Liakos. They want to marry but his father does not agree.
Ordinary people meet in a laundry service in Budapest, Hungary and they share the same thing, their dirty secrets.

Dika visited Ina's Father before her wedding day, he told about his high school experience of having Ina as his crush. He also creates a detective group with his other friends trying to be famous in his high school to get Ina's attention.
Kinfolk is a family drama about a Dysfunctional functioning family

movie_name: The Coterie: An Unholy Alliance of Biblical Proportions Between Mayor Justice and Dr. Syringe
synopsis: A global spy organization recruits the son of a world-renowned war hero and martial artist just as a cosmic threat emerges from a corrupt mayor and a mad scientist.
An ex-con manages a top band in the UK, and he wants to re-enter the crime scene.
As the descendant of Planet Fantasy, Soul Hunter Yang Lie Xue is armed with heavy responsibilities. But her path as a soul hunter was met with numerous obstacles due to her forgetfulness.
Jane Utley reunites with her Detective father to solve a murder that leads to unexpected corruption.
While attending the wedding of a school friend, four teenage sisters investigate the murder of the bride on board a luxury liner.

A catastrophic volcanic eruption releases ancient dragon-like creatures on the surrounding areas. Scientists believe this could start a chain reaction of volcanic eruptions giving way to a global Dragon Apocalypse.
When a zombie outbreak strikes London, a group of American friends must escape the chaos and destruction as they fight for their survival and try to make it out of the city alive.
A mark of dishonour became a symbol of justice and courage.
Keegan Dark returns to the the heart of California's wine valley to make peace with his long-estranged family. Instead, he finds a harrowing mystery that endangers his life and those he loves.
A hopeful romantic experiences a fantastic life-changing event in her search for the boy that saved her life years prior.
In desperate need to raise money for his ailing daughter's operation, driver Nathu kidnaps his employer's daughter, not knowing that he is being manipulated by someone with his own agenda.
A teenage girl sets out to give a nebbish classmate the ultimate high school makeover. An updated remake of the 1999 film, 'She's All That'.
A specialist soldier is accidentally sucked through time from 1971.
With the help of his assistant, a psycho drugs, photographs and tortures women he meets through personal ads to find the ultimate degenerate. His latest target is a thrill-seeking lesbian.
The ghost of a man murdered by two kids comes back to haunt them.
A violent patient escapes an asylum to exact her revenge on a unsuspecting young couple.
A late night airport shuttle ride home descends into darkness.
A boy searches for the truth in a town full of people who would do anything to keep their secrets buried.
In the latter half of the sixth century in the kingdom of Koguryo, the Princess Pyonggang married the poor and ugly Ondal and helped him become an educated and successful general.
A battle between two brothers tears their family apart.
In the Victorian village of Milford Green socially awkward inventor, Alfie Fairfield discovers we're not alone in this universe.
Viswam and Sarada loves each other and gets married. But when Viswam gets impotent because of an accident, a lot of changes and problems occur in their marital life.
Plot kept under wraps.
Invisible spacemen, a scatterbrained professor and the National Conciliator of Finland all come together in this screwball comedy.

In the year 2050 mankind must face its first alien invasion. With the help of man-made humanoids, Earth's Space-Force march into battle, while a group of scientists find out more about the true agenda of the aliens and question the war.
In ancient China, rich Prince married to sexually obsessed Princess. Despite all the love delights of her husband, she finds a lover and betrayed him sophisticated passion.
A group of children come together to fight the predatory machines that threaten the nature around them. To do this, they must transform themselves into cartoons and defeat an ambitious witch.
A computer scientist running a virtual reality simulation of 1937 becomes the primary suspect when his colleague and mentor is murdered.
A yakuza, who has an untamed rage and lack of respect for authority, finds himself leading the remnants of the gang he once belonged to in order to secure an area of their own.
Two American executives for a cosmetics company travel to the Greek islands in search for a model for their new line of suntan lotion, "Venus". They run into more than they bargained for.

A nuclear device, DC8, has been stolen from South Korea. As the weapon will change hands in Hong Kong, Inspector Lee sets up a task force in order to get it back. But the elusive criminal mastermind, Helios, is always a step ahead of Lee.
Based upon the History (A+E Networks)/Prometheus Entertainment non-fiction series.
A waitress, desperate to fulfill her dreams as a restaurant owner, is set on a journey to turn a frog prince back into a human being, but she has to face the same problem after she kisses him.

A magic blade made thousands of years ago from the remains of a meteor is stolen by a criminal gang in Japan. A Japanese policeman tracks the gang to California in his quest to get the sword back before it can be put to evil use.
Mario Ferrara of Villalta, a nobleman, hires the poor Nino Esposito, a young student about to graduate as an accountant who, secretly, is the confidant of Don Alfredo Spinosa, a boss of the Camorra.
A bloody scarf leads a mental patient, a troubled detective, and a caring doctor to come together to unravel the mystery of a murder.
The son of a rich businessman who has ties with the Russian mob. But the mob sets up his family and forced the young guy at fighting in martial arts tournament.
In LA, the City of Dreams, a Nepali immigrant balances his life stuck somewhere between family, career, love and dreams.

Based on the very underground comic book of the same name, a Tibetan monk becomes a mentor to a young street punk and tries teaching him how to protect the scroll of ultimate power from a secret Nazi organization bent on world domination.

movie_name: The Pirate Queen: Night of Succession
synopsis: A widowed woman takes over her husband's pirate fleet and becomes the most powerful pirate in history, commanding 70,000 men during the lead up to the Opium Wars.

When a paperboy goes missing in the local woods, it's up to his friends to find answers. Following a mysterious trail of clues, they venture into the heart of the unknown, and unearth something much deeper.
GRANDMOTHER DOLL is the AFRICAN AMERICAN SCRIPT aka FAMILY DRAMA, POLICE OFFICER'S WIFES is the POLICE DRAMA.
A spaceship from Earth is trapped on the unknown planet. Based on book "Tumannost Andromedy" by Ivan Efremov.

movie_name: Die Letzten werden die Ersten sein
synopsis: Adaptation of a short Galsworthy play: The brother of a high ranking lawyer has killed the husband of a Polish woman, with whom he is having an affair. Can the counsel help his brother without getting himself involved in scandal?
An ambitious vlogger experiences the dark side of the internet when his latest video, which features an alleged haunting, goes viral.

Two FBI agents attempt to clarify the murders occurring in a desolate region. They approach the witnesses of the latest incident with the help of the local police. All of them hide something and all have wildly different stories to tell.
Journalist Henryk Bielecki is not very talented but he desperately wants to become a famous writer. Nothing will stop him from making his dreams come true.
A beautiful young drifter comes to a small village and battles Death itself to save the man she loves.

Jack Hall, paleoclimatologist, must make a daring trek from Washington, D.C. to New York City to reach his son, trapped in the cross-hairs of a sudden international storm which plunges the planet into a new Ice Age.

During lectures, student Sasha Mukhin sleeps and dreams. In his dreams he tries to prevent the duel of Pushkin with Dantes, then he intervenes in the events of the revolt of Spartacus, is present during the renunciation of Galileo.
A squad of special forces soldiers are caught in a deadly ambush with no hope of escape - until they're rescued from certain death by an alien spacecraft and offered a chance at a new life.

After losing his job for nearly losing a cargo of gold bars in a holdup, Gatdula finds himself working as a nightclub bouncer. There he meets and is smitten by Varga, a college coed forced by poverty to work as a ramp model.
Pirate wreckers ravage a small seaside community while the ineffectual local squire tries to discourage his son's romance with a smuggler's pretty daughter.
A father reads his son a bedtime story about young Oblio, who is banished from the fantastical kingdom of pointed heads and things for having no point.
Ronny receives a mysterious video where his sister Krissi can be seen covered in blood. Determined and armed to the teeth, he and his friends set out to rescue his sister.

movie_name: Wei xian de mi yue lu xing
synopsis: A husband is called back to emergency duty from his honeymoon and his bride investigates the sudden death of a couple also on their honeymoon.
Aunt and Uncle cannot stand each other. But they are forced to cooperate when a headless corpse found on their new family property turns out to be a vengeance-seeking ghost.
In the year 2199, a starship must make a dangerous voyage to the distant planet Iscandar and back to save Earth from an alien invasion.

After a woman mysteriously vanishes without leaving a trace, a man by the name of James Booker appears in search of her. What he discovers is a thread that is linked to a powerful crime organization that deals in human trafficking.
In her attempt to promote her friend's tune and her own singing career, a teen girl brings chaos to the start of a commercial TV station on a ship 3 miles off the Danish coast.
Japanese spymaster Prince Daka operates a covert espionage organization located in Gotham City's now-deserted Little Tokyo which turns American scientists into pliable zombies.

In 1958 Nebraska 19 year old garbageman Charles Starkweather goes on a murder spree with his 14 year old girlfriend Caril Ann Fugate killing 11 people in three months, introducing America to spree killing.
A Young Man and Woman awake to find them selves trapped in an remote location. Learning about each others past may be the only key to saving their lives .
A couple of Los Angeles detectives with no leads investigate nothing.
A scientist who lives in fear of visions of herself in alternate realities is forced to face reality when someone unexpected enters her world.
Story follows an out-of-work steel worker as he struggles to provide for his family and avenge his brother's death by fighting in a mixed martial-arts match against a dangerous opponent.

Vitello is brimming with energy and has good friends in Max and Hasse, but misses having a father in his life, so he decides to go off in search of one, only to find he isn't the person Vitello was quite expecting.
Former undercover police officer Jack Adleth returns to London seeking those who tried to have him killed in Amsterdam.
A story of mistaken identity... A story of love, lust and power... A story of guns, and men who use them...
Sometimes love blooms once again at the most unlikely stages of ones life. These are stories that are a little bit exceptional. And Jara Hatke is one such story.
