A story about summer adventures of ten years old Adulis.
Banno, is a young woman who periodically transforms into a ferocious half cat, half human creature and prowls the night in search of rapists.
A man with an asthmatic voice telephones and assaults clerk Kelly Sherwood at home and coerces her into helping him steal a large sum from her bank.
A group of heroin addicts are besieged by a group of mysterious figures inside a rural bar. As withdrawal starts to set in, a secret one of them is carrying threatens to destroy them all.
When a young wife discovers her husband of two years is involved with his beautiful secretary, she applies for a job as secretary to a business rival.

Sailor Jan/John cleans up his home town plagued by thieves and becomes known as fearless. His jealous cousin tries to scare him, but things end badly. Now an outlaw, John teams up with a local servant to slay a shapeshifting demon.
When a coolie's family is murdered by a group of gangsters and politicians, he swears revenge on them.
A crime comedy around a murder on the Orient-Express with lots of twists around the investigation and love affairs. One of the last entertainment comedies of the declining Nazi-regime.
Omar decides not to marry his love, Alia, after he discovers about her sister's bad reputation. He marries Esmet and Alia marries her neighbor who loves her, traditional marriage.

Set in a fantasy-medieval context, Mystikal shows the adventure of Eldyn, an apprentice magician rather clumsy and innocent, in which he gets involved in troubles due of a "small" error. He must repair the damage done, with the help of Fira.
A brave queen battles an evil mystic. Three generations later, he comes back to haunt the queen's descendants.

Is a sweet story of loss and freedom three women, sing, laugh, cry, dance and crack jokes in a quest to find Grandma Alma. Along the way there are lots of distaffs, bible scripture, cake, and West Indian recipes.

When Helen develops an unlikely friendship with a homeless man, her spiritually eccentric roommate, Lois, is the only one who can help unfold the true meaning and mystery of their connection- even if it means traveling through time.

The CDC was supposed to help the citizens by creating Pax-A, a cure for everything. The country became divided as people got sick and overrun by the scavengers. Can the rebels find a cure or will the CDC silence them?

During Covid19, Carlos flees from his home- pulled towards a mysterious mountain in the wilderness where he thinks he can stay safe and reconnect with his childhood. But when Joey steps out of the woods, things take a dark turn.
After she gets into a film-production accident that leaves her crippled, successful actress Jane Ciego slowly transitions into madness after experiencing horrors and torture in her own home.
When a raffle ticket sends two strangers on a spur of the moment weekend to Bermuda, they find falling in love is a little like being lost in The Triangle.
A Police Officer investigates a series of brutal rapes and murders, with the culprits seeming to cover more than one country.
Anthology film consisting of ten short films, each by a different director set in Greater Los Angeles. Same structure as film anthologies "Paris, I love you" and "New York, I Love You"
Two former exotic dancers devise a plot to expose a physciatrist as the murderer of their friend.

A group of retired spies once former enemies, are forced to work together in an attempt to retrieve a neutron bomb stolen by a group of new-wave, high-tech operatives who have supplanted them in the post-Cold War intelligence game.
Giorgio Venturini's version of the classic 'Man In the Iron Mask' story.

movie_name: Y a Dios que me perdone!
synopsis: Toribio's wife has been diagnosed with postpartum leukemia. Cornered between the lack of reliable health plans and his low income as a police officer, Toribio takes his gun and goes out to do everything he can to save his wife.
Centers on a student on vacation in Latin America who finds himself entangled in a gold-for-arms conspiracy run by a mad arms dealer in a banana republic.
The story about the life of the students at a university in Hangchow. Chu Ying-Tai is a female who has to be disguised as a man in order to gain entry into the school.
A group of survivors try to avoid the battles of World War III. When they try to escape to the quiet lands, they encounter something much more deadly.
A beautiful redhead becomes involved with a smalltime gang of hoodlums who plan and perform a daring diamond robbery.
An upright Forest Officer who strives for balance in a world of man-animal conflict while she also seeks her true calling in a hostile environment.
As a young couple falls in love, their happiness is quickly extinguished when they discover that they are trapped within a world that has been built to test their sentience.
In order to wed his sweetheart, a male must reverse a 350-year old curse on her family.
Stephen Mobius is just your normal guy until the day after Christmas, he finds a time traveling watch and it leads him to an adventure but it has it's obstacles.
Animated fantasy film about an optimistic space boy and his friends.

Becoming a ''Star'' is often the dream of many kids and young guys, or the fulfillment of the parent's ''missed dreams'' and so here we are, in a very special School called "Teen star academy"......where dreams come true.
A young boy is magically transported back in time to a pirate ship on the high seas.

movie_name: The Magic School Bus Rides Again: Kids in Space
synopsis: The Magic School Bus kids blast into orbit and onto the International Space Station only to find themselves on the run from a giant tardigrade.
Seena and Devika experience crime in different phases of life by meeting different people who may make them realize human values and emotions or not.

Two small-time jewel thieves team up with a larger gang to pull off a $1-million heist. However, the police always seem to be one step ahead of them, and the gang soon begins to suspect that one of them is a police informant.
Saga of Danveer Karna - fated to a life of humiliation - and war with his siblings.

movie_name: The Man Who Came to Dinner
synopsis: An acerbic critic wreaks havoc when a hip injury forces him to move in with a Midwestern family.

movie_name: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time
synopsis: A high-school girl named Makoto acquires the power to travel back in time, and decides to use it for her own personal benefits. Little does she know that she is affecting the lives of others just as much as she is her own.
A few decades after her original visit, Mary Poppins, the magical nanny, returns to help the Banks siblings and Michael's children through a difficult time in their lives.
A headstrong journalist whose investigative podcast uncovers a strange artifact, an alien conspiracy, and the lies at the heart of her own story.
Unforeseen circumstances threaten the passionate relationship between star-crossed lovers.
In Greece, a stewardess is murdered by a masked maniac. Suspicion falls on a drunken American playboy (George Hamilton) and a murderous gangster (Cameron Mitchell).
Mark marries Marnie although she is a habitual thief and has serious psychological problems, and tries to help her confront and resolve them.
What if you could do in life what you can do in your favorite video game? Now you can.
Three adventurers search for the son of a U.S. Senator, who is lost on the island of Komodo, home of fierce, man-eating giant lizards known as the Komodo Dragons.

A maniac with a suitcase full of razorblades unleashes a super human killer upon a group of kids in a small Alabama town. They must take up arms with a insane Chili enthusiast if they want to survive.
A poor man, in love with a princess, is persuaded by an evil sorcerer to help him get the blessing of a Goddess.
Katniss Everdeen and Peeta Mellark become targets of the Capitol after their victory in the 74th Hunger Games sparks a rebellion in the Districts of Panem.
Mondi, a talented but misunderstood boy, befriends a puppy named Diana, who reveals to him a kind spirit of care and love that no one, especially his teacher, has ever seen.

After trying a new version of the drug Changa, Maryssa finds herself transported to a hell dimension where the demon, Belial, latches on to her. through Maryssa, Belial begins killing her friends one by one in horrific hallucinations.
When the Earth comes under alien attack, humanity's only hope is a down-and-out NASA Astronaut who must struggle to save the world in its darkest hour.

movie_name: Anohana the Movie: The Flower We Saw That Day (Ano hi mita hana no namae wo bokutachi wa mada shiran
synopsis: A group of friends were separated when one of them died in an accident. Later on she comes back as a ghost trying to get into heaven but to do that her friends must grant her a wish.
Chronicles the true story of a convict's escape from Alcatraz.

Victorita escapes from the mercenary soldier who attacked her family, after which she dresses as a man and runs to the outlaws. Together with the leader of the outlaws, they rescue her sister from a boyar who had bought her.

A contemporary fantasy that delves into three of Grimm's fairy tales in one frightening narrative of captivity, abandonment, and sacrifice. The stories that kept you warm at night as a child, will turn you stone cold relived as an adult.
A microorganism from Mars, brought to Earth by a space probe, terrorizes passengers in a railroad office.
A hit man traumatized from accidentally killing a young girl during a job is given the mission to eliminate her mother, and begins the ultimate fight to save her life.
A man meets a clone of himself and stumbles into a grand conspiracy about clones taking over the world.
1943 in occupied Byelorussia. It tells the story of Franz, an SS soldier who deserts, and Polina, a Byelorussian woman whose village is massacred.

When a spaceship lands on the moon, it is hailed as a new accomplishment, before it becomes clear that a Victorian party completed the journey in 1899, leading investigators to that mission's last survivor.
Story of Hindu God Ayyapan and his Muslim friend Vaavar
A family of strangers finds peace through tragedy.

Deep in the jungle a mad scientist has invented little blue pills that cause a permanent erection. Now the Drug Cartel and militant Church are fighting for the pills and each have plans for world domination. Fear not: Dace is on the case!
The Hero Factory's mission: to build the bravest, most advanced Heroes in the galaxy! When rookie Rocka responds to a civilian distress call from the planet Quatros.

Fifty-seven years after surviving an apocalyptic attack aboard her space vessel by merciless space creatures, Officer Ripley awakens from hyper-sleep and tries to warn anyone who will listen about the predators.
The life story of a girl named June from 16 years of her age until she turned 26, thereby giving an insight into those ten years of her life.
An honest encounter specialist's life begins to change with the arrival of a new police commissioner who has ties with a local don.
Even though the world has been taken over by the Living Dead, Wendell still finds a way to encounter the tribulations of mankind.
The daily routine of two London Policemen is interrupted by a killer.

movie_name: Norm of the North: Family Vacation
synopsis: Overwhelmed with his Kingly duties, Norm's crown is stolen and he embarks on a journey to find it in conjunction with repairing his family's relationship.
"Blood Hockey" brings gladiator-style combat onto a futuristic Ice Rink where only one team survives each match.
This is a story about a group of beauty-contest finalists stranded on a desert island without food, water, or shelter.
A car thief finds himself in one of those race-against-time situations.
After a robbery gone wrong, two Japanese criminals go to America to find the victim's niece and millions in stolen cash.
A flower seller seeks justice for her murdered son.

Coming from the heart of the Belarusian Rebellion, an intimate portrait of a young woman. When her regular self enters emotional turmoil, her seifuku-wearing magical witch alter ego is keeping the fighting spirit ablaze.
A devastating war for supremacy between human clones and breeding humans seems unavoidable, and the clones have the mental and physical advantage.
A modern day young writer falls into a difficult and disappointed life, so he travels in time to meet his ancient ancestors and find personal confidence and growth.
The film is a remake of the Telugu hit - Courier Boy Kalyan. It is the story of a courier boy who finds himself in the middle of big trouble due to a parcel he has to deliver.
The journey of a woman who overcomes her personal anguish to help deliver justice to another woman trapped in a web of deceit and deception.
Yang Luchan marries the Chen style kung fu grand master's daughter in Chen village in 1800s China, so he can learn Chen style kung fu/tai chi. The deputy governor wants the village.
Shuihua wants to help Huowang after Shuihua's sister dumps him as her boyfriend.

After doing time in jail for killing the cop who murdered his father, Joao heads for Brasilia where a distant cousin from Argentina helps him get a start as a carpenter's apprentice - as long as he sidelines as a drug dealer.
A streetwise New York police officer transforms into the world's most unusual superhuman hero.
An American salvage diver plunges into dangerous intrigue around a sunken treasure in the Philippines.

The plot involves Ireland, captain of a tired oil tanker, and Crawford, the ship's engineer. The pair soon find themselves at odds over their mutual affection for Drew (who happens to be Crawford's fiancee).
In the eve of the Day of the Dead, among mysterious old rituals of the Vilnius region, ghosts of the past and present start to appear.
A gang of high class corporate thieves use blackmail to induce their victims to sell property at knock-down prices.
The husband sets up the breakfast table that his wife won't even at that day, cleans it, and does the laundry.
A group of National Guard trainees find themselves battling against a vicious group of mutants on their last day of training in the desert.
Transhuman follows a young journalist into the underbelly of a transhumanist cult, spanning generations leading back to the nazi's during world war two.
A psychological thriller based on the infamous 1892 murders of Lizzie Andrew Borden's family.
In the future, an L.A. cop whose girlfriend is a stripper uncovers a conspiracy concerning killer cyborgs.
A famous novelist breaks out of a mental hospital, taking an ex pro quarterback who fell from grace hostage. The two men embark on a crazy road trip of self discovery through the Arizona desert.
Rocket is a man bored with his shallow and quiet life, until one day his life is changed forever.
A young vintner discovers a secret vineyard with magical grapes that possess extraordinary properties leading to an adventure of discovery rivalry and the pursuit of winemaking perfection.
Moses, raised as a prince of Egypt in the Pharaoh's household, learns of his true heritage as a Hebrew and his divine mission as the deliverer of his people from slavery.
A family gets stuck in an old abandoned movie studio that comes to life and puts the family members in various films.
Don Farrell wakes up from a night on the town with a strange mark on his arm and an overwhelming urge to save the planet from a returning evil.
The Filipina superheroine Darna and her little brother Ding must foil an alien plot to invade Earth.
In this offshoot of the 1950s "claymation" cartoon series, the crazy Blockheads threaten to ruin Gumby's benefit concert by replacing the entire city of Clokeytown with robots.

Love stories, a beauty parlor,a Moroccan nanny, children to educate and family feasts are what Isa,Alice,Léa and Nina share together because they are united by their Sephardi families and their friendship.
A secret agent battles a secret brainwashing organisation.
An island Princess falls for a visiting Frenchman, but her people are against it.

Maria auditions for the lead role of Clytemnestra in the Greek tragedy Agamemnon. As the repressed pain of her past surfaces she must resist the manipulations of those around her before she is set on a path of violence she cannot escape.
A bogus legionnaire proves his mettle during an Arab attack.
Two men fall deeply in love with the same woman but when she suddenly gets kidnapped they get involved in the case to rescue her.

movie_name: San da ming bu hui jing shi
synopsis: The pursuit of the Devil Clan, a gang of very efficient robbers who have never been caught.
After witnessing a violent swatting prank, a disgraced video game champion recruits a diverse group of nerds to take down his former corporate sponsor.
The Milanese judge Damiano Fortezza, back from a hot and personal crisis, is sent to a small town in Southern Italy.
A tale of a Jazz Singer set in New York City 1962.
A demented nurse slaughters not-so-innocent victims in the hope of acquiring a suitable heart to resurrect her dead husband.
A young man tries to self-justify that he's a good person, only to spiral into primitive urges, leaving his mark all over Chicago.
A young boy enters a life of the unknown and adapts to his surroundings against his morals.
Jack Petty gets more than he bargained for when he travels to Havana on business and gets caught up in an assassination conspiracy with his new friend Harry Smith.
Historic adventurism movie inspirited by legend about mystery monk, alchemist and healer who made the flying machine according to lost book wrote by Leodardo DaVinci in 18th century.
A widow finds choosing a new husband might not be her choice at all, as the actions of her various prospects confine her freedom.
A witness to a murder is marked for death by the Supernatural realm and It's demons lead by Lucifer.

This is to be a film about the trek that Lt. Col. James Doolittle and his men took through China to avoid the Imperial Japanese Army after successfully conducting the first ever raid against the Japanese mainland.
Joseph and Mary, now pregnant, travel to Bethlehem for the Roman census, they face a threat from King Herod.
Posing as a private tutor, Azra secretly coaches students on achieving their goals in life and love - but not without a few bumps in the road.
Professor Challenger leads an expedition of scientists and adventurers to a remote plateau deep in the Amazonian jungle to verify his claim that dinosaurs still live there.
When a young girl accidentally destroys the mixtape that belonged to her mother, she sets out to track down each of the obscure songs on the cassette.
A group of semi-slave laborers rebel against the appalling work conditions in a logging camp deep in the Mexican jungle.

Kaspar is a young filmmaker willing to develop his projects in cinema. He passes his time drawing, writing and making up his own imaginary world, that day by day seems to be getting more ...                See full synopsis »

An NRI from Canada travels to Chennai to start a property business. As his company starts doing well, he realizes he is he being cheated by his most trusted people, and gets imprisoned for fraud. What happens next?
Old people tend to be kept apart, even humiliated by the new generations. The stories and different destinies of three old persons are linked together, and the realism of it imposes itself on us.

An unorthodox Texas Ranger finds himself tested to his mental and physical limits when he must rescue his wife kidnapped by the brutal hands of the Mafia in Palermo, Italy, only to discover she is not the woman he thought he had married.
Two vaudeville flops pose as bad guys and join the Klondike gold rush with a saloon singer.
Terrorists embark on a bold plan to strike at the heart of Western civilization by weaponizing the outbreak of Ebola in Western Africa.
A young Greek photographer boards and an elevator of a very very very very tall building and goes up.

Henry is missing and his fiancée (Kat) solicits a mutual friend (Andy) to help find him. Suddenly the search for Paradise turns deadly as famous archaeologists attempt to locate the elusive Garden of Eden. Classic battle of good vs evil.
Blind swordsman Badra saves a child, becomes friendly with a king and takes on his arch enemy and his murderous thugs.
At the end of the 21st century, the dead are walking the earth. Four survivors try to escape the zombies. They hide in an old house. Will they survive?
Five comedic tales criss-cross at random, focusing on the emotions of the main characters and told with a lot of rhythm and action.
Released from prison, a gangster (Michitaro Mizushima) retrieves diamonds sought by fellow yakuza.

Nick Cochran, an American in exile in Macao, has a chance to restore his name by helping capture an international crime lord. Undercover, can he mislead the bad guys and still woo the attractive singer/petty crook, Julie Benson?
Soon after a Chinese princess comes to the US to buy planes for her people, she is murdered by a poison dart fired by an air rifle.
Turkish remake of 'Rambo: First Blood'.

Two bisexual characters with opposite approaches to their sexuality get in and out of trouble as they grapple to find love. Their ensemble of friends, family and lovers struggle with the ripple effect of their actions.
He's young, he's bold, he's vicious, his name is Eric.
Nightclub singer and her brother-in-law try to find her husband's killer.

Dinda, who is considered strange by the village children because of her strength, accidentally injures Panji and Ambar. She regrets and asks Aunt Donna to register her at the Mata Hati School, so that she can learn to control her power.
A bookish CIA researcher in Manhattan finds all his co-workers dead, and must outwit those responsible until he figures out who he can really trust.
Munna Bhai embarks on a journey with Mahatma Gandhi in order to fight against a corrupt property dealer.
Jewel smugglers in Cairo try to pin their crimes on a kidnapped baron.

Phillip and Blanca decide to go to a family house in southern Chile, hoping to save their relationship after suffering a pregnancy loss. However, both are unaware that in that place there is a dark family secret linked to black magic.
Inspired by the Asian mythological hero Karna with a modern day twist.
A spoof of the Filipino fantasy icon Ang Panday and He-Man and the Masters of the Universe.
Two Viking Gods and sworn enemies fall through a ripple in space time and find themselves in the present day world. Only a young girl, unaware if her powers can find the portal and bring them back.
In order to protect himself from his enemies, Jai, a businessman, brings together his son, Vivek, and his friends, Ritesh and Nidhi, who are victims of different psychological disorders.

movie_name: Haven Lost: The Dragon's Brood Cycle
synopsis: When a teenage girl is transported into a mysterious world, she goes to war with the despotic sorceress that has turned The Haven into a nightmare using dark magic.

The two-hour scripted feature THE CANNIBAL IN THE JUNGLE follows the story of an American scientist who was convicted of killing and cannibalizing two colleagues in the jungles of Flores, Indonesia in 1977.
Guo Zhida and his twins brother scheme an bomb explosion near the gym to take away money from gambling group. Korean police officer and psychologist Yang cooperates to prevent this conspiracy.
Young Peter Joe decides to go to Southampton to sea, this is the story of his land voyage there with many adventures for him and his friends along the way.
During the 1956 Hungarian uprising, an American mercenary is hired to smuggle a Hungarian resistance leader out of Soviet-occupied Budapest.
Three brothers murder a connected man for raping their sister. The brothers fight to free themselves from the debt from the New York Mafia.
The first movie of the trilogy about Armenian Bolshevik revolutionary Simon Ter-Petrosyan, known as Kamo.
A group of schoolchildren come upon an alien from Venus, and help him against a gang of criminals who are trying to kidnap him.
A love story set in Split, Dalmatia during the last years of Italian occupation. A local girl falls in love with Italian soldier.
After a young woman suffers a brutal gang rape in a bar one night, a prosecutor assists in bringing the perpetrators to justice, including the ones who encouraged and cheered on the attack.
In a very long eclipse of the sun, an unknown disease has been widespread. Ali is accused of the murder of Saman in a club and the police is going to stage a reconstruction of the murder.
A boozing young man in love with his co-worker finds that everyone around him, even his pompous and condescending best friend, is changing into a rhinoceros.

The story of Willie Sutton, the famed bank robber who robbed over 80 banks and escaped three maximum security prisons. When asked why he continued to do so, he replied "Because that's where the money was."
A meeting between two traveling gamblers leads to a case of mistaken identity that has deadly consequences.

Story of estranged teenage lovers, Jimmy and Nithya. Set in the backdrop of the coastal region, Jimmy belongs to a middle-class muslim family while Nithya is a Hindu girl and their inter-faith relationship didn't go well.
Strange things begin happening to an expedition deep in the Antarctic.
Luisa Latin, betrayed by her husband, is imprisoned for the murder of her husband's mistress - who is still alive. When Luisa is released from prison, she kills her.
A group of kids have a lock-in in there school. They don't realize that its a trap. One by one they are killed by one of their friends.
A protector of fine art is sent on a mission to save the most valuable piece of art known in the world.
A scientist invents a formula that removes old, thinning hair and replaces it with thick, new hair. Complications ensue.
An ex-con is the prime suspect when a series of murders occur under the full moon, every victim a young blonde woman.
Andrea and Isabelle patiently build a boat on the terrace of their home that should take them away from the monotony of daily routine.
Just days before her wedding, a one-eyed bride-to-be develops an obsession for a mysterious stranger that may cost her her marriage, her home, and her other eye.
Two filmmakers are hired by a corporate alert force to document a massive hurricane that is set to collide all of Michigan's Great Lakes into the strongest storm ever recorded.
A young man is hired to protect a wealthy businessman from a killer.
A Beverly Hills millionaire with an obsession about actress Grace Kelly blackmails a woman into becoming her.
A New York City cab driver in need of $200 picks up a movie star in his cab, and schemes to get the money from her.

Daniel, the driver of a very special taxi in Marseille, gets a famous soccer player to the stadium in time and later helps his clumsy police friend Émilien catch the dangerous Belgian after he escaped on Émilien's guard.
The story of a broken family striving to stay together while a curse and the ghosts of a haunted house try to tear them apart.

To avenge her defeat and with the help of the Cardinal's army leader Rochefort, the treacherous Milady de Winter kidnaps both D'Artagnan and Constance, in order to spur a war between the French and the English, as per the Cardinal's wish.
A suspended crime branch officer gets involved in the investigation of a twisted case after he suspects a group of 5 friends of weird behavior.
One woman and a detective are looking for lost children, in México City.
Inspired by a true story about Hollywood big shots who will bet on anything.

Ariana has always gone unnoticed until, unintentionally, she posts a video in which she declares herself to the most popular boy in school. Now his ex-girlfriend will do anything to ruin the romance and make her want to be invisible again.
Gianni is a young criminal who is indebted to the nasty gang boss "Er Tajola". He must find a bunch of money by evening and he'll dive into absurd and dangerous situations.
An upright car mechanic falls in love with the girlfriend of a gangster. This forces him to participate in the criminal underworld.
A gay Chinese-American and her traditionalist mother are reluctant to go public with secret loves that clash against cultural expectations.
The nice town Kellyville is too small to accommodate the world's worst scoundrels, Albert and Egon, who decides to go out in the world.
In 1970, 75-year-old Jonathan Sperry starts mentoring three boys--Dustin, Albert, and Mark--to follow the Lord.
Five years ago Frank Phoenix robbed The Firm. Betrayed by his own crew and murdered, the stolen gold was never found. Now someone is planning revenge.
Tom Felber, a young cop, receives orders to guard a witness at a hotel. Shortly before he starts his job he learns that there are indications of an undercover agent working in his new unit.
Marvelous entertainment for the whole family to relish.

Fox spirit Bai gets a quest for immortality in human world where he befriends the innocent scholar Wang. They ally to fight mythic creatures and evil spirits on their journey. Yet, to finish Bai's quest, he must sacrifice Wang after all.
A story centered on a man who works as an informant for the French border patrol.
5 friends who have fun together face several twists and turns due to their rebellious deeds. Together they end up learning important life lessons.

The young magician Marek dreams of exciting adventures. When she meets the help-seeking priestess Teela she offers her assistance and provides a motley troupe. Together they go in search of Teela's sister, who was kidnapped by a wild ogre.

When eighteen leaders of the Common World Governments are killed at the 2177 G20 Summit, only swift justice will stop a world war. But the only "people" equipped to find the assassins are two escapees from a shuttered genetic experiment.
A story about teenagers who live as someone's marionette before they even normally go through the process of ego development or even think about moral values.
A musical horror film that will make you like musicals! A young girl tries to solve the mystery of her grandmother's disappearance in a haunted theater.

Veera Pratap is a 1987 Indian Telugu film, directed by B. Vittalacharya and produced by Mohan Babu. The film stars Mohan Babu and Madhavi in lead roles. Music of the film was composed by Shanker Ganesh.
When a respected martial artist is accused of killing, he goes around in search of answers about his own mysterious origin story and the unknown enemies working to destroy him.

Looking for her twin brother who has suddenly disappeared, Octavia reaches his apartment in a very high building in the centre of Rome, where an ancient Roman coven is plotting something dark and dangerous.
Two siblings cursed in prehistoric times survive for millennia by feasting on the entrails of young people, prowling in what eventually becomes a park in contemporary Los Angeles.

movie_name: My Little Pony: Equestria Girls - Legend of Everfree
synopsis: The students of Canterlot High come to a summer camp where there are odd counselors, strange phenomena and, hidden agendas.

A man whose wife and child die in San Francisco flees his home in grief and goes to San Sebastian where he encounters a myrid of characters who made his life better but one who puts his very life at risk.
Sadie's death propels a former basketball champion, a deaf beauty, a drug addict, and an aspiring actress into an unlikely romance and a desperate quest to appease drug-lord William Spinks.
Based on the novel by Isaac Asimov.The End of Eternity is a science fiction film with mystery and thriller elements on the subjects of time travel and social engineering.

Taking advantage of his mother's absence as she departs on a cruise ship for some rest and relaxation, 12-year-old Félix sets out to find his father, a fisherman who disappeared at sea two years earlier.
A young software engineer ventures into a vivid journey to study a newly developed A.I. interface.
Soldiers in a rural English town are being brutally murdered by an unknown creature. Two sisters living nearby realize they might understand what's happening.
A woman's purpose is redefined when a space alien she encountered as a child returns to reclaim what was left behind.
An action thriller about a young man's rise into the ranks of an Outlaw Biker club.

Adnil, a strong minded adventurer from a distant planet has spent her life exploring the universe, and now on the day of her retirement, wishes to return to Earth to find her long lost Earth friend to the surprise of her adult children.

An artist who's failed to define her true self, returns home to S.Texas amidst a global health crisis. Trying to locate her mother's body, who died from a respiratory disease, she experiences a deeper emotional connection with herself.
Fans of video games are collecting disks and questionable adventures.
The story of surgeon Cristóbal Payano, who tried to rob a bank office in Santo Domingo in March 1993, in a 12-hour hostage situation that ended in tragedy.

A gateway to hell appears randomly around the world allowing demons to travel between hell and Earth. A physics prodigy with the power of teleportation must battle his demons to save a government task force that becomes trapped in The Boxx
A group of outlaws, once known as the "Order of Warriors", fight to regain their former glory.
Five friends exploring a remote cave system in Northern Australia find themselves threatened by a hungry crocodile.
A young girl has been left an orphan but in the custody of her step parents. From the afterlife, her parents look out for her and don't like the treatment she is getting.

movie_name: Bala... Dapat Kay Cris Cuenca, Public Enemy No. 1
synopsis: Cris (Ramon Revilla Sr.) tries to avoid trouble to support his family but due to an incident, he becomes a completely notorious criminal.
This is a shortened version of the 1949 Republic serial "Ghost of Zorro," and was released to television as part of a syndicated package in 1959.
A series of mysterious events change the life of a blind pianist, who must now report a crime that he should technically know nothing of.
Two booksellers search for diamonds in Africa, along the way meeting a visually-impaired gunner, a hungry lion, and a tribe of cannibals.
A mobster breaks out of prison to kill his ex-wife's new husband - who, by accident, is a FBI agent trying to capture him.

A small shop owner catches a little mutant Octopus and accidentally becomes involved in a conspiracy involving genetic mutation experiments and a giant kaiju Octopus.
Neela and Akash fall in love with each other after a comedy of errors. They manage to stay together in spite of all the obstacles.

A group of young, highly educated and wealthy individuals enter a confined space (a typical glass tower in New York) from which they cannot escape and will be confronted by a "powerful enemy" who wishes to annihilate them.

A ship docks in Brooklyn with all its crew dead, but someone gets off and the killing continues on land. A Caribbean vampire is searching for a specific woman, half-human half-vampire. Rita is the detective investigating the many killings.
Sunny Kincaid is the story of a country girl who learned about men from a bad one, the woman she becomes walks the dark side.
An astronaut battles mutant cannibals after returning from space to find earth ravaged by nuclear and biological war. A B-movie cult classic.

movie_name: The Pirate and the Slave Girl
synopsis: When a ship carrying the daughter of Rhodes' governor and secret documents is captured by Mediterranean pirate Dragut, the governor tasks captain Diego with their recovery before they can be sold to Sultan Selim.
A criminal attempts to rob a car and ends up trapped by the owner, who plans to make justice with his own hands.

Munich in the late 1940s. Marianne desperately waits every evening at the train station for her friend, who has been missing on the Eastern Front since 1944. She accidentally falls into the arms of a stranger and falls in love with him.
How far are you willing to go to save your child and what if that child doesn't want to be saved? A mother fights to save her child and she has to fight her child to do it.
A story about twin brothers from a family of hereditary military sailors.
A British nurse visiting Scotland in 1945 stumbles upon a time portal that transports her to the 18th Century.
A group of middle school friends go on the hunt for treasure after finding a skeleton in the woods.
9-year-old Simon, bullied at school by Alex, has a real lion as a companion, a beast that has the strength he himself lacks.
Haunted by images, "deja vu", Karen Gold wanders through her life, finally guided by Mark Blackhawk, her broker's advice as he places her into destiny hands.
As Ishaan, a music producer who has commitment issues with the women in his life, feels a connection with Gauri, his next-door neighbor, he begins to learn the importance of relationships.

Is chemistry subject knowledge enhancement ever been useful for a student in his/her real life? Mr. Thomas Bee will show his teenager student how to use chemistry knowledge in his own benefits, but it's not that easy it looks.
Two small time hoods pretend to be serious henchmen in order to get to do a job in Toronto that they think will get them serious recognition in the mob. Things soon get out of control.
This film teams the Japanese superhero Jumborg Ace with a giant stone idol called Yuk Wud Jaeng, simply known as "Giant" against Ace's own enemies.
Jekyll is autistic scienist that wants to create cure for cancer but he didnt know it will be his nightmare
When Sunder loses everything, he seeks refuge in a graveyard, where he befriends a ghost.
Kakek Pacul was Nenek Gayung's husband. When he died, Kakek Pacul's body was not properly buried. Duta, Coki, Danu, Thalia, and Miki had to deal with an angry Kakek Pacul who demanded a proper grave.
A Russian peasant girl becomes a member of the Imperial Ballet.
A story centered on the only human kid in a school for (mostly) aliens.
When a travelling monk is stranded in a wasteland, The Monkey King must escort him across the land to retrieve sacred scriptures and protect him from an evil demon.
A fast-moving, feature-length dramatic film that portrays the events in the book of Revelation.
A shy young woman facing potential deafness happily customises and repairs headphones until rejection drives her to an extreme form of sabotage.
A married woman is kidnapped by her ex-boyfriend.

Black Butterfly, steals from the rich and gives to the poor. In reality, she is Bao Zhu, the daughter of retired swordsman Kwan Yee. Trouble starts when a bandit gang who she has robbed come to town looking for her.
A magic hat brings a snowman to life, but makes him the target of people who want his magical powers.

Thieves fall out when over a half million dollars goes missing after the daring and carefully planned robbery of the Los Angeles Coliseum during a football game, each one accusing the other of having the money.
Juan Pistolas gathers money and weapons to help the revolution.
The music of The Beatles and the Vietnam War form the backdrop for the romance between an upper-class American girl and a poor Liverpudlian artist.
Plot undisclosed.

A professor goes to a small town in Italy to study the story of a witch killed in the early 1800's, and is drawn into a web of terror and possession as the spirit of the witch attempts to find a new host.
Julia, a fashion designer harboring a secret, spends ten days of passion in the Alps with Valerio, a race car driver, in what will be their last vacation together.

After his ex-fiancée's sudden and mysterious suicide, a jilted bridegroom seeks answers. What he finds, makes him question if he ever really knew her. And then he begins to see her face everywhere he goes.
Lady Lee, gambler's daughter, plies her trade while pondering the proposal of a social-register suitor.
Feature version of the 1952 serial "Zombies of the Stratosphere. " Alien invaders plan to use a Hydrogen bomb to blast Earth out its orbit so Mars can replace it.
A Scientist must encounter alternate time-lines in order to save his wife from dying.

An ordinary 60 plus couple - Vidhyadhar Patwardhan and his wife are forced to search for their faith in human values and society after the death of their only son Amar. In the process they undergo the most testing struggle of their lives.

A talented 22 year-old musician barters his father's Stradivarius violin for three magical beans. The beanstalk sprouts out of the 9/11 debris. The young man climbs it and discovers the earth world and fantasy world are bound together.
When six friends from Massachusetts travel to the Jersey Shore, they end up on Clinton Road at a house on a lake. They're not alone, and one by one they disappear. Who will survive?

movie_name: 2177: The San Francisco Love Hacker Crimes
synopsis: Mysterious stranger helped save the day when proper data was obtained no one was harmed
Tommy Jones, a well-built plumber, is invited to join a troupe of professional wrestlers, but is surprised to learn that the sport of exhibition wrestling is not on the up-and-up.
Seven years after he survived the monster apocalypse, lovably hapless Joel leaves his cozy underground bunker behind on a quest to reunite with his ex.
A group of white high school teens become involved with Harlem's black hip-hop crowd.

The mayor of Detroit ends his business with the Russian mob when young women are abducted and turn up drugged and dead. The best detectives (2 women) are put on the case. The Russians abduct the mayor's adult daughter as well for leverage.

Anthology movie by, and starring, Michael Jackson in his prime, combining a number of music videos from his bestselling "Bad" album with a fantasy tale of Michael's confrontation with a ruthless drug dealer known as Mr. Big.
After undergoing a procedure to erase his memories, a successful author begins having unexplained recollections relating to a series of unsolved murders.

A journalist in Barbados investigates a video that surfaced on social media claiming to show a giant, unidentified creature. Her story uncovers a multi-nation government conspiracy that will forever change the face of Barbados.

After being dumped by her serial killer boyfriend, a beauty-obsessed woman goes on a blood-soaked quest to create the perfect female face, while navigating her new relationship with the cop investigating the murders.

movie_name: The Subtle Caricature of the Would Be Assassin
synopsis: In this wild absurdist comedy, a seemingly amnesiac man wakes up on the beach and gets caught up in a number of events with various characters in a quasi-fictitious world.
When feudal lords try to exploit the tribal people, a group of naxals put up resistance. The feudal lords decide to suppress the resistance. Who will emerge triumphant in the fight for justice?
A young girl photographs an assassin killing 4 at a cemetery. He wants no witnesses. Carter, a veteran in a farmhouse, is all standing between him and the girl.
A rising political star faces scandal and blackmail when the young woman he tries to help turns out to be a juvenile delinquent.
A stray dog, found in the alleys in New Delhi, is brought to Sweden.
A psychiatrist protects the identity of an amnesia patient accused of murder while attempting to recover his memory.
A dentist finds himself a murder suspect after a sexy patient seduces him and steals all of the drugs from his practice.
Rin Tin Tin witnesses a murder for which his master is blamed. Rinty knows who committed the crime, and sets out to track down the killer and clear his master's name.

Jens(Richard) is a normal 16 year old boy. Torn between the paths of his older criminal brother(Andreas) Money,Power and Fame. And Emma(Sasha) the love of his life, who just wants him to do right by himself and live a simple normal life.
A family moves into a possessed bungalow. A sudden turn of events in the house leaves them astonished. When things worsen, escape seems to be their last resort.
A family caught in the middle of a jewelry store robbery is chased all over Saigon. They bond and become closer through their hilarious caper.
If we found a 1-mile long humanoid skeleton. Would we like to know more?
Five grisly tales from a kid's comic book about a murdered father rising from his grave, a bizarre meteor, a vengeful husband, a mysterious crate's occupant, and a plague of cockroaches.
An aimless youth starts working for drug baron and his mission is to kill is rival.
The discovery of rich pearl beds in 1498 during the arrival of Columbus' third voyage triggered greed and genocide, intertwining the lives of the Conquistadores, Natives and African slaves.
Two couples find themselves entangled in a drug deal between the Irish and the Turkish mafia. When a cold-blooded hitman knocks on their door, they have to choose between each other or the money.
Doctor Justice is a crusading physician with the World Health Organization and also a swimming champion, karate expert and philosopher must investigate a series of pirate attacks.

Tat, ex SWAT turned CID cop in HK, has a 29 y.o. Disabled brother, behaving like the small boys, he plays with, always getting into trouble. Tat struggles to care for him - at the expense of his cute girlfriend and dreams.
Buried grudges have disasterous consequences for a class reunion in this unapologetically bloody film from Korean director Dae-wung Lim.
An agent works for a secretive organization that uses brain-implant technology to inhabit other people's bodies - ultimately driving them to commit assassinations for high-paying clients.
Women leaves her true love, ranch and family to go to Australia to support her family.
Police officers Kishan and Dawood joins forces with Mr. Sinha, a freedom fighter to eradicate crime and corruption. In the process, their faith in law is tested.
Fantasy adventure origin story about a young man discovering he has god-like powers based on ancient Norse mythology.

Shubunka (Barry Sulivan) is a cynical gangster who controls the Neptune Beach waterfront. He runs a numbers racket with the local soda shop owner. The police are in his pocket and the local hoods are on his payroll.
2059: humanity's last hope lies in the hands of a dying ten-year-old girl, obsessed with finding the ARK, a missing repository of DNA from Earth's extinct plants and animals
It has been 13 years since the incident that happened to Madi and Spark. Madi is now working as an instructor at a scrambler training centre which is owned by Roy and runs a workshop with Macha.
There is a French family were the daddy died and came back to say goodbye to his family on a happy way helping his family doesn't suffer with his lost.

movie_name: Pettson and Findus: Findus Moves House
synopsis: The old man Petterson is trying to sleep but his cat Findus is keeping him awake, so they both agree that Findus shall have his own house. Based on the beloved books by Sven Nordqvist.
Strange things begin happening to an expedition deep in the Antarctic.

movie_name: Darkness on the Edge of Town
synopsis: A troubled teenage sharpshooter decides to avenge the death of her estranged sister after she is found murdered in a public bathroom.
A mermaid is ripped from the Pacific, her tail is chopped off and she's thrown into a mental home where no one believes she is a mermaid.
A troubled, lonely teen gets a new lease on life when he comes upon a group of selkies, mythical people with the power to change into seals.

movie_name: Harry Potter and the Untold Stories of Hogwarts
synopsis: After being cast aside by Voldemort, two rogue Death Eaters decide to track down Harry Potter, Ron Weasley and Hermione Granger in the middle of their search for the last horcurxes.

movie_name: Little Rascals: Best of Our Gang
synopsis: Spanky, Buckwheat, Porky and all The Little Rascals at their hilarious best!
A small-time rancher agrees to hold a captured outlaw who's awaiting a train to go to court in Yuma. A battle of wills ensues as the outlaw tries to psych out the rancher.
A psychological thriller about a young beautiful violent punk-rocker descending into psychotic hell who may be responsible for a series of murders along her current U.S. tour.
In a vein similar to the James Bond movies, British Agent Philip Calvert (Sir Anthony Hopkins) is on a mission to determine the whereabouts of a ship that disappeared near the coast of Scotland.
Ladies man Ronnie makes a bet with his friend Karey that he can sleep with a popular girl from campus before her.

Set in the dystopian corporate state of Axiom Quantum in the year 2054, the film fuses cyberpunk, film noir, and surrealist elements; blurring the lines of reality and dreams, the past and future, as well as good and evil.
When a prank goes horribly awry during a camping trip, one friend is left dead, one friend slowly loses his mind, and the rest are running for their lives.
Two petty crooks seek refuge in a church after a drug-deal-gone-wrong - and find that their troubles are just beginning.

After a lot of hurdles, two youngsters get married and head to a farmhouse located on an island off coastal Karnataka for their honeymoon. Just when it was to be happily ever after, they experience a series of horrific incidents.
A post-apocalyptic adventure as seen through the eyes of a young woman who is the hope of her world, yet who holds fundamental doubts about whether she can live up to the task.
Set against the backdrop of a church festival in Thrissur, is a story of friendship, love and revenge that revolves around the lives of a rowdy, an aristocratic and their mutual friend.
A young woman is apprehended and held by police when they suspect that she is possessed by a demon.

A woman leaves an abusive husband to start a new life in Chicago, where she befriends a man undergoing an emotional crisis, who she does not know is a professional killer, and a detective, who is investigating the hit man.

A pair of lifelong friends looking to escape the violence and corruption of their homeland in Medellin, Columbia, and start a successful business in Mexico City find that no matter how far you run, you can never truly escape your past.

11-year-old Eskil and his father Roger moves around the power plants in northern Sweden. When they're about to move again, Eskil doesn't care where. But this time, he meets two people that changes everything.

Fibber McGee enlists the help of Edgar Bergen and Charlie McCarthy in enticing an aircraft manufacturer to build a factory in the small town of Wistful Vista. Based on the "Fibber McGee and Molly" radio series.
Three American friends travelling through Spain get stuck in a remote town where something very dangerous is changing the town's people.

Follow a debonair colonel and a brilliant botanist on a nail-biting covert journey through Taliban-held back country to recover from ruthless thieves the rarest of poppies with such unique DNA it's capable of making anyone invincible.
A homeless man is struck by lightning and finds himself with the blessing of increased intelligence and the curse of seeing evil entities everywhere he goes.

movie_name: Casolaro Protocol: The Last Circle - III
synopsis: Disavowed CIA analyst must find a jailed hacker to redesign a forbidden technology (PROMIS) and stop Octopus using a pandemic threat to enforce global depopulation program.
In Confessions of a Serial Killer, a film makers obsession grows so great that he is willing to do anything to achieve it, even murder.
A quiet neighborhood prepares for the end of the world after a conspiracy theorist doomsday prepper moves in.

If student Peder Pedersen had the same interest in his legal studies, as for everything that has to do with detectives and crimes, he would - instead of being involved in a terrific crime gang - have long been considered lawyer.

Husband and wife, Richard and Rachel Kline, find themselves deep in the wooded wilderness, after their small plane crashes into the trees. The pilot is killed on impact, leaving Richard and Rachel injured and alone.
Based on the Robert Penn Warren novel. The life of populist Southerner Willie Stark, a political creature loosely based on Governor Huey Long of Louisiana.
A geologist aids the escape of a young woman whose father was murdered to recover forged oil documents.

movie_name: SPIT: The Story of a Caveman and a Chicken
synopsis: A quirky caveman sets out on a journey to find his family after they accidentally bury him alive and along the way he meets a very unusual traveling partner; a Chicken.
In the dying days of WWII, a battalion of Russian soldiers is lured into the secret lab of a deranged scientist and forced to face off against an army of horrific flesh-and-metal war machines.
A woman helps her lover marry an heiress and kills him when he refuses to share the spoils.
CASE 30 tells the story of a murder case which has been assigned to Crime Branch Officer Arjun bharadwaj. How Arjun investigates and unthreads the case is the rest of the story.
Limit is about Olivia's eye opening journey to experiencing the limitless possibilities of life with the help of Bianca, a ball of fire with passion.
An underworld kingpin recruits people endowed with 'Luck' from across the globe to take part in a series of challenges designed to test their 'Luck' factor, as gamblers around the world bet on them.

Never is a long time. Stephen Ryder swore he would never return to New Mexico after a tragic ordeal. When his Mother dies, he is forced back home to confront his past, while falling back in love with the woman he left all those years ago.

An older woman suffering from dementia is convinced that her young live-in nurse is out to kill her and take her life's fortune. But people are not always who we think they are. And dementia has a way of unraveling the truth.
A political activist is convinced that her guest is a man who once tortured her for the government.
A future where quantum mechanics are integrated into every decision humans make.
After the sudden death of his wife, Ezequiel lives sad and resigned in solitude. Until the day that an extra-terrestrial being appears in his life and changes the color of his destiny.
Nothing is left to the imagination in this sexy gay tale about love and the meaning of life.
What is important in life? Getting money by losing moral values, relations etc or leading a life with conviction and thus winning hearts and trust of near and dear.
Follows the evolution of four relationships over the course of a single night at a Kentucky party.

Tired of being on the social fringe, four 8th graders make a daring pact to go analog and give up their phones, video games, and technology for a summer of "real life" firsts that change them forever.

The interwoven lives, loves and histories of a coven of vampires - who all run a hair salon in present day America - are explored through their peculiar professional practices, which attract the attention of the local police department.

A new form of entertainment. The Cleveland Symphony Youth Orchestra preforms a hallucinatory mixture of sounds along with animated interpretations, equally keen to challenge the orthodoxy of the classical music world.
A chimney sweep and a shepherdess seek to escape from the clutches of a tyrannical king.

movie_name: Aladdin 3477- I: The Jinn of Wisdom
synopsis: In the year 3477, a scrappy thief from Hong Kong becomes obsessed with the Princess of India and sets off on a globe-trotting journey that leads him to an ancient sage.
A military experiment to create a race of super-warriors go awry, and legions of murderous zombies are unleased upon a surburan neighborhood.
Two siblings witness a murder and bring the killer to justice, only to discover that they have put themselves in a dangerous game of cat and mouse.

The true story of the border town of Juarez, Mexico where since the mid-1990s thousands of women have gone missing or turned up as sun-burnt corpses in the desert. Can new police captain Blanca Bravo stop the savagery?
100 Million worth diamond which was supposed to reach the regional office of Royal Bank gets stolen while on its way for the delivery.
At a student party someone has died. But who is it and why did it happen? Told in fractured time lines this multi-stranded ensemble will keep the audience guessing until the very end.
A water-borne virus has strained humanity to the brink of extinction: a self-isolating survivor with a haunting past must protect her deepest secret from four threatening intruders.

Professor Preobrazhensky puts courageous experiences, trying to turn a dog in equal to in all of the person. As a result somebody turns out Doggies. Unfortunately, experience proves that it is better for dog to remain a dog.

Three friends (two guys and one girl) retreat deep into the wilderness for some camping, but after finding a dead body buried near their campsite, they are preyed upon by a shape-shifting cursed entity. Nothing is as it seems.
A woman returns to the USA after a German U-boat sank her ship, and finds out that someone wants to kill her for her inheritance.
Thomas, a scientist, lives in a childless marriage. When his wife travels to Copenhagen he begins an affair with a girl of 19. The girl and large amounts of drugs disappears from Thomas laboratory.
Based on a short story by Yaakov Shabtai.
When troublemaker Stefan finds himself on the Naughty List, he must find a way to return home after a Christmas demon named Krampus whisks him away to a dangerous magical land.
A hero who doesn't exist must save America from another enemy we never knew we had.
Axel Foley returns to Beverly Hills to help Taggart and Rosewood investigate Chief Bogomil's near-fatal shooting and the series of "alphabet crimes" associated with it.
Sophie is being hunted by evil forces that have converged on the earth in a bid to use her to take over the galaxy once ruled by her kin, the mighty and ruthless race known as the Titans.
When Renard the Fox's mischievous pranks go too far, King Lion is forced to attempt to bring the trickster to justice.
Godzilla is threatened by two new forces: Mogera - another UN built machine; and Space Godzilla - a beast spawned from Godzilla's particles in space.

Naomi Turner is celebrating her 30th birthday but a night of alcohol and drugs leads to a hangover with no memory and Naomi missing. As her husband, Justin Turner searches for her, he finds nothing but secrets and lies.

In two weeks absence of his wife, a young brilliant architect has to look after his two little girls as a clueless father. In the meantime he got a deadline of the most important project in his career.
A man who lives at the beach in despair after losing his wife finds a naked young woman washed up on the waves one day.
A black man is opposed to his sister's falling in love with a white man.

Ford Adams regains consciousness in Boston, bloody and suffering from amnesia. Information he eventually uncovers (with the help of Marie Smith) connects him to a well-known producer--who's just been murdered.
Peter McShade is a hitman, whose contract involves killing the major mobster of the Iberian Peninsula, but nothing is what it seems.

Kurt, combat veteran with PTSD and hallucinations, fortifies his home and builds a secret underground shelter due to doomsday like weather changes. He gets a security job to pay for it and his boss' cute daughter for company.
Aliens punish one of their own by sending him to earth. The alien is very violent, and when the body he occupies is damaged, he is forced to find another.
Balu (Sai Dharma Tej ), a cab driver, gets involved in a fight against the mafia when he comes across a child that the mob wants dead.
A soldier spends the weekend with an actress after being stood up by her friend. Will he be able to change her cynical attitude towards love?

Hendrik's marriage gets strained after their wedding gift - a yellow canoe - vanishes. Searching for the boat he finds himself stumbling over dead bodies, and quickly becomes a suspect in Inspector Mahler's murder investigation.

The widowed Catherine is busy trying to protect herself and her son from a local criminal organization. When Nick Boon and Catherine's lives cross paths, they find themselves leaning on each other to protect everything they stand for.
A pair of teenagers come up with a plan to ensure their families' futures when an occupying alien race's promise of economic prosperity leaves most of humanity impoverished and desperate.
The life of an overweight, unhappy cook is changed after a kind, beautiful college drop-out comes to work as a waitress at his and his mother's road-side restaurant.
The peaceful life of a middle aged architect Francis turns upside down after the street attack.

A young woman (Symphony) living in Atlanta has a loving boyfriend, great friends and a Grandmother who worries like any other. But one night things change Symphony's life forever. A choice has to be made, kill or be killed.

A man races through the city at night, narrating the events that lead to the present apocalypse and trying to escape the disease he believes is the cause of it all. A disease that, in its current mutation, causes heads to explode.
A sweeping, epic tale of a martial arts warrior who attempts to defy a kingdom to be with his love.
Four high school girls in Echo Park deal with everyday adolescent issues: life, family, school, love, and felony crimes.
When a boxer is murdered a newspaper reporter tries to frame the boxer's sister, a nightclub owner, for the crime.
Who's killing the college students during the annual Harvest Festival?
In this first ever feature film from Chamber 10, a small student film crew decides to film on location at a remote destination where nothing is as it seems.
In Cold War London, young American Melinda Greyton marries British Army Major Michael Curragh, who is a Communist spy working for the Soviets.
A young woman falls in love with an angel who is sent to earth to fight demons.
When a terrorist's body, infected with a stolen chemical, is cremated by the US military, a virus is unintentionally released into the atmosphere over a small island.

Benoît, jeune père de famille, mène une vie heureuse et sans histoire. Un jour, son père détective privé, disparaît mystérieusement. Benoît va découvrir la part dombre dun père quil pensait...                See full synopsis »
Phil, 10 years old, living with his mother, has fallen in love with a girl of his age. He also likes skateboarding with his friends.

A man becomes obsessed with facts and events that have been collectively misremembered by thousands of people. Believing the phenomena to be the symptom of something larger, his obsession eventually leads him to question reality itself.

movie_name: Battle in Space: The Armada Attacks
synopsis: A series of shorts depicting a future in 2420 after aliens and powerful space wizards enslaved human villages until a group of rebels organize a counter attack against their alien overlords by piloting fully loaded spaceships.
A mild-mannered software consultant begins to change after suffering an animal bite. As unbelievable as it may be, he thinks he's figured out what's going on. He has no idea.

Shannon Cable looks after a weird old house that is haunted by a trio of singing ghosts known as the Funky Soul Retrievers. Joined by this supernatural trio, Shannon must confront the real threat that haunts the house.
A strangler is loose on a British estate, and he not only strangles his victims but brands an "M" onto their foreheads before he decapitates them.
With his noble squire by his side, a retired country gentleman sets out on an adventure to right the wrongs of the world.
Andy and Maggie, a young Irish couple, travel to England as the result of an unplanned pregnancy, where Maggie will face the biggest decision of her life.

movie_name: The Weiss Album: Star of the Unborn
synopsis: Adaptation of Franz Werfel's STAR OF THE UNBORN - a disheartened Greenpeace researcher goes looking for his girlfriend lost at sea during a whale watching expedition and finds himself 100,010 years in the future on the eve of a world war.
Pastor Estus W. Pirkle preaches about hell, where all non-Christians will suffer eternal torment. He's also visited by two self-professed "Christians" who don't believe in hell.

While on a voyage to North America, a colonial woman believes that a deceased, attractive woman, murdered in their shared space, is still alive and attacking her when everyone else on the ship is unaware.
A young Russian boxer makes a comeback after going against all odds. When he accidentally kills his opponent in the ring, the son of a powerful mafia kingpin, he must fight for his own life.
A nice young couple move into an eerie house which is located in a small Louisiana town, unaware of its violent history, and soon find themselves tormented by the previous owners.
Minty (Adam Byrne) decides to go on the deep web and begins to deeper and deeper until he is shrouded in darkness. Welcome To The Dark Web.

movie_name: Joniko and the Kush Ta Ka
synopsis: A brave Alaskan Indian boy journeys to find his father and overcomes the perils of the wilderness only to find himself confronted with the task of vanquishing the demons of ancient legends.
With the help of a memory chip that allows people to relive their lives, a man is able to deconstruct his fractured relationship with his deceased wife from her point of view.
The chance to flush out a corrupt politician with a mission that goes badly wrong.
After being abducted by extra terrestrials, Jean and her friends are committed to a top secret government run mental institution to undergo tests and be brainwashed.
While investigating the disappearance of a chemist, a detective uncovers a larger conspiracy to unsettle Calcutta.

"A nine year old kid is extremely troubled with the fact that we are all going to die. He begins a psychological and spiritual journey looking for the real meaning of death until an unexpected experience will transform his whole understanding of the thing we call Life."
Star-crossed lovers fight for survival on-board the first cruise ship in space when disaster strikes and aliens attack.

A single mother and her daughter are forced to stop by a black car on the way home. When they regain consciousness, they are in a Karst cave with seven strangers. The game is to find out a killer among the nine.

A little girl, Mary, is disappointed when she doesn't receive a pet rabbit for her birthday, but then she gets one after all, in the form of an imaginary friend. Mary's parents can't see him, even though she insists that he is real.
Saajan Bakery Since 1962 revolves around a family-owned bakery that faces sibling rivalry between the two children of the Bakery's founder Saajan.
A retired Sheriff's Detective had the perfect life and career on the outside. On the inside; he will finally face the demons he created through lies and corruption.
The movie tells the story of a young girl, who goes from being a shop girl to a billionaire, after her father leaves her his empire to run.
The Chinese version Detective Holmes story, with every well-known characters-Holmes, Watson, Adler, etc.-of a different gender and 20-year-old.
Octonauts must find a way to hold back hungry swarms of coral eating starfish to save a new friend's fragile reef home.
Mark marries Marnie although she is a habitual thief and has serious psychological problems, and tries to help her confront and resolve them.
A parable on the moribund human bonds in a fast-paced world, which is a warning that poignantly highlights the futility of life and death.

A murder investigation of a security guard where two people are the prime suspects. Surasha, A lady in her late 30s and Ranjan, a man in his late 40s. They have two different versions of the crime. But there is a third version, the truth.
The military's attempt to shoot down an orbiting satellite unleashes a space-borne epidemic on a remote, small town.
After an alien saves his life, a rebellious teenager tries to become a part of the strange society that killed his mother.
THIS ACTION-COMEDY FILM IS A WACKY TAKE-OFF ON AMERICA TELEVISION'S "CHARLIE'S ANGELS".
Alice Carter has the ability to see visions. How did she come of this unique gift? While trying to discover the answers, her visions become more disturbing.
A group of martial-arts warriors has only six days to save the Earth from an extra-dimensional invasion.
Evil Queen Himiko and her army invade a small rural province in order to kill a Phoenix in order to achieve immortality, a young boy survives and goes on an adventure to amend the injustices.
A young woman is desperate to save her company from a take-over. When she hears that being in a relationship will get her a deal, she hires a model to be her fake boyfriend.
After his partner's death, a downtrodden cop must choose between resigning in defeat or taking one final shot at cleaning up the city and finding vengeance.
