The door of time opens between the swordsman who wants to seize the legendary divine sword at the end of the Goryeo Dynasty and those who chase after an alien prisoner imprisoned in a human body in 2022.
A cop finds a mysterious map from the Age of Exploration inside a stolen painting, and enlists the aid of his antiquarian brother to solve its riddles .
18 years before the events of 2nd Generation. 1st Generation follows Aaron Russel Sr and Bee Russel as they fight to protect their son who is considered a lethal weapon to the United States.
Teenage outcasts attempt to fit in while attending their first rave.

movie_name: Jason and the Argonauts: The Kingdom of Hades
synopsis: The quest to find the Golden Fleece is over, but now Jason and his band of Argonauts must embark on a new and more difficult journey, the journey home.
The ghost of a young German woman of the turn of the century appears to taxi drivers in the streets of present-day Chile.
An naive personal assistant is drawn into a murder
Story of a very successful singer/songwriter, enjoying night life until a daughter of an old dear friend stepped into his life and changed his life forever.

Queer are the ways of smugglers in which they try to hoodwink the police of every nation. But the police too have their methods smarter and surer to nab them. The police was tipped off that...                See full synopsis »
Europol Agent Tom Brindle (Timothy Hutton) is called to Barcelona, Spain, to track down the notorious serial killer known as Pygmalion.

movie_name: Spacehunter: Adventures in the Forbidden Zone
synopsis: On a distant planet inhabited by mutants, two bounty-hunters race to rescue three Earth female captives from the clutches of an evil mutant warlord.
SOME HEROES ARE BORN OUT OF STRUGGLE
Reyhan is forced to face the facts she does not know about her arrested lover Selcuk.
A collection of human stories in Stockholm, where a taxi becomes the link between them. One night a taxi driver disappears.
Dark horror comedy with a twist.

In the future, a health nut and his tag-along girlfriend become trapped in a drive-in theater that has become a concentration camp for outcast youths, who are placated with new wave music, junk food, drugs, exploitation movies, and racism.

In 1944 Chang Chin's father was murdered by the Japanese with the help of Ching Tang and Fan Hsi-Shang, two collaborators led by Fung Mu. Now a grown up and a master of kung fu, Chang is ready to revenge his father.
A singer/songwriter falls in love with a girl who can't hear the music she inspires him to write.
A hitman is caught in a crossfire when he gets lured into working for two organizations. He seeks redemption after deciding to quit, but things don't go according to plan.
An animated retelling of Charles Dickens' classic novel about a Victorian-era miser taken on a journey of self-redemption, courtesy of several mysterious Christmas apparitions.
Superstition never killed anyone...until now Voodoo is unleashed in a small backwoods bayou town in the form of a large hairy beast which comes face to face with an unlikely hero with his own curse.

A bunch of friends met up for a barbecue in a big house in L.A. They all have something in their past and/or are screwed-up. Arguments, fights, murders and some sex occur in this talky drama that very slowly connects together.

William Thomas Healthaway II embarks on a fateful journey of supernatural discovery beginning with the Battle of Pickett's Mill. "Cold Mountain(2003)" with elements of "Dreamcatcher(2003)" and "The Sender(1982)"
A group of professional athletes conspire to steal back money from the team owners who are exploiting and underpaying them.
A young journalist must recount her version of events when a dead body winds up in her apartment.
A would-be songwriter and a would-be inventor run a cigar stand and get mixed up in the murder of a song publisher.
Brave soldier goes to Hell to save the souls of a beautiful princess and her maid (fairy tale).
Follows three small time criminals from Dublin's North Inner City as they each aspire to be somebody in a fast changing society.
A man from the countryside lives only with his three daughters. Away from everything and everyone, they face the drama and despair of their own lives.
Ex-Police Commissioner Lenders makes a staggering discovery while investigating a murder: one of the victims comes from another time period.
Small town mechanic meets aspiring country singer. Is it love at first sight for this young adult couple or just mutual attraction in a musical without warning?
A couple travels to the Australian rainforest for a hypnotic retreat to repair their dysfunctional relationship where they are faced with their inner traumas plagued by their deepest fantasies.
Gwen is a young girl adopted by a nomad tribe in a desert post-apocalyptic world. When Gwen's friend is kidnapped, she and an old woman called Roseline embark on a trip to bring him back.
As a small-town social worker investigates a commune headed by a spiritual leader calling himself Moses, she discovers a dead child, sadistic rituals, and ruthless mental and physical abuse.
Crack police officer Damon (aka: #426) is ordered to infiltrate the triad as mounting crime waves hit Hong Kong.
Claudia Lanza can not overcome the death of her son, Marco, killed in an accident for which she blames her husband, Andrea.

movie_name: Una calle entre tú y yo
synopsis: When the national league coach selects Luis, a football star, to participate in a match against the US team, his father forces him to leave his girlfriend and his nemesis.
Four friends get involved in a diamond heist gone bad and have to run from the mob and the police. Their earlier bonds of trust and allegiance break when money is on the line.
A man being held captive seeks acceptance and closure for violent actions that have unfolded.

movie_name: La cripta de las condenadas: Parte II
synopsis: 100 years later. The condemned women are still under the spell of Fata Morgana.
A hoarder's stockpile becomes a deadly trap for a demolition crew.
Heroic hackers must defeat Vladimir Putin and evil aliens from taking over the world.

Financially struggling, a married indie band duo regretfully takes a job on a children's show ("The Rumperbutts"). Despite the money and success, their relationship turns to one of resentment. On one extraordinary evening, a magical man leads them on a path of rediscovery and gives them a second chance at happiness.

movie_name: Bubble Bubble Meows and the Things That Happen in Movies Like This
synopsis: Bubble Bubble Meows and his cohorts cooperate to conquer a cold-hearted condiment coup.
A martial artist discovers a conspiracy between an escort service and bandits who are taking advantage of a small town.
Four teens are swept into the adventure of a lifetime involving a legendary creature and a mystery from the past that will change their lives forever.

A woman transformed into a giant after she is struck by a meteorite on her wedding day becomes part of a team of monsters sent in by the U.S. government to defeat an alien mastermind trying to take over Earth.
A man who denies the value of committed relationships meets a woman and has a change of heart.
An ex-con goes looking for his late cellmate's hidden loot.

movie_name: Honey, I Blew Up the Kid
synopsis: The Szalinski family is back, this time hilarious disaster strikes when an experiment causes their new toddler son to grow many stories tall.

A group of youngsters led by PK, the son of a political heavyweight are on a journey to their resort and the Karma returns in various forms through all the sins they have committed in the past. Will the Karma triumph over the tyranny ?
A young couple visit a property left from the late father's estate. A haunted and disturbing past unravels. The main character has to overcome his personal issues and learn how to move forward.
A Man which does acrobatic with motorcycle, dies during an action. His children, Setareh and Shahab, decide to continue his work on "wall of death".
Tells the tale of a nasty teen A-list Hollywood actress, who is transported into a mirror world as she must capture her evil reflection, before she is replaced forever.

Lucas and Lily both love serial killing, although for different reasons: she's a sociopath, he's working through Mommy Issues (with Jesus's consent!). Will their Romeo and Juliet love story survive? Settle down, have some tea and find out.

Martin Malone, a lonely voyeur, is caught and arrested following a misstep. As he nears the end of his court-mandated rehabilitation, Martin suspects that someone or something far more sinister is watching him.

An international team of agents compete in an elite fighting tournament to infiltrate a tyrant's compound on the eve of a global security threat. Based on the characters of the Capcom video game series.
Weapon trade for half a billion, and the Olsen Gang is involved. They plan their final coup, and finally is Valgjerd allowed to participate, but not without some challenges.
JUPÍA is a mystery / dark fantasy film inspired by the Taino legends of the Caribbean region and how these myths influence our present in unexpected ways.
After investigating her boyfriend's suicide, a young woman and her friend discover a live video stream that unleashes a nightmarish chain of events.

A shark exterminator must retrieve a rare diamond from the stomach of a massive black-finned white shark; however, the powerful local crime lord has, too, set his sights on the gem. Will the fearless shark killer live up to his reputation?
Asha loves Baldev Singh. She is pregnant and deceived by him. After years she comes back for avenge..
In South America, an American engineer is asked by his boss to build a mountain railroad tunnel following a shorter but more dangerous route.

Gastón and Daniela are about to go to a party when a call will take them to Uruguay. Daniela is pregnant. Between surprise and joy, a small strangeness begins to grow. They say goodbye with melancholy and that climate is accentuated more.
An auctioneer's daughter and a rich buyer's emissary fall for each other while trying to keep a rare wine out of the hands of evil doers.

A teenager finds herself transported to a deep forest setting where a battle between the forces of good and evil is taking place. She bands together with a ragtag group of characters to save their world--and ours.
A blind Vietnam vet, trained as a swordfighter, comes to America and helps to rescue the son of a fellow soldier.
A latchkey child living in the industrial city of Kawasaki confronts his loneliness through his escapist dreams of Monster Island and friendship with Minilla.
An unscrupulous archaeologist searches for Alexander's treasure, using clues he finds by desecrating historical sites and artifacts; but he is not the only one who is trying to find the treasure.
With a Kansai syndicate vying for Tokyo, one man reunites with his roguish half-brother in the midst of negotiations, when all hell breaks loose.
Based on a book by Earl Derr Biggers, "The Agony Column".
Three British subjects arrive in the land of the Rajah of Rukh during the time of the British Raj.

A wrestler gains super power through a mystical mask who originally fought Spider-Man in a charity wrestling match in which he nearly unmasked the webslinger before being stung by Spider-Man with a paralyzing poison.
Caine Shipton was attacked & killed by Yeti.Then many suddenly saw Yeti. So no one wants to go to Everest for fear. Kakababu and Santu go to Everest to solve this mystery. KBBO-AINOS
Trelkovsky moves into an apartment whose previous tenant jumped out of the window. The young man witnesses increasingly mysterious phenomena and becomes the victim of his neighbors.
A community in the Brazilian countryside has its order disturbed by the arrival of outsiders: a group of teenagers who find out, the hard way, that the Devil exists.
15-year-olds Hayley and Taylor Ryan secretly use their wits and their telepathic "twin-sense" to uncover the truth about their town's victims and culprits.
A young boy named Pelle falls in love with the drug addict Lena. Then he and his friend Proffen tries to save her from the drugs.
Spirou and Fantasio have to team up when Count Pacôme de Champignac is kidnapped by the men of Zorglub.
Our hero, Halvar the Brave, seeks vengeance aboard a witch-born chopper, journeying across a psychedelic landscape on a quest to defeat the deadly beast Mördvél for the slaying of his bride.
Jacob, an everyday guy, ends up with a job collecting souls for death.
Chief of police Carla Renzi and the criminal anthropologist Mara Young continue to follow the Dossier "Botticelli Murders" - Incredible facts happen around them.

Identical twins Annie and Hallie, separated at birth and each raised by one of their biological parents, discover each other for the first time at summer camp and make a plan to bring their wayward parents back together.
Three of the most popular girls at Reagan High accidentally kill the prom queen with a jawbreaker when a kidnapping goes horribly wrong.
Eight cops are organized into an anti-vice squad. They risk their lives and test their brotherhood in every mission they accomplish.
An orphaned cheetah becomes the best friend and pet of a young boy living in South Africa.
Several people contemplate, and attempt suicide for all different reasons. We delve in to what does it take for someone to want too take their own life.

movie_name: The Blind Man Who Did Not Want to See Titanic
synopsis: Jaakko and Sirpa have never met face to face but used to talk on the phone every day. When he heard about her declining health, he decides to go meet her in another city ,and when he saw he was blind and paralyzed from the chest down.

When wealthy treasure hunter Cara Loft meets reclusive art collector, Dr. Scrotus, the sexy adventurer is thrust head on into the greatest and most dangerous erotic adventure of her life: the search for the three sacred "wombs."
A former Special Forces soldier gets caught between warring crime syndicates as he fights to save the life of a young girl.

An intense crime drama about a Canadian drug lord who amasses a fortune from the cocaine and marijuana trade. His empire is threatened by the Mafia, Hell's Angels and the police who are all trying to bring him down.
An innocent young backpacker traveling through Europe is hunted by a time-traveler and confronted by a past he no longer remembers.
After avenging the death of his father and brother, a man must now content with another vengeful male.

Aima tells her babysitter that the Witch, created in a game of make-believe, will never stop chasing them. Imagination rules as they march toward their showdown with the evil Witch. The unreal becomes reality, but the consequences remain.
A swordsman must stop an evil wizard bent on world domination.
A mysterious soldier tries to survive a war torn, future United States, while running from his past.
Foul-mouthed mutant mercenary Wade Wilson (a.k.a. Deadpool) assembles a team of fellow mutant rogues to protect a young boy with supernatural abilities from the brutal, time-traveling cyborg Cable.

Insp. Jacques Clouseau teams up with a squad of International detectives who are just as bumbling as he is. Their mission: Stop a globe-trotting thief who specializes in stealing historical artifacts.

Four aging animals - a donkey, a dog, a rooster, and a cat - are rejected by their ungrateful owners and thrown out to the streets. Together, they drive a group of robbers out of their hut and live out the rest of their lives in peace.
A group of kids tries to help a old music conductor finish his last symphony.
Joan's (Patricia Medina) mother wants her to marry her pompous boss although she loves a soldier (Jimmy Handley).
In the final battle, The Chosen One returns to stop his sworn enemy.
The young girl Lora has to change her life to survive.
UFOs invade Canada in a rapid-fire, feature length collage of over 450 Canadian feature films. 'Prepare to face the power of the ultimate dimension!'
The family of a dying man celebrates his wake while the man is still alive, showing their darker, selfish ambitions and trying to take the best part of the inheritance.
Romeo enters a Virtual Reality Matrix Tale of Romeo and Juliet with the help of a mysterious video game graphics card powered by nanotechnology.

A wife and husband have two very different families, one is positive, loving, and supporting while the other is negative, and disapproving, can these two families come together and meet eye to eye and become one or will they fall apart.
A police officer is on a mission to nab a criminal,who does murder in a same mysteric pattern.
An aspiring actress finds herself in a jam when a gangster, who is backing the show she is in, is found dead in her apartment.

A damaged love-cynic battles his preconceived notions about how relationships should be, as he navigates an interesting new living situation which is made even more complex as they romantically cross the roommate boundaries.

Once upon a time, a princess named Erin Almeda played the innocent heart of their school geek, Leonard Jamieson. Seven years later, they crossed paths. And it seemed like their roles have been reversed.
A family adventure for all ages. When three mischievous orphans Howie, Alicia and Jeff, have a Chance encounter with a mysterious fortune teller, their lives are changed for ever.
A high-powered attorney duct tapes her adulterous husband to the toilet ... right before their home is invaded by burglars.
The adventures of two opera singers, who are descendants of vampires and wolf men as they trek through a dream-like realm and battle cannibals and giant dragons.
A story about the takeover of the Sung Dynasty by the Ching and two kids that were saved when the royal family was being killed.

Kidnapped from an Australian train station, Joella, Peter, and Liane are taken on a rocket to the Galax-Arena, where children stolen from Earth perform death-defying stunts for the amusement of the inhabitants of the planet Vexak.
A hospital nurse is recruited by the police to watch a household where a suspicious death has occurred.
Carmen's caught in a virtual reality game designed by the Kids' new nemesis, the Toymaker. It's up to Juni to save his sister, and ultimately the world.
Continuation of the film "Moscow-Cassiopea": cosmonauts-schoolchildren fly to an extraterrestrial civilization in distress.
The lines between reality and fiction, and good and bad blur when both a nihilistic detective and a serial killer's affairs with a mysterious girl overlap.
An ex-cop is hired to track down a serial killer who carries out his killings according to Bengali poetry.
After going to search for the disappearance of George Pig, the Police Officer has to try to save the world.

movie_name: Dracula vs the Ninja on the Moon
synopsis: A Ninja is sent to the moon to defeat Count Dracula who is hiding there
Joshua becomes interested in a young lady he has helped, and continues in the hope that she will eventually reciprocate his affection.
A criminal plot to control produce and dairy products during the wartime emergency is foiled by an courageous undercover city market official.
Martin lives alone on a Caribbean island. On an excursion to the port city, he helps Nelly, who has fled from her groom.
Eddy Ko is the maverick star pupil of an honorable school who secretly engages in underground "Black Boxing" bouts, a black market sport off limits to the school.
Story of a mentally disturbed playboy serial killer who hunts kills many women.
The crew of a colony ship, bound for a remote planet, discover an uncharted paradise with a threat beyond their imagination, and must attempt a harrowing escape.
A couple goes to a Bed and Breakfast for a weekend and immediately starts to realize that something is not right. Now a relaxing weekend is turning into a fight for their lives.
A detective investigates a murder, only to find that the victim is... himself. Soon, he discovers multiple versions of himself, not all of them friendly.

During summer holidays spent in an old palace, an inquisitive teenager is looking for a treasure, which was hidden by a Napoleonic soldier. What he's unaware of is that a bunch of criminals is also looking for the same thing.
An anxious shut-in moves into a haunted apartment, hiring a stranger to perform an exorcism which quickly takes a horrific turn.

The maniacal Harley Quinn emerges ten years after the Joker's capture at the end of The Dark Knight, in search of him, leaving a now war torn caped crusader to combat the wave of death and anarchy she unleashes.
When a socially inept genius inventor is on the edge of a breakthrough, he immediately becomes the hunted target of mercenaries and law enforcement in a deadly international cat and mouse chase."
A confusing dramatization about the factual mystery of Prince Oak Oakleyski, as many people were puzzling out. This baffling, rousing movie insinuated who Prince Oak Oakleyski really is.

After being accidentally recruited as a spy, 12-year-old Ejen Ali has now grown to embrace his role in secret agency Meta Advance Tactical Agency (MATA) to protect the futuristic city of Cyberaya from outside threats.
A ragtag group of youngsters band together after the American Civil War to form the Texas Rangers, a group charged with the dangerous, ruthless duty of cleaning up the West.
A man is found in an airport, dead of a mysterious disease. A race begins to save humanity from what could be a global plague.

movie_name: Houligans: Kato ta heria ap' ta niata
synopsis: A young man joins a group of hooligans.
A new scientific discovery reanimates a slain man who is either a missing person or a gangster's archenemy.

What if the Rocky Horror Picture Show ended differently? What if, instead of killing Frank, Riff died and left everyone trapped in the castle? Based on the fanfiction "It's All Over" by Cececat, aka M. L. Lanzillotta

After an experiment gone wrong, a virus that turns people into zombies spreads throughout New Guinea. A female reporter and her cameraman, and a team of four commandos sent to investigate try to survive the onslaught.
A low-tech FX film about the horrors of war and robots.
Plotline is being developed and held under wraps
Helene, Mathilde and Ben Scappini are traveling to the Parisian suburbs to see their dying father. On the road to the family house, the siblings are learning to rediscover each other.

movie_name: El miedo no anda en burro
synopsis: A maid and her boss's dog are the inheritors of a large fortune of money, properties and mansions. However, the boss's furious relatives scheme several unsuccessful plans to get rid of them.
After surviving a tough childhood, a young woman becomes a vigilante, fighting to protect abused women.

One peaceful day on Earth, two remnants of Freeza's army named Sorube and Tagoma arrive searching for the Dragon Balls with the aim of reviving Freeza. They succeed, and Freeza subsequently seeks revenge on the Saiya-jin.

A young boy is lying in bed screaming for his mother, but mama is away performing military exercises. People flee through dark basements to the thunder of bomber planes and an insistently peppy, upbeat jazz score.
Big-city girl goes to the country and meets a special horse and young cowboy who teaches her to barrel race, while her mother reconnects with a local rancher she was in love with 20 years earlier.
A scout troupe leader awakens to find his boys missing in the middle of a harsh Maine winter.

This is "Operation Paris Express". A 5 year investigation, leading to the biggest ecstasy ring bust in history. This tells the narrative from one of the females unfortunate enough to be involved in a whirlwind of life threatening events.
The death of Padaiyappa's father destroys his family. But his luck changes, and he is able to lead a prosperous life, until his nemesis plots to ruin his happiness once more.
A crazed scientist invents a serum that induces a catatonic state in whoever it is injected into. He uses the serum to paralyze his enemies, so that he can bury them alive.
Series of events leading to football fans war on the streets of Belgrade.
A manager and his cousin plot to blackmail a business heir.
Alka Singh, the leader of a political party, and her obsessive love for Rohan Mehra, a rising star of Bollywood.
An old Laotian hermit discovers that the ghost of a road accident victim can transport him back in time fifty years to the moment of his mother's painful death.
Two families struggle with very real issues. But faith and love win the the day and the couples choose life.
Six eager students strike out to explore and record live footage of supernatural activity at an abandoned plantation, but one unsettled spirit gives them more than they asked for.
After the disappearance of a young scientist on a business trip, his son and wife struggle to cope, only to make a bizarre discovery years later - one that may bring him home.
A love story between a Spanish conquistador and a Native tribal princess from the Hispaniola island.
In a quiet suburban town, a group of neighbors must survive the night when their friends and family become sleepwalking monsters.

Chung and Peter are two loyal friends. When a loan shark and his heavies start to put considerable pressure on Peter because of his copious debt, Chung devises a plan that puts the villains behind bars.
A newspaper editor in a small agricultural town finds himself going against the people in the town when he gets involved in the plight of the area's fruit pickers, who are mostly Mexican.
A Special undercover Police Squad work to bring down a huge drug trafficking syndicate Istanbul. Larry Anderson

Jimmy takes his dead drug dealer's cash and must unload it and dodge his associates. At a massive house party in the heart of Little Athens, everyone is about to face the consequences of their reckless pursuit of sex, money and acceptance.

Sherlock Holmes investigates when young women around London turn up murdered, each with a finger severed. Scotland Yard suspects a madman, but Holmes believes the killings to be part of a diabolical plot.

Julie, an American on vacation in Mexico, spots a giant, one-eyed amoeba rising from the ocean, but when she tries to tell the authorities, no one believes her. She finally teams up with a marine biologist in an attempt to destroy it.

The Green Oak Project is the 1st British superhero series of it's kind. It's a cross between Misfits meets Avengers. Characters ranging from human born superheroes, aliens and agents to name but a few.
A swashbuckling adventure which takes place in the mid-1800's on the South Pacific islands where bloody raids and battles were once the rule of the day.
A woman tormented by witchcraft calls on God to save her.
The story of Ching Shih, a prostitute turned pirate in 18th century China, who rose from humble beginnings to become the feared Pirate Queen.

movie_name: Kureyon Shin-chan: Chô arashi wo yobu kinpoko no yûsha
synopsis: Shin Chan gets his mother to finally buy him the last Ultra Hero sword, but when he opens the package there is only one rule inside. In addition to this confusion, Shin Chan meets Tostado, a dog just like Nevado but in black.
A group of kids acquire a rare video game rumored to be possessed by a demon who consumes the souls of those that play it.

Two souls connect on their path to eternity. Suddenly, brought back from the ethereal, with only glimpsing visions of their shared experience, they set out to find each other and regain that unbreakable connection ordained by destiny.

3 brothers studying at Copenhagen University are invited to Nøddebo vicarage for Christmas. A steam engine and later a sleigh get them there. The vicar has 2 daughters of 18 and 21. They all sing, ice-skate, dance and have fun.

movie_name: Angelito San Miguel at Ang Mga Batang City Jail
synopsis: Angelito leads a group of young ex-convicts who will risk going back to prison in order to fight a notorious syndicate.
Na Cha is sent to the land of the dead to fight the seven devils.
Relations between two families from different social backgrounds, where neither fathers nor mothers communicate. Despite all, their only son and only daughter befriend and eventually fall in love.
After his son is murdered by drug dealers, a snowplow driver starts seeking revenge.
The murders of three young girls are committed in a single night by a person dressed up as Joker. Can Vikram rescue himself from these murder cases? Will the cops arrest the real psycho killer?

On her last day of work, an acting student at the theater finds herself the target of a crazy killer who brings the deadly wolf from Grimm's dark fairy tales to life to slaughter all seven employees like little goats.
An anthology film consisting of three very different stories about love set in Europe and told in flashback.
On the coast of the Gulf of Mexico, the Native American tribe of chief Black Eagle clashes with the Mayan tribe of king Balam.
A witness under federal protection participates in a secret, high-tech version program allows him to disappear completely and begin a new life.
A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.
Set in a world devastated by a mysterious virus, the human race no longer finds itself alone.

Set in The City where Jonathan Kersky as a Stuntman at Theme park, had a motorcycle accident. After several times changed jobs, finally he got a job which makes saving someone's life and at the same time bring him into trouble with The Secret group.

Fed up with modern American living, two vagabonds rob a psychotic drug dealer and decide to flee the country, taking a road trip and beholding the beauties of the great American West, en route for Canada where they plan to start new lives.

A low security psychiatric ward is plagued by more than careless staff when a woman named Mira arrives. The patients must discover if the demons she is battling are a disorder, or something deadly about to commit them all permanently.

movie_name: Love Is for the Two of Us
synopsis: A perfect love team - for a perfect love game.
Siva, an investigative scribe, shares a live-in relationship with the rich and bratty Madhu. Madhu starts a restaurant with her friend's brother and this sparks off a break up between the two.
Harry, a self-proclaimed intellectual, searches for an epiphany while camping with his girlfriend Avis, unaware that she might be what he is searching for.
When a hostage-for-ransom exchange goes wrong, the F.B.I. sends an agent to Turkey to retrieve the ransom money and the hostage who's an important nuclear-weapon scientist.

Ryan is missing. Ford (his struggling actor roommate) and Mae (the drifter he slept with last night) turn amateur detective to solve the caper but find themselves in a dangerous web of rogues who are searching for him as well.
Glen, a former sperm donor and recently diagnosed sociopath, takes his daughter on a murder spree of his sperm-donated offspring in the dark comedy, 'Spermicide.'
Follows Catwoman in an attempt to steal a priceless jewel. This puts her squarely in the crosshairs of both a powerful consortium of villains, Interpol and Batwoman.
A reality show on an inhabited island where eight contestants must fight for their survival becomes more than it appears to be.

Kalle and his dad is having a long planned summer holiday at his grandparents in the countryside, where has made a hang-glider as planned. But when the father falls down with it, and dies, only an angel keeps Kalle on his feet.

A man is brought back from the dead to work in the hell of sugar cane plantations. 55 years later, a Haitian teenager tells her friends her family secret - not suspecting that it will push one of them to commit the irreparable.
A heart felt tale about a boy and his dog who set out to solve the death of the young boy's father.
A White Sea. a man, a boy, and an old man.
Two lovers struggle to stay together because of their uneven social status, setting up an epic saga to follow.

Thirteen years after the "Lawnmower Killer" killed her sister, high school student Mary Graves and obsessed detective Dick Harbinger are on the lookout for the killer to reappear during the annual Halloween Pumpkin Prom.
A group of strangers embark upon a tour of the macabre, and visit vital locations of an infamous murdering spree. Once the tour progresses, history begins to repeat itself.
Aspiring musician Miguel, confronted with his family's ancestral ban on music, enters the Land of the Dead to find his great-great-grandfather, a legendary singer.
When Professor Brainard experiments further on Flubber derivatives, he gets in trouble and only his students can help.
Two single parents, one man and one woman, along with their kids, have to involuntarily share a house for their holidays.
An insurance investigator runs into an ex-girlfriend, who is still as beautiful as he remembered her, but is now married. He soon finds himself involved in arson, blackmail, and murder.
With their parents preoccupied with their new careers, a young girl and her brother befriend a talking monkey who is struggling to be taken seriously as an actor.
Christ, a mixed-blooded, human-blooded and Phaya Yama (Devil), who is responsible for collecting thousand souls in order to meet with his mom in Hell for 10 minutes.
Bobby (Michael Duwe) fights for his life and his faith in a surburban high school. Only a girl named, Holly (Susan Fossen) can affect the thrilling outcome.

Hassan who is a skint wants to pay back the debt of his father to Malek Salman who is a fraud. In a virtual world Hassan became an imaginary person but the love of Malek Salman's daughter is hindering him from continuing on his mission.
Three teenage criminals break out of juvenile prison and head south to Mexico.

A fantasy from Ibsen's verse drama. Ne'er-do-well and braggart Peer Gynt has many adventures in varied countries, making and losing money, gaining fortune at others' expense, until he finds salvation in the love of Solveig.
Abby is determined to do anything to avenge her father's murder. Posing as a dominatrix, she enters the world of sadomasochism and sexual fantasies...a perfect setup for revenge!

12 y.o. Ida's dad'll die without a DKK1,500,000 operation. Ida plans to steal the money from the bank, her mom installed alarm systems in. She'll need her climbing skills, her 2 friends and 3 go-karts.

A student keeps a journal while a one-world government takes over the world. Years later, a soldier finds her journal and questions everything he believes.
Plot not disclosed.
A rich guy falls in love with an independent and strong-minded girl, and moves into her simple neighborhood to earn her love.
Whilst in hiding, a ruthless gangster falls in love with a young woman.
Sgt. ISAGANI GUERRERO, A COURAGEOUS POLICEMAN, ASSIDUOUSLY GATHERS EVIDENCES TO UNMASK A CORRUPT JUDGE.
A patriarch (Nedumudi Venu) of a royal family whose descendant was murdered, assigns the task of finding the culprit to two of his police officer nephews - Vivek (Jayaram) and Kishore (Indrajith).
The last and final sequal of Goopi-Bagha series as they invited at a palace of a king and their various attitudes as they are trapped by a astrologer cum imposter.
Yu is in a team of police chasing Kao, a rogue cop. There is a shootout in a banana plantation, during which a ghost is released.

A black dockworker Pedro getting mixed up with a gang of arms smugglers and falsely imprisoned on a charge of murder. He is finally released and Mr. Mil convinces him to become a luchador/wrestler under the name of "Black Power".
When her grave is disturbed by modern-day land developers, a 300-year-old witch is accidentally resurrected and terrorizes an English village.
3 ignorant kids break the rules of their grandma's house that will let the hell breaks loose.
After a man confesses to his wife that he has been unfaithful, she imagines all kinds of ways that historical figures such as Cleopatra and Joan of Arc might handle the situation.

Karhu is a middle-aged Finnish gangster following the steps of his grandfather. Karhu is running a small criminal enterprise and he wants plenty of more, but the gangster's life is very stressful, and it is taking its toll.
Injured scientist Eric Godfrey asks his protege to give him a fatal dose of opiates to end his misery. When he dies the doctor is accused of murder.
A man is shot in an underground car-park by a mysterious bearded man. As he dies he recollects the events that led him to this situation, including adulterous liaisons and jealous envy.

Gloria is a lawyer who throughout her career has never been able to defend someone who was not guilty. His new client seems to be not so different: a man accused of rape in a small town where no one believes his story.
As if getting pregnant weren't complicated enough, Lucy sets out to uncover the unsettling truth about her fertility doctor.
A story about Human beings and their relations which has a man in the center of it. Because of a car accident he has Alzheimer and must face a different new world.
The bear who went to war. The story of Wojtek, the only bear who became an enlisted soldier in WWII.
Fiona and John have fallen out of love. As they try to navigate a night filled with memories, questions, strangers and friends, they attempt to come to grips with the future as well as their past.

In this Sci-Fi thriller, when a group of friends go missing, the local Police are shocked at the return of a mysterious stranger. While searching for their missing friends, they uncover a dark secret and the truth behind the 'Grey Agenda'.

Ruthless armed robber Leon Hastings proposes that his brother in law; PC Eddie Rowe leaves the police and works for a security company so that he can provide inside information to facilitate his robberies.
Four single men hatch a plan to get intimate with members of the opposite sex.
The Solo ship and its crew continue to battle against the Buff Clan leading to the final battle that will determine the fate of all life in the universe

The alarm blips for the 6th time in an army base on a Swedish Island. Two female bird photographers try to stay hidden as Russian special forces "in ninja suits" make short work of the Swedish conscripts on their way to steal a secret code.
A young Hollywood couple stays with a rural family after crashing in a rainstorm in 1920s California.
A mysterious love triangle leads to a tragic shooting. Months later, eight members of a MySpace-esque chat room are being gruesomely murdered in the privacy of their own homes.
Jean-Marie buys an old Alsatian chest and installs it in his home. From that moment on, increasingly violent abnormal phenomena occur in the flat.
Abby looks after Tom, but her life changes - everything changes - when Tom's eye falls out.

movie_name: Legend of the Guardians: The Owls of Ga'Hoole
synopsis: When a young owl is abducted by an evil Owl army, he must escape with new-found friends and seek the legendary Guardians to stop the menace.
A man raised in the jungle by apes falls in love with a wealthy American heiress.
A philosophizing uninvited hitchhiker terrorizes a writer, who's selling dictionaries while he's struggling with writer's block.
A man's wife and kids suddenly disappear without explanation and are replaced by a Strange Woman claiming to be his wife.

In the year 2022, the eternally re-elected president MM decides to start a second war against the United Kingdom for the Islas Malvinas. A soldier will make the difference and discover the best kept secret of the island.
Aided by an ex-military officer, a young woman becomes an unwitting fugitive after discovering that her son's catatonic state may be at the heart of a global conspiracy.
Based on true accounts. Money for Nothing explores the greedy few who promise the disadvantaged the ability to work from home and make it rich.
He has a taste for beautiful women.
A trio of teenage skateboarders looking to film at a new location stumble upon a dark and mysterious discovery.

A band of International assassins named after the infamous Shinsengumi samurai of feudal Japan, determined to silence a scientist on the verge of a solution to global warming. Protected by equally determined counterparts.
Group of unlikely friends decide to cheat on the final exam of the night school for privileged kids, but instead they unearth something completely unexpected.
Euro-crime thriller about a high-tech criminal organization that aims to find the fabled treasure of the Order of the Knights Templar.
A provincial young elementary-school teacher falls in love with a Venetian girl, the daughter of a rich industrialist.

Fed up with the materialism of Christmas, Santa runs away to New Zealand for a summer holiday. When two Kiwi kids figure out who he is, they have to find a way to get him back to the North Pole in time for Christmas.

Robbie Crusoe, a brilliant young chemical engineer with a dubious ethic, come to Brazil to meet his father. When his plane crashes in the middle of the forest, Robbie will have to survive the Amazonian jungle and the ghosts from his past.
A tech savvy ten year old video blogger's "Ultimate Christmas" unravels into chaos when her dad leaves to NY two days before Christmas and her dog, Luke, runs away leaving her in utter despair.

A talented, artistically stuck composition student starts seeing escort clients after failing to secure her scholarship. Struck with unexpected sounds during her sexual encounters, she turns them into music and the clients into her muse.

movie_name: Namastey Ji, May I come in
synopsis: A housewife, home alone on a drenched rainy afternoon, is in for a surprise from a stranger.

movie_name: The Revenge: A Scar That Never Disappears
synopsis: A lawman (Shô Aikawa) works under cover to infiltrate the Yakuza
When the Devil comes to collect the soul of a local farmer, the town's badass steps in and challenges him to a drag race.
A rich prince who lives in luxury wants to attain inner peace. He leaves his riches to become an ordinary villager and from there on, his adventure begins.
On the eve of her Bat Mitzvah, the innocent daughter of a powerful crime boss must choose between informing for the FBI or watching her family go to prison for life.
The hunt for an ancient jewel in Istanbul.
A young woman investigates the death of her mother, who drowned when her daughter was still a baby. The question is: was it murder, suicide or merely an accident?
A disturbing and original shocking horror film from the dark heart of England.

When a mysterious super soldier hunts down a fellow trooper, leaving a bloody trail of victims through a small Texas town, the soon to be retired Sheriff discovers these men might be the link to his missing-in-action son.
Deciet, perversion, and an unseen murderer follow a wealthy socialite through Italy as her mind breaks down into madness.

Freddy is going on one last camping trip with his closest classmates. Before the trip, he finds a box with letters that claim to tell the future. The message is clear: One of his friends is going to kill him.

In a world where immortality is achieved by drinking alcohol, having sex and partying every night, three friends in their hundreds (who don't look a day over eighteen) try to hold onto their youth in the face of a rapidly changing world.
Inder, a contractor who believes in the power of money, places a bet with his friend Prakash to woo Rama, a simple girl. Rama is charmed by Inder but an event forces her to leave the city.
Once again on the lam, Matsu is helped by a strip club worker who holds a grudge against the detective who's trying to find her.
A young man takes shelter in a mansion when a landslide blocks his route to the railway station. Then, he finds the mansion familiar and soon learns about the story of his previous birth.
Lizardo is about to start a summer of heartbreak, a summer of obsession, a summer of witchcraft.
Struggling to survive with her father after the collapse of Earth's ecosystem, 13-year-old Vesper must use her wits, strength and bio-hacking abilities to fight for the future.
In 1971, twenty-four male students are selected to take on randomly assigned roles of prisoners and guards in a mock prison situated in the basement of the Stanford psychology building.

movie_name: I Was a Teenage Alien Mutant Cyborg
synopsis: It's 1954. Mad Scientists. Hostile aliens, an escaped cyborg, and the fate of the world hangs in the balance.
A court-appointed psychiatrist must look beyond the cold facade of a killer in order to discover the motives behind his terrible crime.

Genetically-engineered Komodo dragons have become ginormous creatures hunting people on a remote tropical island. A small group of scientists must stop the dragons before they escape the island and destroy the rest of the world.
Two men, one living the beach/yacht boho lifestyle, the other sampling it for the first time, fall for an enigmatic woman.
After a series of mishaps, Rhyme, Autumn, Zoe, and Effie find themselves together in Miami for spring break. New crushes and new friends will make this a trip they'll never forget!

A woman with tragic past never felt secure enough to pursue a relationship, gets lost in the forest where she encounters a strange naked female monster with a tiger tattoo, who transforms her into a sexy seductive tiger beast.
Maya struggles with the effects of the caramel that gave her the ability to hear men's thoughts.
Wealthy thrill-seekers pay huge premiums to have themselves inserted into military adventures, only this time things don't go exactly to plan.
In a corporate-controlled future, an ultra-violent sport known as Rollerball represents the world, and one of its powerful athletes is out to defy those who want him out of the game.
A young woman rents a cursed house, forcing her to solve the mystery to find a way out.

A jewel thief hides his loot in a WELL while escaping. He returns several years later only to find there is a Resort on the site and the well is the centerpiece of the place. He then has to find a way to retrieve his haul. Larry Anderson
In a deep cave, from a deep sleep, a caver awakens into an infinite dream.
When Scott Carey begins to shrink because of exposure to a combination of radiation and insecticide, medical science is powerless to help him.

Two men travel deep into the woods to search for a Bigfoot-like creature called "Big Bay-Ty" which has recently been sighted near Boggy Creek. Three children secretly follow. Little do they know a hurricane is about to commence.
An intimate and confronting portrait of a couple of individuals who struggle with the dark side of their lives, placed in an everyday and recognizable context.
An ex-convict/aspiring writer's briefcase gets switched with that of a gangster.
Super Sketch is Investigative suspense thriller. It is a story about Cop and Culprits.
Radio presenter Karla's biological clock is ticking, and it's now very loud and clear. But no matter what she does, she simply cannot find a suitable man with whom she could imagine a family.
A group of kids, who are part of the police-sponsored scheme 4D Special Agents, tackle a gang of Cockney crooks.

When a woman takes a new job, she discovers the skyscraper she works in is haunted by victims of a corporation's pursuit of profit. Unable to ignore injustice embodied by the disembodied, she sets out to reveal the truth.
An origin story set on Cybertron, home of both the Autobots and the Decepticons. The film is said to focus on the relationship between Optimus Prime and Megatron
After being thrown out of her home, a young woman decides to disguise herself as a man to survive the ruthless Wild West.

movie_name: Laura's Star and the Mysterious Dragon Nian
synopsis: Laura's star and the mysterious dragon Nian.
Maria's and her grandmother's love for cooking, and Maria's energy and creativity to change those around her. The importance of Mexican food and family traditions.
A MERMAID REALIZED HER DREAM TO BE FULLY HUMAN AND LIVE WITH THE MAN SHE LOVES.
An anthology of Kaiju shorts from 28 different filmmakers.
The lives of several Miami denizens, from ad agents to gunrunners to street thugs to law enforcement to school-children, intersect with humorous and dangerous results.
Two U.S. border patrolmen find a buried 20+ year old jeep in the desert with a skeleton, rifle and $800,000. They keep the money. Suddenly, the FBI shows a lot of interest in the car.
Newly wed couple Oladele and Funmilayo embark on their honeymoon in a country side where tragedy struck!!!!
Six college students find themselves trapped in the middle of a grisly mystery after a house party gets out of hand.
The lives of two treasure hunters collide when they are both sent to steal an ancient and dangerous artifact in exchange for their criminal debts to be paid.

movie_name: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water

When four terrorists infiltrate India, ACP Jai and Ranvir set out to track them and bring them to justice.
Guns for hire on a haunted set. A story about a haunted low budget film shoot where everyone pretends to be something there not, while fighting ghosts and trying to stay on schedule.

A man who is tormented by his intuitions and by dreams goes away to find answers to his discomfort. Revelations are made to him along his path, until he meets his soul mate and is prepared to the Blue Desert.

In an alternate timeline, Smart Brain has accomplished its goal of world domination where the human race had diminished to near-extinction. Takumi Inui was regarded as mankind's savior until he was presumed killed by Smart Brain troops.
Reeling from a family tragedy, a beautiful vampire who dreams of becoming human must unmask a deranged killer before the blame falls on her.

After a family of high-class cockroaches are fumigated out of their Beverly Hills mansion, they try adapting to a new lower-class lifestyle in Los Angeles.

When the Weatherman puts on his boots it gets frosty, when he puts on his scarf it gets windy, and when he puts on his hat it gets warm. The problem is, the Weatherman's lost his umbrella. Without an umbrella, there will be no more rain.
Two young lovers, Lucas and Belah, who navigate their vacillating lives while coping with their addictions and a tumultuous new love that takes them higher than any drug can go.
A magician embarks on a road trip at the dawn of an apocalypse.
A mad scientist creates a Frankenstein creature that is better "endowed" than his ancestor, and uses his female assistants to prove that point.
Three brothers are separated and united after many years - one is brought up a Hindu, another a Muslim and the last (and most memorable) a Christian. Hilarity and adventure ensues.
MMA fighter Cole Young seeks out Earth's greatest champions in order to stand against the enemies of Outworld in a high stakes battle for the universe.

A skilled young hit man is new in town and hooks up with a prominent local crime family. Trusted with his first hit, things go decidedly off-course when he discovers his target was hiding much darker secrets than Ray was prepared for.

movie_name: Within the Shadow of the Tree: Dark Dreams
synopsis: A little character named The Small One must try and set a spell right that was cast by his adopted father, a powerful wizard, who was once the protector of the land Marimdorph before he died.

An alien ship crash lands onto a Russian city, many who saw it and the occupants start to question their own existence, while there are those who demand the aliens leave Earth.

Ad executive Bella is a nice and hardworking girl turning to her thirty,she devoted herself to love and work but end up got dumped and about to lose her job.Until the airborne secretary Kai showed up.

Two of Japan and China's greatest heroic swordsman find themselves caught in a plot to protect a young child. But will national distrust and simple misunderstanding keep the two kindred spirits apart?

movie_name: Let Us Go and Burn Her Body; or, the Devil Done Let Out
synopsis: A young female paranormalist is pursued by a man claiming to be the devil in human form.
A woman is covered with strange radiation and sometimes becomes huge. She fights an octopus that seems to know where her tits and fanny are.

A Jewish-American doctor and a Muslim State Department employee find themselves in the center of a conspiracy that could bring about the end of days. With time ticking away, they take on a mission to unravel the mystery and save the world.

The beautiful wife of a geologist frantically searches for her missing husband and is haunted by a man who bears a striking resemblance to him.

It's a film about sea life and a sad romantic story. The film is full of Action, Romance, Messages and nostalgic moments. Human destroying the atmosphere by their rude behavior. That's why nature takes revenge to the world.
Three retired veterans end up embroiled in a money laundering scheme while making ends meet as movers for storage unit park.
A Global Health Organization physician investigating a sudden outbreak in Spokane, WA, grows more and more determined the outbreak is connected to a clandestine military operation.

It depicts story of twin brothers. Suresh is a rich man who lives life in a lavish manner, while his brother Mukesh aka Micky is poverty-stricken who plans to be from rags to riches but his every plan gets foiled by his destiny.
Four young monsters--a werewolf, zombie, sea creature and boogie monster--bond over their outsider status and set out on an adventure of their own. Based on the comic book series by Christopher.

movie_name: Once upon a time in Tel Aviv
synopsis: A Love triangle between a Tel Avivian Stripper and Two Malicious Gangsters who happen to be best friends
When an android replica of a boy is rejected by his aggrieved creator, he goes off to find his own identity in an adventure that would make him the greatest hero of his time.
Crazy love story between rich girl (Aishwarya) and poor boy (Sai).
The suspect in a 12-year-old murder case is finally caught and tried, but the witnesses are a bit hard to track down...
A rich man asks a womanizing playboy to marry his daughter and make a grandson for him.

Good time girl Kit Carmichael is dead, except she doesn't know it yet. She only discovers the truth of her condition as she travels up a lonely rural highway meeting many of "those who have gone before"

movie_name: Mr. Shine and the Tainted Bloods

A woman who doesn't like harming even an ant is possessed with the ghost of the man who loves her, which wants to take revenge on the corrupt men who murdered him.
A large serving of gourmet food, a side of steamy seduction, and a sprinkle of mental illness.
A lawyer and a little girl must prove that a man claiming to be Santa Claus is the real thing.

Jorge, an ambitious young computer worker, diverts a large amount of money from the company where he works for his personal account. When his boss discovers threatens to kill him, if he does not receive the money back.
Darrell Jacobs, a retired member of the mafia, who is dying of lung cancer, unknowingly puts a college student, Alicia Foret's life in jeopardy when they begin meeting in public.

A alien race lands on Earth and disguises themselves as humans. A feature film version of the TV series 'V'.

During the hectic chunyun period, 2 strangers traveling home meet on the train.
Three young hobby archeologists witness a satanic ritual in a secluded villa. Instead of helping poor female victims they decide to secretly document the events.
An LAPD detective and his rookie partner are on the trail of a psychopathic young man who is murdering young women.

The trio of adventurous pals, a man who is a scientist, a fine lady and a former military pilot are in the Indochina jungles looking for some mysterious vase that holds a metal container that is of no mundane origin.
A cop confronts a gang of drug traffickers.
Englishmen race to find the tomb of Genghis Khan before the sinister Fu Manchu does.

movie_name: Cop Brutus Logan, the Crime Buster
synopsis: IN THIS COMEDY-ACTION MOVIE, A DETECTIVE IS ASSIGNED TO IDENTIFY AND BREAK-UP A SYNDICATE SPREADING SEXUAL DISEASE IN THE CITY THROUGH A GROUP OF PROSTITUTES.

An episode film initiated by Erik Borge, the fresh director of Norwegian Film, giving fresh film makers a chance of being seen by a big audience. Anja Breien, Egil Kolstø and Espen Thorstensons got the chance with very diverse films.

Two tigers are separated as cubs and taken into captivity, only to be reunited years later as enemies by an explorer who inadvertently forces them to fight each other.
The hunt for the empire's gold continues.

Eve Mannering realizes too late that her abusive husband is a philanderer and murderer and seeks protection with her true love, explorer John Beetham.

movie_name: A Espiã Que Entrou em Fria
synopsis: Espionage film spoof: scientist discovers a formula coveted by agents from all over the world, who want to kidnap him.

Beneath the decay of a dying world lives the Mad Doctor Mindskull. Using the planet's power of creation he has created the ultimate Weapon. Can mankind find a way to stop this Evil before time runs out?

Ji-hun takes a break from his art studies in Paris to return to Korea and visit with his family. While there, he falls in love with a young widow. However, their future happiness seems doomed as she is already engaged to be remarried

Martha Barlow, a modern-day outlaw, must reconcile her dark past after her teenage son commits a horrible crime.

A female cop gets transferred to a village where she gets visions of a little girl in her house.But the girl has passed away many years back and its her spirit which appears in the house and calls the as her mother.
Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson investigate the legend of a supernatural hound, a beast that may be stalking a young heir on the fog-shrouded moorland that makes up his estate.
In 2204, people need to escape their doomed planet before it's too late.

A political Godfather dies and a lot of thieves dressed up as politicians took over the rule. Question arises regarding the successor of the God, unfolding few names, along with the God's most beloved angel, Lucifer.
A charming man of questionable character marries a wealthy woman. Did he marry her for her money? How soon does he want it? Or is he as happily married as he seems?

In the future, pollution has driven humans deep under ground, where they tell legends of the paradise above. Two kids must find the path to the surface, while avoiding the humanoid, militaristic rats seeking to steal their dreams.

Rafa's hooked on the pure, fiery feelings he gets from speed racing, but when his kid's mom gets mixed up with drug dealers, he burns rubber to save her.
A cyborg tries to break free from his villainous programming.

Shane, a hustler-turned-blackmailer, has an encounter with an extra-terrestrial. It imprints on him, reads his thoughts and begins assaulting the people he's angry with, leaving a trail of bodies and trauma in its wake.
While working at a family friend's business, a penniless orphan draws the attention of a corrupt competitor and is torn between divided loyalties.
Jack Ryan, as a young covert C.I.A. analyst, uncovers a Russian plot to crash the U.S. economy with a terrorist attack.
Almost half a century ago, a remote village in the middle of a tropical rainforest starts witnessing a series of unexplainable events which they attribute to the supernatural.
A troubled young woman runs away from home with her imaginary boyfriend in order to preserve their relationship.

Movie actress Linda Winters has gone into the jungle to find her lost husband Fred. Bomba the Jungle Boy helps in the rescue effort. A major obstacle facing them is a killer leopard which specializes in tearing people limb from limb.
Anglo-American relations go bad when London mob bosses invest in a West Virginia oil deal in hopes of laundering dirty money.
A girl's "sweet" sixteenth birthday is anything but special: her family forgets about it, and she suffers from every embarrassment possible.

Due to that accident, Yi-Young loses her memory and Soo-Jin goes missing. Under that situation, Yi-Young regains her diving skills, but her strong desire to keep her position as a diva and Soo-Jin's disappearance push her into madness.

Famous TV anchor Shiva Shivu marries Paru but due to some unfortunate circumstances, he gets killed by a Mumbai based hitman named Kittappa.

Attempting to recover from his failed marriage to Rita Hayworth and restart his career, Orson Welles travels to Italy only to be drawn into a dangerous web of intrigue, murder and politics when an actor is murdered on his set.
G-Man and a female detective sergeant pursue racketeers, unaware that her police commissioner is actually a gang boss altered by plastic surgery.

movie_name: In the Arms of My Enemy
synopsis: Four men living in Eastern Europe in 1856 get caught up in tales of thievery, murder and revenge.
In a futuristic society, PR has evolved into an entirely different realm.
A priest disobeys church law to track down the vampires who kidnapped his niece.
Dojun found himself that he became a murderer after having affair with Seryun who just looked like his wife. He is fighting for the truth behind the puzzle that he is in.

movie_name: Ginza senbuji - arashi ga ore o yondeiru
synopsis: Mindless, non-stop serial action, postcard images and many songs.

A young spitfire cowgirl, and her coolheaded Native American friend, race a gang of neighborhood bullies to find a mysterious treasure supposedly having mystical powers.
A modern crime story set on the outskirts of Chicago's gang underworld.

movie_name: Et liv på den anden side II: Tilbage til livet på den første side
synopsis: The discontinued super agent, Søren Vegger, finds himself back in the business when his arch enemy, Senor la Muerte, plans to assassinate the president's daughter and threaten the world's safety.
The plot is set after the events of Mind-Bender 2

Plot is unknown.

The naive and honest Arbo reveals himself to the bone in his function as a youth leader, leading to something that might change the system.
