A female cop assigned to protect a dead drug dealer's girlfriend from mob assassins takes her to a home for battered wives. When revenge is the only option, the emotionally scarred women are forced to fight back.

movie_name: PAX: Welcome to the Occupied States
synopsis: Seven years after the invasion, over a hundred million Americans have been displaced by the war, with millions more dead. Ash has spent seven years learning to walk again, and she'll be damned if she's going to lie down for anyone.

Shouting Silence is a multi language Crime/Thriller/Drama film written and directed by Jaimin Bal And produced by Jaimin Bal and Neha Desai under the banner of Hiranyagarbha Motion Pictures. The film is going to release by the end of 2021.
A remote mountainous region is terrorized by a legendary monster that regularly abducts newlywed brides and kills them.
A ragtag group of Peeps characters set out on a cross-country journey in order to attend Peepsfest, an annual brand celebration in Pennsylvania.

A mysterious presence has threatened humanity for hundreds of years as it lurks in the frozen wastes people avoid. It takes two groups of adventurers, separated in time, to defeat her and the army of demons and monsters she can summon.

To broaden the mind of his studious son, Dong-wook, and to make a man out of him, a father hires a prostitute to sleep with the young man. But Dong-wook falls in love, shocking his father and bringing shame to his family name

A horror writer unknowingly takes a dangerous amount of magic mushrooms after wanting to escape cabin fever during confinement and must get through what should have been a dull day without losing his mind.

A father obsessed with an old school copying machine wreaks havoc on the family, causing a change in their relationships. Explores the life of each family member and how their lives are intertwined with each other.
A reclusive inventor must protect the young son of the lord of Praxton from assassins who seek to overthrow the government and propel the planet into a maelstrom of chaos and civil war.
The post-apocalyptic world both expands and shrinks as the remainder of once heroic fighter groups follow their journey of self-discovery and destruction.
Inger has lived a peaceful family life until one day vikings invade and she must survive. But a supernatural force will awaken.

Armed with laser guns and wit, Pete Winning and his rag-tag crew navigate a flooded earth in the not-too-distant future. Braving mutants, pirates and the seas, they search for the self-crowned evil Queen's coveted maps of the new world.

Jake Blues rejoins with his brother Elwood after being released from prison, but the duo has just days to reunite their old R&B band and save the Catholic home where the two were raised, outrunning the police as they tear through Chicago.

Based on actual events. A Navy helicopter pilot leads a near-impossible midnight jungle rescue of two downed jet pilots behind enemy lines, for which he earned the Medal of Honor. One of the great untold stories of the Vietnam war.

Tyrannical, but ailing, tycoon Charles Richmond becomes very fond of his attractive Italian nurse, Maria. The nurse, in turn, falls in love with Charles' ne'er-do-well nephew Anthony, who plots ways to gain control of his uncle's fortune.
Actress Norma Sands explains why she committed a crime to actor Bob Dallesandro.
The Taylor family struggles with drama and heartbreak as they face a football injury, an illness, and a career change, all while planning a wedding.
A guy, a girl, and a robothead hike across a desert planet in search of a mythical lake.
To escape heartbreak, Hope writes herself into a short story as a character who falls in love with the story's central character with unexpected real world consequences.
An alien encounter warns humans that they are about to be invaded.

movie_name: Dorothy and Toto's Storytime: The Marvelous Land of Oz Part 1
synopsis: It's story time. Take a ride with Dorothy and her best pal Toto in Dorothy And Toto's Storytime: The Marvelous Land Of Oz Part 1.
Violence and mayhem ensue after a hunter stumbles upon a drug deal gone wrong and more than two million dollars in cash near the Rio Grande.
A couple suffer from a series of hauntings.
The further adventures of super-strong girl Pippi Longstocking and her friends Tommy and Annika in this sequel compilation film of the classic Swedish TV series.
After the German Occupation, a businessman hides from his sick daughter, the death of her beloved and hires an adventurer to impersonate him.

After finding he is spied on by a secret organization, a screenwriter tries to discover who is stalking him. With the help of an old friend of his, he falls into a maze of problems, and his only way out is by throwing a few punches.

movie_name: The Rascal Kids- NIght before Christmas
synopsis: Group of kids saving Christmas spirits from low-income neighborhoods.

Private Joe Bauers, a decisively average American, is selected as a guinea pig for a top-secret hibernation program but is forgotten, awakening to a future so incredibly moronic he's easily the most intelligent person alive.
The Hunters of the Undead arrive and are on a mission to remove from the Earth anything supernatural. The town's cover has been compromised.
Two boys try to send their strict father back to the city with the help of the forest witch, but instead get taken for a merry ride by her granddaughter.
The deformed Paris bellringer Quasimodo and his doomed love quadrangle with the beautiful gypsy girl Esmerelda, the crazed archdeacon Frollo and the dashing military captain Phoebus.
A dinner party is interrupted by an emergency alert, warning of a possible extinction level event.
A university research scientist, about to lose funding and status, has a lab accident and discovers he can see people's true intentions -- making his situation even worse.
Devastating secrets come to light during an engagement dinner party following the murder of two young women that was pinned on an innocent man.
Katherine refuses to fall for playboy Drew Evan's tactical skills to seduce her, making him desire her more.
An erotic dancer turns up dead in a California resort recently inherited by a man & his family.
Two young lovers caught up in the underworld decide to get out and go straight, but a gang leader has other plans for them.
An ancient mythical creature returns three young people to their childhood forms so that they can find the true path to their dreams.

Puras Joyitas tells the story of some professional thugs nicknamed "Los entendidos", led by the mysterious nameless man, NL, that get hired to steal the country's most important beauty ...                See full synopsis »
A young boy is on vacation at the beach with his family. He becomes bored and wanders onto the set of a television production about pirates aboard a ship.
A decades-spanning romantic drama about a woman who pays dearly for following her heart.
A bush pilot is hired for fifty thousand dollars to go to Mexico to free an innocent prisoner.

30-year-old Joon is a prison guard in a notorious Gulag in the world's most repressive nation when she discovers an evil so hideous it transforms her from a guardian of the totalitarian order into an enemy of the state.
A hypochondriac irks his partner by embracing the advice of an eccentric healer.
After a heist, hardened criminal Daniel escapes to a small town assuming the identity of the new school teacher, where he undergoes personal growth.

movie_name: We're All Going to the World's Fair
synopsis: Alone in her attic bedroom, teenager Casey becomes immersed in an online role-playing horror game, wherein she begins to document the changes that may or may not be happening to her.
This is a cat-and-mouse crime movie adapted from a popular Japanese comic book about a contractor killer-assassin who uses methods so smart and so difficult to solve by the police.
After defeating Ravana, Rama returns to Ayodhya with his wife Sita and brother Laxmana. But when questions arise regarding Sita's character, Rama decides to leave her by sending her to the forest.

Every night as Sofia falls asleep, her father Djibi takes her into "Storyland", a fantasy film studio where their extraordinary fairy-tale adventures come to life starring Djibi in the lead role as the heroic Prince Charming.
Madea's back hallelujer. And she's not putting up with any nonsense as family drama erupts at her great-grandson's college graduation celebration.
Prison gangs clash in a high-tech security jail where there are no rules.
In old Heidelberg the marriage of a student to a princess is nearly compromised when the landlady pays his debts from the kindness of her heart.
Maxi, the survivor of a terrorist attack, joins the beguiling student Karl and becomes part of a European youth movement; one that aims for nothing less than seizing power.

movie_name: The King Kong That Appeared in Edo
synopsis: In part one of this silent two-part film, an ape nicknamed King Kong by its master kidnaps the daughter of a wealthy man as part of a revenge plot by one of his lackeys. The story concludes in King Kong Appears in Edo: The Episode of Gold (1938).
Alex and Me is an uplifting story of the passion and drive it takes to succeed and the power of family to help realize your dreams.

A marriage that started on love and trust suddenly nose dived into the ditch of wealth and opulence and the marriage went sour. An African woman's struggle to retain and sustain her marriage knows no bound.
A defense lawyer goes to find his former client whose late husband's money is missing. He's not the only one who's looking for her, and she has a plan of her own.
A corrupt New York cop working for the department's elite crime-fighting squad is forced to choose between his family, his fellow officers and his life.
A Soho restaurateur's protégée becomes a star.
A scientist discovers a formula that makes a baseball which is repelled by wood. He promptly sets out to exploit his discovery.
A smalltime US filmmaker goes to Cannes to try to get his movie in the limelight. A wife of one of the producers there gets interested in his story and they begin an affair.
Faced by a society of criminals, these three youths avenge their rights.
The owner of a plantation in the jungle marries a beautiful woman. Shortly afterward, he is plagued by a strange voodoo curse which transforms him into a gorilla.
A boy and a little bird are on a journey across a strange island trying to get back home.
A woman is suspected of her husband's murder, and their blind son faces a moral dilemma as the sole witness.
This is a character-centric, grounded sci-fi love story in the vein of Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind and Her.
Anna and Emilie are 14 and 15. They are sisters and orphans. Hardly have they been in their new home when a strange event turns their world upside down.

A wealthy entrepreneur goes to an antique shop to get a gift for his wife. Unfortunately he picks out an ornate old box that happens to be cursed by the spirit of a woman executed for witchcraft by monks years earlier.
Characters in an Al generated TV show become sentient and take revenge on their producers.
An American polo player, arrogant and full of himself, must vindicate his actions to win the heart of a girl, Polly, after getting himself booted off the U.S. polo team.
New oriental adventures of three friends. They free a woman from a harem, fight against oil tycoons and look for a better future.

movie_name: The Forest of the Lost Souls
synopsis: The Forest of the Lost Souls is a dense and remote forest, Portugal's most popular place for suicide. On a summer morning, two strangers meet within the woods.

In the company of housewives, professionals and a retired tennis instructor, Hernán is part of a middle-class community that is preparing for the eventual arrival of the end of the world at a holiday resort in the marshy Tigre delta.

movie_name: Fireheart: The Legend of Tadas Blinda
synopsis: A romance blooms between a noblewoman and a common man amid a peasant revolt against the brutal Russian army
Hidden Well beneath a Mansion unleashes its secretes when old treaties are broken.

In a quiet Irish village, a group of enterprising youngsters make a model of the legendary monster supposedly residing in the bottom of the local lough, in the hope of attracting tourism and prosperity to the village.
A musical film about human relationships and how today's working life and the pressures of our surroundings can lead a person to the point of exhaustion.
The Suspicious centers around a mysterious pharmaceutical company and its new drug that cures insomnia.
A married couple suffers a terrible car accident that sends the woman in a coma, where she's transported into another place and falls for another man.
Flash Gordon, Dale Arden and Dr. Alexis Zarkov visit the planet Mongo to thwart the evil schemes of Emperor Ming the Merciless, who has set his planet on a collision course with Earth.

Six American special agents are sent to an idyllic Greek island to disrupt the operation of an international operation of illegal arms deals and African based terrorists. Three agents are killed - so their team has an infiltrated enemy.

Alex, a reclusive, lonely war veteran must interpret his disturbing delusions in order to deal with his unsettling PTSD, which causes him to remember some disturbing secrets about his past, and jeopardizes any sort of acceptable future.
With his wife's disappearance having become the focus of an intense media circus, a man sees the spotlight turned on him when it's suspected that he may not be innocent.

Naagu is a small time criminal by profession. Naagu's father was also killed by a person called Jagapati Rao, its Naagu's turn to bring him to justice. How Naagu succeeds in his mission form the climax of this movie.
A forensic psychologist (Collette) is tasked with determining whether or not a minor should face murder charges for killing his schoolmate.

A horror-thriller centered on a woman living with "face-blindness" after surviving a serial killer's attack. As she lives with her condition, one in which facial features change each time she loses sight of them, the killer closes in.

A cooler-than-ever Bruce Wayne must deal with the usual suspects as they plan to rule Gotham City, while discovering that he has accidentally adopted a teenage orphan who wishes to become his sidekick.

movie_name: Ritter Rost - Eisenhart und voll verbeult
synopsis: Embark on an adventure like no other with a very special knight who must save the magical kingdom where he lives by redeeming his knightly honor.
An art driven movie based on graffiti and paintings but will be cinematic and daring in a fun artistic way. Get ready for Parkour, graffiti, montages, and paintings in a cinematically motion picture.
A family is haunted by the previous occupants who are deadly creatures that live inside the walls of their own home.
One young Catholic priest versus the Abomination of Desolation.

An ex-marine is hired by a defense contractor to travel to Panama to complete an arms deal. In the process he becomes involved with the U.S. invasion of Panama, and learns an important lesson about the true nature of political power.
Two roommates living in an all-girl dormitory. They fall in love with each other.

A dysfunctional family goes to their summer cottage hoping to reconcile their problems when a violent stalker crasher their dinner party. Suddenly, the family is forced to work together to get out alive.
Kawana Tsugumi works at an interior design company. She happens to meet her first love Ayukawa Itsuki from her high school days. He is now an architect and in a wheelchair because of an accident.

One stormy night, a doctor offers a ride to a ghostly woman he meets on the side of the road. Later, he discovers his intended bride is identical in appearance to the ghost. Who was she and why does she haunt him?

A father wants to retire from criminal activity and leave something to his children, so he takes one last mission that could give the tranquility of retirement and a certain well-being to his family. But things don't go as planned.

Rudin is Erudite and eloquent, received European education.He earns the love of an intelligent girl,Natasha.However, is not able to act decisively,Natasha marries another.After long wanderings, he dies in barricades of Paris.
A couple goes on the run after being accused for a crime they didn't commit.

movie_name: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
synopsis: With their warning about Lord Voldemort's return scoffed at, Harry and Dumbledore are targeted by the Wizard authorities as an authoritarian bureaucrat slowly seizes power at Hogwarts.
A naive country boy goes to New York City, where he gets mixed up with real estate swindlers.

movie_name: Son of Darkness: To Die for II
synopsis: Vampires come to town. Who's a vampire? Who's not? Ask our main character, who is suspicious, and our main character's brother, who gets seduced by one.

The stage magician Eglé Elohim offers a show that is causing a sensation in an old archaeology professor who comes to see her in the theater, who is also a great specialist in the history of magic, witchcraft and ancient rituals.

In the year 2125, a captain and his crew of miners aboard a spacecraft come across a woman in an emergency escape pod, taking her on board but soon discovering that she has brought on a dangerous extraterrestrial organism.
A fisherman, a smuggler, and a syndicate of businessmen match wits over the possession of a priceless diamond.

A woman falls to her death after getting attacked by a black-clad assailant. Her sister arrives in town and starts dating a police detective, who's friends with a strange movie theater curator, as other women fall prey to the killer.
Disaster in a New York tunnel as explosions collapse both ends of it. One hero tries to help the people inside find their way to safety.

movie_name: Di Renjie zhi hui gui chimu
synopsis: During the Empress Wu Zetian's reign, Detective Dee supervised the case of "Red-eyed monster" causing trouble and eliminated Prince Wu Minzhi, who tried to usurp power and seize the throne, preserving the stability of Jiangshan.

Set in the Chinese Anti-Japanese War. A white horse named Feifei steers away enemy raiding team to save its wounded master --a cavalry officer --and gets caught. Enemies can't tame Feifei and it fasts to death.
A Public Security Bureau agent re-opens a robbery case.
After a car accident, a young woman caught between life and death meets a funeral director who claims to have the gift of transitioning the dead into the afterlife.
This film explores complex family dynamics within a nuclear family that have been caused by lies, corruption and deceit.
A young boy stumbles onto a witch convention and must stop them, even after he has been turned into a mouse.
Follows a youngster ready to get married, but funny events happen and changes his plans.
A truck convoy traveling the Burma Road is menaced by a group of smugglers.
Set in South Philadelphia, Laney and Coach Tayor teach these high School kids how to fight for the right to Sing Loud, Sing Proud and "Singout".
A woman out late for Christmas Eve shopping is soon terrorized by a small gang of troublemakers, and she must fight for her life.
A battle between the world's two greatest minds begins when Light Yagami finds the Death Note, a notebook with the power to kill, and decides to rid the world of criminals.

3 Idealistic officers, He Zhong Heng (Piao), Luo Zhnag (Chien) and Ying Hao (Sau-Yin), find corruption and deceit rule the department, magistrate and jailers. Will they succumb to corruption? What cost must be paid to stay true to ideals?
A crime thriller movie based on a kidnapping situation that's about to go horribly wrong!
A man has psychic premonitions of bad things happening to both a young boy and a young lady in a flaming vehicle.

Mankind's savagery in the Third World War left most of the population barren. Now, two centuries later, humanity has been reduced to warring factions across Russia and Asia, and there are few fertile women left.

A university professor and the members of his circle delve into a mysterious and lascivious world to uncover the legend of a tragic love ghost depicted on an Edo-era scroll in this sensual drama of ghost stories.
A happily married couple, trying to advance their careers, is divided by an unexpected visitor who brings chaos and death.
A group of children are harassed by a local bully. In order to stop it, they seek the help of a retired boxer.
Frozen in the ice for decades, Captain America is freed to battle against archcriminal The Red Skull.
The descendents of the guardians of the light team up with enigmatic prophet Isiah Cloud to stop the evil demon Lord Velid from unleashing Hell on Earth.
A Japanese gangster is forced to work for the police to find out who is responsible for the robbery of a truck full of gold.
A gorgeous American arrives in Brazilian headhunter country seeking her scapegrace fiancé.
The story of two aging Canadian C-130 Hercules pilots ravaged by atrocities experienced together while flying humanitarian missions into the worst conflicts known in the late 20th century
A newlywed English tourist and an eccentric Transylvanian Count must work together when the former's beautiful wife is made the bodily host of a horrific witch.
A princess must recruit the most brave and powerful swordsmen in the land with the sole purpose of vanquishing the dark wizard who terrorizes the kingdom with a giant, menacing dragon.
While on vacation in Rio de Janeiro, the wife of a respectable Mexican physician becomes amnesic and ends up as a gangster's moll and entertainer at a night club.

A ripping adventure yarn about teenage boys who join the crew of a ship of the Dutch East India Company in the 17th century. After a dramatic shipwreck and escape from an attack by natives, they must make their way to safety by themselves.
The epic myth of the Minotaur brought to life through computer animation.
A lone warrior nicknamed Deathstalker is sent by a witch on a quest to find a sword, a chalice, and an amulet, two of which are held by the wicked king and sorcerer, Munkar.
Neutron, a wrestler/superhero, investigates a series of murders at a sanitarium.

Atrocious serial killings on holidays in Gotham City send The World's Greatest Detective into action - confronting both organized crime and a unified front of classic DC Super-Villains - while attempting to stop the mysterious murderer.
A young girl is kidnapped by a masked killer and held captive. She miraculously escapes, but the relentless killer will stop at nothing to get her back.

In a hospital on the outskirts of 1920s Los Angeles, an injured stuntman begins to tell a fellow patient, a little girl with a broken arm, a fantastic story of five mythical heroes. Thanks to his fractured state of mind and her vivid imagination, the line between fiction and reality blurs as the tale advances.
A man who works in a chemistry lab, learns that his wife deceives himself. He uses invisibility serum to revenge from his wife and wife's lover.

Dante goes on a journey through the first and worst part of the afterlife, Hell. Virgil guides and protects Dante on his dark journey descending circle-by-circle to the center of the Earth, and out into Purgatory (sequel).
Can Gordon's team win the Junior Goodwill Games in California in spite of all the set-backs?
A man fights against drug dealers around his neighborhood.
A hired gun wants to complete his last big job--killing a sheriff who hides away inside an old monastery--so he can retire with a prostitute.

Deep beneath the surface a team of spelunkers explores a labyrinth of interconnected caverns filled with ancient relics deadly traps and a hidden chamber rumored to hold the ultimate secret of destiny.
When zombies overrun a high school, the students band together to face the onslaught of the undead.
An elite group of soldiers on a covert mission to retrieve a scientist from an underground lab encounter an ancient evil in the facility.

The toys are mistakenly delivered to a day-care center instead of the attic right before Andy leaves for college, and it's up to Woody to convince the other toys that they weren't abandoned and to return home.

A young couple in tropical Australia is trapped in their home by three fugitives carrying a mysterious icebox containing unknown contents, and they must rely on their wits and cunning to survive as a severe tropical cyclone looms.

Academy Award -winner Faye Dunaway, Daniel j. Travanti, John Laughlin (CRIMES OF PASSION), Kim Cattrall (MANNEQUIN) and Ned Beatty (THE FOURTH PROTOCOl) star in a twisted suspense thriller of murder, lust and greed.
A young woman investigates the death of her mother, who drowned when her daughter was still a baby. The question is: was it murder, suicide or merely an accident?

A rich ill mannered Jingle Composer is left by his love of life Anya and is visited by a modern age God Of Death (Yamraaj) , who offers to take his life in a unique way via a special deal, will he find a way out or will he give up and succumb to God of Death's plan? Will Anya come back in his life?

Tatkshan is a brutal story of grit and indomitable spirit of Sub Inspector Harshvardhan Dubey,UP Police,who comes across mutilated unidentified human body in Lucknow.Investigating the case layer by layer leads to many shocking revelations.
The winter caretaker of an abandoned campus awakens a long forgotten darkness.
A war veteran discovers treachery, murder and ghosts from his past at a remote island lodge funeral. Psycho thriller.
In late 19th century, a Transylvanian revolutionary fleeing the Imperial authorities goes to Italy where he meets a beautiful soprano who later disappears under mysterious circumstances.
A man who returns to his hometown for a funeral may have a much larger purpose in life than those around him can see.
A secret document is passed around the world.
Three friends and a stranger go to a house and plan to commit suicide. But later they realize the house is haunted
A mysterious, knife-throwing Viking warrior protects a young peasant woman and her son from the clutches of a evil regent bent on claiming the title of King and the woman for himself.

movie_name: The Adventures of Elmo in Grouchland
synopsis: A tug-of-war between Elmo and his friend sends his blanket to faraway Grouchland, a place full of grouchy creatures and the villainous Huxley. Elmo embarks on a rescue mission, learning important lessons about sharing and responsibility.
A man struggles to balance his love for a woman with his hatred for her brother.

William lives with his uncle Nils. His father is dead and his mother is mentally unstable. Nils retired early and spends his day buying and selling stuff at a favourable price. Nils owes some gangsters money and they want their debt paid back.
A medical student who volunteers for the night shift at a Californian zoo. But after a rescue mission goes awry, she finds herself trapped in the anaconda enclosure.
A young governess for two children becomes convinced that the house and grounds are haunted.
An action-comedy following the misadventures of American and British Special Operators who launch the first 9-11 counter-strike against Al-Qaeda and Taliban terrorists in northern Afghanistan.
A murderous drug dealer breaks his partner out of police custody. An undercover cop is assigned to track down the two killers and bring them in.
During World War II, the Nazi High Command sends agents into the African jungle to stir up the local Tongghili tribes against the British Allies.

movie_name: Abaddon: The King of the Locusts
synopsis: An ancient and sinister cult, responsible for the disappearance of many young adults, is tracked and brought down by the twin sister of their latest victim.
Months after the events of the original film, Ming suspects a police superintendent as being a new mole for the triads, while years earlier, Yan embarks on his first mission.
Military scientists discover an alternate dimension and, subsequently, aliens with an appetite for human flesh.
After a college student becomes obsessed with a co-ed, she and her husband attempt to heal him, with dangerous consequences.
An officer killed on the job returns to Earth as a ghost to solve his own murder and seek justice with the help of a rookie cop and some funky magic.

The fragile and eccentric actress Hristina couples with the medicated, yuppie filmmaker Odessea and they embark on a cross-over journey to Ithaca. Odessea's mysterious disappearance interrupts the seemingly functioning affair.
A walk across continents & cultural landscapes.
Inspired by the popular tale of Red Riding Hood, this Malaysian Tamil slasher film, which gives a dark twist to the story, tells of the painful journey of a girl.

When two siblings discover their seemingly normal mom is a former thief in witness protection who has been forced to pull one last job, they team up to rescue her over the course of an action-packed night.
An immortal vampire, suffering at the hands of his own creator, seeks to fill the empty void of his soul within the arms of an unlikely woman.
A detective and inventor of a revolutionary sound-recording device becomes an unwitting suspect of a series of brutal crimes.

movie_name: Nothing Left to Do but Cry
synopsis: In the 80s, two friends misteriously wake up in the XV century and clumsly try to intermingle with the society of the time.

movie_name: The Case of the Midnight Murderer
synopsis: A rookie P.I. gets in over his head when a murder case comes his way. It could be his ticket to fame and glory, if he manages to solve the case without making a fool of himself.
A passionate storyteller believes that anything under the sky can be conveyed through a story. The film talks about the inseparable father-son bond, parenting, kids and their thinking process.

movie_name: The Wish, a Story of Hope, Faith and Generosity
synopsis: A beloved high school teacher fights for her life while waiting a much needed organ transplant.
The story is based on a short novel written by one of the good Indian Authors in the Indian language Kannada named Sri.Basavaraja Kattimani. It is family drama.
Beary Barrington goes on an adventure to save Country Bear Hall by getting the Country Bears back together for a reunion concert.
In 1855, a daimyo sends his men on a grueling marathon to discover if they're tough enough to face the newly arrived Americans. Misunderstanding his intent, the Shogun dispatches assassins.

Ex-drug dealer is forced to go back to business by a corrupt policeman. He must go to Colombia and bring back some cocaine, but discovers the whole thing is a set up. He then devises a suicidal plan for revenge.
A young couple embark on a cross-country journey, only to run into trouble at the Texas/Mexico border.

A government department known as the Six Panels appoints their best officer to infiltrate a special force called the Divine Constabulary, to ensure their way in stopping the circulation of counterfeit coin currency in the capital.
A psychological romantic thriller where fantasy and reality become indistinguishable for a woman leading a double life in her dreams.
In the small town of Cherry Falls, a psychotic murderer is killing off the virgins of the local high school.
Seven friends travel to the countryside to play war in the woods. They stumble upon three paranoid and sadistic ex-soldiers.
An indolent guy who relies on astrology rather than effort leaves behind his family and his childhood love to move to London.
After the events of "#TubeClash", ten new German YouTube stars wake up in the ruins of a city, but this time team up against their captor.
A young Chicago advertising executive believes a woman he sees in a café is his long-lost love. His belief leads to obsession, as he puts his life on hold in order to trail her.
A woman of twenty-one opens her grandfather's will left to her thirteen years earlier, per his instructions. Murder soon follows.
Two lonely singles find love in the most unexpected place when they fall for each other during their children's play date.
A family of small-time crooks take in a child they find outside in the cold.
During the age of worship of dinosaurs, friendship between dinosaurs and human beings, and life-and-death fights are greatly displayed.

Jerry and Rachel are two strangers thrown together by a mysterious phone call from a woman they have never met. Threatening their lives and family, she pushes Jerry and Rachel into a series of increasingly dangerous situations, using the technology of everyday life to track and control their every move.
Vampire death dealer Selene (Kate Beckinsale) fights to end the eternal war between the Lycan clan and the Vampire faction that betrayed her.
A lawyer defends a killer, but soon after he wins, he finds out that the killer is guilty.
Three couples go into the mountains for an overnight hike, seeking relaxation and fresh air. Instead, they find themselves engulfed in terror as they fight to stay alive.
A Chinese family moves from their native land to a town in Germany and struggles to adjust to the different culture. Marriage hangs in the balance...
A process server and his marijuana dealer wind up on the run from hitmen and a corrupt police officer after he witnesses his dealer's boss murder a competitor while trying to serve papers on him.

It's Christmas time at the Baker household, and Bailey is at it again. Worried that he won't get any presents from Santa, Bailey learns about a mysterious Native American brave who can make his holiday wishes come true.
Based on Sax Rohmer's cult novels "Sumuru", this futuristic fantasy takes you to an Earth-colony in the far future, in which women rule and men are used to propagate the race and work in the mines.
The Candy Witch seeks vengeance on the wealthy family that wronged her.
For some a mercenary. For him not so.
The double deals and shady schemes are served between courses at the most elite members-only supper club.

In the year 2154, the very wealthy live on a man-made space station while the rest of the population resides on a ruined Earth. A man takes on a mission that could bring equality to the polarized worlds.
The survivors of a prison break set out on an arduous journey to retrieve some loot.
An ex-detective, a deadly child, two dim-witted hit-men, and a captive all cross paths with one mysterious assassin corporation.

Carol Danvers becomes one of the universe's most powerful heroes when Earth is caught in the middle of a galactic war between two alien races.
A therapist in San Francisco struggles to raise her child after the death of her husband.
By means of archival footage, this mockumentary "reconstructs" how the Russians secretly realised the first manned flight to the moon as early as the 1930s.

movie_name: Antboy II: Revenge of the Red Fury
synopsis: A superhero called Antboy fights against evil in his hometown.
Two women are at the bar talking about urban legends. As midnight approaches and it is last call, they are about to discover if one of those urban legends is real.

When a couple check-in at a mysterious hotel, overly religious owner Remedios begins to act more strange than usual, while her children begin to try to contact their late father by using a strange book they found in the basement.
About two men Gregorio and Andrés who are seeking a treasure that they have only seen in their dreams. In their search they arrive at a place where only women live and Matilde is one of them.
A war correspondent's new wife is suspected by his colleagues of being a Nazi spy.
Secret video files just discovered on an FBI server prove that the government has been hiding unexplained disappearances and a dangerous presence in the Pacific Northwest wilderness.
A happily married London barrister falls in love with the accused poisoner he is defending.

FARM DAYS is a fable and charming take on "Old McDonald Had a Farm;" incorporating live-action animals with virtuoso cinematography and a smart sense of humor for adults. Follow a family as they discover the true meaning of home.
The trials and tribulations of a small town in middle America trying to grapple with the disappearance of a teenage girl.
A destitute ronin allies himself with an established clan, but its ruthless leader tries to turn him into a mindless killer.
Blondie and Dagwood are in charge of operations at a mountain motel. The elderly owners of the establishment are in danger of losing their life savings. Among other things, arson threatens.
When Alvin's ceiling begins oozing sticky brown sludge, he finds a peculiar escape from his sheltered existence.

Award winning writer, celebrity Mark Travis seeks inspiration by returning to his hometown. What he finds is not what he expected. Her name is Holly. What Holly would do, is like nothing Mark has ever experienced before.
After a mother disappears without a trace, her troubled daughter spirals in her search, unaware a vampire will save them both.
An unassuming track coach accidentally invokes the spirit of a notorious pirate long believed dead, and who must now team up to lay the pirate to rest, and save a local hotel from a mobster.
After going through the most terrifying time of her life, Tara has finally found some peace in her life, or has she? will Daddy find what he's looking for?
When 11yo Joey finds the map to stolen loot, he and his pals set off on the journey of a lifetime, realizing in the end that the real fortune is their friendship.

On Papua, a group of students who have been without a teacher for six months are waiting for a teacher, who should arrive through the small airstrip in their village; the airstrip is their only contact with the outside world.
A strange red sofa bed becomes the conduit for mayhem when payoff money goes missing in Las Vegas. Murder moves with the sofa bed as it exchanges hands, becoming stranger.
A scientist bearing a horrible secret is haunted by dark forces.
The son of a politician is abducted. The kidnappers play a dangerous double game to support activists against land grabbing by the Government.
A man has limited time in which to make a woman fall in love with him.
A ruffian with a bad reputation assists the police against his brother but ends up getting arrested himself.
The Three Supermen accidentally use Prof. Aristide Panzarotti's time machine and find themselves back to the wild, wild west.
A group of friends reunite for a holiday at a recluse cabin in the woods.
A modest theatrical company, soon to debut, organizes a superstitious spiritual session. During the evening the spirit of little Thomas is evoked.

movie_name: Kamen Rider Ex-Aid Trilogy: Another Ending - Kamen Rider Genm vs. Lazer
synopsis: Kuroto Dan has obtained the God Maximum Mighty X and the world falls into the chaos. Kiriya has found the key to face the power that not even Muteki can overcome and ready to face him.
Sarah adores her husband, Jason, but when Jason disappears and she tries to track him down, it opens up a whole new can of worms and she realizes that he has a dark past that he is trying to hide.
Scientists mount an expedition to find a Bigfoot-type creature.
After a woman survives a bizarre attack at an abandoned well, her mental state deteriorates as she tries to prove to others what really happened.
In the tradition of Arsenic and Old Lace, comes this morbidly funny Australian tale of murder and mayhem at the hands of two charming old ladies.

17-year-old Johann meets his new classmate Ludwig at school and becomes friends with him. They both develop a common hobby: two without. When one of the two rowers falls in love with the sister of the other, things escalate.
Nature (The Ancient Dryad Spirit) has become angry and vengeful because of mankind's blatant abuses that have destroyed the balance that protects all living creatures.
Plot kept under wraps. Described as an alien-abduction film.
Timian and Rudolf owns a car repair shop, where a 1930 Ford is the main thing, when someone steals their savings.

When he runs short of money, a newspaper reporter pawns a police revolver he was given after he helped the police solve a case. Later on the gun is used in a murder, and the reporter is suspected of committing the crime.
Plot kept under wraps.
An innocent boy who support his family is betrayed by the society.
A reclusive programmer, his sister and her new boyfriend are held hostage by a rapidly evolving computer virus.
A dead captain's daughter saves a burning ship when it is abandoned by its mate.

A Science Fiction adventure set in two different time-periods. An impending visit by extra-terrestrials is discovered by Government Agents. Ten years later we discover the outcome of the extra-terrestrial visit.

movie_name: A Long Day in Lone Pine
synopsis: A down on his luck actor has to make right a debt inherited from his deceased brother for which he must travel to Lone Pine, California where things are not what they seem.
A family leverages their nest-egg purchasing a century-old house in Roe County, but the deal comes with strings.
An amateur scientist and father accidentally shrinks his family with his latest invention. A sequel to the 1989 film 'Honey, I Shrunk the Kids".
The story of Siddhu and Anu, a young couple who face an inconvenient situation on their first date. However, these circumstances test their love.
A psychic's girlfriend finds out that a lump on her back is a growing reincarnation of a 400-year-old demonic Native American spirit.
A miscarried women gets affected psychologically and turns her marriage into misery after witnessing some terrifying notions of her dubious child.
Eggs of the small but voracious alien creatures called Crites are left behind on earth and, after hatching, set their appetites on the small farm town of Grover's Bend.

A Kung Fu master finds out that an opium den is destroying the lives of the town he lives in, and vows to put an end to the den, but first he must try to defeat the strongest enemy he has ever faced: his addiction to the drug itself.
Repudiated by King Ego, a town of deformed characters lurk in the depths of the forest.
Three sisters on the run with a suitcase full of stolen heroin hide out in their childhood home, which is haunted by the ghosts of their parents.
Engineer Sara finds herself in the middle of a political conspiracy when her look-alike Alexa turns out to be the prime suspect in the murder of city mayor.
Soon after Hope Howard is mysteriously fired, her former boss, a desperate scientist, discovers she holds the secret to his fatal illness-but she has disappeared.
A story that follows a group of close friends over two decades, through their respective lives and loves.

The master of the secret Monkey Fist Kung Fu style must fight a gang of warrior thugs who are terrorizing a small village that he is visiting. He teams up with a young Silat expert who has been trying to defeat the bandit gang on his own.
In 2017, director Denise Castro wants to shoot her most personal work: A new adaptation of Bram Stoker's novel Dracula.
A series of mutilated corpses is upsetting a town in central Italy. Police believe that this is a wolf, but it might not be a wolf as others.

BILLIE VALENTINE, a sixteen-year-old African-American girl, TRAPPED and ALONE in a DANGEROUS TOWN with TWO HALF-BROTHERS TO FEED, gets a LIFE-CHANGING OPPORTUNITY to START ANEW but only if she can ESCAPE her TUMULTUOUS PAST
Weary immortals inhabit a metropolis in the sky and amuse themselves with constructions as they kill time and await whatever comes next.
An anthology comedy consisting of three segments.

In 1963, military industrialist Arthur Blackmark and a Soviet commander must race against the clock to stop an international nuclear incident which threatens to fire up the Cold War and end the world.

A power-hungry ruler known as King Bohan seeks to obtain the long-protected "Heavenly Sword" in order to use its devastating power for evil. Why doesn't anyone ever use immensely powerful swords for good anymore?
A giant prehistoric praying mantis, recently freed from the Arctic ice, voraciously preys on American military at the DEW Line and works its way south.
Flash Gordon, Dale Arden and Dr. Alexis Zarkov visit the planet Mongo to thwart the evil schemes of Emperor Ming the Merciless, who has set his planet on a collision course with Earth.
After having escaped the Maze, the Gladers now face a new set of challenges on the open roads of a desolate landscape filled with unimaginable obstacles.
An overlooked engineer is sent to Alaska to scope out an eccentric scientist's claim that capturing lightning can be a new source of renewable energy.
At a small, isolated farmhouse in the middle of nowhere, six people must find a way to survive the horror of the Harvestman.
The masked wrestler battles Martians intent on taking over Earth.

In this final installment of the Blind Dead series, a doctor and his wife move to a small inhospitable coastal village where he plans to start a practice only to discover that undead demon-worshiping Templar Knights haunt the place.

When a single father and his son discover their house is haunted by three evil spirits, they turn to the only place they can think of for help...THE INTERNET. Which is where they find an exorcist known as the "Ghostpuncher".
A team of scientists go to a nuclear mining facility to investigate a possible meltdown and instead find a large amount of cloned dinosaurs.
Johnny Victor, an actress living with Louis Galt on the Riveria, becomes involved with Pierre Clemont and learns he is a dangerous criminal.
Francesca, a young pediatrician, and her husband Pedro, move to their new country house trying to forget a tragic event that has marked their lives.
A down-on-his-luck sea captain goes treasure hunting for a wrecked Spanish galleon that is rumored to be cursed by God and protected by supernatural forces.

A mechanic runs afoul of a group of modern day pirates when he falls for a female member of a water based criminal gang.
After discovering that the reason behind all of his physical differences is a genetic mutation called "Marfan Syndrome", Mo is forced to come to terms with a more serious reality.
Does the color of your skin determine your ability to love .

Clark Manning, a fur trapper, is false accused of stealing pelts from other trapper's traps and sets out, with the aid of a Royal Canadian Mounted Policeman, Constanle 'Bones" Blair, to clear his name and find the true thief.

Dick and Suzy become infected with an unknown virus. They soon discover that they have a new found taste for blood. The problem is, they only seem to be able to suck blood out of their victims crotches.
The killer lurks close by.
In a fantasy land called Reptiland a little reptile Tavoo was born and his quest for survival just began .

Albalad, Saudi Arabia. The year is 1919. The day is one of birth and death. Saleh Al Dahaleezi is a son, a husband and a dead man. He returns from the spirit world to his family home to investigate his murder and confront his killer.
Set in the past, in which a family gets a visit from a strange little girl with a frightening prediction.
Plot Unknown - Sequel to the 1993 Anime film, Ninja Scroll.

A westerner named Casey, studying Ninjutsu in Japan, is asked by the Sensei to return to New York to protect the legendary Yoroi Bitsu, an armored chest that contains the weapons of the last Koga Ninja.
An Australian heiress gives up a poor Lord to marry a miner.
A murder mystery irrelevant romantic comedy that takes place in Malibu.
Several ghosts in an ancient palazzo in Rome join together to save their home from destruction. Mastrianni plays several parts and is hilarious. The other actors are great too.
An MMA fighter and a recent immigrant fall for each other in unexpected ways.
A local doctor is recruited as a cold war spy to fulfill a very important secret mission in the Middle East, only to experience that his mission is complicated by a sexy female double agent.
A government agent trains Cody Banks in the ways of covert operations that require younger participants.

movie_name: In the Name of My Daughter
synopsis: Agnès Le Roux, a young independent woman, returns to Nice in 1976 to have a new start in her life after a failed marriage. All while falling in love with an older lawyer.
High drama, set in the English moorland of the 1600's. John Ridd wants revenge on the criminal Doone family, but falls in love with the daughter of the family, Lorna.
The Three Little Pigs as political allegory.
The Merman. King of the Mermaids, set in the Great Barrier Reef Australia

Narok is sent on a crime-job to Morocco, to steal scrolls of Arabic culture. Escaping from the police, he is saved by mad scientist Siegal in his time traveling Mercedes where they travel through a network of portals.
A young nurse and her boyfriend are caught in an all-in-one-night fight for their lives after they unintentionally unleash a deranged man from the trunk of an abandoned car.
In 1924, a group of gold miners returned from Ape Canyon on Mount St. Helens with a terrifying story of an attack by mysterious figures.

movie_name: The Power of the Dark Crystal
synopsis: A girl made of fire steals a shard of a legendary crystal in hopes of reigniting the dying sun.
A man becomes romantically obsessed with his friend's wife as she reminds him of his deceased girlfriend.

Paddington, now happily settled with the Brown family and a popular member of the local community, picks up a series of odd jobs to buy the perfect present for his Aunt Lucy's 100th birthday, only for the gift to be stolen.

In 1871, Horatio Spafford loses all of his possessions in the Great Chicago Fire. Upon rebuilding, his four daughters are lost at sea. Devastated but unwavering in his faith, he writes a song that would become cherished by millions.
Two small time drug-dealers cross paths with a female-assassin, a monster hunter, a Japanese swordsman and even the Devil himself at a gentlemen's club housing murderous she-demons.
A survivor of a supersoldier project must fight his former comrades as a masked hero.
After the robbery of a store, detective Snezhkin suspects one of the drafters working at a saw mill. It starts a mental duel between two strong personalities.
A bullied young boy befriends a young female vampire who lives in secrecy with her guardian.
World War II. Lieutenant Bogdan Mayer is tasked with delivering a sample of valuable metal alloy from Warsaw to London.
A serio-comic look at drug use and abuse and its effect on families in Cabo Verde.

movie_name: Bleach: Fade to Black, I Call Your Name
synopsis: An explosion happens in the middle of Seireitei, and Rukia has a memory loss. Then Urahara tries to seek the background of the events.
One Strange House, Two Strangers and a Strange Night. What would you do when you just have One Night to Change everything about you?

A wide variety of eccentric competitors participate in a wild and illegal cross-country road race. However, the eccentric entrants will do anything to win the road race, including low-down, dirty tricks.
In medieval Hungary, the heir to the throne must prove that he is worthy of being a monarch for preventing the country from chaos.

movie_name: Liang gong po ba tiao xin
synopsis: Three segments where advanced genetics allows men to be pregnant.
Policeman (Nolan) flirts with waitress (Bari) and finds out her sister (Valerie) is involved with the robber (Fowley) he is trailing.
A team of genius-but-broke grad students invent mind-reading technology that destroys their lives and threatens the future of free will itself.
Colos, a former Jedi, must journey across the galaxy and become the absolute ruler, while facing some threats on the way.
A man investigates the murder of his cat.
Angela is raped by 5 men and is out for revenge
A talented mechanic prepares to battle his way through hordes of flesh-eating monsters after his sister is kidnapped on the eve of a zombie apocalypse.
A policeman in need of money is persuaded to take a $1000 bribe to stay away the night a packing house is to be robbed.

A North Carolina sheriff investigates the near-fatal drug overdose of an underachieving college girl, and uncovers many sordid details of her life before and during her descent into drugs and debauchery.
A story about the aristocratic Basak family and their mansion in northern Kolkata.

A deserting soldier is caught and sentenced to death and his only way to win his freedom back is to convince the judge that he had no other choice. His plead tells of both supernatural entities and an extreme fear of death.

Wollmer, the owner of a sawmill in Tyrol, has been assassinated. But since he was hated by almost everyone, there is a plethora of possible assassins. His wife returns to attend the funeral and to try to clean up the sawmill
Destiny of a poor unhappy woman in pre-revolutional Georgia.

One day a group of student decide to check a haunted place situated in the forest at the foot of a mountain. They come there but do not find anything uncommon. However, when the night comes, the young folks find themselves in a trap.
When their home security system malfunctions, a family struggles to survive an attack against a state of the art patrol guard that believes they are intruders.

An eccentric chicken farmer, with the help of his granddaughter, trains his mischievous dog Oddball to protect a penguin sanctuary from fox attacks in an attempt to reunite his family and save their seaside town.

Years after a parallel world verging on self destruction reveals itself to our world, an elite team crosses over to their side for the first time to extract a high value target who may hold the key to reversing our world's climate change.
Two jewel thieves take refuge in a remote village where, unbeknownst to them, the government is about to unleash a virus that turns people into savage killers.

Deals with the quality of being expressive, explores the locations & reveals a life in a small house and its surrounding. The film slowly evolves and shows the history of nothingness of the characters who are in Zoetrope.

A violinist experiences paranormal experience in his flat after a death of a girl who he tries to save due to accident. Later he realises that actually the spirit is helping him and he tries to find out who killed the girl by accident.

A furloughed convict reluctantly gets pulled back into a life of crime, all while trying to recover a hidden treasure, stave off a police detective bent on revenge, and reconnect with a daughter he never really knew.
Prince Adam is sent to the world of Etheria to find his long abducted sister, Adora, and awaken her to her own destiny.

"DopeSmack" follows Alex Santos, a self-taught scientist, who develops a bulletproof suit and receives superhuman powers that allow him to battle super-villains, fight for his city, avenge his father's death and rescue the ones he loves.
In Shanghai, China in the 1940s, a wannabe gangster aspires to join the notorious "Axe Gang" while residents of a housing complex exhibit extraordinary powers in defending their turf.
During a warehouse robbery, a youth counselor is killed by the leader of a teen gang and the prosecuting district attorney is determined to see justice done.

When government attorney Mike Mandell begins to suffer from a mental disorder that periodically transforms him into another mobster personality known as "Sonny," his strange behavior doesn't escape the notice of a narcotics agent.
The farcical adventures of unhappy suicidal billionaire Arthur Lempereur.
An assistant district attorney tries to stop his girlfriend's father from being swindled out of his money by a crooked lawyer in a racetrack scam.
Two men, an assassin and his victim is a small time crook and a question lies between the men is WHO IS ANTHONY?
Elderly Lena Braake loves her tiny house, but her bank wants the property, so a loan officer talks Lena into a new mortgage.
A gardener in East L.A. struggles to keep his son away from gangs and immigration agents while trying to give his son the opportunities he never had.
British businessman Tom is an opium smuggler in the early years of the Republic of China.
As the Nobel Prize winners come to Stockholm to receive their awards, their lives are overturned and perturbed in various ways.
A rogue artificial intelligence kidnaps the son of famed basketball player LeBron James, who then has to work with Bugs Bunny to win a basketball game.
A gang of black militants plots to rob a factory to finance their "revolutionary struggle".
A young woman enters an underground storage facility, where she soon finds herself trapped and stalked by a killer.
A detective out to combat opium sellers. Encountering high-level corruption along with close friends being murdered, the detective sets out to stop the dealers.
Una would do anything to be a successful actress, and when the perfect killer role does arrive, she will do anything to succeed.

movie_name: Dragon Ball Super - Rise of Gods
synopsis: Follows a group of people who have created new and mightier Androids, and reformed The Red Ribbon Army, an evil organization that was once destroyed by Goku in the past, seeking vengeance against Goku and his family.

movie_name: Hotel Inferno 2: The Cathedral of Pain
synopsis: Having been slain by the Mistandrian Cultists, Frank is lost in a special level of Hell: Hotel Inferno. Frank must now collect the five elements that comprise the human soul so that he can return to Earth and reclaim his body.
The final film in the Life Chronicles Trilogy. Beth's son, John, sets out on an adventure to fulfill his destiny.

After Wonderland, Alice dreams of going to Paris. A mouse named Francois, the grandson of Anatole, agrees to take her there if she will tell him her favorite cheese. Along the way they share several stories.

Three college buddies Wah, Matt and Ellen are surprised to see their friend Nam reappears after she has gone missing for several years. Only Matt seems to know the shocking reason behind Nam's reappearance.
Set in the late 1940s jazz scene, a black cop is paired with a white officer for the first time in history to bust a marijuana ring.

A burger shop employee discovers that by changing the background music from pleasantly calming to industrial "noise" music, he can incite riots and a revolution against the looming power of the government.

Four people find themselves stuck on a haunted antique bed where leaving means suffering a gruesome death. Plagued with frightening hallucinations, they must figure out the bed's secrets before they are ultimately picked off one by one.
A group of contestants travel to a castle in Italy to participate in a million dollar treasure hunt hidden on the premises. Little did they know, the lord of the castle hides a deadly secret.
A corrupt Korean cop and a US military CID agent stationed in Seoul get caught up in an action packed detective story in order to solve the gruesome murder of a prostitute.

movie_name: The Statistical Probability of Love at First Sight
synopsis: A teenage girl misses her flight at JFK Airport and meets a young British guy who may turn out to be her true love.

When a young man gets seduced into helping with the removal of a dead body, he must find out the truth behind the corpse before he loses his life or gains a fortune. It's a madcap comic heist film with a lot of heart.
A soldier fighting aliens gets to relive the same day over and over again, the day restarting every time he dies.
The only daughter of the Chinese emperor Han Xuandi, escapes from a strict prince and seeks help from the Gauls and the two brave warriors Asterix and Obelix.

After failing to rob the general store, the gangsters (Josh Hall and Tristen Forrest) seek revenge and make Bobby Dicey (David Burris) pay for interfering with their plan. Can Bobby Dicey end this madness?
A bride's wedding night takes a sinister turn when her eccentric new in-laws force her to take part in a terrifying game.
After being brutally murdered in a subway station, a teen boy awakens to find himself resurrected by a strange computer named Gantz, and forced to fight a large force of invading aliens in Osaka.
Karaoglan comes to the Byzantine land with Balaban to find his father, Baybora.

An enthusiastic American journalist goes to Brazil as the Carnival starts to investigate mass executions of street kids. She meets a savage crime boss called Boca who seemingly wants to help the children and falls for his brutal charm.

The Bananas in Pyjamas are back, and they are getting ready for adventure outside your very own home, with their friends, the teddies and Rat-in-a-Hat, they are going to master our own with an adventure you'll watch again.
A prince passes himself off as Hercules and does battle with an evil queen and her bloodthirsty religious cult in Mycene, in order to free the people of a neighboring kingdom.
In the tradition of Arsenic and Old Lace, comes this morbidly funny Australian tale of murder and mayhem at the hands of two charming old ladies.
See the Strangest Adventure, The Most Faithful Love, The Cruellest Vengeance Ever Written - NOW in One MIGHTY Spectacle.
'In this fast-moving thriller, the work of a brilliant investor puts his entire family and the world at risk'
New York Assistant District Attorney Howard Malloy investigates a series of murders and uncovers an extremist group.

Jilted by her husband on the eve of embarking on an African safari, a woman travels to the continent solo and meets an elephant conservationist.
A homespun minister (Andy Griffith) and his family move to a small town where he tries to win the support and trust of his new congregation.
When a tween mermaid enthusiast discovers an ailing water creature, she uses a magical wish to change the fate of their existence - and her own.

It all starts with the discovery of a mysterious mummy. Dr. Stevens brings the suspected missing-link's remains back to the United States. Soon the creature's body turns up missing and people are suddenly being brutally murdered.
A look at the top-secret, high-tech espionage war going on between cats and dogs, of which their human owners are blissfully unaware.
Luke and Roger are just another couple of college guys trying to lose their virginity. But when Luke sees something unusual, he begins to suspect that the girls on campus aren't exactly human.

Malik, an aspiring painter, takes a job as a security guard at an art museum to make extra cash. However things quickly become terrifying when the figure inside one of the paintings starts speaking to him and walking around at night.

The psychology and life of Brazilian hitmen, common in the Northeast part of the country. In this particular case, the story revolves around a young and idealistic politician from Salvador, whom the enemies are eager to eliminate.

The adventures of Golden Retriever pup Napoleon and his friend, the parrot Birdo Lucci.
A lawyer turned private investigator takes on a missing person case, propelling him on an unexpected and life-altering quest.
Logline is being kept under wraps.
Follows a housewife psychologically terrorized by a manipulative contractor, leading to a twisted battle of wits with deliciously unexpected results.

A group of rodeo trick-riders recruits a young girl to join them.

Feature version of the same-titled 1930 serial, with re-shot and added material.

Godzilla's fiftieth Anniversary project, in which Godzilla travels around the world to fight his old foes and his allies plus a new, mysterious monster named Monster X.
A boy and a girl who are friends from their childhood fight and break up during their school and college. They meet again at the age of 25 and fall in love.

movie_name: Everything Will Be Fine in the End
synopsis: Follows three grifters dealing with a meaningless existence.
Frank films an instructional how to kill criminals show as a way of reaching out to people, but when he hires a camera man, he discovers what he'd really needed was a friend.

An unemployed graduate risks his freedom to commit a crime that he hopes would pay off big time.

movie_name: Tie Me Up! Tie Me Down!
synopsis: An unbalanced but alluring former mental patient takes a porn star prisoner in the hopes of convincing her to marry him.
A safe cracker claims he has lost his memory when two criminals come calling for their cut of the bank heist loot.

Jakub Procházka, orphaned as a boy and raised in the Czech countryside by his grandparents, overcomes his odds to become the country's first astronaut.
A photographer finds herself falling under the spell of a witch.
A female cop goes undercover to trap a dangerous serial killer.
Four friends decide to record themselves having a séance. When they summon a demon by mistake they'll have to find a way to drive the demon out before it destroys them all.

The Spirit Stalkers reality show, once a big hit, faces cancellation without a ratings boost, which leads the investigative team to Gloria Talman, whose house is rampant with unexplained ghostly activity.
