A weary undercover cop must maintain his cover while trying to save the daughter of a notorious Triad Boss from becoming collateral damage in a sting operation gone wrong.
A couple struggling in their marriage head out of town for the weekend and soon face unexpected visitors who challenge them at every turn.
A grad student and her friends become trapped at a women's academy run by a cult of homicidal feminists.
The movie tells the story of a man who sees himself as a bully in his dream. It is a comedy film starring Rustu Asyali who legendary actress of the films of Keloglan (Bald boy).
A group of scientists trek across space to locate the original DNA of humanity, but when they get there they find the unexpected.
Jun-oh, an insurance claims agent, faces off with a client who he suspects of committing murders with the intention of collecting insurance premiums.
A group of friends must confront their most terrifying fears when they awaken the dark powers of an ancient spirit board.
A nice young couple move into an eerie house which is located in a small Louisiana town, unaware of its violent history, and soon find themselves tormented by the previous owners.
Kitahara Shuji, an ordinary business man turns into a spy for his town's war against a neighboring town in a Dystopian society.
Four friends struggle to separate their nightmares and hallucinations from reality as people around them begin gruesomely dying after they take part in their own occult ritual.
A framed man is saved when a nurse confesses to killing her bastard child's father.
Myra Maynard, is plagued by a wide variety of metaphysical assaults by the corrupt Black Order, a secret organization which uses magic, curses and any supernatural means possible to achieve its ends.
A reclusive inventor must protect the young son of the lord of Praxton from assassins who seek to overthrow the government and propel the planet into a maelstrom of chaos and civil war.
The flight of a rugby team crashes on a glacier in the Andes, few passengers who survived the crash, find themselves in one of the world's toughest environments to survive.
A science-fiction social drama. Four strong women escape Mars to 1888 period Philadelphia. The rest is history.

A bush-flying duo crash-land in the heart of the Peruvian jungle where an unscrupulous speculator controls a precious emerald source and an entire mining community. Can they right the wrongs, and in the process, manage to make a profit?
Jeremy and his family go on a coast to coast road trip from Boston to San Francisco. But during the trip they notice unusual activity at a town in Western Massachusetts.

1870's America. A Chinese immigrant falsely accused of murdering a white woman is viciously hunted down; he'll have to prove his innocence in a time when people of color had "no legal rights" and could be bought and sold for a profit.
When a black ops team is sent to investigate the crash of an unidentified aircraft, they soon find themselves being hunted by the former occupants.
When a suburban housewife discovers that her husband has become a Zombie with an appetite for human flesh, she must decide whether to stay in the marriage or wade into the dating pool.
During the early days of the Iraq War, a kidnapped archaeologist must discover who his captor is and why he's being held before the situation ends in bloodshed.
A series of murders at a Santa Barbara beach house has three couples terrified for their own safety and pitted against one another. The murderer had to have been one of them.

As loyal as a dove, a family man is about to tell his first lie to his wife when he falls for an enchanting woman in a billowy red dress. With a bit of help, he just might get what he wishes for; however, is love always a bed of roses?
An exotic bird salesman falls into the dark crime world of Hilo, Hawaii.

Tony (Claudine Barretto) is woman desperate to find love. She meets Lawrence (Rico Yan), a photographer, who offers her to help find the man of her dreams. Together, they will discover the real meaning of "True Love".
Five bizarre stories with no apparent connection to one and other eventually become intertwined, resulting in surreal circumstances.
An expelled priest is accused of killing the servant girl who fled form his attack.
An American living in 19th-century Tahiti gets involved in intrigue against the French colonial government.

After loosing Matthew, Remy is in despair. But he cannot mourn as he must stop Daniel from destroying the world of sorcery! He cannot do it alone, with the help of Ariel, they see the Inqusitor. Is Matthew Caldor truly gone?
A former cop reunites with his estranged daughter, visiting her at her college campus 10 years after a family tragedy - when a mass shooting breaks out.
Machiko and Haruki are not allowed to meet. When at last they find each other, Haruki has to part for Europe.
When the youngest goes missing after an accident, Eli and his family and friends relationships are put to the test.
As an Orc horde invades the planet Azeroth using a magic portal, a few human heroes and dissenting Orcs must attempt to stop the true evil behind this war.
A criminal mastermind known as the Crimson Ghost is out to steal a device called the Cyclotrode, which can short-circuit every electrical current on the planet.

movie_name: The Apple Dumpling Gang Rides Again
synopsis: The adventures of two idiotic outlaw wannabees, Amos and Theodore.

When the newly crowned Queen Elsa accidentally uses her power to turn things into ice to curse her home in infinite winter, her sister Anna teams up with a mountain man, his playful reindeer, and a snowman to change the weather condition.
A famous horror writer finds inspiration for her next book after she and her husband take in a young couple.
A troubled hitman seeks aid from a forger to help him get papers to China. However, the drug lord has hired replacements to finish the job, and kill the hitman.
A high-profile murder case, puts a man's childhood recollections in conflict with the community's presumption of guilt.
Film makers catch live footage beyond their wildest dreams while shooting a low budget movie.The shocked and stunned Actors and Film makers are traumatized by what they have all just witnessed.
A story of love interwoven throughout a lifetime
Bully Bob is in love, but it is very difficult to say it. At the same time beautiful Sally interested in making their presence felt. When a sudden, a television crew to town she gets her chance.
A post-apocalyptic tale of Hope, Faith, Death, and the discovery of humanity last breath for survival.

A young man recently released from prison recruits his three best friends to rob the local drug kingpin who is responsible for his incarceration. Can he get revenge and win back his fed-up girlfriend?
A woman doesn't realize that the man she has just married is a gangster. When she is implicated in a murder he committed, she turns to an ex-boyfriend, who is now a park ranger, for help.
The "origin" movie of the title Ultraman, who befriends a little boy named Musashi and fights an updated version of a classic Ultra-foe, Baltan-Seijin.

A gang of armed robbers finds a safe haven in a secluded village crammed with witches--only to encounter the bizarre, the unexpected, and the occult. Can they save themselves, and the rest of the world from the next witch apocalypse?

movie_name: The Chronicles of Anatta: Mark of Existence
synopsis: A Taoist monk journeys through history to find other reincarnated souls and deliver a device to those chosen to save mankind from a prophesied apocalypse.
Interlocking stories about sex, control and paranoia.

A deranged woman tries to create the perfect man - by harvesting her one favorite body part from each of the imperfect men she dates. Beneath the murder and mayhem is a simple story of someone needing to be loved.
Kurt and Sonja are happily married and dream of buying a house and have children. One day Kurt's old friend Nick pops up. Secrets from Sonja's past life surface.
"Awakened" is a psychological drama/mystery thriller about a young woman who returns home to unravel the mysteries behind her mother's untimely death 14 years before.

A play within a play within a play within a play. Actors perform a play in a house; an audience member invites them to work in his own home improvising a play around his own life. The line between fiction and reality blurs.

Never in the history of Philippine movies has there been a film such as this: four sets of great stars, four great directors, in a story of life and love, horror and romance, action and suspense in stunning realism.

Alan, a timid anthropology graduate student is coming to terms with his fate as the last man on Earth, until he discovers Sarah, a beautiful, intelligent woman who can't stand that Alan is the last man she'll ever see.
A young boy journeys across the boundaries of reality to a secret, haunted place, half-a-century back in time, in this tale of enchantment, shadows and lost memories.
The secret is out, and the Atractor's sanctuary has been revealed to the enemy. With Quon badly hurt, it's up to the rest to defend their homes, their lives, and their freedom.
A woman tries to help her twin sister, with whom she has a strong connection, recover from a trauma. But weird things surround their lives.

movie_name: Bubba Nosferatu: Curse of the She-Vampires
synopsis: This prequel to Bubba Ho-Tep finds Elvis shooting a film in Louisiana when he runs afoul of a coven of she-vampires.
A cop on the verge is sent to his small hometown to shape up. When a girl no one cares about goes missing, his slow recovery ends abruptly.

movie_name: Fate/Kaleid Liner Prisma Illya: The Movie - Oath Under Snow
synopsis: A young Shirou Emiya and his adoptive father Kiritsugu travel to Fuyuki in order to investigate the Sakatsuki family, who are rumored to be harboring a child with powerful magic abilities.
A troubled police detective investigates fixed betting and corruption in the world of heavyweight boxing and uncovers a plot by a crime boss to use computerized data to rig fights.
Two friends get busted for drug possession and the illegal ways they go through to gather money for the bribe.
THIS IS A TRUE-TO-LIFE STORY OF A POLICE OFFICER, Sgt, ROMEO MAGANTO, WHO RISKS HIS LIFE FOR HIS PROFESSION.
After wondering what her life would be without children, workaholic Sharon is unexpectedly granted her wish while on Christmas vacation.

A shy office boy not only suffers from a lack of success in women, but also humiliated by everyone around. However, things change when he mixes ingredients from his late grandfather's medicine shop to create the ultimate aphrodisiac drug.
When Ravi is falsely accused of a crime and sentenced to imprisonment, his boss' wife promises to take care of his younger brother. However, Ravi is unable to find his brother after he is released.
When his father is killed, Robert decides to be a policeman.

After killing and cannibalizing several men and being found unfit for trial, Regina Stevens desperately tried to convince her psychiatric caregivers that she wasn't mentally ill, but was in fact slowly becoming a real life zombie.
Two very different love stories cross each other in warm and magical way. A humanistic and yet mysterious film about love and death near the German/Danish border.
Returning from European exile where she avoided testifying against her criminal associates, a former singer with a tell-all diary is murdered to ensure her silence.
PCS is an action thriller about a man who discovers the truth about a series of mysterious events.
A mysterious ethicist hires a blunt representative to help four troubled teens.
Du-sik, the owner of the DVD room, and Tae-jung, a part-timer, confront each other to protect Room No. 7.
Crichton-esque techno-thriller about hackers and sysadmin fighting to escape a data center overrun by a deadly artificial intelligence.
Arch criminals clash violently at a house by the river.
This anthology slasher film presents eight killers in five gory tales.
Gordolfo, a self-stylized ladies man, and his doting mother (Naborita) help out a childhood friend claim an inheritance by beating the feared wrestler Tulipan Jones.
A formal Naval officer is forced into piloting a Narco submarine for a Mexican drug cartel looking to move a big load of cocaine.
A poor gardener's wife nurses a countess's weak baby, gets a taste for wealth and takes a rich lover.
Three twenty-somethings find themselves in an impossible time loop, where each day they awaken to the same terrifying day as the preceding one.
A comedy centered around a group of people who meet -- and whose personalities collide -- over the course of a couple's wedding.
Terror strikes the underground train system in Moscow in the form of a flood from a collapsed tunnel.

Qiaohu is having a temper tantrum because his mom is spending too much time on taking care of the little sister, he meets with the little inventor squirrel Jin Jin from the forest kingdom while he tells the story to his friends.

Taking its cue from classic survival-thrillers such as 'Duel' and 'Deliverance', 'Survival Instinct' is a fast-paced edge-of-your seat thriller with a strong female lead and a plausible, morally-ambiguous villain.

The dark and decadent journey into one man's nightmare of betrayal, lust and ultimate death...going beyond the realm will bring forth the terror of real love for John Ashcroft as he searches for the answers to all deceptions.

Mothra's egg washes ashore and is claimed by greedy entrepreneurs who refuse to return it to her fairies. As Godzilla arises near Nagoya, the people of Infant Island must decide if they are willing to answer Japan's own pleas for help.
A strait-laced French student moves into an apartment in Barcelona with a cast of six other characters from all over Europe. Together, they speak the international language of love and friendship.
Sent out to prevent Getafix from being thrown off the edge of the Earth by the Romans, Asterix and Obelix find themselves in America and encounter a Native tribe.
An agent from Allspace arrives on Earth to prevent the Total Takeover by the evil Neural Nebula Network.

movie_name: Pure Bloodlines: Blood's Thicker Than Water
synopsis: Continuing on from the successful action/drama/romance/martial arts indy film 'Pure Bloodlines:The Ties That Bind us'. Comes the sequel 'Bloods Thicker Than Water' hot from winning a media award at the 'London Hall of Fame'. Twin brothers Eric and Alec continue the hunt against head vampire Mr Visconti and his supernatural assassins.
A man with incredible powers is sought by the government and military.
After phony stage mentalist Triton mysteriously acquires supernatural powers of precognition, he becomes frightened and abandons his act to live in anonymity.
Two awaken on Earth with no recollection of their past and embark on a devastating crime spree but are sent to an infamous lunar penitentiary named Dead Leaves.
Four strangers become trapped in the elevator of St. Julian-a decrepit, inner-city building. One of the four is an assassin.
After years of being tread upon and cheated on, a man awakens to find his face has a been replaced by a blank, white mask.
A teenage boy is cursed with periodically turning into a sheepdog.
A group of old friends meet up for a house party which quickly goes awry. Now the friends must work together to prevent the apocalypse.
Before he retires, investigator Andy Rosenzweig vows to solve a case that has haunted him for his entire career - the 27-year-old murder of his friend.
Kannan, a local school teacher, has Mathukutty, a street musician, pretend to be a qualified band master for his school band. The duo keep struggling to keep the act up.
When six women all claim to have independently killed the same man, lawyer turned detective Lois Delgrad has hours to solve the crime or they all go free.

Sher Foxworth is a local hero after running into a fire, but there are those who want to see him fail. One such person is Cordell Pixler, the same lawyer that ruined the career of Sher's father. Meanwhile, an arsonist is on the loose.
Clumsy but deft Londre confronts a corrupt priest and a Mayor of the town to help youngsters in love.
Refugees of racial violence in the 70s, an interracial couple finds themselves stuck in their haunted basement when a gang of anti-war extremists invades their new California home.

Brutal murders in a small town bring together a young journalist and a mourning widower hell-bent on vengeance. Are these just a another series of serial killings, the work of a copycat, or part of a vast conspiracy?
A group of ladies with strong friendships, provide support to each other on issues of career, family and relationships.
Anandakuttan has to bring home his sister who had ran away with a Tamilian.
When a young woman ends up dead in an LA hotel, her twin sister follows to find out what happened - and discovers the hotel has many more secrets to hide.
A failed singer in Los Angeles gets caught up with a secret society and faces danger beyond her comprehension.

Kyle leads his friends on a fantastic journey when their a time machine malfunctions sending them to an alternate earth where magic is science, dragons rule the skies, a cat talks and an evil king wants them dead.
The story of 1970s musician and activist Helen Reddy.
The son of a murderer is entangled in his father's crimes and is sentenced to a rehabilitive farm, where he learns a new way of life.

A prison guard at Leavenworth with lofty ideals and hopes of reform struggles to understand a violent, hateful and conscienceless convict. The result is a written testimonial to a crime that no one could have predicted.
A team of girls go on a killing spree across the country.
When a number of old men being to die off, all beneficiaries of a policy established when they were in college, insurance clerk Mary Lou and her boyfriend Dr. Wilson investigate.

Ji Mo is regarded as an outlier because she can see monsters. One day, she sees a monster in the supermarket and meets a monster hunter, Meng. She discovers that there really are monsters in the world, and she is involved in a new storm.
Love, betrayal and death in Bangkok.
A flight crew tries to save the survivors of a shipwreck off the coast of Japan during a raging typhoon.

When Harriet Zapper is hired to find the identity of Karel Duval, and the true heir to the Duval family fortune, a bloody trail of murders leads the Big Zapper to the South of France and into a hornet's nest of betrayal and death.

When King John imposes oppressive taxes and cruel treatment upon the local population in medieval England, the son of legendary bandit Robin Hood reforms his father's "Merry Men" to once more rise against the king.

At a Hong Kong shopping center, Buck Yuen's (Jackie Chan's) intuition warns him. He saves a robbery's loot and gets on television, ends up in Istanbul via South Korea, and accidentally becomes a spy. Fortunately, he knows Kung Fu.
Chairman and Counsellor hunt down previous Symmetry organizations by reverse engineering their own Symmetry.
When an arrogant old millionaire ends up friendless, jobless, and broke; a used phone and its surviving voicemails help save his life, and his soul.
An injured stunt woman is infected by an ancient biological compound, when a side job as a PI goes wrong.
A reclusive scientist who makes a time machine to round-up the greatest minds in history in order to solve all of the world's current problems.

movie_name: Untitled Taika Waititi Star Wars Film
synopsis: The plot is unknown.
When a student's suicide rattles an all-girls Catholic school, a clairvoyant guidance counselor leans on a ghost to uncover the convent's abusive past.
A German submarine disguised as a merchant sailboat attacks foreign merchant ships and drowns them. The Soviet merchant ship, turned into a warship, sets off for the interception of a "pirate".
A woman meets her male partner for a coffee at his place. The woman discovers a male intruder upstairs and struggles with the decision of waiting for the cops or killing him.

A Rin-Tin-Tin serial presented in 12 episodes. The mysterious Wolf Man is terrorizing settlers in a western town. With the help of Rinty, young Jimmy Carter unmasks the Wolf Man and foils his evil plot.
An absorbing story of love and deception a dramatic giant that dwarf's all others.

Secret Service agents target a presidential candidate by hijacking the Concorde he is on and kill the pilots. It's up to an Air Force officer, nicknamed "Washout" because he can't fly a plane, to land the Concorde.
Follows the life of Cu Chulainn, the hound of Ulster.
The memories of people are erased periodically and replaced with the new memories.
A madman kidnaps an innocent child and only an ex-race car driver can deliver the ransom, a fortune in gold, in time.
An Evil Threat Sends Bounty Hunters after DKE defectors, the Farazies
Based on a true story. Isobel goes for a job interview, gets locked in and sex trafficked for 3 consecutive days.
A cancer stricken child tries to find the meaning of death.

Don, a wanted criminal, dies in a police chase. DSP D'Silva is the only one who knows about his death, and to get hold of the gang he trains Don-lookalike Vijay. But Vijay faces danger from the police and from within the gang.
Naga lives with his stepfather, Vishwanath Gowda, and his half-siblings. His life takes a turn when his stepfather makes Naga in charge of his estate, which enrages his half-brother.

movie_name: Once Upon a Time: The Rock Opera
synopsis: Join Emma and the gang and sing along in this zany musical spoof of ABC's Once Upon a Time.
The lone surviving thief of a violent bank robbery is sprung from a high security facility and administered an experimental drug.

Armand and Leila are in love. Together they plan to go to New York for an internship. But few days before their departure, Mahmoud, Leila's big brother, comes back from his long-term stay in Yemen, during which he has changed drastically.
A knight hires a tramp to pose as his lost son and wed his niece, who loves a younger man.

movie_name: Xuxa and the Mystery of the Little Ugly Princess
synopsis: Princess Ugliness mysteriously disappeared. Because her story is not well known to children, she risks being forgotten forever. But to prevent this from happening, all enchanted princesses come together to save the little princess.
A detective tries to remain loyal to his partner, and his best friend - a mobster.
MISTERIOS DEL PASADO straddling drama, fantasy and suspense, tells the story of a girl who tragically loses her brother.
In the distant future, a father and daughter survive in a weather station with the support of a Artificial Intelligence. But an unexpected event will turn their stay into a race to survive.

An unemployed astrophysicist finds a job of a docker at a grocery store, where he falls in love with a street-wise saleswoman in the produce department. But the groom runs away at the wedding reception.
A nameless assassin is hunted through the dark streets of an empty city, pursued by the mysterious man he had just killed...
A young girl tries to understand how she mysteriously gained the power to set things on fire with her mind.
On leaving prison, a former gang member faces a world of vendettas that drags him to a bloody path
While attending his brother's wedding, a serial womanizer is haunted by the ghosts of his past girlfriends.
A long time ago, long after the conclusion of Episode IX..
It's been asleep for two hundred million years. Now it been awakened by aliens from another galaxy. The aliens are using Yonggary to destroy mankind.

The unsettling true story of America's first serial killing family. A troubled doctor searches for patients swallowed by the prairie and encounters the Benders, homesteaders trapped by a life of unspeakable sin.

A recreation of the trial and several hypotheses of the death of the model Alicia Muñiz on February 14, 1988 in the city of Mar del Plata starring the world boxing champion Carlos Monzón as the main suspect of the crime.
Xiaogang is rude to his younger sister Xiaoduo until she performs an unselfish act.
A psychopathic gangster rapes and murders a woman and then her brother kills everyone responsible one by one.
Three friends who con people by exploiting their fear of ghosts are hired by a man to scare his business rival. However, things change after the three encounter a real ghost.
Mary Contrary is set to marry Tom Piper when he is kidnapped by Roderigo and Gonzorgo, two goons working for the evil Barnaby who wants to marry Mary for her inheritance.
Famous TV anchor Shiva Shivu marries Paru but due to some unfortunate circumstances, he gets killed by a Mumbai based hitman named Kittappa.

When a revered diplomat's plane is diverted and crashes in the peaks of Tibet, he and the other survivors are guided to an isolated monastery at Shangri-La, where they wrestle with the invitation to stay.
Two foreigners decide to take a trip. On the way, they come across a Sheriff. The terror begins.
Seven dwarfs face a dragon and a witch to find the one man who can save their beloved princess.
The victim of a vicious assault faces diabolical retribution linked to her role in the demise of her assailant.
It's everyone's favorite time of year in the magical land of Puff. However, when Pet Pals notice the evil Crow Witch is trying to ruin their big party, the animals begin their hunt to save the town.

Sam, a disenchanted young man, finds a mysterious woman swimming in his apartment's pool one night. The next morning, she disappears. Sam sets off across LA to find her, and along the way he uncovers a conspiracy far more bizarre.
A nightclub manager with financial problems accepts an offer to seduce another man's wife for money, and soon finds himself entwined in a web of double-crossing con artists.

During the Cold War, an organization called "Patriot" created a super-hero squad, which includes members of multiple Soviet republics. For years, the heroes had to hide their identities, but in hard times they must show themselves again.
A group of young astronauts are sent on a mission to establish a colony on Jupiter's moon.
Two women descend into madness after an alleged meteor strike sets off a series of strange events in their town of Troy, N.Y.

The government cover-up of the causes behind a massive explosion in a futuristic UK metropolis spur photo journalist Jennifer Preston on to search for the truth and in the process blow open a paranormal phenomenon haunting the city.

When two brothers Angelo and the younger Paulie, get into a fight, it's broken up by the local Mafia don, the much feared and respected Santo. Fed up with their dead-end-jobs, Angelo, Paulie and two friends abandon the 9-5 grind
In a framework of adventure and suspense, the events of the film revolve in one night, in which the hero (Karim Kassem) enters an atmosphere of risk in order to save himself and his friends.
Kaede and Hisano form a club. When Hisano vanishes, Kaede throws himself into bringing change to the club.
Three roommates are in search of true love. They each find a girl with whom they fall head over heels in love with. Now they just have to get the women to reciprocate.

Widowed Audrey retreats to an isolated Welsh cabin after a failed suicide attempt, to recuperate. Still haunted by the tragic death of her husband and struggling with her psychosis, she begins to hear strange noises.
A group of teenage friends spend the evening telling stories - only to find the stories are all too real.
Dee Dee is back with a vengeance, but his street antics lead him to retaliate against one of the biggest drug dealers in the city of Atlanta.

Emiliano Saudado is a writer who goes to a small village in the Italian to collect information about some popular legends. Saudato looks for some details about the legend of the "Seeds of God". He will discover a terrible truth.

A young American tourist is found dead in the south of France. The possible culprits are numerous so the police investigates to discover what she's done during the five weeks she spent in France before being murdered.
A research vessel finds a missing ship, commanded by a mysterious scientist, on the edge of a black hole.
The TITANS OF ACTION thunder across the screen in a mighty showdown.
Centers on a group of corporate consultants who work together on a mysterious and ethically ambiguous project for the government.
When a son of a gangster shark boss is accidentally killed while on the hunt, his would-be prey and his vegetarian brother decide to use the incident to their own advantage.
A UN reporter broadcasts a report on the appearance of a prehistoric monster that emerges from hibernation while a pharmaceutical company seeks publicity with a monster of their own. (US Version)
An young priest commits a crime when he falls in love with a beautiful and troubled woman.
Plot kept under wraps.
While traveling across country with her fiancé, Beth wakes alone in an isolated clinic to find her unborn baby has been removed. Just how far will she go to get her child back?
A Navy veteran purchases a government surplus vessel and becomes involved in the capture of waterfront racketeers.
While on a journey of physical and spiritual healing, a brilliant neurosurgeon is drawn into the world of the mystic arts.
A computer programmer who uses his mind palace as a hard drive, loses the most important data in there. He should find it.
Byomkesh Bakshi with his confidant Ajit digs deep into the case of a tripartite story of love, betrayal and infidelity.
Pororo and his friends go on an adventure as they travel on the ship and they search for treasure.
The hidden powers that run the World, exist in all ages and will exist forever by changing their names and appearances through mythological characters.
Blade, now a wanted man by the FBI, must join forces with the Nightstalkers to face his most challenging enemy yet: Dracula.
Two friends collude to prank their mutual friend, but their trick has repercussions they never envisaged.

movie_name: Sith Wars: Episode II - Legacy of the Sith
synopsis: After the defeat at Agamar, Darth Vader discovers that both Master Yoda and Master Vaal, are training a new apprentice who is rumored to be able to defeat the sith, now he takes a personal vendetta against the rest of the Jedi order.

Menousis, a teacher in a village in Thessaly, clashes with Turkish Resul Aga over Anastasia's heart. Menousis secretly marries the girl and Resul tries unsuccessfully to burn down his school. The two men are preparing to clash.
A man obsessed with the idea of writing "high literature" starts to cause conflicts around him to write about it.
Karan goes to London to stop a terrorist attack on India.
A wanted Russian lieutenant becomes a masked vigilante seeking vengeance upon the man who stole his family's land, only to fall for his charming daughter.
A study in fear escalates into a heart-stopping nightmare for a professor and three subjects trapped in a mysterious mansion.
A private detective journeys to Africa to find a legenday white gorilla. The gorilla turns out to be an escaped Nazi war criminal.

International genre favorite Bill Oberst Jr. plays an amnesiac horror writer who becomes trapped in his own nightmare as terrifying images emerge that may or may not be memories, madness, or both! Remembering can be murder!
Dhuruvan is a forest ranger, who is assigned the job of training five girls from the NCC camp. The group hears of a terrorist activity being carried out in the forest and makes a plan to defeat them.
A young environmentalist wakes, trapped, kidnapped in the elevator of a super high-rise building at the mercy of her tormentors
The stroy of the famous Siva devotee, Kanappa.
Honest hardworking and hard fisted.
In Paris, a cat who lives a secret life as a cat burglar's aide must come to the rescue of Zoe, the little girl he lives with, after she falls into a gangster's clutches.

movie_name: The Return of Dr. Fu Manchu
synopsis: The villainous master criminal Dr. Fu Manchu sets out to destroy the people he holds responsible for the death of his family.

Manuel bids farewell to his routine and boards a 15th century vessel under pirate law. Treason on board triggers a series of terrible events our protagonist overcomes while keeping his moral principles intact.
Dolly is a con woman who marries unsuspecting men and on the wedding night runs away with their money. On the case is a police officer and two disgruntled grooms.
Her passion made her the most ferocious female spy in history - at the cost of her one true love.
A neglected and naive teenage girl uses the internet to deceive people for gifts until she crosses the wrong person and things take a terrifying turn.
Follows unexplained events surrounding the first alleged haunting in a public housing project that terrified a young boy in New Jersey.
A faithless barrister's wife enters a convent and fakes drowning so he marry his mistress.

A robbery goes horrifyingly wrong when five have-a-go criminals are forced to take refuge from the police in an old castle. What starts out as 'one last job' quickly becomes a hilarious, fun-filled journey of ghostly misfortunes.
A guy vacationing in Europe gets sucked into dangerous conspiracy when he runs into an old friend.
When an expired Flu shot turns the High School Faculty into Zombies, the Students must come together to make through the day.

Da King Fernando Poe Jr. stars as a jeepney driver that sparks a romance with a spoiled balikbayan heiress, played by beauty queen Anjanette Abayari. But when an evil man is after her wealth, their lives are at stake.

Salma is an orphan who has spent most of her life searching out clues about her parents. One day, she discovers a special book that is filled with stories and sets off onto an adventure with her foster brothers to find her parents.
Bhanwar is a Gujrati features Film-It's an untold story of folk puppeteer in moder Gujrat. A Cinematic Film with entertainment.
A young Prince is visited by the Ghost of his father and compelled to vengeance - but can he stop thinking for long enough to do it?
A social drama about the lust of men and women.
The Treasure of Sierra Madre meets Jaws.

When the chips are down and everything seems lost, it's good to have a best friend.

At an absurdly self-indulgent student film festival, the directors of the (mostly terrible) short films start getting killed off one by one and a budding British documentary filmmaker decides to investigate.
A beautiful British intelligence agent attempts to reveal the identity and motives of a powerful German spy during World War 1.

When a Mafia don's right-hand man, a bulldog named Sonny, swallows his ring, comedy ensues as two of the don's best soldiers try and retrieve the ring from Sonny, who has been adopted by a new family.
After a workaholic banker journeys to Monaco to investigate the suspicious activities of a company, he finds himself framed for murder and running for his life.

When a clever young goblin learns he is on the wrong side of history -- part of a evil overlord's army -- he is cast out of his castle, where he encounters a ragtag group of wizards, giants, princesses, and other fantastical creatures.

Following a tragic accident in 1977, the three Winters siblings move into the mysterious home they inherited. They soon discover the house holds dark secrets that seek to threaten everything they hold dear.
A detective must solve a case where a girl was murdered in a room--and all the doors and windows were locked from the inside.

A budding playwright and his wife attend a dinner party hosted by wealthy, cultural elites, who have promised to bankroll the writer's latest play to Broadway, but, in fact, have darker designs in mind for the couple.
Slip confronts a monopolizing taxicab company whose criminal tactics aim to drive its rivals out of business.
Man proposes and God Disposes, A Canadians greed towards the dowry, An Indians greed towards women and Singaporean love towards his loved ones collides in front of Godsview
An ex-con and thief must allude the authorities and the criminal underworld as he attempts to locate a stash of jewelry stolen by the Nazis.

The trials and tribulations of two high school students deeply in love with each other, but facing the challenge of their completely different social backgrounds, during the twilight of the communist Romania.
Karthik and Yamini can't stand each other, but there lies the twist when opposites attract.
The childhood of author Lu Xun, called A Zhang in the film, and his two brothers.

movie_name: Snow White and the Three Stooges
synopsis: An ice-skating Snow White finds refuge from the Wicked Queen with the Three Stooges.

What if there was a seed that could grow without rain and sun, even without soil? The genius inventor pig Albert Einswein has with his super seed the solution for Cattle hill, which is struggling with supplies.
Arriving home to find his native land under the yoke of corrupt merchants, an adventurer named Sadko sets sail in search of a mythical bird of happiness.
T.J. and the gang must save summer vacation from disappearing forever.
Animated version of the classic story of a young farmgirl who is transported to the magic land of Oz.
An experienced police detective has to investigate the murder of an unknown woman dressed in a scarlet dress.
Prequel to The Overnight Party
An average aquarium cleaner house-sits for a gigolo, only to be forced to become one himself.
A Chicago cop -- with zero wanderlust -- must travel to London to solve a crime.
Five interwoven tales of horror about online dating.
Gerak Kilat tells the adventures of Jefri Zain a secret agent who uncovers the secrets of Commander Jeaman who founded the Russian Spy.

Inspired from the golden age of religious cinema, Satan Hates You is a graphic horror film that tells the stories of a brother and sister and their personal struggles with the ultimate evil: Lucifer himself!
In the ancient forest of Soza, a fighter, a thief, and a hermit go searching for a magical sword that can control minds.
The story revolves around a group of teenage boys. When one of them suddenly gets a chance to make a pact with the devil things shift quickly in their lives.
An ex-soldier is being convinced to take his murdered father's place as an honest mayor of his hometown. But when political enemies play dirty, he opts for the vengeful path of a vigilante.
A group of kids must save the planet from polluting invaders with the help of a friendly alien.

Charlie Darwin is a Time Traveling vigilante, join him as he reflects his journey when cornered by his past wife Lara Darwin in 1984 who takes a fancy to this unknown older version of her husband and delves in to his life story.

USAF Captain Brandon Clark returns home to his small town to help turn a group of high school students into a "well oiled" clay target shooting team in time for a national competition, while mending his relationship with his father.
A down-and-out law student sues Satan for $8 trillion dollars. Satan appears to defend himself with seven of the greatest trial lawyers and the trial of the century begins.
Reyes Mendoza (Carmen Sevilla) is a Spanish artist who arrives in Mexico in 1913 and finds herself involved in the Pancho Villa (Jose Elias Moreno) revolution.
Astronauts travel back in time to a prehistoric Earth.
Railway Anti-Criminal Task Force (RATs) investigates three unrelated murders happened in a train.
American ambassador is kidnapped by terrorists after an accident with the plane that was taking him to the Philippines, for a special mission.
A hypochondriac vacations in the tropics for the fresh air - and finds himself in the middle of a revolution instead.
Several children find out what's the matter with a wreck offshore, which puts them into jeopardy.
Continuing his "legendary adventures of awesomeness", Po must face two hugely epic, but different threats: one supernatural and the other a little closer to home.
It's day one of the end of the world, as vampires take over the Earth in one night of blood and slaughter. Four strangers must work together if they are to stay alive.
Amidst the hot Italian summer of Rome, two unlikely people, a young American college graduate and a forty-something Italian writer, discover forbidden love, lust, and connection in the Eternal City.

movie_name: Chronicles of the Roman Numeral X
synopsis: The minority party attempts an insurrection using illicit romance as a weapon against it's enemies. The plot succeeds, but with considerably different results than anticipated.
A jaded cop. A narcoleptic journalist. A nation divided. A Fantasy you'd wish never come true.
A girl is transferred to a mysterious boarding school, where she is forced to discover its secrets to survive.
Nobita and his friends go to rescue Shizuka into the world of the "Arabian Nights (Thousand and One Nights)".
"Quota" is all about the underprivileged children with families whose dues are yet a question in the society.

movie_name: Charlie Chan in the Chinese Cat
synopsis: Charlie Chan investigates the locked-room murder of a chess expert.
A veteran of the Chechen War is helped by the ghosts of his two fallen comrades to leave the war behind.
The Henderson's just met their new neighbor and she is truly hot. What they do not know is how far their relationship with her will get.
An international superstar's career and life are turned upside down after discovering an obsessed fan is stalking her.
Lost in a world of violence...torn between two men. Was she Ramona Castillo, the wealthy heiress...or Flora Cristobal, the bandit queen.

After a love triangle turns fatal, a self-indulgent high schooler is given the divine opportunity for a second chance at life. But when the time comes, will he choose to right his wrongs or seek revenge?

One man's mission to follow his dream is comically halted in its tracks at the request of his dear, but difficult, aged Jewish mother who is hell-bent on seeing her warring dysfunctional grown up grandchildren together one last time before she dies.

Infinity Cyber Arms created a computer virus that caused a major EMP and killed 90% of the population of New England. Vincent, John, and Tom must stop this company from destroying the world. Only one person can stop them.
Two undercover cops accidentally find themselves in the middle of a small-town bank robbery.

movie_name: A Ghost and the Boy with A Box on His Head
synopsis: Theo meets his perfect girl whom no one else can see. Denying the reality that others impose on him, he is sent to a psychiatric hospital. Here he goes through an adventure into the depths of his mind while battling schizophrenia.
Hopeless American expatriates inhabit a small Spanish village where residents are mysteriously dying after the arrival of a religious cult.
A suppressed robot uprising leaves the world devoid of electronics, while a group of renegade robots plot their revenge against the humans.

In Ancient Greece, in the time of Agamemnon, shortly before the Trojan War, events are reversed and the order of things changes. Young Electra while is in an existential quest for truth, she's being trapped in the crack of time.
Old school werewolf thriller.

After her last encounter, Ellen Ripley crash-lands on Fiorina 161, a maximum security prison. When a series of strange and deadly events occur shortly after her arrival, Ripley realizes that she has brought along an unwelcome visitor.

2 Korean brothers live together with the older's wife. The 2 each have a car accident and end up in a coma. After a year the younger wakes up but behaves like and claims to be the older brother. Is he and will the wife accept it?
Murad is from a rich fractured family. He grew up lonely and lost. He found crime as a way to vent his anger, but Rima showed up to become his way out of this deep.
5 Confederate soldiers desert, make their way through the Everglades and try to make it to Cuba.
Aqila, 9 years old, will learn to read the Qur'an in a Iqro method, which is fun, rhythmic and sung lightly. Aqila's experience inspires her mind of the greatness of Allah who created the universe.
a boy-child at his seventh birthday loses his parents , three sisters and four brothers including his twin by unknown murder , ends up adopted in another city after many years as an orphan.
To save his fiance after a catastrophic accident, an ambulance driver for a cryonics life-preservation company transplants her consciousness into another woman's body.
A young NASA JPL scientist is abducted by extraterrestrials, but when no one believes his story he becomes obsessed with finding proof, which leads him on a journey of discovery.
COLD PLASTIC TV is a new disturbing and horrifying series that explores various worlds of the strange and macabre.

Adult campground sounds like heaven But when one of the camp counselors mysteriously doesn't show up to pick up the previous kids and teenagers they are told to stay inside as adult night continues and also as the night gets worst .

Reza is a poor musician who is wandering the streets. One night he finds a baby and with all the difficulties he decides to brings him up. But when the boy's real father becomes aware that his child is alive he decides to take him back.
A private detective is hired to find a missing stripper. A simple job turns complicated when everyone he questions ends up dead.
Teenagers Jude and June spend seven minutes in a locked closet and emerge in a hostile and dangerous alternate world.
Based on the play 'Asymmetric'. A burnt-out intelligence agent is brought back to find out who is leaking state secrets, only to realize that the person he is looking for is his ex-wife.

movie_name: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress: The Battle of Unato
synopsis: The film chronicles the attempt of the team to take back Unato castle.

SMILE is a murder mystery that takes place inside the punk counterculture of the nineteen eighties. It is a crime mystery wrapped in a study of fame and arrogance in the art world, and a glimpse into the punk ethos of the early 1980's.

A couple on holiday travels around Corsica. There's some tension between them because Pierre wants Natalie to have his child. They stay at another couple's house and are joined by the disturbing appearance of a girl.

A tribute to the classic epic genre, After the murder of their father, a family of animals plans to avenge their father's death by freeing the Kingdom Trinity, which includes their kingdom from the overshadowing of an evil warlock.

In this classic film noir with a stunning feminist twist, an enigmatic "perfect blonde" manipulates an amoral young financial whiz to get revenge for herself and other victims of an FTX-style billion dollar scam.
A wealthy casino owner is murdered in her mansion at 36, China Town and the investigating detective uncovers multiple suspects, all with independent motives to commit the crime.
Henry (James Lydon) gets into another jam when he becomes the editor of the Centerville Hish School newspaper. The Fire Chief suspects him when he covers fires.
When three different animals become infected with a dangerous pathogen, a primatologist and a geneticist team up to stop them from destroying Chicago.
A young woman spends an adventurous winter with a trapper on Spitsbergen.
Six friends from one neighborhood and elementary school, leave for an MT at a cabin. The fee includes food and change of 4,000 won into a Lotto and divide it to them.

A supernatural thriller in which a hitman, facing an existential crisis, decides to exit the game and leave town with the woman he loves, but his plans are disrupted by a mysterious young man and his ruthless former boss.
Young Isabelle is left to die with her mother when she gets a gift that changes the course of her life and the lives of all of those around her.
When Guddu and Salina end up in a car accident, Salina loses her sight. Guddu soon finds out that he has a brain tumour, and decides to donate his eyes to Salina.
A concert pianist, as concert panists are wont to do, goes pearl diving in the South Seas to find a giant pearl for his girlfriend. He does, and that's when all the trouble begins.
In Britain, bodies of NATO paratroopers are being snatched during routine jumps by a mysterious red-beam of alien origin.
In a post-apocalyptic, possibly near future wilderness revolutionary leader Jim Burton and his girlfriend Star are pursued by a ruthless mercenary and the soldiers of the oppressive regime they fled.

movie_name: The Luckiest Girl in the World
synopsis: A wealthy society girl must live on $150 a month to prove to her father that she can stand being married to a poor man.

Lucrèce, the best killer in the business, accepts a final job: eliminate an opera singer who threatens the interests of a corporation. She's hired as a contralto for a festival her target is singing in, but things don't happen as planned.

Priscilla Williams, a young girl living with her widowed mother and paternal grandfather at the post he commands in northern India, becomes enamored of military life and embroiled in brewing rebellion against the crown in the early 1900's.

Dimples Appleby lives with the pick-pocket grandfather in 19th century New York City. She entertains the crowds while he works his racket. A rich lady makes it possible for the girl to go legit. "Uncle Tom's Cabin" is performed.
A different kind of sci-fi.
Baron Frankenstein, with the aid of a young doctor and his fiancée, kidnaps the mentally sick Dr. Brandt in order to perform the first brain transplant operation.
Psychologist Dr. Brennac is asked by a colleague to help with the case of Claude, a patient on trial for multiple murders. Is Claude really guilty of the crimes, or is he a victim of his own mind?

Author of erotic literature is suffering from writer's block. Beautiful women from various eras of history start appearing to the desperate man to introduce him to erotica popular in their times to help him find inspiration.
A struggling actress must play the role of a detective in order to save an adorable Maltese puppy from a murderous group of Goth Thugs, a Devilish Dominatrix, and a handsome, lying doctor.
The demands of her family and the stress of daily life drive the mind of a woman into permanent fantasy as a way to cope.
Godspeed, and welcome to Americatown.

In order to power the city, monsters have to scare children so that they scream. However, the children are toxic to the monsters, and after a child gets through, two monsters realize things may not be what they think.
A substance-abusing model believes that her wealthy boyfriend's brother molested and killer her sister.
Eva is a singer at Noah's Ark nightclub, where the guests wear animal masks. She is approached by a stranger who claims to know her and to remember her singing Mozart.

Following the lead up to one of the biggest robberies of the century, Hatton Garden The Heist watches the journey of Brian Reader, John Collins, Terry Perkins, Daniel Jones and the mysterious Basil throughout the audacious heist.

Detective Shivaji Surathkal is entrusted with the task of unraveling the many mysteries in Ranagiri and the secrets that surround them. To make matters worse, he has to do all this while already dealing with severe internal conflicts.

And suddenly, overnight, the world came to a halt. Two men, two survivors, one kid, and hatred that separates them. A place forgotten by everyone, including the creatures that inhabit the Earth... until now.
A wealthy wine grower has trouble with his wife, his children, his best friend, and his mistress across the way, who is murdered.

An entomologist and painter who moves into an old house with his family discovers the work of a mysterious scientist. He finds a cinematography archive with a completely new theory on the reasons why humans became bipedal.
A female inmate is whisked out of prison and into a police-guarded hotel until the district attorney can convince her to testify against the mob.

movie_name: Fullmetal Alchemist: The Sacred Star of Milos
synopsis: In the lost holy land of Milos, the Elrics search for the truth behind an unknown form of alchemy. What secrets are hidden in Milos? Riddles must be solved and dangers faced before the truth can be found.
During World War II, successive tugboat British Captains sent on dangerous salvage missions pass-on the key to a home-port apartment, where a lonely Swiss-Italian young war-widow lives.

(1937, Republic) Alan Baxter, Andrea Leads, Owen Davis, Astrid Allwyn. Captivating story of two brothers, one good, one bad. The good one becomes a lawyer while the bad one resorts to crime and ultimately...
When the leading lady of a low-budget musical revue sprains her ankle, the assistant stage manager is forced to understudy and perform in her place, becoming a star and finding love in the process.
A beloved superhero turns on the world he formerly protected. He must be stopped, somehow.
Bitten by a rabid bat, a late-night radio host terrorizes her co-workers as she slowly transforms into a vampire.
Two teenage boys try to help a tiny spherical alien get back to its mothership, while the army and a devious petty crook pursue the creature for its wonderful powers.
An actress who suddenly goes missing. Soon a reporter gets a call from police. He investigates her disappearance and in the process gets exposed to the dark glamorous of cinema.

Set during the Korean War, a Navy fighter pilot must come to terms with with his own ambivalence towards the war and the fear of having to bomb a set of highly defended bridges. The ending of this grim war drama is all tension.
Human gets to meet much more developed alien civilization that comes to Earth with one goal, and that is to destroy it all.

Octave Feuillet's play about an elderly Parisian rake who romances a parade of sophisticated women without falling for any of them. He meets his match when he tries to win a young girl away from her fiance, a struggling young artist.
Five tales of horror and suspense based on award-winning shorts by Jarno Lee Vinsencius.

movie_name: The Dead the Damned and the Darkness
synopsis: To reach the sea, a soldier has to fight his way through zombie hordes as well attempt to help other survivors along the way.
A woman's ex-husband teams up with her fiancé's one-time lover to come between the woman and her true destiny.
Story of a physco businessman
Seven friends reunite for a week-long reunion at a summer camp in Ontario they used to attend as children which is now threatened with being closed down.
Framed for a robbery he didn't commit, a man flees to a Caribbean island and gets involved with a woman, gun-runners and murder.

On the day that a serial killer that he helped put away is supposed to be executed, a noted forensic psychologist and college professor receives a call informing him that he has 88 minutes left to live.
The troubled adventures of a country novice who goes to the big city to work as a nanny, taking care of the rebellious young sons of a widower businessman.

A dark secret hidden surrounds a mysterious girl who is an outcast the entire village alienates and a boy who tries to get close to her who has a tragedy of his in his past. As romance blossoms so do rumours.
A failed but good-hearted inventor must make it home by Christmas before his wife and kids unknowingly fall in love with a robotic replica of himself.
A cop relies on a young car thief to take down four gangsters, who plan to rob a rich merchant for a large amount of money.
Holmes is recruited to escort the heir to a European throne safely back to his homeland after his father's assassination.
Adventure, Romance. Comedy, Songs - In a setting of an isle of enchantment.
During the Cologne carnival in Germany, Interpol inspector Tom Wilkins, master of disguise, hunts a band of jewelry thieves who haunt the cathedral square, disguised as beggars.

movie_name: La muerte cruzó el río Bravo
synopsis: Placed near the Rio Bravo (Rio Grande) a son of the richest family in small town that sees all it's inhabitants as servants. Which leads him to believe there are no consequences for his actions even rape and murder.

Lucy and the Lake Monster is the story of Lucy, an orphan girl, who believes in "Champ," the legendary sea serpent of Lake Champlain. Lucy and her grandpa, "Papa Jerry," look for Champ despite mockery and mercenary forces opposing them.
Dorka's life turns upside down when her widowed father announces his engagement. The lonely, imaginative pre-teen girl does her best to protect her father from the dangers of love.
In 1840s Missouri, young Huckleberry Finn, wanting to escape his violent drunkard father, joins Black runaway slave Jim on a quest for freedom down the Mississippi River on a raft.
Antoine Doinel works dying flowers in the courtyard outside his apartment. He is married to Christine, who is pregnant. He has an affair with a Japanese woman, jeopardising his marriage.
'VICTOR' is a crime thriller set in London with the backdrop of 2008 financial crash. The plot is based on kidnap, ransom, murder and betrayal.

When a career criminal is double-crossed he goes after his money and revenge but quickly finds himself knee deep in cannibalistic clones, flamboyant gangbangers, and absurd doses of crimson blood and gold teeth.
A young burnout couple enters the dangerous world of dream farming, a counter-economy in which the impoverished sell their dreams to the wealthy.

A group of teenagers heads for an adventure in a secluded area. Along the way they meet a group of vampires who are infesting the place. They then find ways to survive the night fighting against the vampires.

movie_name: Epic of Ra and the Temple Apophis
synopsis: We are who we choose to be.

Set on the North West Frontier of colonial India in 1905. A British Army Officer, Captain Scott is sent to rescue a five year old Indian Prince and his American governess, Catherine Wyatt from certain death at the hands of rebel tribesman.
There are dead people. Dreams of an oversized rabbit. More dead people, various murders and a detective.
On the run from the police in Athens, a man named Jason has in his possession a microfilm eagerly sought by both criminal gangs and government agencies.

Nick Hume is a mild-mannered executive with a perfect life, until one gruesome night he witnesses something that changes him forever. Transformed by grief, Hume eventually comes to the disturbing conclusion that no length is too great when protecting his family.

movie_name: At Night All Wolves Are Grey
synopsis: Private detective Varg Veum investigates a case where his good friend Evans, a highly decorated ex-army officer, is falsely accused of bombing armakon, a weapons storage facility, and to prove him innocent.
During the 1922 Turkish Civil War, two Americans and a group of foreign mercenaries offer their services to a local Turkish governor who hires them as guards for a secret transport.
In Bangkok, an assassin who turns down a job that hits too close to home finds himself targeted by the elite members of his profession.
The Danish fantasy film 'The Land of Glass' is about the young boy Jas who lives alone in a closed gardener with his father, a truck driver and often away.
Richard spends a day in lockdown hanging out on zoom with his family and friends while preparing to relaunch his musical career - and maybe also fight off an invasion of pan dimensional clones
Sequel of "In the Zone of Special Attention" about military training of Soviet paratroopers and marines.

16-year old Marie lives on a small island with her seriously ill mother and her father, who takes care of the family. But suddenly mysterious deaths happen and Marie can feel something strange happening to her body.

Woo Jin takes care of his son Ji Ho alone after his wife Soo A passed away. Before she passed away, she promised she would be back on a rainy day one year later. One year later, Soo A appears again, but she does not remember anything.
A gas station robbery and murder. A community tired of watching their city fall victim to senseless crime. An effort to put make a difference.
Children Andreika and Mariyka receive a magic seed as a gift, which should bring people joy and abundance. But the evil wizard Kara-Mor sends his subjects to destroy the wonderful plant.

movie_name: The Man Who Knew Too Much
synopsis: An ordinary British couple vacationing in Switzerland suddenly find themselves embroiled in a case of international intrigue when their daughter is kidnapped by spies plotting a political assassination.
A small town school teacher with protruding canine teeth finds that he has striking similarities with the legendary Count Dracula.
A therapist with a wounded past works with survivors of an industrial accident. Unfortunately for them, it was no accident, and someone is eliminating the witnesses.
An American agent undergoes plastic surgery to make him look Japanese so he can infiltrate Japan and help to free an American POW.
A woman's terrifying journey filled with unimaginable twists and turns that opens doors behind which lies a horrifying secret.
Video game adventurers George Stobbart and Nico Collard battle evil forces across the globe for ancient relics of power.

A decorated war hero returns to the States after the brutal murder of his wife and child back home in Rockaway, Queens, and vows revenge against the network of neighborhood criminals responsible for their deaths.
A young woman goes on a solo vacation to the English countryside following the death of her ex-husband.
A monk turned body-builder, with the gift to see into people's lives, befriends a female cop, and uses his gift to change the force of Karma and her destiny.
A knight fights to save a princess from a legendary beast.
Plot under wraps. Sequel to 2021 movie "Cruella".
A traumatized Iraq War refugee joins an Ontario-based terror cell to exact personal revenge on the West, but eventually finds herself torn about her ultimate decision.
Sonny Chiba is a master prison breaker.
Feature film based on the popular video game, Halo.

movie_name: The Return of the Pink Panther
synopsis: Inspector Jacque Clouseau (Peter Sellers) is put on the case when the Pink Panther diamond is stolen, with the Phantom's trademark glove the only clue.

Genetically-engineered Komodo dragons have become ginormous creatures hunting people on a remote tropical island. A small group of scientists must stop the dragons before they escape the island and destroy the rest of the world.
A desperate Mexican Waitress seeking to earn money for her father's life-saving operation takes a new job only to find herself on the deadly path of a savage crime family's hunt for a stolen diamond.
A woman who is kidnapped and forced to compete in elite underground fights and has to battle her way out to freedom.
A young woman is haunted by visions of a faceless man after she is awoken from the dead in a body that is not her own.
Donna's senior prom is supposed to be the best night of her life, though a sadistic killer from her past has different plans for her and her friends.
In 1980, a young mother buys a zoetrope for her 7 year old daughter to cope with the death of her husband. Unfortunately for them, the dark spirit that inhabits the toy doesn't play nice.
In 1958, young Egon Olsen tries to escape from the orphanage by being adopted by a rich couple - but his new "parents" are rocket scientists who want to shoot him into space.

In future Moscow, where corporate brands have created a disillusioned population, one man's effort to unlock the truth behind the conspiracy will lead to an epic battle with hidden forces that control the world.
Follows a young boy who runs away from home in search of his estranged mother.
Four Danish media students travel to the heart of Siberia to uncover the truth behind the mysterious disappearances in Ytchvill Valley since the '80s.
Following an unspeakable tragedy, a rogue secret agent seeks revenge against a serial killer through a demented game of cat and mouse.
Comedy about an invisible man.

An aspiring artist is commissioned to create a life-size sculpture of some perfect men, but soon finds herself spiraling down a path of unspeakable psychopathic terror and murder as she frantically tries to complete her masterpiece.

AN HEIR TO A HUGH FAMILY PROPERTY COVETED BY SOME AMERICAN IS FRAMED UP AND THROWN INTO JAIL. HE ORGANIZES A JAILBREAK AND GETS BACK AT THE PERPETRATORS OF THE CRIMES COMMITTED AGAINST HIS FAMILY MEMBERS.
Two corrupt LAPD Captains have come to a Beijing restaurant to kill a Beijing Police Captain who is failing to cooperate sufficiently with their plans but it is not as easy to get away as they think.
A warrior returning home to his country must battle giant bats, three-headed dogs and a vicious dragon to save his wife, and his people, from the machinations of an evil ruler.

A little girl asks her guardians to take her by boat to a nearby swamp believing her older brother, a sailor who recently went M.I.A. in WWII, is somehow there. She finds a grumpy old Crusoe-like hermit, instead, but there's still hope.
Séneca gets in trouble after receiving an e-mail from Heaven and becoming the fastest man in the world.
A weekend reunion becomes a confrontation with an incredible, inhuman creature as a group of young adults are forced to face the terrible sins of their past.
Futuristic view of life in Pankow, East Berlin. What if the reunion never happened? GDR has turned into a madhouse with serious economic problems.
A high school sports star's perfect life unravels when he tries to solve the mystery surrounding a classmate's death.
Two young girls turn to drug dealing as they are on the hunt for the American Dream.
Twelve-year-old Peter Hatcher almost has it all, with just one massive problem: Fudge, his 3-year-old brother. When Fudge runs away under Peter's watch, an epic family adventure across NYC ensues.
Follow the life of resilience and effort of Carlos Lavernia, as he faces political exile from Cuba, and is wrongly convicted for racial profiling.

FBI Agents Luke Murphy and Jessica Rosen must resort to creative and unethical methods to combat Noah Moretti and his criminal crew who have partnered with a major cartel to traffic young women and children.

movie_name: Will You Just Hold Me & Tell Me Everything's Gonna Be Alright?
synopsis: After missing his father's funeral, a young man, Lloyd, and his best friend, Drew, navigate through the home and people he left behind, then take a trip across the country to learn more about Lloyd's recently deceased parent.
A FBI agent going back to his home town. He have to decide if he should be true to his job or take care of his brother who is on the wrong side of the law.
A young revolutionary questions humanity and the chaos of war during socio-political upheaval in the fictional Latin American country of Caldera.
A private detective goes after the people who murdered his girlfriend.
The Doubleganger tells the story of Cillian a talented musician who craves fame he meets Agelina played by Irish actress Maria Anastacia Keogh a singer and street busker who changes his life.

movie_name: I Don't Feel at Home in This World Anymore
synopsis: When a depressed woman is burgled, she finds a new sense of purpose by tracking down the thieves alongside her obnoxious neighbour. But they soon find themselves dangerously out of their depth against a pack of degenerate criminals.
Margherita, an Italian girl, comes to America to avenge the murder of her fiancé by the mysterious Cardi.
A strict French headmaster sends his frivolous son to England to learn English. But the student has a better idea of how to spend his summer holidays.
FILMED with the exotic splendour of Mohammendan pageantry, FILMED with the fire of a great romance, FILMED with suspense that soars to breathless heights.
Chang E, the goddess of the moon, accidentally follows the Chinese spacecraft to Earth, and she needs to return to the moon.
An Interpol agent fights drug dealers in his homeland, the beautiful island of Sardinia and in America.
A modern day version of The Prodigal Son Parable
A woman finds romance when she takes a job at an aircraft plant to help make ends meet after her husband goes off to war.
LOGLINE: Bokor's Secret A young medical student discovers the elixir of life in a special plant in Haiti, but an evil sorcerer will stop at nothing to retrieve it from her.
Present day. A WWII veteran Vilen has a visitor, his Navy buddy Leonid, who was killed in action in 1941. He comes to execute Vilen as a traitor.

Three months ago, Piper met Mollie online. And Mollie changed everything. Now a knock at the door. John Sharp. Mollie's brother. He was sent to talk Piper out of the thing's she's threatening. But neither may be who they claim to be.

Movie about a stoning execution.
